entry.summary: This paper proposes a multiscale probabilistic reconstruction framework for hypersonic Couette flow using conditional diffusion models over overlapping wall-normal subdomains. It introduces a bounded binned spectral approach and soft-overlap inpainting to improve spectral fidelity in reconstructions.

entry.title: Coercivity and Local Convergence of Physical Learning in Linear Circuits

author.name: Joshua A. McGinnis, Xinbo Li, Yoichiro Mori

entry.summary: Provides the first local convergence analysis of three physical learning methods (Equilibrium Propagation, Coupled Learning, and a new Adjoint Coupled Learning) for linear circuits in the small-nudging limit. Identifies a coercivity condition guaranteeing convergence.

entry.title: Lesion-DDPM: Lesion-Enhanced 3D Diffusion for MS MRI Synthesis

author.name: Weidong Zhang, Yongchan Jung, Shafayat Mowla Anik, Furen Xiao, Vasudevan Janarthanan, Enkhzaya Chuluunbaatar, Byeong Kil Lee, Jeeho Ryoo

entry.summary: Introduces Lesion-DDPM, a 3D conditional diffusion framework for synthesizing FLAIR MRI scans in multiple sclerosis with lesion-aware anatomical mask injection and lesion-weighted reconstruction loss. Targets data scarcity for neuroimaging machine learning models.

entry.title: Stochastic trace estimation with tensor train random vectors

author.name: Zvonimir Bujanovi\'c, Daniel Kressner, Hrvoje Oli\'c

entry.summary: Studies Gaussian random tensor-train vectors as a structured alternative for stochastic trace estimation in tensor-structured settings, showing they recover dimension-independent guarantees with appropriate tensor-train rank. Includes a median-of-means variant.

entry.title: Acoustic Prompting via Stage-wise Modulation for Few-Shot Learning in Audio Language Models

author.name: Hyebin Cho, Jaehyuk Jang, Changick Kim, Joon Son Chung

entry.summary: Introduces audio-side learnable prompts (in addition to text prompts) for few-shot adaptation of audio-language models, using stage-wise modulation to capture task-specific acoustic features. Demonstrates improvements as a plug-and-play module across 11 datasets.

entry.title: Learning the Geometry of Data: A Mathematical Review of Shape Space Analysis

author.name: Gary P. T. Choi, Khanh Dao Duc, Shira Faigenbaum-Golovin, Karen Habermann, Emmanuel Hartman, Christoph von Tycowicz, Chi Zhang, Wenjun Zhao, Felix Zhou

entry.summary: A mathematical review synthesizing shape space analysis for learning the geometry of data, covering nonlinear geometric structure across biology, medicine, and computer vision. It surveys methods that traditional ML overlooks.

entry.title: AmchiBias: Measuring Stereotypical Bias in Goan Identity Groups with a Minimal Pair Dataset in English and Konkani

author.name: Michelle Barbosa, Sebastian Pad\'o, Franziska Weeber

entry.summary: AmchiBias is the first benchmark measuring socio-cultural stereotypical bias at the subnational level for Goa, with 313 minimal pairs across eight dimensions in English and Konkani. It finds near-chance results in Konkani revealing multilingual model incompetence.

entry.title: Interactor: Agentic RL oriented Iterative Creation for Ad Description Generation in Sponsored Search

author.name: Penghui Wei, Jiayu Wu, Chao Ye, Zhi Guo, Shuanglong Li, Lin Liu

entry.summary: Interactor is a multi-turn iterative creation framework optimized with agentic RL for generating informative ad descriptions in sponsored search, using multiple generative reward models in a customized environment. It incorporates world knowledge and fine-grained selling points.

entry.title: Does Traversal Order Matter? A Systematic Study of Tree Traversal Methods in Transformer Grammars

author.name: Zongru Liu, Pengyu Ji, Pengcheng Wang, Kewei Tu

entry.summary: This paper systematically studies how tree traversal order (depth-first, breadth-first, and a new production-rule traversal) affects Transformer Grammars for syntax-aware language modeling. It expands a design space previously limited to depth-first linearization.

entry.title: Disagreement-Based Cross-Model Routing for Implicit Video Question Answering

author.name: Durga Sandeep Saluru

entry.summary: This paper proposes disagreement-based cross-model routing for implicit video QA, a training-free inference procedure that triple-samples a video LLM (Gemini 3.1 Pro) and routes hard questions where self-consistency fails. It addresses correlated errors that majority voting cannot fix.

entry.title: CoMNeT: A MedNeXt-CorrDiff Framework for Volumetric Brain Tumor Segmentation

author.name: Michael L. Evans, MD Fayaz Bin Hossen, MD Shibly Sadique, Walia Farzana, Khan M. Iftekharuddin

entry.summary: CoMNeT combines a MedNeXt 3D convolutional segmentation model with corrective diffusion-based refinement and ensembling for volumetric brain tumor segmentation. It targets improved voxel-level precision for small clinically important regions like enhancing tumor and tumor core.

entry.title: Timestep Rescheduling in Diffusion Inversion

author.name: Shangquan Sun, Ting Gong, Zhirui Liu, Jiamin Wu, Runkai Zhao, Mianxin Liu, Wenqi Ren, Xiaochun Cao

entry.summary: Identifies that diffusion inversion error depends on timestep size in a parabolic manner, with larger errors at small and large timesteps, and proposes a nonuniform timestep rescheduling to improve inversion fidelity. Relevant for image reconstruction and editing tasks.

entry.title: RaLMPH: Reliability-aware Learning for Multi-Pathologist Harmonization in Whole-Slide Image Classification

author.name: Sungrae Hong, Jiwon Jeong, Soeun Cheon, Donghee Han, Sol Lee, Jisu Shin, Kyungeun Kim, Mun Yong Yi

entry.summary: RaLMPH is a multiple-instance-learning framework for whole-slide image classification that reconciles labels from multiple disagreeing pathologists via reliability-aware learning, instead of assuming a single gold label. Addresses clinically realistic inter-annotator variability.

entry.title: SpatialAvatar-0: High-Quality 4D Head Avatar with Multi-Stage Reconstruction

author.name: Yiran Wang, Zeyu Zhang, Yuanming Li, Ziming Wang, Yang Zhao

entry.summary: SpatialAvatar-0 unifies feed-forward and per-subject 3D Gaussian Splatting regimes for high-quality 4D head avatar reconstruction from few portraits, using a shared FLAME-mesh-bound representation. Targets telepresence and AR/VR digital humans.

entry.title: SiGnature: Explicit Motion Diffusion for Stylized Semantic Gesture

author.name: Adi Rosenthal, Tomer Koren, Nadav Shaked, Doron Friedman, Ariel Shamir

entry.summary: SiGnature generates stylized, semantically meaningful co-speech gestures in an explicit joint-rotation space rather than entangled latents, improving rare semantic gestures (iconic shapes, deictic pointing) while preserving speaker style. Addresses the sparsity of semantic gestures.

entry.title: Mind the Gap: Diagnosing Constraint Discovery Failures in Text-in-Image Editing

author.name: Rui Gui

entry.summary: A diagnostic study of constraint discovery failures in text-in-image editing, showing across 461 cases and four MLLMs that models recover only 46% of required secondary edits unguided versus 94% when constraints are explicit. Reveals a gap in deciding which visual dependencies matter under a task.

entry.title: BadWorld: Adversarial Attacks on World Models

author.name: Linghui Shen, Mingyue Cui, Xingyi Yang

entry.summary: BadWorld is a label-free adversarial attack framework for autoregressive visual world models, overcoming the lack of ground-truth future videos and unpredictable user controls. It uses a self-supervised velocity attack on early denoising dynamics plus an action-generalizing formulation.

entry.title: Test-Time Adaptation of Spiking Neural Networks for Intracortical Neural Decoding using Membrane Potential Alignment

author.name: Guangzhi Tang

entry.summary: Membrane Potential Alignment (MPA) is a test-time adaptation method for spiking neural networks that realigns a pretrained intracortical neural decoder to shifted recordings by matching membrane potential distributions via KL divergence. By restricting updates to low-rank weights it adapts fewer than 9% of parameters, matching state-of-the-art while being suitable for implantable hardware.

entry.title: PhysVLA: Towards Physically-Grounded VLA for Embodied Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Namai Chandra, Shriram Damodaran, Lin Wang

entry.summary: PhysVLA is a plug-and-play inference-time framework that wraps any frozen vision-language-action backbone to enforce physical principles like rigid-body dynamics and contact constraints without retraining or weight access. It bridges the physics gap where standard temporal smoothing trades trajectory quality for failures, adding less than 1ms overhead.

entry.title: Universal Manipulation Exoskeleton: Learning Compliant Whole-body Policies with Real-time Torque Feedback

author.name: Litian Liang, Jingxi Xu, Xinda Qi, Yujun Cai, Houzhu Ding, Luqi Wang, Zhixin Sun, Jyh-Herng Chow, Ming Yang, Mark Cutkosky

entry.summary: Presents the Universal Manipulation Exoskeleton (UME), a low-cost upper-limb exoskeleton providing real-time haptic torque feedback while recording whole-arm configurations and joint torques for teleoperation. It enables collection of force/torque data for learning compliant manipulation policies.

entry.title: How Matryoshka Sparse AutoEncoders Recover Feature Hierarchies That Vanilla SAEs Lose

author.name: baimamboukar

entry.summary: A walkthrough and guided replication explaining how Matryoshka Sparse Autoencoders train nested dictionaries simultaneously to organize features hierarchically, mitigating the feature-splitting and feature-absorption problems that plague vanilla SAEs at scale. It is an accessible exposition of mechanistic interpretability research.

entry.title: Can the Safety Tax Be Highly Concentrated?

author.name: ozziegooen

entry.summary: Argues that AI safety's alignment tax could be highly concentrated, applying expensive specialized safety measures only to the under-1% of actions carrying catastrophic risk, making blended overhead small even with enormous per-action multipliers. It reframes the competitiveness objection to compute-heavy safety.

entry.title: CONCORD: Asynchronous Sparse Aggregation for Device-Cloud RAG under Document Isolation

author.name: Xuedong Hu, Zhiqing Tang, Zhi Yao, Tian Wang, Weijia Jia

entry.summary: CONCORD proposes an asynchronous sparse aggregation framework for device-cloud RAG where private documents stay on-device and public knowledge is in the cloud, avoiding raw document exchange. Improves throughput under latency and bandwidth constraints.

entry.title: Your Agent Has a Genome: Sequence-Level Behavioral Analysis and Runtime Governance of LLM-Powered Autonomous Agents

author.name: Sidi Deng

entry.summary: Proposes Base Sequence Analysis, encoding LLM agent runtime behavior into symbolic sequences using a four-letter alphabet (Explore, Execute, Plan, Verify) and applying genomic-style analysis to identify risky patterns from real execution traces. Enables runtime behavioral governance.

entry.title: Overcoming the Impedance Mismatch: A Theoretical Roadmap for Fusing Foundation Models and Knowledge Graphs

author.name: Sahil Rajesh Dhayalkar

entry.summary: Formalizes the impedance mismatch between continuous foundation models and discrete knowledge graphs, arguing that RAG-style lexical bridging is superficial, and proposes a three-tiered taxonomy of neuro-symbolic integration. A theoretical roadmap for fusing the two paradigms.

entry.title: Agentic Framework for Deep Learning workload migration via In-Context Learning

author.name: Qiyue Liang, Steven Ingram, George Vanica, Andi Gavrilescu, Newfel Harrat, Hassan Sipra, Sethuraman Sankaran

entry.summary: Presents an autonomous system combining in-context learning with oracle-driven self-debugging to migrate deep learning models from PyTorch to JAX, using actual execution outputs as ground truth rather than relying on the LLM to deduce math. Automates an error-prone manual task.

entry.title: PH-KAN: Port-Hamiltonian Kolmogorov-Arnold Network

author.name: Achraf El Messaoudi (UMLP, ENSMM, FEMTO-ST), Karim Cherifi (UMLP, ENSMM, FEMTO-ST), Yann Le Gorrec (UMLP, ENSMM, FEMTO-ST), Yongxin Wu (UMLP, ENSMM, FEMTO-ST)

entry.summary: PH-KAN proposes a structure-preserving identification framework for nonlinear port-Hamiltonian systems using Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks instead of MLPs to yield more interpretable learned constitutive components. Combines physics-informed structure preservation with KAN interpretability.

entry.title: AdaMame: A Training Recipe for Adaptive Multilingual Reasoning

author.name: Dayeon Ki, Kevin Duh, Marine Carpuat

entry.summary: AdaMame is a two-stage training recipe for multilingual mathematical reasoning that adaptively aligns reasoning language to query language without sacrificing accuracy, addressing language collapse. It uses multilingual SFT followed by an adaptive RL stage to avoid mid-trace code-switching and excessive tokens.

entry.title: Post-Launch Capability Expansion of Vision-Language Models via Prompting for On-Orbit Spacecraft Inspection

author.name: Nicholas A. Welsh, Lennon J. Shikhman, Monty Nehru Attazs, Seemanthini K. Putane, Van Minh Nguyen, Ryan T. White

entry.summary: Tests whether prompt-driven vision-language models can add new spacecraft inspection capabilities post-launch via natural-language prompts without weight updates, evaluating zero-shot instance segmentation on unseen satellites. Addresses operational constraints of deployed orbital perception.

entry.title: Task-guided cross-subject latent alignment: a multi-encoder-decoder VAE

author.name: Angeliki Papathanasiou, Jascha Achterberg, Thomas E. Nichols, Rui Ponte Costa

entry.summary: Introduces MED-VAE, a multi-encoder-decoder VAE that aligns neural activity across subjects without requiring shared stimuli by anchoring to a pretrained ANN scaffold. Demonstrates superior cross-subject latent alignment on the Natural Scenes Dataset.

entry.title: LLM-Powered Virtual Population for Demand Simulation and Pricing

author.name: Chengpiao Huang, Kaizheng Wang

entry.summary: Develops an LLM-powered virtual population model representing customers as a finite mixture of personas to simulate demand and uncertainty for pricing decisions on text/image-described products. Aggregates persona-level purchase probabilities through calibrated mixture weights.

entry.title: ArtNet: A JEPA-Like Articulatory Predictive Framework for Robust Zero-Shot Phoneme Recognition

author.name: Zeqian Hu, Fuliang Weng, Shu Shang, Yaqian Zhou

entry.summary: ArtNet is a JEPA-like framework that predicts universal articulatory features from self-supervised speech representations, using a variational information bottleneck to suppress language-specific variation for zero-shot cross-lingual phoneme recognition. It improves robustness on seven unseen languages.

entry.title: Attention is Just Another Name for Coupling?: A Fast-Slow ODE Perspective on Hierarchical Pretraining

author.name: Zhengyuan Gao

entry.summary: This paper recasts self-attention as a coupling mechanism and proposes adding a slower second coupling subsystem on a downsampled sequence view, formalized via singularly perturbed ODEs. It explores whether fast-slow timescale separation complements standard attention.

entry.title: Semantic Flip: Synthetic OOD Generation for Robust Refusal in Embodied Question Answering and Spatial Localization

author.name: Dongbin Na, Chanwoo Kim, Giyun Choi, Dooyoung Hong

entry.summary: Semantic Flip synthesizes auxiliary out-of-distribution examples to teach embodied vision-language agents robust refusal, enabling them to say they do not know when visual memory cannot support a query. It targets overconfident answers in embodied QA and spatial localization.

entry.title: ActiveSAM: Image-Conditional Class Pruning for Fast and Accurate Open-Vocabulary Segmentation

author.name: Tran Dinh Tien, Zhiqiang Shen

entry.summary: ActiveSAM turns SAM 3 into a training-free active-vocabulary segmenter by estimating an image-conditioned active class set from a low-resolution preview and decoding only retained classes at full resolution. This avoids inefficient full-vocabulary decoding for open-vocabulary semantic segmentation.

entry.title: {\alpha}-Fair Insurance Pricing: A Fairness Continuum

author.name: Tianhe Zhang, Xiguang Liu, Peng Shi

entry.summary: This paper proposes alpha-fair insurance pricing as a continuum interpolating between actuarial fairness (risk differentiation) and solidarity fairness (cross-subsidization). It provides a tunable framework to navigate the tension as granular data enable finer risk differentiation.

entry.title: Unlocking Latent Dimensions: Exploring Representations of Large-Scale X-ray Scattering Data using Variational Autoencoders

author.name: Monika Choudhary, Xiaoya Chong, Runbo Jiang, Wiebke Koepp, Petrus H. Zwart, Damon English, Gregory M. Su, Eric Schaible, Chenhui Zhu, Mostafa Nassr, Noah P. Wamble, Kelvin Kam-Yun Li, Jonathan M. Chan, Jose Carlos Diaz, Cameron McKay, Lynn Katz, Benny Freeman, Guillaume Freychet, Yevgen Matviychuk, Eliot Gann, Daniel B. Allan, Benedikt Sochor, Frank Schluenzen, Stephan V. Roth, Ethan Crumlin, Dylan McReynolds, Tanny Chavez, Alexander Hexemer

entry.summary: This work trains an attention-based convolutional variational autoencoder on 1.5 million X-ray scattering images to learn low-dimensional representations capturing structural variation, supporting both offline exploration and live on-the-fly analysis. The latent space reveals organized clusters and smooth experimental trajectories.

entry.title: Diversity-Driven Offline Multi-Objective Optimization via Nested Pareto Set Learning

author.name: Yiyi Zhu, Yaolin Wen, Xiang Xia, Xin An, Hanyi Si, Xiang Shu, Yangde Fu, Liang Dou, Hong Qian

entry.summary: This paper proposes nested Pareto set learning for offline multi-objective optimization that improves diversity and mitigates the out-of-distribution bias where surrogate errors push solutions toward Pareto-front extremes. It learns the Pareto set from a fixed dataset without true objective access.

entry.title: Probabilistic Signature Inversion: Learning Conditional Distributions from Truncated Signatures

author.name: Junoh Kang, Kiseop Lee, Bohyung Han

entry.summary: Reframes truncated signature inversion as learning a conditional distribution of paths given the signature, using signature-conditioned flow matching since the truncated map is non-injective. Derives Bayes-optimal reconstruction error under linear statistics.

entry.title: David vs. Goliath in Next Activity Prediction: Argmax vs. LSTM, Transformer, and LLM

author.name: Hans Weytjens, Ingo Weber

entry.summary: Benchmarks LLMs, scratch-trained Transformers, LLM-distilled Transformers, and LSTMs against a simple counting-based argmax baseline for next-activity prediction across seven real event logs. Investigates whether model complexity actually pays off in predictive process monitoring.

entry.title: Inference-Time Decision Calibration for Temporal Classification

author.name: Arthur Chagas, Arthur Buzelin, Yan Aquino, Pedro Bento, Gisele L. Pappa, Wagner Meira Jr., Cristiano Arbex Valle

entry.summary: Proposes a representation-calibration decomposition for temporal classification, keeping a frozen classifier and adding inference-time interventions: a residual multi-scale branch and a branch-aware calibrator. Distinguishes missing temporal evidence from underused decision-level evidence across five benchmarks.

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning-Guided Retrieval with Soft Fusion for Robust Multimodal Imitation Learning under Missing Modalities

author.name: Hassan Ismkhan, Hamid Bouchahcia

entry.summary: Introduces RL4IL, a reinforcement-learning-guided imitation learning method for robotics that retrieves relevant expert demonstrations and uses soft fusion to handle missing input modalities like failed sensors or dropped instructions. Targets robustness for real-world robot deployment.

entry.title: Learning a Sampling-Free Variational DNN Plugin from Tiny Training Sets to Refine OOD Segmentation With Uncertainty Estimation

author.name: Jimut B. Pal, Suyash P. Awate

entry.summary: Introduces VarDeepPCA, a lightweight sampling-free variational DNN plugin that refines degraded out-of-distribution segmentation maps using geometric priors learned from small in-distribution datasets, with uncertainty estimation. Avoids costly retraining or target-domain data for medical imaging robustness.

entry.title: Spectral Adaptive Conformal Prediction for Structured Non-Exchangeable Data

author.name: Jeffery Opoku, David Banahene

entry.summary: Proposes spectral adaptive conformal prediction for structured non-exchangeable time-indexed data, forming weighted conformal quantiles using local spectral similarity and online miscoverage updates. Provides approximate coverage guarantees.

entry.title: Scaling Human and G2P Supervision for Robust Phonetic Transcription

author.name: Alexander Metzger, Aruna Srivastava, Ruslan Mukhamedvaleev

entry.summary: Studies how automatic phonetic transcription scales with human versus G2P supervision, identifying a quality threshold where G2P labels only help below 20-30 hours of human annotation. Shows ASR pretraining is effective beyond that threshold, achieving a 2.3x error reduction.

entry.title: Differentiable Packing of Irregular 3D Objects with Adaptive Container Estimation

author.name: Palak Gupta, Shanmuganathan Raman

entry.summary: Presents a differentiable 3D packing framework that jointly optimizes all object pose parameters and all three container dimensions in a single gradient-based loop using physics-inspired differentiable losses on meshes. Includes an adaptive squeezing mechanism that progressively tightens the container.

entry.title: Variational Deep Unfolding with Mamba-Based Nonlocal Modeling for Underwater Image Enhancement

author.name: Daniel Torres, Julia Navarro, Catalina Sbert, Joan Duran

entry.summary: This work presents a model-based deep unfolding network for underwater image enhancement integrating variational dehazing modeling with Mamba-based nonlocal layers. It provides theoretical analysis of solution existence and preserves structural detail via nonlocal gradient constraints.

entry.title: Trusted Multi-View Deep Learning Classification of Fetal Congenital Heart Disease with Feature-level and Decision-level Fusion

author.name: Tan Zhou, Shifa Yao, Suncheng Xiang, Dahong Qian, Baoying Ye

entry.summary: This study presents a trusted multi-view deep learning framework for binary classification of fetal congenital heart disease using five echocardiographic views, with feature-level and decision-level fusion plus uncertainty-based decision-making. It integrates multi-angle image data for improved diagnostic reliability.

entry.title: EmoZone-Talker: Regional Semantic Control of Audio-Driven 3DGS Talking Heads via Facial Action Units

author.name: Tingting Chen, Shaojun Wang, Huaye Zhang, Diqiong Jiang, Chenglizhao Chen

entry.summary: EmoZone-Talker enables fine-grained, interpretable facial expression control of audio-driven 3D Gaussian Splatting talking heads via facial action units, reformulating animation as spatial-temporal coordination under cross-modal conflicts. Introduces Synergy Zones for spatial disentanglement.

entry.title: PointDiffusion: Diffusion-Based Scene Completion in the Point Cloud Domain

author.name: Chidera Agbasiere, Mikhail Sannikov, Faith Ogunwoye, Erik Shaikhiev, Alex Kozinov, Ilya Mikhalchuk, Iana Zhura, Dzmitry Tsetserukou

entry.summary: PointDiffusion performs diffusion-based 3D scene completion directly in the point cloud domain for sparse LiDAR in autonomous driving, using a multi-token Gaussian VAE with cross-attention pooling and an anchor-based ICP ground-truth refinement to combat odometry drift. Also addresses multi-step inference latency.

entry.title: Multimodal LLM-Empowered Re-Ranking for Generalizable Person Re-Identification

author.name: Jiachen Li, Xiaojin Gong

entry.summary: Improves domain-generalizable person re-identification by enhancing inference-time re-ranking with multimodal LLMs, rather than only training generalizable encoders. Uses MLLM reasoning to refine ranking lists that conventional neighborhood-distance methods degrade on unseen domains.

entry.title: GRACE: Boosting Video MLLMs with Grounded Action-Centric Evidence for Viewer Sentiment Prediction

author.name: Ruoxuan Yang, Tieyuan Chen, Xiaofeng Huang, Haibing Yin, Jun Wang, Xiping Chen, Jun Yin, Xuesong Gao, Weiyao Lin

entry.summary: GRACE augments video MLLMs with grounded action-centric evidence (explicit event structure and localized visual cues) to better predict viewer sentiment in video advertisements, addressing the limits of holistic frame representations. Bridges what is shown and what is felt.

entry.title: Vision-Language Models as Zero-Annotation Oracles in Histopathology

author.name: Vishal Jain, Giorgio Buzzanca, Sarah Cechnicka, Maarten Naesens, Priyanka Koshy, Tri Nguyen, Jesper Kers, Candice Roufosse, Bernhard Kainz

entry.summary: This work recasts histopathology foreground segmentation as a natural-image perception task and uses general-purpose vision-language models as zero-annotation oracles, arguing tissue-versus-background discrimination generalizes where domain models fail. It introduces the Leica-75 benchmark covering specialized stains.

entry.title: R2RDreamer: 3D-aware Data Augmentation for Spatially-generalized 2D Manipulation Policies

author.name: Xiuwei Xu, Haowen Sun, Angyuan Ma, Yiwei Zhang, Zhenyu Wu, Xiaofeng Wang, Bingyao Yu, Zheng Zhu, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu

entry.summary: R2RDreamer is a 3D-aware real-to-real data augmentation method for spatially generalized 2D manipulation policies that jointly edits 3D observations and action trajectories from few source demonstrations. It reduces reliance on the strong 3D scene parsing and geometry completion that prior real-to-real methods require.

entry.title: Generative Predictive Distributions for Time Series

author.name: Jordi Llorens-Terrazas, Mika Meitz

entry.summary: Proposes a flexible generative framework for modeling predictive distributions of nonlinear multivariate time series using conditional GANs, enabling direct simulation-based computation of forecasts, fan charts, value at risk, and tail risks. It provides formal statistical analysis of estimation under this generative representation.

entry.title: Synthetic Counteradaptation: A Principle of Human-AI Co-evolution

author.name: Ivar Frisch, Jackie Kay, Philip Moreira Tomei

entry.summary: Introduces synthetic counteradaptation, a conceptual framework for how humans and AI co-evolve by adapting to each other's novel strategies, illustrated through Go, mixed-motive interactions, and geopolitical simulations. Authored by DeepMind-affiliated researchers.

entry.title: Integrating Reasoning and Generalization in Text-to-SQL via Self-Enhanced Fine-Tuning

author.name: Feng Lyu, Jinfeng Cen, Sijing Duan, Hao Wu, Shucheng Li, Weixu Zhang, Haolun Wu

entry.summary: CoTE-SQL improves LLM-based text-to-SQL via self-enhanced reasoning traces distilled without human annotation, structured chain-of-thought with modular decomposition, and error-aware revision from execution feedback. Aims to balance reasoning and generalization.

entry.title: Towards Next-Generation Healthcare: A Survey of Medical Embodied AI for Perception, Decision-Making, and Action

author.name: Cheng Zhang, Qing Cai, Xingzheng Wu, Xun Yang, Xiaojun Chang, Bingkun Bao, Liqiang Nie, Xinwang Liu, Yi Yang

entry.summary: A survey of medical embodied AI covering perception, decision-making, and action in clinical environments, framing intelligent agents as integrated end-to-end systems. Maps the rapidly expanding field for healthcare applications.

entry.title: SciText2Eq: Assessing LLMs for Explainable Equation Generation for Scientific Creativity

author.name: Yifan Mo, Xiao Fu, Yue Su, Qingyu Meng, Koen Hindriks, Qingzhi Liu, Jiahuan Pei

entry.summary: SciText2Eq assesses LLMs' ability to generate mathematical equations from scientific text, constructing a dataset of AI research papers paired with ground-truth equations and an evaluation protocol combining automatic metrics, LLM rubrics, and human judgments. Targets explainable equation generation for scientific creativity.

entry.title: Measuring Whether LLM Tutors Teach or Solve: A Diagnostic for Educational Impact

author.name: Junyi Yao, Zihao Zheng, Baichuan Li

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight diagnostic that measures the gap between LLM tutors' problem-solving ability and their pedagogical support, finding only partial alignment (correlation 0.421) on MathTutorBench. Highlights that stronger task-solving does not imply better teaching.

entry.title: GIST-CMTF: Goal-State Inference for Causal Minimal Tool Filtering in LLM Agents

author.name: Rahul Suresh Babu, Rohit Shukla

entry.summary: GIST-CMTF adds a goal-state inference layer atop causal minimal tool filtering to handle ambiguous user requests that could map to multiple goals, preventing wrong-goal execution in tool-augmented agents. Predicts candidate symbolic goals and estimates ambiguity before applying tool filtering.

entry.title: A Causal Model of Theory of Mind in Conflict for Artificial Intelligence

author.name: Nikolos Gurney

entry.summary: Presents a structural causal model (DAG) formalizing when theory of mind engagement is causally warranted in conflict, treating ToM as a condition-activated mechanism rather than an always-on capacity. Specifies exogenous situational/agent variables driving ToM engagement decisions.

entry.title: Phishing Email Detection Using Large Language Models

author.name: Najmul Hasan, Prashanth BusiReddyGari, Haitao Zhao, Yihao Ren, Jinsheng Xu, Shaohu Zhang

entry.summary: LLMPEA is a framework using frontier LLMs to detect phishing emails across multiple attack vectors including prompt injection, text refinement, and multilingual attacks, evaluating GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4, and Grok-3. Argues current LLMs need substantial hardening before deployment in email security.

entry.title: Agentomics: Economic Foundations for the Valuation, Attribution, and Pricing of AI Agents in Human-AI Workflows

author.name: Quanyan Zhu

entry.summary: Agentomics proposes an economic framework for valuing, attributing, and pricing AI agents within human-AI workflows, treating workflow value as a team-level quantity with complementarities and bottlenecks. It shifts agent evaluation from isolated technical metrics toward economic contribution.

entry.title: PANDA: An LLM-Enhanced Performance-Driven Analog Design Framework Bridging Design Intent and Layout Generation

author.name: Haoyi Zhang, Weijian Fan, Xiaohan Gao, Bingyang Liu, Runsheng Wang, Yibo Lin

entry.summary: PANDA is an LLM-enhanced analog circuit design framework that bridges high-level design intent to final layout by managing cross-stage dependencies across topology synthesis, sizing, and layout. It reduces turnaround from days/weeks to hours while improving performance.

entry.title: MimicIK: Real-Time Generative Inverse Kinematics from Teleoperation with FK Consistency

author.name: Jiahao Yang, Shenhao Yan, Fan Feng, Chengsi Yao, Ge Wang, Zhixin Mai, Yiming Zhao, Yatong Han

entry.summary: MimicIK is a real-time generative inverse kinematics framework that learns smooth joint-space motion priors from noisy teleoperation demonstrations using conditional flow matching with forward-kinematics consistency. It targets stable real-time robot manipulation, avoiding discontinuous branch switching of classical solvers.

entry.title: CAP: Towards PPG Universal Representation Learning with Patient-level Supervision

author.name: Chenyang He, Xinyi Shao, Shun Huang, Bosong Huang, Daoqiang Zhang, Ming Jing, Cheng Ding

entry.summary: CAP is a PPG representation learning approach that anchors signal representations to patient-level electronic health records via cross-modal contrastive alignment, moving beyond signal-only objectives. It builds a large paired PPG-EHR dataset by distilling fragmented medical records into cohesive patient-level histories.

entry.title: Let LLMs Judge Each Other: Multi-Agent Peer-Reviewed Reasoning for Medical Question Answering

author.name: Zaifu Zhan, Shuang Zhou, Rui Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-agent peer-review reasoning method where multiple LLM agents generate chain-of-thought answers then evaluate each other to select the best reasoning chain for medical QA. Tested on five models across three medical benchmarks.

entry.title: Beyond Classification: A Cough Regression Benchmark for Respiratory Acoustic Foundation Models

author.name: Mayur Sanap, Prasanna Desikan, Edgar Lobaton

entry.summary: Introduces a cough regression benchmark for respiratory acoustic foundation models, evaluating five FMs across six continuous health targets (age, BMI, disease probability) under subject-disjoint protocols. Moves beyond classification to continuous prediction.

entry.title: Domain-Guided Prompting of the Segment Anything Model for Seismic Interpretation: The Role of Attributes, Visualization, and Hybrid Prompts

author.name: Aniq Ahmad, Heather Bedle, Ahmad Mustafa

entry.summary: Introduces a principled framework for zero-shot adaptation of the Segment Anything Model to seismic interpretation using domain-guided prompting, aligning seismic attributes with appropriate visualizations and hybrid prompts to avoid costly fine-tuning. Preserves generalization while improving geological segmentation.

entry.title: PreLort: Prefix-Nested LoRA for Federated Fine-Tuning under Rank Heterogeneity

author.name: Muhammad Waseem, Nurbek Tastan, Andrej Jovanovic, Nicholas D. Lane, Nils Lukas, Karthik Nandakumar, Samuel Horvath

entry.summary: Proposes PreLort, a nested prefix-hierarchy LoRA formulation for federated fine-tuning under heterogeneous client adapter ranks, ensuring lower ranks encode task-relevant information. Improves on existing rank-heterogeneous aggregation methods.

entry.title: Phys-JEPA: Physics-Informed Latent World Models for Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting

author.name: Weizhi Nie, Weichao Liu, Honglin Guo, Yuting Su

entry.summary: Introduces Phys-JEPA, a physics-informed joint-embedding predictive architecture for multivariate time-series forecasting that decomposes latent predictive states into physical and residual components. Aims to make hidden predictive states physically structured rather than merely statistically useful.

entry.title: LUCID: Learned Undersampling-Adaptive Consistency-Guided Inference with Deterministic Flow Matching for Sparse-View CT Reconstruction

author.name: Jigang Duan, Jiayi Wang, Heran Wang, Ping Yang, Genwei Ma, Xing Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes LUCID, a sparsity-adaptive consistency-guided sparse-view CT reconstruction framework built on a flow-matching generative prior trained only on high-quality images. Adapts to varying undersampling settings while avoiding anatomically inconsistent hallucinations.

entry.title: Propagating Structural Guidance: Synthesizing Fluorescein Angiography from Fundus Images and Sparse OCT Scans

author.name: Tengfei Ma, Ruiqi Wu, Chenran Zhang, Ye Geng, Na Su, Xiangyuan Duanmu, Tao Zhou, Yi Zhou, Wen Fan

entry.summary: Proposes a framework synthesizing fundus fluorescein angiography from non-invasive color fundus photography with structural guidance from sparse OCT scans. Constructs the first tri-modally aligned retinal imaging dataset from 3,676 patient eyes.

entry.title: Is Your Trajectory Displacement Safe in Long-tail?

author.name: Qiao Sun, Weicheng Zheng, Yixin Huang, Hang Zhao

entry.summary: Reframes autonomous driving planning evaluation as additional-threat detection, asking whether a planner's displacement introduces new unsafe behavior relative to an expert reference. Proposes FluidTest with a human annotation protocol, a 32-threat taxonomy, and evidence-grounded evaluation.

entry.title: SMEPilot: Characterizing and Optimizing LLM Inference with Scalable Matrix Extensions

author.name: Feiyang Chen, Haibo Chen

entry.summary: Provides a roofline-based characterization of Arm Scalable Matrix Extension CPUs for LLM inference and presents SMEPilot, an engine that selects CPU-only, SME-only, or cooperative execution per operator. Addresses mismatched arithmetic intensities across prefill, decode, attention, and KV-cache.

entry.title: Lost at the End: Primacy Bias in Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering

author.name: Jieyuan Liu, Jianyang Gu, Shijie Chen, Jefferson Chen, Zhen Wang

entry.summary: This work probes whether the lost-in-the-middle positional bias of text LLMs transfers to multimodal retrieval-augmented VQA, finding a primacy-leaning pattern via a controlled gold-position protocol. It matters for understanding reliability of deployed KB-VQA systems.

entry.title: PATCH: Action-Chunk-Conditioned Latent Patch Innovation Monitoring for Robot Manipulation

author.name: Yanan Zhou, Ranpeng Qiu, Yincong Chen, Jiajie Cui, Weiming Zhi

entry.summary: PATCH is an action-chunk-conditioned latent patch monitor that detects deployment-time execution risk in robot manipulation by predicting an expected execution corridor and flagging local anomalies. It distinguishes task-relevant risk from benign visual variation.

entry.title: MuVAP: Multimodal Multiparty Voice Activity Projection for Turn-taking Prediction in the Wild

author.name: Haotian Qi, Gabriel Skantze

entry.summary: MuVAP extends Voice Activity Projection to multiparty turn-taking using monaural audio and a single camera, introducing Role-Relative Projection to handle combinatorial speaker complexity and a new audiovisual dataset. It targets practical human-robot interaction setups.

entry.title: Upper Bounds on the Generalization Error of Deep Learning Models via Local Robustness and Stability

author.name: Abdul-Rauf Nuhu, Parham M. Kebria, Vahid Hemmati, Mahmoud N. Mahmoud, Edward Tunstel, Abdollah Homaifar

entry.summary: This paper tightens robustness-based generalization bounds for deep learning by addressing the looseness originating from the robustness term itself under 0-1 loss, not just the uncertainty term. It aims to produce less vacuous bounds for safety-critical evaluation.

entry.title: Probing Low Frame Rate Degradation in Neural Audio Codecs

author.name: Alex Gichamba, Moise Busogi

entry.summary: This work probes the mechanisms behind quality degradation in low-frame-rate neural audio codecs, reproducing a quality cliff at 6.25 Hz and showing it stems from suboptimal training configuration rather than fundamental barriers like phonemic collisions. It clarifies how to train efficient low-rate codecs for autoregressive speech synthesis.

entry.title: The Importance of Phase in Neural Representations: An Internal Oppenheim-Lim Test of Image Classifiers

author.name: Alper Y{\i}ld{\i}r{\i}m

entry.summary: This paper tests whether trained image classifiers internally reproduce the Oppenheim-Lim phase-dominance effect by transplanting Fourier phase and magnitude across images at hidden layers and observing which prediction wins. It finds identity rides on phase in several architectures while ResNet-50 partially differs.

entry.title: Benchmarking Instance-Dependent Label Noise with Controlled Corruptions

author.name: Shadman Islam, Agustinus Kristiadi, Mostafa Milani

entry.summary: CILN is a benchmark generation framework that creates instance-dependent label noise through controlled input corruptions labeled by a diverse voter pool, making both the source and severity of ambiguity explicit. It produces 90 benchmark settings across CIFAR10, MNIST, and Adult.

entry.title: Bayesian Networks with Latent Time Embedding for Stage-Aware Causal Modeling of Alzheimer's Disease Progression

author.name: Nguyen Linh Dan Le

entry.summary: BN-LTE is a Bayesian network with latent time embedding for stage-aware causal modeling of Alzheimer's progression, estimating disease pseudotime from baseline biomarkers and constraining dependencies by biologically plausible amyloid-tau-neurodegeneration ordering. It uses posterior spline-varying structural equations.

entry.title: LiFT: Local Search via Linear Programming for Overfitting-Controlled Transformers

author.name: Abhishek Shukla, Anikeit Khanna, Ankur Sinha, Faiz Hamid

entry.summary: LiFT formulates transformer fine-tuning as a bilevel regularization problem solved via linear programming, jointly updating model parameters and regularization hyperparameters using warm-up validation gradients and training Hessian information. It constructs validation-aware descent directions to control overfitting.

entry.title: Assessing Reliability of Symbol Detection in Concept Bottleneck Models

author.name: Javier Fumanal-Idocin, Javier Andreu-Perez

entry.summary: This work studies the reliability of symbol detection in Concept Bottleneck Models by swapping independently trained detectors and heads to expose concepts prone to spurious firing. It proposes reliability-aware metrics for interpretable AI.

entry.title: HorusEye: Language as Dynamic Attention for Emergency Visual Analysis

author.name: Armel Yara

entry.summary: HorusEye benchmarks vision-language models on degraded emergency imagery (fog, smoke, thermal) using language feedback as dynamic attention for visual grounding and recovery. It finds that language feedback effectiveness is strongly model-dependent, with Gemini gaining 47 percent in thermal conditions.

entry.title: Understanding Cross-Modal Contributions in Continual Vision-Language Models: A Theoretical Perspective

author.name: Salimeh Sekeh, Mary Wisell

entry.summary: This paper offers a theoretical perspective on modality-specific contributions in continually fine-tuned vision-language models, addressing stability-plasticity tradeoffs. It analyzes cross-modal contributions across sequences of tasks/environments.

entry.title: HiRo: A Compact Four-Directional Hierarchical Reservoir Token-Mixer for Efficient Image Classification

author.name: Md Farhadul Islam, Ishan Thakkar, J. Todd Hastings

entry.summary: HiRo is a parameter-efficient image classifier integrating shifted-window partitioning with multi-directional hierarchical reservoir computing as a token mixer. It uses fixed reservoir dynamics rather than fully trainable mixers to reduce parameters and complexity.

entry.title: A Conservation Law for Equilibrium Propagation and Coupled Learning

author.name: Joshua A. McGinnis, Adam G. Kline, Yoichiro Mori

entry.summary: Shows that coupled learning and equilibrium propagation conserve a mass-like quantity in trainable parameters in the continuous-time small-nudging limit. This conservation law constrains training dynamics and makes convergence reliable for linear circuits.

entry.title: Ricci-Filtration: Boosting Retrieval-Augmented Generation Reranker to Query-Answer Tasks by Discrete Ricci Flow

author.name: Tian Qin, Wei-Min Huang

entry.summary: Proposes Ricci-Filtration, a geometry-based reranker enhancement for retrieval-augmented generation that models queries and chunks as a graph and applies discrete Ricci flow to increase cluster separation. Aims to improve query-answer relevance ranking.

entry.title: Information Gap and Feasibility-Aware Inference in Binomial Logistic Mixtures

author.name: Yuta Hayashida, Shonosuke Sugasawa

entry.summary: Studies the gap between detecting mixture structure and recovering labels in binomial logistic mixtures, proving a detectable-but-unrecoverable regime where BIC selects two components but posterior labels remain unidentifiable. Characterizes the differing local orders of evidence versus per-observation information.

entry.title: The limits of interpretability in multiple linear regression

author.name: Anand Sharma, Chen Liu, Daniele Coslovich, Misaki Ozawa

entry.summary: Examines the limits of interpretability in multiple linear regression, showing that under multicollinearity learned weights exhibit large dataset-to-dataset fluctuations and oscillatory behavior across similar features, undermining interpretation. Relevant for physical-science applications seeking mechanistic understanding.

entry.title: Creative Collision: Directorial Persona Steering and Competition in Large Language Models

author.name: Subramanyam Sahoo, Justin Shenk

entry.summary: Studies superimposing two semantically opposing activation steering vectors (constructed for Spielberg and Scorsese directorial personas) in an LLM residual stream, a regime termed Creative Collision. Interpolates between vectors with mixing and steering coefficients, evaluating across moral and stylistic axes.

entry.title: TreeGRNG: Binary Tree Gaussian Random Number Generator for Efficient Probabilistic AI Hardware

author.name: Jonas Crols, Guilherme Paim, Shirui Zhao, Marian Verhelst

entry.summary: Presents TreeGRNG, a binary-tree Gaussian random number generator for efficient probabilistic AI hardware that uses ultra-low-cost constant comparators instead of arithmetic units and lookup tables. Targets Bayesian neural network inference at the extreme edge.

entry.title: Context-Aware Markov VAE for CSI Compression in Wireless Systems

author.name: Efstathios Chatziloizos, Konstantinos Vandikas, Aneta Vulgarakis Feljan, Zheng Chen, Nikolaos Pappas

entry.summary: Proposes a context-aware k-memory Markov variational autoencoder for compressing time-varying massive MIMO channel state information with limited feedback in FDD wireless systems. Explicitly models latent temporal dynamics across snapshots, unlike memoryless or naive temporal extensions.

entry.title: A nonparametric two-sample test using a parametric integral probability metric

author.name: Yuha Park, Yongdai Kim

entry.summary: Proposes PReLU-IPM, a new nonparametric two-sample test statistic based on an integral probability metric using a single PReLU-node neural network discriminator. Establishes theoretical guarantees for the associated PReLU-TST testing procedure.

entry.title: Selection Without Signal, Recovery Through Expression: A Measurement Study of Post-Hoc Falsification Operators for Frozen Small Code Models

author.name: Mehmet Iscan

entry.summary: A measurement study evaluating 26 post-hoc operators for selecting, repairing, or verifying outputs of small frozen code models, finding none beat Best-of-N under a matched-compute protocol. It offers a rigorous negative result on improving small code models without retraining.

entry.title: Distilling Examples into Task Instructions: Enhanced In-Context Learning for Real-World B2B Conversations

author.name: Guy Rotman, Adi Kopilov, Danit Berger Zalmanson, Omri Allouche

entry.summary: Proposes distilling verbose few-shot examples into compact task instructions to improve in-context learning for classifying complex multi-party B2B sales conversations. It introduces the Call Playbook dataset with five classification tasks.

entry.title: Bridging the Usability Gap: Lessons from Interpreting Studies for Machine Interpreting Design

author.name: Claudio Fantinuoli

entry.summary: A position paper defining machine interpreting as a distinct speech-translation subfield and identifying the accuracy illusion where systems appear accurate but fail to support real interaction. It draws on interpreting studies to argue for usability-grounded evaluation.

entry.title: TMASC: Transmasculine Attitude and Speech Corpus

author.name: Sidney Wong

entry.summary: TMASC is a multimodal corpus of 196 transmasculine individuals including questionnaire responses and 66 audio recordings with vocal health items and cough, throat-clearing, and reading samples. It presents three case studies showing the corpus supports transmasculine vocal research.

entry.title: Understanding Scam Trends and Rail Paths from Reddit Self-Disclosure Narratives

author.name: Yangjun Zhang, Mirko Bottarelli, Mark Hooper, Carsten Maple

entry.summary: The authors build a dataset of 21,304 Reddit scam self-disclosure posts (2023-2025) to analyze yearly scam trends and multi-stage rail paths across identity, communication, platform, and payment dimensions. It addresses the lack of annotated longitudinal scam datasets.

entry.title: Avoiding Exponential Blow-Up in Distributive Lattice Submodular Minimization

author.name: Ishant Shanu

entry.summary: This paper proposes a framework for distributive lattice submodular minimization that avoids the exponential blow-up of transformations to boolean lattices, working directly within the distributive lattice. It targets applications in computer vision and machine learning.

entry.title: S23DR 2026: End-to-End 3D Wireframe Prediction via DETR-Style Set Prediction with Contrastive Denoising

author.name: Nitiz Khanal

entry.summary: WireframeDETR is a DETR-style set prediction approach for end-to-end 3D building wireframe reconstruction from multi-view point clouds, predicting edge coordinate pairs without intermediate vertex detection. It introduces contrastive denoising training, a multi-scale encoder, and progressive auxiliary loss weighting.

entry.title: ST-DiffEye: Diffusion-based Continuous Gaze Generation via Joint Scanpath-Trajectory Modeling

author.name: Brian Nlong Zhao, Ozgur Kara, Junho Kim, James M. Rehg

entry.summary: ST-DiffEye is a diffusion-based gaze generation model that jointly models continuous eye-tracking trajectories and discrete scanpaths, treating gaze variability as a generative property. Joint modeling of complementary scales improves gaze prediction.

entry.title: The Circumplex Degeneracy Behind the Rare-Class Limit in Affect Recognition

author.name: Van Thong Huynh, Hong Hai Nguyen, Soo-Hyung Kim

entry.summary: Argues that persistent failure on rare emotions in affect recognition is due to geometric degeneracy on Russell's circumplex rather than mere class imbalance, using a circumplex-cost optimal-transport analysis. Shows gains are not specifically geometric via careful controls.

entry.title: EdgeZSAD: Practical Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection on Edge Devices

author.name: Taewan Cho, Andrew Jaeyong Choi

entry.summary: EdgeZSAD is a compact zero-shot anomaly detection system using a TinyViT-21M backbone with an asymmetric global-local readout, achieving competitive AUROC on MVTec-AD and VisA while fitting edge hardware budgets. Targets practical industrial inspection on embedded devices.

entry.title: Attention-Based Prototype Calibration for Multi-Rater Few-Shot Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Truong Vu, Minh Khoi Ho, Yutong Xie

entry.summary: Proposes an attention-based prototype calibration framework for multi-rater few-shot medical image segmentation that models rater-specific deviations from a consensus prototype without modifying the backbone. Enables personalized segmentation compatible with existing prototype-based methods.

entry.title: PermaVid: Consistent Video Generation Across Edits via Disentangled Context Memory

author.name: Shuai Yang, Bingjie Gao, Ziwei Liu, Jiaqi Wang, Dahua Lin, Tong Wu

entry.summary: PermaVid maintains long-term consistency in video generation after editing operations using a disentangled multi-modal context memory that separates semantic appearance and geometric structure. An edit-aware update and retrieval strategy keeps stored context aligned with subsequent observations.

entry.title: PROSE: Training-Free Egocentric Scene Registration with Vision-Language Models

author.name: Zhiang Chen, Nahyuk Lee, Boyang Sun, Taein Kwon, Marc Pollefeys, Zuria Bauer, Sunghwan Hong

entry.summary: PROSE is a training-free egocentric scene registration method that uses a pretrained vision-language model for both scene understanding and cross-scan matching from RGB-only head-mounted captures. It avoids the clean point clouds and trained matchers that classical and scene-graph methods require.

entry.title: BRDFusion: Physics Meets Generation for Urban Scene Inverse Rendering

author.name: Yi-Ruei Liu, Jie-Ying Lee, Zheng-Hui Huang, Yu-Lun Liu, Chih-Hao Lin

entry.summary: BRDFusion unifies physically-based and generative models for urban scene inverse rendering from captured videos, recovering explicit consistent scene properties while using generative priors to alleviate optimization ambiguity. It enables controllable forward rendering for content creation and autonomous driving simulation.

entry.title: HairLRM: Strand-based Hair Modeling via Large Reconstruction Models

author.name: Yuefan Shen, Yican Dong, Xiufeng Huang, Zhongtian Zheng, Youyi Zheng, Kui Wu

entry.summary: HairLRM integrates the strong geometric priors of Large Reconstruction Models into strand-based hair modeling, using the LRM mesh as a structural anchor and a Dual Orientation AutoEncoder to lift coarse geometry into high-fidelity strands. It resolves global occlusion and local directionality failures that plague unconstrained 3D hair regression.

entry.title: Classifying by Proxy: Explainable and Reproducible Ensemble of Proxy Tasks for Child Sexual Abuse Imagery Classification

author.name: Clara Ernesto, Carlos Caetano, Sandra Avila, Jo\~ao Macedo, Camila Laranjeira, Leo S. F. Ribeiro

entry.summary: This work applies an explainable, reproducible ensemble of proxy tasks to child sexual abuse imagery classification, addressing the restrictive data access that makes most studies non-reproducible and the lack of explainability needed by law enforcement. It uses proxy tasks to avoid direct sensitive-data training while providing interpretable outputs.

entry.title: V2P-Manip: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Monocular Human Videos

author.name: Kaihan Chen, Yanming Shao, Haifeng Ji, Xiaokang Yang, Yao Mu

entry.summary: V2P-Manip learns dexterous manipulation policies directly from monocular human demonstration videos as a scalable supplement to costly teleoperation data. It establishes an integrated pipeline of 3D asset acquisition, trajectory estimation, and a two-stage refinement to enforce spatial alignment and physical plausibility.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Embodied Autonomous Driving: From V2X Information Exchange to Shared World Models

author.name: Senkang Hu, Zhengru Fang, Yihang Tao, Zihan Fang, Sam Tak Wu Kwong, Yuguang Fang

entry.summary: This survey examines the transition from isolated vehicle intelligence to multi-agent embodied autonomous driving through the lens of Shared World Models, predictive cross-agent representations maintained across vehicles and infrastructure. It reviews over 380 publications spanning V2X communication, collaborative perception, cooperative planning, and end-to-end cooperative driving.

entry.title: AnyGoal: Vision-Language Guided Multi-Agent Exploration for Training-Free Lifelong Navigation

author.name: MoniJesu James, Marcelino Julio Fernando, Miguel Altamirano Cabrera, Dzmitry Tsetserukou

entry.summary: AnyGoal is a training-free multi-robot navigation architecture that places a vision-language model at the core of frontier-based exploration and coordinates agents through a shared 2D Gaussian Bayesian Value Map. The map maintains per-pixel posteriors over goal relevance updated via precision-weighted fusion of VLM scores for lifelong navigation across diverse goal modalities.

entry.title: SplatlessDF: Continuous Distance Field Mapping with Non-Splatting Gaussians

author.name: Monisha Mushtary Uttsha, Lan Wu, Teresa Vidal-Calleja

entry.summary: Introduces SplatlessDF, which repurposes Gaussian primitives spatially rather than photometrically to learn continuous distance fields for robot navigation. It unifies distance-field mapping with 2D Gaussian splatting using a single primitive type.

entry.title: GAIT: Legged Robot Proprioceptive State Estimation with Attention over Inertial-Leg Tokens

author.name: Young-Rang Seo, Hajun Kim, Sangmin Kim, Dongyun Kang, Hae-Won Park

entry.summary: GAIT applies inertial-leg tokenization with attention to proprioceptive state estimation in legged robots, learning to reweight sensor measurements based on contact conditions. This contact-aware reweighting improves estimation reliability over flat-vector baselines.

entry.title: Robust Fall Recovery for Armless Bipedal-Wheeled Robots Via Force-Guided Learning

author.name: Haidong Hou, Zhangguo Yu, Tao Han, Hengbo Qi, Khaleel Ghazal, Yu Zhang, Yidong Du, Xuechao Chen, Fei Meng

entry.summary: FTSR is a force-guided teacher-student framework with stage-wise rewards that enables fall recovery for armless bipedal-wheeled robots relying solely on leg actuation. It introduces an optimizable auxiliary force correlated with robot height during simulation training.

entry.title: Whole-Body Impedance Model Predictive Control for Safe Physical Human--Robot Interaction on Floating-Base Platforms

author.name: Yongyan Cao

entry.summary: Extends fixed-base Impedance MPC to floating-base robots through a three-level architecture (centroidal MPC, priority-driven whole-body control, and a null-space receding-horizon QP) for safe physical human-robot interaction. It rejects sustained interaction forces while maintaining balance.

entry.title: Score-Based Martingale Posteriors for Deep Neural Networks

author.name: Abylay Zhumekenov, Ajay Jasra, Mohamed Maama, Raul Tempone

entry.summary: Investigates score-based martingale posteriors (SMP) for uncertainty quantification in large-scale deep neural networks, using a stochastic-gradient martingale recursion whose limiting random variable can be simulated rapidly, unlike MCMC. This expository study probes SMP's efficacy for modern ML uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: Hierarchical Modeling of ICD Codes in EHR Foundation Models

author.name: Megha Thukral, Dong Gyun Kang, Rudra Pratap Singh, Shruthi Kashinath Hiremath, Katrin H\"ansel, Thomas Pl\"otz

entry.summary: Studies incorporating the ICD-10-CM diagnostic code hierarchy as an inductive bias in EHR foundation models, via hierarchical token augmentation in transformers and graph-based hierarchy injection. Aims to improve clinical representation learning.

entry.title: Mitigating Visual Hallucinations in Multimodal Systems through Retrieval-Augmented Reliability-Aware Inference

author.name: Pratheswaran Hariharan, Haiping Xu, Donghui Yan

entry.summary: Proposes a retrieval-augmented reliability-aware inference framework to mitigate visual hallucinations in multimodal LLMs by quantifying instance-level prediction reliability and flagging incorrect visual outputs. Targets overconfident outputs under weak visual evidence.

entry.title: ROSA-RL: Uncertainty-Aware Roundabout Optimized Speed Advisory with Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Anna-Lena Schlamp, Jeremias Gerner, Klaus Bogenberger, Werner Huber, Stefanie Schmidtner

entry.summary: ROSA-RL is an uncertainty-aware reinforcement learning speed advisory for roundabout entry in mixed traffic, using a Transformer to predict conflict-zone occupancy over a five-second horizon. Enables safe and efficient entry by anticipating conflicts and available gaps under non-deterministic human behavior.

entry.title: Limited Marginal Benefit of Reasoning-Heavy LLM Deployment in ESG Narrative Scoring: A 4-Model Consensus Study on Japanese Listed Firms

author.name: Hiroyuki Kokubu

entry.summary: Empirically tests whether reasoning-heavy frontier LLMs add value for ESG narrative scoring of Japanese listed firms using a four-model consensus design, finding only marginal deviation (mean 0.38 on a 5-point scale) between reasoning-on and reasoning-off models. Concludes limited marginal benefit from costly reasoning models in this task.

entry.title: Knowledge-Based Zero-Replay Debugging of Multi-Agent LLM Traces

author.name: Dong Ho Kang, Hyeonjeong Cha, Daein Weon

entry.summary: This paper frames debugging of long multi-agent LLM execution traces as a knowledge-based decision problem, compiling traces into structured event knowledge graphs over routing, memory, and tool use. A calibrated predictor allocates a scarce counterfactual replay budget instead of exhaustively replaying all events.

entry.title: FreeSonic: Training-Free Temporal-Aware Decoupled Attention for Precise Audio Editing

author.name: Yuxuan Jiang, Mingyang Han, Yusheng Dai, Andong Wang, Tianhong Zhou, Jiaxin Ye, Dongxiao Wang, Haoxiang Shi, Boyu Li, Jun Song, Cheng Yu, Bo Zheng, Weibei Dou, Zehua Chen, Jun Zhu

entry.summary: FreeSonic is a training-free audio editing framework built on a rectified-flow TangoFlux model, using optimized inversion and joint text-audio attention maps for precise target segment extraction. A scheduled attention decoupling confines edits to target regions while preserving background acoustic context.

entry.title: AQ4SViT: An Automated Quantization Framework with Search Gating Policy for Compressing Spiking Vision Transformers

author.name: Rachmad Vidya Wicaksana Putra, Saad Iftikhar, Muhammad Shafique

entry.summary: AQ4SViT is an automated quantization framework with a search gating policy to compress Spiking Vision Transformers for resource-constrained embedded deployment, replacing slow manual quantization. Provides quick accuracy-memory trade-offs.

entry.title: LLM-Assisted Stance Detection in Scientific Discourse: A Test Case in Bayesian Cognitive Science

author.name: Eyup Engin Kucuk, Tarik Kelestemur, \"Omer Da\u{g}lar Tanrikulu

entry.summary: Uses LLMs to assist qualitative stance detection in scientific discourse, specifically classifying whether authors treat Bayesian models as realist mechanisms or instrumentalist tools, with a theory-driven codebook and multi-rater reliability analysis across three frontier models. Validates LLMs for interpretive social-science coding.

entry.title: Continuous Cross-Domain Traffic State Prediction via Memory-Augmented Graph Liquid Time-Constant Networks

author.name: Jinrong Xiang, Ming Xu

entry.summary: Proposes a memory-augmented graph liquid time-constant network for continuous cross-domain traffic state prediction, addressing coarse source-target adaptation, unseen target patterns, and irregular continuous dynamics in data-scarce regions. Combines liquid time-constant networks with graph memory.

entry.title: Long-Context Modeling via GSS-Transformer Hybrid Architecture with Learnable Mixing

author.name: Kuzey Torlak, H\"useyin Arda Arslan, An{\i}l Dervi\c{s}o\u{g}lu, Beyza Nur Deniz, Onur Boyar

entry.summary: Proposes a Parallel Hybrid Architecture that runs gated state spaces, grouped query attention, and feed-forward networks as independent parallel branches fused by a learnable mixing mechanism for long-context modeling. Aims to balance the efficiency-perplexity tradeoff between SSMs and transformers.

entry.title: RealityBridge: Bridging Editable 3D Gaussian Splatting Driving Simulations and Real-World Videos

author.name: Zhenhua Wu, Yun Pang, Mingkun Chang, Yuwei Ning, Liangzhi Wang, Yi Xiao, Guanbin Li

entry.summary: Proposes RealityBridge to close the sim-to-real gap in editable 3D Gaussian Splatting driving simulations by jointly repairing rendering artifacts, improving realism, and ensuring temporal consistency. Targets generation of long-tail hazardous scenarios for AV safety.

entry.title: Learning Interface Breakup: A Geometry-Conditioned Latent Surrogate for Spray Formation

author.name: Julius H Ramlau, Friedrich Hastedt, Tolga Birdal, Ehecatl-Antonio del R\'io Chanona, Nausheen S Basha, Omar K Matar

entry.summary: This paper introduces a geometry-conditioned latent surrogate for spray nozzle breakup that encodes adaptive-mesh cell-density as a compact proxy to predict transient two-phase flow. It enables fast design exploration where high-fidelity VOF simulations are too costly.

entry.title: DCP-Prune: Ultra-Low Token Pruning with Distribution Consistency Preservation

author.name: Xifeng Xue, Xiaokang Wang, Zirui Li, Ming-Ming Cheng, Guolei Sun

entry.summary: DCP-Prune addresses instability of vision token pruning under ultra-low budgets by introducing a distribution-consistency metric and a two-stage framework with anchor-context graph recovery and text-aware cluster selection. It reduces feature distribution shift to preserve accuracy.

entry.title: A Unified Causal-Origin Taxonomy of Distributional Shifts in Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ardianto Wibowo, Paulo E Santos, Amer Baghdadi, Matthew Stephenson, Karl Sammut, Jean-Philippe Diguet

entry.summary: This work develops a unified causal-origin taxonomy of distributional shifts in reinforcement learning, relating in-distribution/out-of-distribution generalization to non-stationarity through the agent-environment interaction. It focuses on the causal origin of shift rather than only mitigation.

entry.title: An Integrable Token Mixing Layer from the Generalized Yang Baxter Equation

author.name: Snigdha Chandan Khilar

entry.summary: The YB Mixer is a sequence token-mixing layer derived from free-fermion and generalized Yang-Baxter structures, using the Ising exchange algebra to create a norm-preserving orthogonal map and commuting transfer matrices for order-free, length-generalizable inference. It uses a spectral circulant generator to preserve these properties at longer sequences.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Framework for Audit Risk Assessment with Explicit Uncertainty and Evidence Conflict Modeling

author.name: Yuhan Wang, Manqing Wang, Yixuan Lu, Zhaoyue Peng, Shengda Lin

entry.summary: UMAR is a multi-agent audit risk assessment framework with three specialized agents producing calibrated risk scores, fused via Dempster-Shafer evidence theory that explicitly measures inter-agent conflict. Evaluated on 3,200 firm-year SEC 10-K observations predicting financial restatements.

entry.title: IBAD: Interpretable Behavioral Anomaly Detection on Human Mobility Data

author.name: Bita Azarijoo, John Krumm, Cyrus Shahabi

entry.summary: IBAD learns interpretable daily mobility templates (commuting, caregiving, nightlife, etc.) via LDA and represents individuals as distributions over template mixtures for anomaly detection on human mobility data. It characterizes activities across locations rather than specific places, with hierarchical self-supervision.

entry.title: Diffusion Offline Reinforcement Learning for Fair and Energy-Efficient UAV-Assisted Wireless Networks

author.name: Eslam Eldeeb, Hirley Alves

entry.summary: Diffusion-SAC combines conservative Q-learning with denoising diffusion probabilistic models for offline RL to optimize UAV trajectory and scheduling in energy-efficient, fair 6G wireless networks. The generative diffusion policy improves generalization in low-data or dynamic conditions where CQL alone struggles.

entry.title: An RRAM-based Hardware Implementation of a Radial Basis Function Neuron for Edge Classifiers

author.name: Georgios Papandroulidakis, Shady Agwa, Themis Prodromakis

entry.summary: This paper demonstrates an RRAM-based analogue content-addressable memory implementing a radial basis function neuron for edge classifiers, enabling metric-based classification and online adaptation. It targets resource-constrained safety-critical edge applications.

entry.title: YTClickbait21K: Human-Annotated Multimodal Dataset for YouTube Clickbait Detection Across Diverse Channels and Content Categories

author.name: Md. Minhazul Islam, Md. Tanbeer Jubaer, Amith Khandakar, Shovon Sarker, Sumaiya Rahman, Md. Masum Mia, Mohamed Arselene Ayari, Hamed Noori

entry.summary: YTClickbait21K is a human-annotated multimodal dataset of 21,238 YouTube videos across 40 channels and 29 countries with metadata and thumbnails, triple-labeled for clickbait. It enables comprehensive multimodal clickbait detection research.

entry.title: ShipNet: A Geometric Deep Learning Surrogate for Real-Time Ship Hydrodynamics

author.name: Kirsten Odendaal, George Drakoulas

entry.summary: ShipNet is a geometric deep-learning surrogate predicting hull-surface pressure and far-field wave patterns directly from hull geometry and speed using a dynamic graph convolutional backbone. It enables rapid hydrodynamic approximations at far lower cost than high-fidelity CFD.

entry.title: When Does q-error Predict Plan Regret? Three Regimes of Cardinality-Estimation Error

author.name: Madhulatha Mandarapu, Sandeep Kunkunuru

entry.summary: Provides a measurement-driven analysis of when q-error predicts query-plan regret in database cardinality estimation, identifying three error regimes. Shows a condition-number predictor outperforms q-error for small errors while large-error behavior differs.

entry.title: To forget is to preserve: Machine Unlearning for 3D medical image segmentation

author.name: Nitesh Kumar Singh, Akhilesh Singh, Arjun Arora

entry.summary: Investigates approximate machine unlearning strategies on 3D medical image segmentation using a pretrained 3D ResNet-50, evaluating retain versus forget accuracy under GDPR-style data erasure requirements. Considers four unlearning mechanics.

entry.title: Contrastive Learning for Seismic Horizon Tracking with Domain-Specific Priors

author.name: Alexandre Thouvenot, Lionel Boillot, Vincent Gripon

entry.summary: Proposes a self-supervised fusion for 3D seismic horizon tracking that uses signal-derived local horizon correspondences as domain-specific priors to train a texture-based deep model via a contrastive objective. Combines signal precision with deep robustness near faults without labeled data.

entry.title: HSQ-VLM: A Novel Spatially-Constrained Quadrant Segmentation VLM Model for Explainability in Diabetic Retinopathy

author.name: Shivum Telang

entry.summary: HSQ-VLM is a quadrant segmentation pipeline for diabetic retinopathy that uses a Landmark-Anchored Cartesian Cross-Attention mechanism to unify visual feature extraction with structured clinical reasoning. It aims for anatomically grounded explainability instead of arbitrary image partitioning.

entry.title: Learn Temporal Consistency For Robust Satellite Video Detector

author.name: Weilong Guo, Shengyang Li, Yanfeng Gu

entry.summary: This paper proposes a Temporal Consistency Learning framework for satellite video object detection of oriented, fine-grained objects, integrating temporal feature aggregation, structure encoding, and consistency learning. It leverages temporal context for complete and accurate detection across whole videos.

entry.title: City landscape in sight: A crowdsourced framework for unlocking urban-scale window view perceptions from real estate imagery

author.name: Chucai Peng, Sijie Yang, Ang Liu, Yang Xiang, Zhixiang Zhou, Filip Biljecki

entry.summary: This study presents a crowdsourced framework for large-scale urban window-view perception mapping using over 12,000 real estate window-view images from Wuhan and 27,000 pairwise human comparisons across six perceptual dimensions. A hybrid neural network predicts perceptions from a rarely explored form of urban imagery.

entry.title: Continuous Splatting meets Retinex: Continuous Gaussian Splatting and Implicit Reflectance Modeling for Low-Light Image Enhancement

author.name: Yuhan Chen, Yicui Shi, Guofa Li, Wenxuan Yu, Ying Fang, Guangrui Bai, Wenbo Chu, Keqiang Li

entry.summary: CGS-Retinex is a low-light image enhancement framework integrating continuous Gaussian splatting with Retinex theory, using a continuous Gaussian renderer to estimate global illumination plus implicit reflectance modeling. Aims to jointly handle global illumination and local detail recovery.

entry.title: HAFMat: Hybrid Priors Guided Adaptive Fusion for Single-Image Human Material Estimation

author.name: Yu Jiang, Jiahao Xia, Jiongming Qin, Jianchi Sun, Chunxia Xiao

entry.summary: HAFMat estimates physically based rendering materials from a single human image using hybrid priors (appearance, body geometry, structure, and pretrained material predictions) with adaptive fusion of heterogeneous guidance cues. Targets relighting and digital human rendering.

entry.title: SurroundNEXO: Ego-Centric Metric Bridging for Spatially Consistent Geometry in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Shuai Yuan, Runxi Tang, Yuzhou Ji, Fudong Ge, Hanshi Wang, Yifei Wang, Xianming Zeng, Jianyun Xu, Xingliang Liu, Yanfeng Wang, Zhipeng Zhang

entry.summary: SurroundNEXO is a low-overlap multi-camera metric depth framework for autonomous driving that grounds cross-view reasoning in ego-centric geometry rather than dense visual correspondences. It assigns image tokens global structure before fusion to handle the limited visual overlap of outward-facing surround-view rigs.

entry.title: DC-Motion: Decoupling Semantics and Details via Discrete-Continuous Tokens for Human Motion Generation

author.name: Hequan Wang, Jiaxu Zhang, Zhengbo Zhang, Zhigang Tu

entry.summary: DC-Motion is a factorized text-to-motion generation framework that decouples semantics and fine-grained details via discrete-continuous tokens, using a DC-VAE to split motion into discrete semantic tokens and continuous residuals. A masked autoregressive model then handles compositional reasoning while preserving physical detail lost to quantization.

entry.title: FlowMo-WM: A World Model with Object Momentum and Hidden Ambient Drift

author.name: Yitao Jiang, Luyang Zhao, Muhao Chen, Devin Balkcom

entry.summary: FlowMo-WM is an end-to-end trainable visual world model that infers object-centric motion state and a predictive long-history context for hidden ambient drift like water currents or wind, without direct flow-field supervision. It targets settings where objects continue moving under inertia and drift rather than being dominated by immediate control.

entry.title: BIM-Loc: BIM-Integrated Discrepancy-Aware LiDAR-based Indoor Localization

author.name: Yinqiang Zhang, Liang Lu, Yipeng Pan, Maolin Lei, Yuhan Xie, Zhanteng Xie, Xiaowei Luo, Jia Pan

entry.summary: BIM-Loc integrates Building Information Models from the design phase into LiDAR-based indoor localization, simultaneously estimating trajectories and detecting discrepancies between as-designed BIM and real observations. It targets feature-sparse indoor environments lacking precise prior maps.

entry.title: Safe Reinforcement Learning of Autonomous Highway Driving: A Unified Framework for Safety and Efficiency

author.name: Chufei Yan, Zhihao Cui, Yiyan Lv, Taojie Chen, Ning Bian, Yulei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes MoE-RM-SRL, a unified safe RL framework for highway driving combining safe-distance constraints, reward machines encoding traffic rules, and a sparsely gated mixture of up to 11 deep Q-networks. It aims to achieve both safety during training and efficient deployment behavior.

entry.title: Semantics-Enhanced Retrieval-Augmented Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Shiqiao Zhou, Zipeng Wu, Holger Sch\"oner, Edouard Fouch\'e, IAG Wilson, Shuo Wang

entry.summary: SERAF augments time series forecasting with dual retrieval over both series and self-generated textual descriptions to handle non-stationarity. It applies a RAG-inspired multimodal approach to improve forecast accuracy.

entry.title: Toward Vibe Medicine: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Framework for Clinical Decision Support

author.name: Qianxue Zhang, Yiming Ren, Shihuan Qin, Xiao Zhang, Liao Zhang, Jinyang Huang, Zhengliang Liu, Chenbin Liu, Hongying Feng, Jingyuan Chen, Yuzhen Ding, Weihang You, Hanqi Jiang, Yi Pan, Yifan Zhou, Junhao Chen, Lifeng Chen, Wei Liu, Tianming Liu, Zengren Zhao, Lian Zhang

entry.summary: VIBEMed is a self-evolving multi-agent clinical decision support framework with diagnostic, therapeutic, and other agents plus an architecture-level safety sandbox, designed to learn from chat session history and past failures. Targets dynamic clinical decision support.

entry.title: Agentic Retrieval and Reinforcement Learned Equation Chains: A Controlled Generation Framework for Complex and Novel Physics Word Problems

author.name: Tirthankar Mittra

entry.summary: ARVRE is a two-stage framework combining offline temporal-difference learning to build valid physics equation chains with agentic RAG to generate novel, complex, solvable physics word problems. Targets educational content generation.

entry.title: AI Pluralism and the Worlds It Misses

author.name: Rashid Mushkani

entry.summary: Argues that AI pluralism debates overlook how AI systems impose ontologies defining what counts as entities, harms, and valid evidence, introducing ontological flattening as the conversion of contested meanings into seemingly neutral technical categories. A conceptual synthesis across value pluralism and STS.

entry.title: Architectural Wisdom: A Framework for Governing Optimization in AI Systems

author.name: Edward Y. Chang

entry.summary: Argues that structural AI failures (engagement maximization, irreversible agent actions, sycophancy) stem from a wisdom problem rather than an intelligence problem, proposing architectural mechanisms to question whether objectives should be optimized. Frames wisdom architecturally as the capacity to interrogate goals.

entry.title: Model Graph Inductive Learning for Knowledge Graph Completion

author.name: Mohommad Esmaei Khani, Mahdieh Hasheminejad, Ali Taherkhani, Hossein Hajiabolhassan

entry.summary: Model Graph Inductive Learning constructs a model graph by clustering entities on relational structure similarity and applies a GNN to capture global structure for knowledge graph link prediction. Addresses the limitation of methods that only aggregate local neighborhoods.

entry.title: FactCheck: Feasibility-aware Long-term Action Anticipation with Multi-agent Collaboration

author.name: Rui Cao, Jiannong Cao, Bo Yuan, Zhiyuan Wen, Mingjin Zhang

entry.summary: FactCheck is a multi-agent collaboration framework for long-term action anticipation that adds a closed-loop Observe-Plan-Verify mechanism to check physical feasibility against the environment. It reduces hallucinated objects and affordance violations compared to open-loop predictors.

entry.title: Human genetic evidence is associated with drug approval across therapeutic areas: an observational analysis of 26,278 target-disease pairs with temporal validation and feature ablation

author.name: Victoria Paterson

entry.summary: This observational analysis of 26,278 target-disease pairs shows genetic evidence is associated with roughly 3x higher drug approval rates, with replication in post-2015 approvals and temporal validation. Feature ablation reveals literature mining drives most classifier performance.

entry.title: Running hardware-aware neural architecture search on embedded devices under 512MB of RAM

author.name: Andrea Mattia Garavagno, Edoardo Ragusa, Paolo Gastaldo, Antonio Frisoli

entry.summary: This paper proposes a hardware-aware neural architecture search that runs on embedded devices with under 512MB RAM, producing tiny CNNs for low-end microcontrollers. It achieves SOTA on the Visual Wake Word TinyML benchmark while enabling on-device, privacy-preserving search.

entry.title: PACUTE: Phonology-, Affix-, and Character-level Understanding of Tokens for Filipino

author.name: Jann Railey Montalan, David Demitri Africa, Jimson Paulo Layacan, Richell Isaiah Flores, Ivan Yuri De Leon, Lance Calvin Gamboa

entry.summary: PACUTE is a diagnostic benchmark of 4,600 tasks evaluating phonological, affix, and character-level morphological understanding of tokens in Filipino, a language with productive infixation and reduplication. It provides a hierarchical six-level framework localizing where morphological understanding breaks down.

entry.title: Controlled Dynamics Attractor Transformer
