author.name: Cheng Zhang, Minnan Luo, Zesheng Yang, Ming Li, Yong-Jin Liu, Qinghua Zheng

entry.summary: The Controlled Dynamics Attractor Transformer couples a mixture von Mises-Fisher attention energy with a Hopfield refinement energy and adds CANN-inspired excitation-inhibition modulation to make transformer inference dynamics more biologically plausible. It instantiates a topology-constrained dynamical system bridging attention, associative memory, and continuous attractor networks.

entry.title: Landmark-free Assessment of Lower-limb Alignment with Implicit Neural Shape Functions from Knee Radiographs

author.name: Zhisen Hu, Antti Kemppainen, David Johnson, Egor Panfilov, Huy Hoang Nguyen, Timothy Cootes, Claudia Lindner, Aleksei Tiulpin

entry.summary: This work proposes a landmark-free workflow for assessing lower-limb alignment from knee radiographs using Implicit Neural Shape Functions that encode anatomy into a latent space and regress alignment measurements directly. This avoids reliance on fixed anatomical landmarks and re-annotation when clinical definitions change.

entry.title: RECTOR: Masked Region-Channel-Temporal Modeling for Affective and Cognitive Representation Learning

author.name: Jinhan Liu, Mahsa Shoaran

entry.summary: RECTOR is a self-supervised framework for affective and cognitive representation learning from EEG/sEEG that jointly models region, channel, and temporal structure via block-sparse self-attention with adaptive functional partitioning. It evolves region structures from static anatomical priors to adaptive functional regions through masked topology and representation learning.

entry.title: Few-Shot Biomedical Relation Extraction with Large Language Models: A Viable Alternative to Supervised Learning?

author.name: Jakob Mraz, Toma\v{z} Curk, Bla\v{z} Zupan

entry.summary: Investigates few-shot biomedical relation extraction with LLM prompting, comparing pairwise classification versus joint generation. Reveals a precision-recall trade-off as a potential alternative to costly supervised models.

entry.title: LLM4RTL: Tool-Assisted LLM for RTL Generation

author.name: Jing Jin, Robert Chu, Ning Yan, Masood S. Mortazavi

entry.summary: LLM4RTL proposes a judge-renew-check pipeline using a hierarchy of commercial LLMs to improve a public Verilog/RTL dataset for building specialized hardware-design code generators via fine-tuning. Targets data quality for RTL generation.

entry.title: MAGE-RAG: Multigranular Adaptive Graph Evidence for Agentic Multimodal RAG in Long-Document QA

author.name: Yilong Zuo, Xunkai Li, Jing Yuan, Qiangqiang Dai, Hongchao Qin, Ronghua Li

entry.summary: Proposes MAGE-RAG, a multigranular adaptive graph framework for multimodal retrieval in long-document QA that dynamically constructs query-time evidence rather than using fixed Top-k retrieval. Aims to balance evidence coverage, noise, and inference cost across text, tables, and images.

entry.title: How to Detect and Measure the AI Dangers to Democracy

author.name: Giulia Sandri, Claudio Novelli

entry.summary: Argues that principal-agent theory can systematize and prioritize the risks AI poses to democratic processes across information ecosystems, elections, and public administration. Provides a framework to compare risks and identify where democratic control breaks down.

entry.title: Tool-IQA: Augmenting Image Quality Assessment with Simple Tools

author.name: Guanyi Qin, Junjie Zhang, Chunming He, Yibing Fu, Jie Liang, Tianhe Wu, Lei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Tool-IQA, shifting image quality assessment from static one-shot VLM scoring to a dynamic tool-augmented inspection that adjusts views and intensity to verify local details. Mimics human iterative visual inspection of quality.

entry.title: HOLO-MPPI: Multi-Scenario Motion Planning via Hierarchical Policy Optimization

author.name: Youngjae Min, Jovin D'sa, Faizan M. Tariq, David Isele, Navid Azizan, Sangjae Bae

entry.summary: HOLO-MPPI combines offline high-level policy learning with online MPPI control to enable robots to plan motions across diverse scenarios without per-scenario retuning. It addresses brittleness of end-to-end RL and the manual prior-tuning burden of sampling-based control.

entry.title: Revealing Artifacts via Noise Amplification: A Novel Perspective for AI-Generated Video Detection

author.name: Renxi Cheng, Jie Gui, Hongsong Wang

entry.summary: This paper detects AI-generated videos by amplifying noise to reveal artifacts that text-to-video models fail to reproduce in fine details and detail dynamics. It targets the underexplored problem of detecting modern text-to-video outputs.

entry.title: Binary Tracking for Spatial QA and Navigation with Open Vision-Language Models

author.name: Dongbin Na, Chanwoo Kim, Soonbin Rho, Giyun Choi, Gangbok Lee, Dooyoung Hong

entry.summary: This work addresses spatial question answering for service robots over long egocentric routes using open-source vision-language models that can run onboard, avoiding reliance on closed-source cloud models. It returns metric coordinates for downstream navigation.

entry.title: IMPACTeen: Intentions, Manipulation, Persuasion, Annotations, and Consequences in Teen Communication Dataset

author.name: Aleksander Szcz\k{e}sny, Wiktoria Mieleszczenko-Kowszewicz, Maciej Markiewicz, Beata Bajcar, Tomasz Adamczyk, Jolanta Babiak, Grzegorz Chodak, Przemys{\l}aw Kazienko

entry.summary: IMPACTeen is a dataset of 1,021 social-influence scenarios in adolescent contexts with multi-perspective annotations from teenagers, parents, psychologists, experts, and teachers. It supports research on detecting manipulation, persuasion, and social influence techniques.

entry.title: Stable Menus of Public Goods: AI-Enabled Progress

author.name: Sara Fish

entry.summary: Using an EC 2025 open problem as a testbed, this paper studies AI-for-economics-and-computation research workflows, examining whether human intuition in prompts and multi-turn interaction help, and whether an LLM can outperform a first-year PhD student. It offers practical workflow guidance for AI-assisted theory research.

entry.title: Temporal Difference Learning for Diffusion Models

author.name: Qizhen Ying, Yangchen Pan, Victor Adrian Prisacariu, Junfeng Wen

entry.summary: This work reformulates the autoresearch pattern as a stateful ReAct agent using typed persistent state, reducing token cost from quadratic to linear by avoiding context reconstruction each iteration. It is benchmarked on hyperparameter tuning and code optimization tasks.

entry.title: Brownian Kernel Ladders

author.name: Mahdi Mohammadigohari, Giuseppe Di Fatta, Giuseppe Nicosia, Panos M Pardalos

entry.summary: Introduces Brownian kernel ladders, a recursively defined hierarchy of integral reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces that encode compositional depth through Brownian-kernel integral constructions. Establishes analytical complexity functionals for these hierarchical function spaces.

entry.title: Causal-Privacy Audit Workflow for Synthetic and Distilled Data in Dropout Support

author.name: Hanghang Zheng, Xiwei Zhuang, Zhong Wang, Hong Liu, Xiao Chen, Jingwen He, Xia Li

entry.summary: CaP-Eval is a decision-facing causal-privacy audit workflow for evaluating synthetic and distilled student data in dropout-support contexts, using a fixed estimand, timing-aware adjustment, estimator set, and privacy-governance screen. It compares original, distilled, adversarial-synthetic, and statistical-synthetic data on preserving financial-status evidence.

entry.title: Multi-Modal Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Network with Mixture of Experts for Soil Organic Carbon Prediction

author.name: Daniele Mos, Felipe Drummond, Anton Bossenbroek, Soufiane el Khinifri

entry.summary: SpTGNN is a multi-modal spatio-temporal graph neural network for soil organic carbon prediction that represents measurements as heterogeneous graph nodes with spatial, spectral, and elevation edges. It uses a TerraMind encoder for spectral and temporal features.

entry.title: Deep Learning-Based Lunar Crater Terrain Relative Navigation

author.name: Batu Candan, Simone Servadio

entry.summary: This work combines a deep-learning lunar crater detector with an Extended Kalman Filter for terrain relative navigation during lunar landings. It uses Hungarian assignment and consensus outlier removal to match detected craters against a global database.

entry.title: Quantum-classical hybrid models based on error correction for time series forecasting

author.name: Jonathan H. A. de Carvalho, Filipe C. de L. Duarte, Fernando M. de Paula Neto, Paulo S. G. de Mattos Neto

entry.summary: This paper proposes the first error-correction forecasting system jointly using quantum and classical models, where quantum models extract patterns and classical models capture residual errors. It compares against classical single and hybrid baselines on time series tasks.

entry.title: MNet++: Extended 2D/3D Networks for Anisotropic Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Kirsten Odendaal, Rade Bajic

entry.summary: MNet++ reproduces and extends a hybrid 2D/3D convolutional network for anisotropic medical image segmentation within the nnU-Net framework, validating reported performance on prostate MRI and liver CT. It adds two lightweight extensions for handling variable voxel spacing.

entry.title: SDVDiag: Multimodal Causal Discovery for Online Diagnosis in Software-defined Vehicles

author.name: Matthias Wei{\ss}, Athreya Hosahalli Prakash, Falk Dettinger, Nasser Jazdi, Michael Weyrich

entry.summary: Presents SDVDiag, a multimodal causal-discovery pipeline for online root-cause diagnosis in software-defined vehicles that fuses log and metric representations into a shared embedding before graph construction. Addresses continuous operation needs unmet by offline single-modality approaches.

entry.title: Petrov-Galerkin Variational Physics-Informed Neural Network Framework for Two-Dimensional Singularly Perturbed Problems

author.name: Vijay Kumar, Gautam Singh

entry.summary: Proposes a Petrov-Galerkin variational physics-informed neural network for solving 2D singularly perturbed problems with sharp boundary layers, using neural networks for trial functions and tensor-product hat functions as test functions. Demonstrates accurate resolution of boundary layers.

entry.title: When Cognitive Graphs Meet LLMs: BDEI Cognitive Pathways for Panic Emotional Arousal Prediction

author.name: Mengzhu Liu, Long Qin, Chuan Ai, Zhengqiu Zhu, Hongru Liang, Chen Gao, Yong Li, Xin Lu, Quanjun Yin

entry.summary: Combines cognitive graphs with LLMs using appraisal emotion theory (BDEI cognitive pathways) to predict the timing of individual panic emotional arousal for emergency intervention. It explicitly models the emotional arousal process across threat dimensions.

entry.title: Islamic Large Language Models: From Knowledge Acquisition to Trustworthy and Hallucination-Resistant AI

author.name: Mohammed Amine Mouhoub

entry.summary: A survey of Islamic LLMs and trustworthy Islamic AI covering Arabic NLP, Islamic resources, Quranic QA, knowledge benchmarks, retrieval-augmented generation, and legal reasoning. It emphasizes source grounding, exact citation, dialectal variation, and representing jurisprudential disagreement.

entry.title: LLM-based Visual Code Completion for Aerospace Geometric Design

author.name: Hau Kit Yong, Robert Marsh, Edmar A. Silva, Andr\'as S\'obester, Stuart E. Middleton

entry.summary: This paper presents an LLM-based visual programming copilot for aerospace geometric design using a ReAct-variant methodology with GPT-5.4, plus a Grasshopper plugin called Wingbuilder. It targets the safety-conscious aerospace industry that has been slow to adopt LLM design tools.

entry.title: UtVAA: Ultra-tiny Vision Transformer with Affix Attention for Mobile Image Classification

author.name: Romiyal George, Sathiyamohan Nishankar, Selvarajah Thuseethan, Roshan G. Ragel

entry.summary: UtVAA is an ultra-tiny Vision Transformer for mobile image classification, featuring a novel Affix Attention block that combines depthwise-pointwise local extraction, linear self-attention, and coordinate attention. Dilated bottleneck blocks expand the receptive field under strict compute budgets.

entry.title: FlexPooling with Simple Auxiliary Classifiers in Deep Networks

author.name: Muhammad Ali (Department of Computer Vision, Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence), Omar Alsuwaidi (Department of Computer Vision, Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence), Salman Khan (Department of Computer Vision, Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence)

entry.summary: FlexPooling introduces a learnable pooling operation with simple auxiliary classifiers in deep networks to better preserve prominent information during downsampling. It aims to improve network discriminability over standard lossy pooling.

entry.title: Comparing Human Gaze and Vision-Language Model Attention in Safety-Relevant Environments

author.name: Marta Vallejo, Siwen Wang

entry.summary: This study compares human gaze (from eye-tracking of 10 participants on 33 scene images) with GPT-4o's predicted visual attention in safety-relevant environments. It investigates whether large vision-language models attend to the same risk-relevant regions as humans.

entry.title: DenseControl: Instance-Level Controllable Synthesis of Dense Crowd Image

author.name: Juncheng Wang, Lei Shang, Wang Lu, Baigui Sun, Shujun Wang

entry.summary: DenseControl is a pipeline for generating dense crowd images with instance-level control over each person's position and scale, using an Isolated Object Embedding map for spatial control and topological integrity. Enables controllable crowd synthesis with background and style options.

entry.title: XPASS-Vis: A Dataset for Cross-Domain Personalized Image Aesthetic Assessment

author.name: Takato Hayashi, Hiroaki Takahara, Candy Olivia Mawalim, Hiromi Narimatsu, Akisato Kimura, Shiro Kumano, Shogo Okada

entry.summary: XPASS-Vis is the first dataset for cross-domain personalized image aesthetic assessment, spanning art, fashion, and photography with sufficient per-annotator samples to study how aesthetic preferences generalize across domains. Fills a gap in cross-domain PIAA research.

entry.title: CPS4: Class Prompt driven Semi-Supervised Spine Segmentation with Class-specific Consistency Constraint

author.name: Qingtao Pan, Hongzan Sun, Bing Ji, Shuo Li

entry.summary: CPS4 is a text-guided semi-supervised spine segmentation network using class prompts and class-specific consistency constraints to improve VLM-generated pseudo-labels in multi-class segmentation. Claims to be the first to apply VLM class prompts in this setting.

entry.title: A Text Recognition Dataset from Sahidic Coptic Ancient Manuscripts

author.name: Fabio Quattrini, Carmine Zaccagnino, Costanza Bianchi, Silvia Cascianelli, Rita Cucchiara

entry.summary: SCAM is a new line-level handwritten text recognition dataset built from digitized Sahidic Coptic ancient manuscripts, capturing heterogeneous acquisition conditions and degradations in an extinct, low-resource language. Targets HTR in challenging low-resource historical settings.

entry.title: SceneCraft: Interactive System for Image Editing via Scene Graph

author.name: Duc-Manh Phan, Ngoc-Dai Tran, Duy-Khang Do, Tam V. Nguyen, Minh-Triet Tran, Trung-Nghia Le

entry.summary: SceneCraft is an interactive image editing system that represents images as editable scene graphs, letting users perform spatial and relational edits by manipulating the graph, which is then translated into precise editing prompts. Reduces reliance on trial-and-error text prompts.

entry.title: AURA: Active-Response Attribution under Treatment Ambiguity in Bacterial Cytological Profiling

author.name: Kartik Jhawar, Mrunmayee Deshpande, Wilfried Moreira, Guillermo C. Bazan, Lipo Wang

entry.summary: AURA addresses recovering which antibiotics were biologically active (not merely applied) from E. coli microscopy images, showing the applied combination matches the active set only about 37% of the time. It proposes an attribution method better suited than forward perturbation models or discriminative classifiers for this inverse problem.

entry.title: Local-GS: Accelerating 3D Gaussian Splatting via Tile-Local Warp Coherence

author.name: Yang Luo, Yan Gong, Yongsheng Gao, Jie Zhao, Xinyu Zhang, Huaping Liu

entry.summary: Local-GS accelerates 3D Gaussian Splatting rendering by reorganizing Gaussians along SIMT warp boundaries rather than scene geometry, reducing warp divergence and redundant computation. It introduces hoisting, culling, and warp-coherent blending stages for better GPU utilization.

entry.title: From Static Inference to Dynamic Interaction: A Survey of Streaming Large Language Models

author.name: Junlong Tong, Zilong Wang, YuJie Ren, Peiran Yin, Hao Wu, Wei Zhang, Xiaoyu Shen

entry.summary: This survey provides a unified definition and systematic taxonomy of streaming large language models, disentangling streaming generation, streaming inputs, and interactive streaming architectures. It addresses the fragmented terminology limiting LLM applicability in dynamic real-time scenarios.

entry.title: Learning New Tasks via Reusable Skills: Skill-Compositional Experts for Embodied Continual Learning

author.name: Shuaike Zhang, Shaokun Wang, Haoyu Tang, Jianlong Wu, Liqiang Nie

entry.summary: SCE (Skill-Compositional Experts) is a framework for embodied continual learning that explicitly organizes reusable skills for coherent task execution, addressing severe catastrophic forgetting from feature drift under closed-loop control. It targets structured skill reuse across continually evolving manipulation tasks.

entry.title: Guided Diffusion with Distilled Vision-Language Reliability for Aerial Navigation

author.name: Ivan Valuev, Iana Zhura, Valerii Serpiva, Didar Seyidov, Dzmitry Tsetserukou

entry.summary: This work presents a reliability-aware diffusion planner for 3D UAV navigation that conditions trajectory generation on observations together with a scene-level reliability heatmap marking where perception is degraded. It addresses end-to-end generative planners' failure to recognize unreliable observations like glass, mirrors, and overexposed surfaces.

entry.title: Selective Agentic Recovery for UAV Autonomy with a Persistent Mission Runtime

author.name: Taewoo Park, Kyeonghyun Yoo, Seunghyun Yoo, Hwangnam Kim

entry.summary: Persistent Mission Runtime (PMR) keeps UAV mission loops and safety-critical execution local while invoking an external agentic LLM reasoner only selectively for recovery when execution stalls. This balances agentic reasoning benefits against latency and reliability costs.

entry.title: ORCA: A Platform for Open-Source Dexterity Research

author.name: Francesco Capuano, Maximilian Eberlein, Fabrice Bourquin, Clemens Claudio Christoph

entry.summary: ORCA is an open-source learning stack for anthropomorphic dexterous hands, unifying scattered control, simulation, teleoperation, and retargeting software and connecting it to the robot-learning ecosystem. It aims to make dexterous hands more accessible for research.

entry.title: Event Generation with Parallel Langevin Sampling and Learned Stein Diagnostics

author.name: Rob Verheyen

entry.summary: Studies event generation for collider physics using many parallel underdamped Langevin chains with a learned Stein discrepancy as a convergence diagnostic, producing unweighted events while avoiding autocorrelation. It offers an alternative to expensive rejection sampling for high-multiplicity final states.

entry.title: QoS-Aware Token Scheduling and Private Data Valuation for Multi-Modal Agentic Networks

author.name: Yao Du, Jing Liu, Pengfei Xu, Zehua Wang, Victor C. M. Leung, Cyril Leung, Victoria Lemieux

entry.summary: Studies fair token allocation and differentially private data valuation for decentralized multi-modal agentic networks, embedding modalities in a shared semantic space and releasing DP prototypes to reduce semantic leakage. Targets data sovereignty and QoS.

entry.title: Phase-Aware Guidance Injection for Recurrent MAPPO in Assembly-Line Disruption Recovery

author.name: Xin Huang, Yongcai Wang, Fengyi Zhang, Zhikun Tao, Yunjun Han, Naiqi Wu

entry.summary: Proposes a phase-aware guidance injection framework that augments a trained recurrent MAPPO scheduling policy with logit-level action bias during evaluation, unifying rule-based, replay-based, and LLM-based guidance for assembly-line disruption recovery. Activates intervention only during abnormal phases to reduce recovery time and preserve delivery.

entry.title: From Affect Prediction to Affect Forecasting: Evidence for Distinct Information Sources in Longitudinal Text

author.name: Sadia Noor, Seemab Latif, Raja Khurram Shahzad, Mehwish Fatima

entry.summary: Investigates whether affect prediction and affect forecasting rely on distinct information sources in longitudinal text, proposing trait-state prediction frameworks and a hybrid change forecaster. Provides evidence that current affect estimation and future affective change forecasting are distinct tasks.

entry.title: Consensus-based Agentic Large Language Model Framework for Harmonized Tariff Schedule Code Classification

author.name: Truong Thanh Hung Nguyen, Khanh Van Quynh Nguyen, Hoang-Loc Cao, Tri Duong, Phuc Ho, Van Pham, Loc Nguyen, Hung Cao

entry.summary: Proposes a consensus-based multi-agent LLM framework for Canadian 10-digit Harmonized Tariff Schedule code classification, integrating multi-agent retrieval, semantic search over tariff documents, evidence-grounded reasoning, and consensus validation. Targets challenging hierarchical, ambiguous classification for maritime logistics.

entry.title: RAMS: Resource-Adaptive and Detection-Conditioned Model Switching for Embedded Edge Perception

author.name: Kushal Khemani, Evan Leri, George Xu, Amit Hod

entry.summary: RAMS is a lightweight runtime controller for embedded edge object detection that monitors device pressure and dynamically switches among three resident YOLOv8 tiers without reload latency, with detection-conditioned policies protecting against downgrades after vulnerable-road-user detections. Introduces an annotation-free offline policy comparison metric.

entry.title: Spectro-Temporal Interference Confounds Phase Encoding in Spatial Audio Foundation Models

author.name: Yuxuan Chen, Haoyuan Yu, Peize He

entry.summary: This paper introduces a psychoacoustic benchmark based on binaural masking level difference to probe whether spatial audio foundation models truly encode microsecond interaural phase fine structure. It finds dedicated binaural SSL models capture phase information while general-purpose models do not, and identifies spectro-temporal interference confounds.

entry.title: Enabling Real-Time Point-of-Care Ultrasound Segmentation: A GPU-Free Deployment in Resource-Limited Settings

author.name: Weihao Gao

entry.summary: This work adapts the ultra-lightweight UltraSeg architecture for GPU-free, real-time point-of-care ultrasound segmentation across ten datasets and six anatomical sites. It addresses the paradox that AI inference cost exceeds the imaging device cost in resource-limited settings.

entry.title: Imperfect Visual Verification for Code Edition : A Case Study on TikZ

author.name: Charly Reux (UR, INSA Rennes, DiverSe), Mathieu Acher (CNRS, IUF, IRISA, UR, DiverSe), Djamel Eddine Khelladi (DiverSe, UR, CNRS, IRISA), Cl\'ement Quinton (SPIRALS, CNRS), Olivier Barais (UR, IRISA, DiverSe)

entry.summary: Case study on TikZ visual code customization showing that iterative refinement with imperfect visual verifiers can still guide localized, semantics-preserving edits to programs producing visual artifacts. Examines verification feedback for visual code editing.

entry.title: Koshur Diacritizer: A Byte-Level Sequence-to-Sequence Model for Kashmiri Diacritic Restoration

author.name: Haq Nawaz Malik, Nahfid Nissar, Faizan Iqbal

entry.summary: Koshur Diacritizer is a ByT5-small byte-level sequence-to-sequence model for restoring diacritics in low-resource Kashmiri text, accompanied by a public dataset of 23.7k aligned undiacritized/diacritized sentence pairs and script-aware normalization. Achieves DERm 0.20 and WER 0.22 on held-out data.

entry.title: ControlMap: Controllable High-Definition Map Generation for Traffic Scenario Simulation

author.name: Marwan Farag, Steffen W\"aldele, Yu Yao

entry.summary: Presents ControlMap, a latent diffusion plus ControlNet pipeline for controllable high-definition map generation to expand autonomous driving simulation scenario diversity. Claims to be first to inject spatial guidance into a diffusion model for HD map synthesis.

entry.title: ALCL: An Adaptive Log-Correntropy Loss for Robust Learning under Non-Gaussian Noise

author.name: Mainak Kundu, Ria Kanjilal, Ismail Uysal

entry.summary: Proposes ALCL, an adaptive log-correntropy loss that learns its robustness geometry during training to handle heavy-tailed and impulsive non-Gaussian noise. Replaces fixed kernel parameters with jointly-learned shape and scale parameters via differentiable reparameterization.

entry.title: XAI-Grounded Explanation Generation for Speech Deepfake Detection with Training-Free Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Yupei Li, Qiyang Sun, Xiaoliang Wu, Chenxi Wang, Berrak Sisman, Bj\"orn W. Schuller

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free framework that integrates XAI attribution evidence with multimodal LLMs to generate grounded natural-language explanations for speech deepfake detection. Bridges low-level attribution signals and human-understandable explanations without task-specific supervision.

entry.title: AI Supply Chain Galaxy: 3D Visual Analytics for License Compliance

author.name: Weiru Han, Xuetao Shi, Wenyi He, Wei Wang, Rui Zhao, Moming Duan

entry.summary: Presents AI Supply Chain Galaxy, an interactive 3D visual analytics system mapping model provenance and license compliance across multi-hop dependency networks. Demonstrated through ecosystem-scale analysis of over 900,000 Hugging Face models.

entry.title: Input-Dependent Fisher Information for Local Sensitivity Analysis of Medical Image Classifiers

author.name: Sourya Sengupta. Mark A. Anastasio

entry.summary: Introduces a local sensitivity analysis framework based on the input-dependent Fisher Information Matrix to characterize how a medical image classifier's predictive distribution changes under input perturbations. Uses a Gram-matrix formulation to recover the eigenspectrum without forming the full Fisher matrix.

entry.title: Unified Multimodal Model for Brain MRI Imputation and Understanding

author.name: Zhiyun Song, Che Liu, Tian Xia, Avinash Kori, Wenjia Bai

entry.summary: UniBrain is a unified multimodal model for brain MRI that jointly performs missing-modality imputation and image understanding via interleaved description-enriched training. It targets real-world clinical settings where data modalities are often incomplete.

entry.title: P3B3: A Multi-Turn Conversational Benchmark for Measuring European and Brazilian Portuguese Variety Bias in LLMs

author.name: Rafael Ferreira, In\^es Vieira, In\^es Calvo, James Furtado, Iago Paulo, Diogo Tavares, Diogo Gl\'oria-Silva, David Semedo, Jo\~ao Magalh\~aes

entry.summary: P3B3 is an expert-curated multi-turn benchmark for measuring European versus Brazilian Portuguese variety bias in LLMs, with an evaluation framework for bias and controllability. Experiments reveal strong pt-BR bias across most models.

entry.title: CrossMaps: Confidence-Aware Open-Vocabulary Semantic Mapping for Rover Navigation

author.name: Jan-Niklas Klein, Sona Ghahremani, Christian Medeiros Adriano, Holger Giese

entry.summary: CrossMaps is a real-time confidence-aware open-vocabulary semantic mapping pipeline for rovers that builds language-queryable maps from RGB-D data using multi-scale CLIP embeddings and a dual short/long-term memory architecture. It couples perception quality with navigation under partial observability.

entry.title: AI for Social Good: An Investigation of the Causal Relationship Between Environmental Regulations and Their Effects on Air Pollution in London, UK

author.name: Yang Han, Jacqueline CK Lam, Victor OK Li, Yiu-Wai Man

entry.summary: Develops an uncertainty-aware Bayesian deep learning framework using a Bayesian LSTM to causally estimate the effect of 32 air-pollution regulations on PM2.5 in London from 2010-2020. It integrates meteorological, socioeconomic, and temporal covariates to disentangle policy effects.

entry.title: AME: A Multi-Type Contributor Attribution Framework in Generative AI Markets

author.name: Yang Shi, Songwen Pei, Yang Gao, Bingxue Zhang

entry.summary: AME (Attribution-Mapping-Execution) is a framework for fairly allocating value across heterogeneous contributors in generative AI markets, including training data, base models, fine-tuning behaviors, and prompts. It integrates contribution valuation, data-rights mapping, and trustworthy execution into a unified workflow.

entry.title: Beyond Defensive Reporting: Machine Learning for Active Anti-Money Laundering Control in Insurance

author.name: Dara Goldar, Geir Kjetil Ferkingstad Sandve, Martin Jullum

entry.summary: This applied study uses gradient-boosted trees on production data from a Norwegian insurer to flag suspicious claims for money laundering before payout, shifting from passive reporting to active prevention. It also tests fraud labels as an auxiliary training signal.

entry.title: Machine Learning-Driven Chemical Reactor Network Modeling of the Sandia-D Flame

author.name: Nicolas J. Tricard, Benjamin C. Koenig, Sili Deng

entry.summary: This work develops an automated ML-assisted framework for constructing equivalent reactor networks to model the Sandia-D turbulent flame, reducing reliance on expert analysis. It aims to retain detailed chemistry while simplifying flow physics for efficiency.

entry.title: KATANA: A Fast, Low-Power Mapping of Kalman Filters onto Edge NPUs for Real-Time Tracking

author.name: Bodhisatwa Kundu, Anish Rooj, Sumit Saha, Abhradeep Sarkar, Arghadip Das, Arnab Raha, Mrinal K. Naskar

entry.summary: KATANA maps Kalman filters (LKF and EKF) onto edge NPUs for fast, low-power real-time multi-object tracking, moving them off serialized CPU execution. It targets strict latency and power constraints in defense and autonomous systems.

entry.title: STAR-NT: Spatiotemporal Acceleration of Real-Time Neural Transparency Rendering

author.name: Grigoris Tsopouridis, Christos Georgiou-Mousses, Aris Panagiotidis, Andreas Vasilakis, David Corrigan, Tobias A. Franke, Aleksei Gorbonosov, Andrei Astapov, Ioannis Fudos

entry.summary: Presents STAR-NT, a spatiotemporal acceleration framework for real-time neural order-independent transparency rendering that exploits adaptive quadtree screen-space subdivision and depth-based temporal reprojection to reduce geometry-pass and network-input costs. Targets mobile and legacy hardware while preserving visual quality.

entry.title: Data-Driven Decoding of Russell's Circumplex Model of Affect

author.name: Amdjed Belaref, Samir Sadok, Zineb Noumir, Renaud Seguier

entry.summary: The study investigates whether Transformer embeddings (RoBERTa, wav2vec2.0) recover the geometry of Russell's valence-arousal circumplex model of emotion. It tests whether latent spaces encode human-like affective topology across text and speech.

entry.title: Deep Learning in Seismic Interpretation: Federated Advances in Salt Dome Segmentation

author.name: Muhammad Zain Mehdi, Muhammad Zaid, Owais Aleem

entry.summary: FedSaltNet is a federated learning framework for privacy-preserving salt-dome segmentation in seismic interpretation, coupling a lightweight Small U-Net with a foreground-weighted aggregation strategy. It addresses data sovereignty and labeled-data scarcity in hydrocarbon exploration.

entry.title: Multi-view feature High-order Fusion for Space Weak Object Detection and Segmentation

author.name: Weilong Guo, Yuhan Sun, Shengyang Li

entry.summary: This work develops simple multi-view attentions and a multi-view feature high-order fusion method (MHF) for detecting and segmenting weak objects in space imagery. It extends low-order fusion to higher orders with recursive gated selection of multi-view features.

entry.title: Fusion-E2Pulse: A Multimodal Event-RGB Fusion Network for Non-contact Pulse Wave Reconstruction

author.name: Qian Feng, Hao Guo, Yan Niu, Zhenhuan Xu, Yidi Li

entry.summary: Fusion-E2Pulse fuses RGB and neuromorphic event camera data for non-contact pulse wave reconstruction, leveraging frame integration and event differential sensing to recover fine waveform features like the dicrotic notch. Targets remote physiological monitoring.

entry.title: Text region detection in historical astronomical diagrams

author.name: Zeynep Sonat Baltac{\i}, Rapha\"el Baena, Fei Meng, Somk\'eo Norindr, Florence Somer, Matthieu Husson, Mathieu Aubry

entry.summary: Introduces a large open-access dataset of 948 historical astronomical diagrams with ~11k oriented polygonal text regions spanning ten centuries and seven linguistic traditions, for text detection in mathematical diagrams. Fills a gap in document text detection for diagrams.

entry.title: Dehaze-GaussianImage: Zero-Shot Dehazing via Efficient 2D Gaussian Splatting Representation

author.name: Yuhan Chen, Wenxuan Yu, Guofa Li, Kunyang Huang, Ying Fang, Yicui Shi, Wenbo Chu, Keqiang Li

entry.summary: Dehaze-GaussianImage is a zero-shot single-image dehazing framework that introduces 2D Gaussian Splatting to model hazy images as continuous anisotropic Gaussian fields with reconstruction-decoupling. Aims to improve efficiency and physical interpretability over CNN/Transformer approaches.

entry.title: Fi-Gaussian: Frequency-Aware Implicit Gaussian Splatting for Single Image Dehazing

author.name: Yuhan Chen, Ying Fang, Guofa Li, Wenxuan Yu, Yicui Shi, Kunyang Huang, Wenbo Chu, Keqiang Li

entry.summary: Fi-Gaussian is a frequency-aware implicit Gaussian splatting network for single image dehazing that decouples low-frequency structure and high-frequency texture in the frequency domain with adaptive Gaussian aggregation. Models clear-image distributions as a continuous 2D representation.

entry.title: ResEdit: Residual embeddings for precise generative image editing

author.name: Ahmet Canberk Baykal, Valentin Deschaintre, Yannick Hold-Geoffroy, Michael Fischer, Anna Fr\"uhst\"uck, Cengiz \"Oztireli, Iliyan Georgiev

entry.summary: ResEdit improves diffusion-based image editing by adding an optimized residual image encoding as additional conditioning, reducing reliance on inversion and improving identity preservation and editability. It avoids large-scale paired fine-tuning data.

entry.title: Text-Vision Co-Instructed Image Editing

author.name: Chenxi Xie, Yuhui Wu, Qiaosi Yi, Lei Zhang

entry.summary: Text-Vision Co-Instructed Image Editing jointly models textual instructions as semantic intent and sparse visual prompts (drag, point) as spatial guidance to achieve precise, intent-faithful editing. It unifies the complementary strengths of language expressiveness and visual spatial precision.

entry.title: DragMesh-2: Physically Plausible Dexterous Hand-Object Interaction with Articulated Objects

author.name: Tianshan Zhang, Yijia Duan, Yanjun Li, Zeyu Zhang, Hao Tang

entry.summary: DragMesh-2 enables physically plausible dexterous hand-object interaction with articulated objects, where target parts cannot be directly actuated and must move through sustained hand-handle contact. It bridges object-centric articulated generation to hand-driven manipulation by modeling the required contact dynamics.

entry.title: Learning Dynamic Swing-Up of an Inverted Pendulum using Remote Magnetic Actuation

author.name: Viacheslav Sydora, Jasan Zughaibi, Denis von Arx, Quentin Boehler, Michael Muehlebach

entry.summary: This work demonstrates the first dynamic swing-up of a magnetically actuated inverted pendulum using a clinically-ready electromagnetic navigation system, going beyond quasi-static control toward dynamic trajectory tracking far from equilibrium. The torque- and force-based control objectives make the method applicable to magnetically actuated devices like catheters and guidewires.

entry.title: An Attention-based Model for Robust Forecasting with Missing Modality

author.name: Zhitian Zhang, Wenjie Zi, Yunduz Rakhmangulova, Saghar Irandoust, Hossein Hajimirsadeghi, Thibaut Durand

entry.summary: Proposes an attention-based conditional variational autoencoder for multimodal robot forecasting that gracefully handles missing sensor modalities during both training and inference. This addresses a practical gap since real-world robotic systems frequently operate with incomplete sensor data.

entry.title: AERMANI-PLACE: Language Guided Object Placement with Aerial Manipulators

author.name: Sarthak Mishra, Ritama Sanyal, Rishabh Dev Yadav, Wei Pan, Spandan Roy

entry.summary: AERMANI-PLACE enables language-guided object placement with aerial manipulators by using an image-editing model to generate a visual marker indicating the target location, avoiding the need for explicit metric coordinates. It makes aerial manipulation interfaces more intuitive.

entry.title: Spectral Sparsification of Laplacian-Constrained Gaussian and H\"usler-Reiss Graphical Models

author.name: Ignacio Echave-Sustaeta Rodr\'iguez, Aida Abiad, Frank R\"ottger

entry.summary: Studies spectral sparsification of Laplacian-constrained Gaussian and Hüsler-Reiss graphical models, leveraging graph Laplacian structure for these two related probabilistic model families used in signal processing and extremal dependence modeling. It connects spectral graph theory to graphical model estimation.

entry.title: Do k-Sparse Autoencoders Reveal Thinking Patterns? Interpretable Features in a Small Reasoning Model

author.name: Artt

entry.summary: Investigates whether k-sparse autoencoders can extract interpretable features from a small reasoning model, with a focus on identifying features that correspond to the model's reasoning process. It explores interpretability of reasoning behaviors in compact LLMs.

entry.title: Cognitive Debt: AI as Intellectual Leverage and the Dynamics of Systemic Fragility

author.name: Shuchen Meng

entry.summary: Develops a formal economic theory of cognitive debt accumulating when people use AI as a substitute rather than complement for first-principles thinking, with propositions about systemic fragility and a cognitive Minsky moment. A theoretical position on human-AI interaction risks.

entry.title: Minimal Oversight: Uncertainty-Aware Governance for Delegated AI Systems

author.name: Carlos R. B. Azevedo

entry.summary: Proposes the Minimum Sufficient Oversight Principle, a variational framework for uncertainty-aware governance of delegated AI systems that minimizes governance burden subject to a delivery constraint, yielding a water-filling allocation of autonomy. Single-author theoretical contribution.

entry.title: Steering Emotional Dynamics for Art Therapy: Controllable Narrative Script Generation through Hierarchically Guided LLM Agents

author.name: Suqing Wang, Qinghai Miao, Chao Guo, Yisheng Lv

entry.summary: Proposes hierarchically guided LLM agents to generate narrative scripts with controllable emotional trajectories for art therapy, addressing the failure of existing methods to follow specified affective arcs. Aims to support emotion-oriented psychological healing through controlled emotional fluctuations.

entry.title: Evaluation of Alternative-Based Information Systems for Deliberative Polling using an Agentic Simulator

author.name: Rwaida Alssadi, Khulud Alawaji, Balaji Kasula, Muntaser Syed, Badria Alfurhood, Markus Zanker, Marius Silaghi

entry.summary: Evaluates alternative-based information systems for deliberative polling using an LLM-based Agentic Bipolar Argumentation Simulator that formalizes a poll as endorsing/opposing justifications with attack and enhance relations. Addresses the coverage problem of ensuring voters encounter representative argument samples at scale.

entry.title: Co-Scraper: query-aware DOM Pruning and Reusable Scraper Synthesis for Lightweight Web Data Extraction

author.name: Shoupeng Wang, Jiantao Qiu, Wuyang Zhang, Conghui He

entry.summary: Co-Scraper is a two-stage framework that combines query-aware DOM pruning with reusable scraper synthesis using a fine-tuned Qwen3-8B model for scalable web data extraction. It achieves SOTA on SWDE with high F1 and reuse success rates.

entry.title: Leptomeningeal Collateral Detection on DSA via Vessel-Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Junyong Cao, Hakim Baazaoui, Chinmay Prabhakar, Suprosanna Shit, Lukas Bastian Otto, Susanne Wegener, Bjoern Menze, Ezequiel de la Rosa

entry.summary: This work detects leptomeningeal collaterals in acute stroke by classifying individual vessel segments on graphs derived from high-resolution DSA imaging. A hybrid graph-pixel architecture fuses topology-aware and dense pixel branches to overcome limitations of coarse CTA-based scoring.

entry.title: EChO-Agent: Evidence Chain Orchestration Agent for Audio Reasoning

author.name: Siyuan Zhang, Jian Zong, Junyu Wang, Peiyuan Jiang, Jiahao Yan, Jingyu Zhang, Tianrui Wang, Xiaobao Wang, Longbiao Wang, Jianwu Dang

entry.summary: EChO-Agent is a modular agent framework for complex audio question answering that reformulates the task as planning, tool execution, evidence integration, and answer verification. It improves accuracy and rubric scores on the MMAR benchmark, with evidence integration identified as the key factor.

entry.title: Edu-Theater: A Data-Efficient Agent Framework for Scalable Learner Behavior Simulation through Staging Roll-Call

author.name: Weibo Gao, Qi Liu, Linan Yue, Zheng Zhang, Yichao Du, Fangzhou Yao, Ao Yu, Zhenya Huang, Shijin Wang

entry.summary: Edu-Theater is a data-efficient agent framework for scalable learner behavior simulation using a cohort-aware roll-call paradigm that builds cohort-level proficiency priors before refining individual states. It addresses the data and computation cost and cold-start fragility of individual-centric learner simulators.

entry.title: Learning Earthquake Wave Arrival Time Picking from Labels with Inaccuracies

author.name: Sen Li, Xu Yang, S. Mostafa Mousavi, Anye Cao, Keting Fan, Yaoqi Liu, Changbin Wang, Qiang Niu

entry.summary: Introduces LaNCoR, a contrastive robust learning approach to handle noisy labels in seismic wave arrival-time picking without large training sets. Targets a domain-specific scientific ML problem.

entry.title: AnonShield: Scalable On-Premise Pseudonymization for CSIRT Vulnerability Data

author.name: Cristhian Kapelinski, Douglas Lautert, Beatriz Machado, Diego Kreutz, Isadora Garcia Ferr\~ao

entry.summary: AnonShield is a high-throughput on-premise pseudonymization system combining GPU-accelerated NER, streaming, and caching to anonymize CSIRT vulnerability data, reducing processing from 92 hours to under 10 minutes with high F1/recall. Enables compliant data sharing.

entry.title: MAF: Multimodal Adaptive Few-shot Prompting for Sentiment Analysis with MLLMs

author.name: Hangling Xie

entry.summary: MAF is a multimodal adaptive few-shot prompting framework that dynamically retrieves query-relevant demonstrations encoding facial expressions, scene context, and text to elicit context-sensitive sentiment reasoning from MLLMs. Addresses prompt sensitivity in multimodal sentiment analysis.

entry.title: Green SARC: Predictive Cost and Carbon Governance for Agentic AI Systems

author.name: Gaston Besanson

entry.summary: Presents Green SARC, a governance-by-architecture framework adding enforcement sites in the agent loop to predict and bound financial and environmental costs of agentic AI. Provides theoretical cost-growth results validated on 3,000 real multi-step plans.

entry.title: Entity Labels Are Not Entity Signals: A Framework for Observable Relevance in Document Re-Ranking

author.name: Utshab Kumar Ghosh, Shubham Chatterjee

entry.summary: Distinguishes conceptual entity relevance from observable entity relevance in document re-ranking, arguing entity links are imperfect linker hypotheses rather than ground-truth signals. Provides a framework explaining when entity signals fail to discriminate relevant documents.

entry.title: MASCOT-Android: A Curated Dataset and Automated Collection Pipeline for Android Malware Source Code Specimens

author.name: Bojing Li, Duo Zhong, Prajna Bhandary, Raguvir S, Charles Maxa, Robert J Joyce, Charles Nicholas

entry.summary: Introduces MASCOT-Android, a curated dataset of Android malware source code with an automated GitHub collection pipeline. Notably finds that repository README documentation alone provides a strong signal for identifying malware repositories.

entry.title: An affordable hardware-aware neural architecture search for deploying convolutional neural networks on ultra-low-power computing platforms

author.name: Andrea Mattia Garavagno, Edoardo Ragusa, Antonio Frisoli, Paolo Gastaldo

entry.summary: Presents an affordable hardware-aware neural architecture search generating tiny CNNs that run on ultra-low-power microcontrollers, with a lightweight search procedure executable even on embedded devices. Preserves state-of-the-art accuracy on tiny computer vision benchmarks.

entry.title: Gaming-Resistant Insurance Contracts for Autonomous AI Agents: Strategy-Proof Toll Mechanism Design

author.name: Hao-Hsuan Chen

entry.summary: Characterizes a five-attack space for autonomous AI-agent insurance contracts and proves when an actuarial runtime pricing side-effect-bearing actions is gaming-resistant against strategic operators. Proposes new contract clauses to close the remaining attack surfaces.

entry.title: Lect\=uraAgents: A Multi-Agent Framework for Adaptive Personalized AI-Assisted Learning and Embodied Teaching

author.name: Jaward Sesay, Yue Yu, Siwei Dong, Yemin Shi, Guangyao Chen, B\"orje F. Karlsson

entry.summary: Proposes LecturaAgents, a multi-agent framework for personalized AI-assisted learning featuring a ProfessorAgent leading specialized subordinate agents for adaptive embodied teaching. Aims to model multimodal and embodied instruction tailored to individual learners beyond lecture automation.

entry.title: Dual-Granularity Orthogonal Disentanglement for Generalizable Audio Deepfake Detection

author.name: Zhuodong Liu, Hugen Lv, Xiangyu Li, Chunhong Yuan

entry.summary: This paper proposes dual-granularity orthogonal disentanglement to prevent audio deepfake detectors from learning speaker identity instead of synthesis artifacts. It enforces feature independence at sample and batch levels via a curriculum schedule without adversarial training.

entry.title: Gen-VCoT: Generative Visual Chain-of-Thought Reasoning via Diffusion-Based RGB Intermediate Representations

author.name: Zhiqiang Zhou, Junliang Dai, Xu ling

entry.summary: Gen-VCoT generates RGB images as interpretable intermediate steps in visual chain-of-thought using expert vision models for grounding, depth, and semantic reasoning, with an adaptive router. It improves spatial and depth questions but can hurt simple factual queries.

entry.title: Beyond Weights and Gradients: A Taxonomy of Federated Learning Messages

author.name: Alvaro Javier Vargas Guerrero, Xinguang Wang, Quang Manh Doan, Guy Nagels

entry.summary: This paper offers a formal mathematical definition of a federated message accounting for utility and privacy, and a taxonomy organizing exchanges into model structures, statistical summaries, and data-conditioned representations. It is grounded in a review of 202 recent publications.

entry.title: Phase-Localized Curation Does Not Help: A Negative Result on Per-Phase Metric Selection for Demonstration Filtering

author.name: Aarav Bedi

entry.summary: This negative-result paper tests whether applying demonstration-curation metrics within trajectory phases beats applying them globally on contact-rich LIBERO manipulation tasks, and finds phase-localized curation does not help. It rigorously evaluates a natural but unsupported hypothesis.

entry.title: M-CTX: Exact and Scalable Spatial Context Retrieval for Trajectory Analytics

author.name: Kun Ma, Qilong Han, Chengjing Song, Jingzheng Yao, Xiao Han, Yuee Zhou, Changmao Wu

entry.summary: M-CTX reframes spatial context construction for trajectory prediction as an ingest-once, query-many spatial database workload, replacing brute-force OSM retrieval, SDF computation, and agent search. It dramatically reduces a hidden 17-CPU-day preprocessing bottleneck.

entry.title: Prediction of Runtime Parameters of Parallel Chemistry Applications via Active and Generative Learning

author.name: Tanzila Tabassum, Omer Subasi, Ajay Panyala, Epiya Ebiapia, Gerald Baumgartner, Erdal Mutlu, P Sadayappan, Karol Kowalski

entry.summary: Develops active and generative learning approaches with gradient-boosted regression trees to predict runtime parameters of highly scalable parallel chemistry (Coupled-Cluster) computations. Achieves very low error and works with only 20-25% of data via active learning.

entry.title: Integrated Marketing Attribution: A Bayesian Framework for Privacy-Safe Granular Measurement Anchored in MMM

author.name: Meghana R. Bhat, Ankit Umare, Utsav Aggarwal, Richard Vecsler, Arunkumar Mani, Karthik Nair, Chandhu Nair

entry.summary: This paper introduces Integrated Marketing Attribution, a Bayesian framework that combines Marketing Mix Modeling with channel-specific attribution models to derive privacy-safe campaign-level effects from aggregated data. It bridges coarse MMM and granular but privacy-fragile MTA.

entry.title: Bayesian Optimization for Learning Nonlinear MPC in Autonomous Agent Navigation

author.name: Lorenzo Ortolani, Gabriel Voss, Gabriele Beltrami, Francesco Dorati, Tommaso Felice Banfi

entry.summary: This paper presents a map-free navigation framework combining LiDAR-based Gaussian occupancy, A* planning, and nonlinear MPC, with Bayesian optimization (TPE) to tune controller parameters offline. It targets robust real-time autonomous navigation in dynamic unknown environments.

entry.title: Peak-Based Nuclide Identification in HPGe $\gamma$-Spectrometry with Machine Learning and SHAP

author.name: Samuel Emmons, Kelly Truax, Maurice Lonsway, Bruce Pierson, Brian Archambault

entry.summary: This work applies supervised ML with SHAP explanations to nuclide identification in HPGe gamma spectrometry, mapping analyst-fitted photopeaks to candidate radionuclides. It aims to provide an expert-informed, automated, interpretable tool to speed up spectral analysis.

entry.title: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of SAM 3 for Automated ITV Generation from 4DCT Images

author.name: Changwoo Song

entry.summary: Adapts SAM 3 via LoRA for automated internal target volume generation from 4DCT, using only seven annotated volumes plus hard negative mining and phase-coherent refinement to exploit respiratory temporal coherence. Targets radiation therapy planning.

entry.title: CEVAR: Centerline Embedding Extraction for Endovascular Aneurysm Repair

author.name: Roman Naeem, Timo Niiniskorpi, Charlotte Sandstr\"om, Naman Desai, Anders Jeppsson, Ida H\"aggstr\"om, Fredrik Kahl, H{\aa}kan Roos, Jennifer Alv\'en

entry.summary: CEVAR is a transformer framework for automated, protocol-driven assessment of stent graft sealing zones after endovascular aneurysm repair, combining 3D centerline tracking with embedding-based geometric prediction. Reduces reliance on manual centerline editing.

entry.title: Redirecting the Flow: Image Customization through Attention Distribution Shift

author.name: Jie Li, Suorong Yang, Jian Zhao, Furao Shen

entry.summary: This work formulates subject-driven image customization as a distribution shift from adding reference images into text-to-image generation, deriving a Conditional Attention Distribution Shift grounded in maximum entropy theory. It aims to preserve subject identity while following text instructions without the inefficiencies of fine-tuning or token competition.

entry.title: A Modular Dual-Arm Apple Harvesting Robot with Enhanced Field Performance

author.name: Keyi Zhu, Kyle Lammers, Chaaran Arunachalam, Kaixiang Zhang, Renfu Lu, Zhaojian Li

entry.summary: Presents a modular dual-arm apple harvesting robot with vertically stacked arms and a foundation-model perception pipeline (Grounding-DINO plus EfficientViT-SAM) for improved field throughput. It targets commercial orchard labor shortages.

entry.title: Impedance MPC with Disturbance Estimation for Dexterous Hand Control

author.name: Yongyan Cao

entry.summary: Presents an actuator-agnostic Impedance Model Predictive Control framework for dexterous fingers that reduces diverse tendon transmissions to a constant-coefficient double integrator, enabling offline-precomputed QP solutions while inheriting stability guarantees. It balances precise trajectory tracking with compliant contact.

entry.title: An integrated interpretable control effectiveness learning and nonlinear control allocation methodology for overactuated aircrafts

author.name: Umut Demir, Aamir Ahmad, Walter Fichter

entry.summary: Proposes an interpretable, physics-constrained control-effectiveness learning method integrated with nonlinear control allocation for overactuated aircraft, balancing accuracy across the flight envelope with the interpretability needed for verification. It avoids both black-box opacity and prohibitive onboard model costs.

entry.title: Attribute Inference from Interactive Targeted Ads

author.name: Peihao Li

entry.summary: Models targeted advertising as a noisy oracle for inferring sensitive user attributes by exploiting interaction signals tied back to campaigns. Provides a reproducible synthetic benchmark to study privacy leakage in ad systems.

entry.title: Do we have the knowledge we need? Rethinking human-AI decision-making in corporations

author.name: Anne S. R. Marx, Ricardo M. Avelino, Torbj{\o}rn Netland, Mennatallah El-Assady

entry.summary: A position paper examining how organizations should store knowledge to remain accessible to both humans and AI, and how to allocate agency between humans and AI across tasks of differing risk and uncertainty. Contributes a framework mapping task attributes to agency allocation.

entry.title: Exploiting Search in Symbolic Numeric Planning with Patterns

author.name: Matteo Cardellini, Enrico Giunchiglia

entry.summary: Presents an improved Symbolic Pattern Planning procedure for numeric planning that exploits search over pattern subsequences via planning-as-satisfiability encodings. Builds on prior SPP work to improve numeric planning efficiency.

entry.title: Beyond Self-Attention: Sub-Quadratic Vision Transformers for Fast Image Captioning

author.name: Chiradeep Ghosh, Dakshina Ranjan Kisku

entry.summary: Proposes a sub-quadratic vision transformer for image captioning that replaces standard self-attention to improve computational efficiency while enhancing local feature representation. Targets the high cost of quadratic self-attention in transformer-based captioning.

entry.title: LLMs on Tabular Data with Limited Semantics: Evidence from Industrial Car Retrofit Prediction

author.name: Aina Vila Pons, Ioannis Tzachristas, Constantinos Antoniou

entry.summary: Studies whether LLMs can match tabular ML baselines on an industrial car-retrofit prediction dataset with limited textual semantics, comparing embeddings, direct prompting, and ML+LLM stacking. Finds practical trade-offs relevant to deploying LLMs on structured operational data.

entry.title: Control-Plane Placement Shapes Forgetting: An Architectural Study of Agent Memory Across Thirteen System Configurations

author.name: Dongxu Yang

entry.summary: Studies how the architectural placement of an LLM within agent memory pipelines affects forgetting failure modes, comparing thirteen configurations on a 385-case adversarial benchmark. Finds distinct placement regimes with complementary coverage for different deletion and canonicalization tasks.

entry.title: Theorem-Grounded Execution Ontologies for Interpretable Machine Reasoning

author.name: Raghu Anantharangachar

entry.summary: Introduces Theorem-Grounded Execution Ontologies (TGEO), modeling LLM reasoning as an executable state-transition process with formal state representations rather than opaque chains of thought. Aims to make reasoning interpretable, verifiable, replayable, and transferable.

entry.title: PVminerLLM2: Improving Structured Extraction of Patient Voice via Preference Optimization

author.name: Samah Fodeh, Linhai Ma, Ganesh Puthiaraju, Srivani Talakokkul, Afshan Khan, Elyas Irankhah, Sreeraj Ramachandran, Ashley Hagaman, Sarah Lowe, Aimee Roundtree

entry.summary: Presents PVminerLLM2, improving structured extraction of patient voice from unstructured text by applying preference optimization to address token-critical errors that supervised fine-tuning misses. Targets fine-grained, rare, and unevenly distributed extraction errors.

entry.title: FlowMPC: Improving Flow Matching policies with World Models

author.name: Chandon Hamel

entry.summary: Introduces FlowMPC, combining an imitation-learned flow matching policy with a learned world model to enable MPPI test-time planning over candidate action sequences. Shows improved manipulation performance on ManiSkill PickCube and PickSingleYCB tasks.

entry.title: Learning aligned EEG representations with subject-specific encoders

author.name: Bruna J. Lopes, Gabriel Schwartz, Sylvain Chevallier, Raphael Y. de Camargo, Bruno Aristimunha

entry.summary: Studies whether subject-specific encoders with a shared classifier can learn subject-aligned EEG representations without explicit Euclidean alignment. Finds the hybrid encoder largely internalizes the recentering role that EA otherwise provides.

entry.title: Decoupling Semantics from Distortions: Multi-Scale Two-Stream Vision-Language Alignment for AI-Generated Image Quality Assessment

author.name: Zijie Meng

entry.summary: MST-CLIPIQA proposes a multi-scale two-stream framework that decouples semantic understanding from low-level distortion sensitivity using dual CLIP encoders for AI-generated image quality assessment. It addresses the semantic-distortion conflict in monolithic VLM representations.

entry.title: Robust Spoofed Speech Detection via Temporal Pyramid Modeling

author.name: Mahtab Masoudi Nezhad, Nima Karimian

entry.summary: This work proposes a Temporal Pyramid Adapter using parallel temporal convolutions with varying receptive fields combined with self-supervised XLS-R features for robust spoofed speech detection. It is evaluated across multiple cross-dataset benchmarks.

entry.title: Unsupervised Learning for Missing Modalities in Multimodal Learning

author.name: Hassan Ismkhan, Hamid Bouchahcia

entry.summary: UL4M4 is a task-independent framework for handling missing modalities in multimodal learning by imputing missing feature embeddings before supervised prediction. It uses modality-specific normalization and a partial-modality distance metric for clustering incomplete observations.

entry.title: Simulation-Augmented Multi-Step Split Conformal Prediction for Aggregated Forecasts

author.name: Andro Sabashvili

entry.summary: SA-MSCP is a simulation-augmented multi-step split conformal method for uncertainty quantification in aggregated forecasts like annual totals and year-over-year growth, generating future paths from cross-validated residuals via block bootstrap. It improves empirical coverage over a simulated-path baseline.

entry.title: TCHG: Tri-Trust Conditioned Heterogeneous Graph Learning for Reliable Dynamic Trust Prediction

author.name: Bohao Liao, Boyu Deng, Qipeng Song, Jieling Wang, Jingchao Wang

entry.summary: TCHG is a heterogeneous graph learning framework for dynamic trust prediction that decomposes trust evidence into separate channels rather than treating signals uniformly. It supports applications like social recommendation and manipulation detection.

entry.title: LLM-Based Synthetic Ground Truth Generation for Audio-Based Emotion Classification via In-Context Learning

author.name: Qing Huang, Pooja Pol, Jianing Zhang

entry.summary: This paper uses LLMs with in-context learning to generate synthetic ground-truth labels for audio-based emotion classification of team collaboration states in VR. It addresses the challenge of sparse expert annotations and noisy sensor data in HCI settings.

entry.title: Analyzing Visual Aircraft Representations with Sparse Autoencoders

author.name: Deepshik Sharma

entry.summary: Trains a sparse autoencoder on intermediate ConvNeXt activations from an aircraft classifier to test whether interpretable features can be extracted. Finds several learned features correspond to recognizable aircraft structures.

entry.title: Progressive Knowledge-Guided Large Language Model Framework for Bearing Fault Diagnosis

author.name: Jinghan Wang, Gaoliang Peng, Yanjun Chen, Wei Zhang, Wentao Wu, Tianchen Liu

entry.summary: Presents a progressive physics-guided multi-scale framework for bearing fault diagnosis using an 81-dimensional descriptor derived from bearing kinematic theory and characteristic defect frequencies. It addresses feature-physics traceability and multi-source information fusion in vibration signals.

entry.title: Hierarchical GRU with Input-Conditioned Slot Queries for Ball Action Anticipation

author.name: Parthsarthi Rawat

entry.summary: This paper presents a hierarchical model for anticipating ball actions in football broadcast video using a local Transformer, GRU aggregation, and a Transformer decoder with input-conditioned event slots. It introduces frequency-reweighted Hungarian matching to favor rare action classes.

entry.title: Variational Network with Wavelet-based UNET in Accelerated MRI Reconstruction from Under Sampled K-space Data

author.name: Yasir Arafat Prodhan (Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology, Dhaka, Bangladesh), Shaikh Anowarul Fattah (Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology, Dhaka, Bangladesh)

entry.summary: This work proposes a variational network with wavelet-based U-Net for accelerated MRI reconstruction from undersampled k-space data. It aims to preserve high-frequency structures under aggressive undersampling.

entry.title: Toward the Whole Picture: Accumulative Fingerprint Mapping and Reconstruction for Small-Area Mobile Sensors

author.name: Xiongjun Guan, Jianjiang Feng, Jie Zhou

entry.summary: Reformulates small-area mobile fingerprint sensing as accumulative fingerprint mapping and reconstruction, stitching repeated partial touches into a complete representation rather than matching each patch separately. Aims to improve coverage and matching reliability.

entry.title: The Third Challenge on Image Denoising at NTIRE 2026: Methods and Results

author.name: Lei Sun, Hang Guo, Bin Ren, Shaolin Su, Xian Wang, Danda Pani Paudel, Luc Van Gool, Radu Timofte, Yawei Li

entry.summary: Reports the NTIRE 2026 high-noise image denoising challenge results, benchmarking 20 finalist teams' unconstrained neural architectures restoring images corrupted by strong Gaussian noise. Provides a snapshot of SOTA in unconstrained image restoration.

entry.title: GraphBEV++: Multi-Modal Feature Alignment for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Ziying Song, Caiyan Jia, Lin Liu, Shaoqing Xu, Lei Yang, Yadan Luo

entry.summary: GraphBEV++ is a multi-modal LiDAR-camera fusion framework for autonomous driving that corrects projection-induced feature misalignment via graph-matching local alignment and deformable/diffusion-based global alignment. It is compatible with both LSS-based and query-based BEV architectures like BEVFusion and BEVFormer.

entry.title: Sinkhorn-CPD: Robust point cloud registration via unbalanced entropic optimal transport

author.name: Jin Zhang, Mingyang Zhao, Bing Liu, Xin Jiang

entry.summary: Sinkhorn-CPD improves rigid point cloud registration by replacing Coherent Point Drift's marginal constraint with dual KL penalties, forming a fully unbalanced entropic optimal transport that discards outliers on both sides. It handles heavy outliers and partial overlap without hand-tuned annealing schedules.

entry.title: WaveDINO: Learning-Based Atmospheric Correction of Unwrapped InSAR Interferograms Validated by GNSS: Results at Laguna del Maule and Campi Flegrei Volcanoes

author.name: Robert Popescu, Juliet Biggs, Tianyuan Zhu, Nantheera Anantrasirichai

entry.summary: WaveDINO is a wavelet-based multi-scale learning method for atmospheric correction of unwrapped InSAR interferograms, trained with a hybrid strategy combining synthetic deformation and real atmospheric noise. It is validated against GNSS at the Laguna del Maule and Campi Flegrei volcanoes for improved deformation monitoring.

entry.title: The N2D Haptic Glove: A Multi-Finger Glove for 2D Directional Force Feedback for Contact Rich Manipulation

author.name: Yao-Ting Huang, Jake Honma, Omar Hernandez, Logan Li, Kaitlin Calimbahin, Bryce Hackel, Michael C. Yip

entry.summary: Presents the N2D haptic glove rendering 2D directional fingertip forces for contact-rich teleoperation, validated through a user study showing improved precision over visual-only and single-axis baselines. It advances wearable haptics for robotic manipulation.

entry.title: A Koopman-PINN Framework for Epidemic Models: Parameter Inference and Forecasting

author.name: Achraf Zinihi, Matthias Ehrhardt, Moulay Rchid Sidi Ammi

entry.summary: Proposes a Koopman-enhanced physics-informed neural network (K-PINN) for parameter inference and forecasting in nonlinear epidemic models, mapping states into a latent space with approximately linear dynamics while satisfying governing equations. It is evaluated on synthetic Mpox and real COVID-19 data from multiple countries.

entry.title: Risk-Aware LLM Agents for Geospatial Data Retrieval: Design and Preliminary Adversarial Evaluation

author.name: Kyle Gao, Joel Cumming, Jonathan Li, Linlin Xu, David A. Clausi

entry.summary: Presents a multi-agent LLM framework for retrieving remote sensing data from cloud catalogues via natural language, with guardrail, QA, and recommender agents, plus preliminary adversarial evaluation. Targets environmental and disaster applications.

entry.title: Do LLMs Reliably Identify Correct Information Units in Aphasic Discourse?

author.name: Jason M Pittman, Yesenia Medina-Santos, Anton Phillips Jr., Brielle C. Stark

entry.summary: Investigates whether instruction-tuned LLMs can reliably perform token-level Correct Information Unit classification from aphasic discourse transcripts, benchmarking four open models in zero- and few-shot settings. Targets automating labor-intensive clinical discourse assessment.

entry.title: Automated 3D Kinematic Monitoring for Circadian Activity and Anomaly Detection in Juvenile Fish

author.name: Chih-Wei Huang, Chang-Wen Huang, Chung-Ping Chiang, Tsung-Wei Pan

entry.summary: Presents a high-throughput 3D behavioral phenotyping framework combining deep learning object detection with binocular stereo vision for real-time non-contact monitoring of juvenile tilapia, reconstructing 3D trajectories and quantifying true physical swimming speeds. Addresses the phenotyping bottleneck in precision aquaculture.

entry.title: GRAPE: Guided Parameter-Space Evolution for Compact Adversarial Robustness

author.name: Zhiyuan Ye (University of Science and Technology of China), Xiangyu Zhou (China Mobile), Ji Qi (China Mobile), Hao Zhang (University of Science and Technology of China), Yi Zhou (China Mobile)

entry.summary: GRAPE is an adversarial training framework that progressively expands the optimizable parameter space, asking whether the order parameters become trainable affects robustness. It stabilizes optimization in exposed dimensions and uses a spectral utilization score to guide newly released capacity.

entry.title: Guiding Federated Graph Recommendation with LLM-encoded knowledge

author.name: Thi Minh Chau Nguyen, Hien Trang Nguyen, Duc Anh Nguyen, Van Ho-Long, Thanh Trung Huynh, Zhao Ren

entry.summary: This work uses LLM-encoded knowledge to guide federated graph recommendation, injecting global semantic context into structural aggregation across non-IID clients. It addresses the misalignment of locally learned structural embeddings that naive averaging fails to capture.

entry.title: LearnOpt: Recovering the Latent Cognitive Structure of Standardized Examinations via Knowledge Graphs and Constrained Optimization

author.name: Joy Bose, Om Thomas

entry.summary: LearnOpt recovers latent cognitive structure of standardized exams (NEET) using LLM-tagged knowledge graphs and constrained knapsack optimization with Bayesian Knowledge Tracing to generate personalized study plans. Finds stable latent skill distributions diverging from official syllabi.

entry.title: CIWI-CKT: Chaos-Informed Wave Interference Feature Fusion and Cross-City Knowledge Transfer for Traffic Flow Forecasting

author.name: Abdul Joseph Fofanah, Lian Wen, David Chen, Shaoyang Zhang

entry.summary: CIWI-CKT introduces a chaos-informed wave-interference feature fusion framework with cross-city knowledge transfer for few-shot traffic flow forecasting in data-scarce cities. Models wave-like interference patterns for cross-regime dynamics.

entry.title: A Self Consistency Based Reranking for Narrative Question Answering

author.name: Molham Mohamed, Ali Hamdi

entry.summary: Proposes a self-consistency-based reranking framework for narrative question answering that generates multiple candidate answers and selects the final one by semantic agreement, addressing sensitivity to single-decoding generation variability. Improves robustness on long-context narrative QA.

entry.title: Graphical-Probabilistic Modeling of Generative Flows in LLM-Native Software Systems

author.name: V\'ictor A. Braberman, Flavia Bonomo-Braberman

entry.summary: Proposes graphical-probabilistic modeling methods for documenting generative flows and stating design properties of LLM-native software systems. Aims to bring software-engineering rigor and design-level reasoning to the currently exploratory practice of building LLM applications.

entry.title: ArtBoost: Synthetic Articulatory Data Augmentation for Acoustic-to-Articulatory Inversion

author.name: Hyung Kyu Kim, Byungchan Hwang, Hak Gu Kim

entry.summary: Proposes ArtBoost, a data augmentation strategy that extracts pseudo articulatory trajectories from large-scale speech-mesh facial animation datasets to pre-train acoustic-to-articulatory inversion models under limited EMA supervision. Shows consistent improvements in correlation and error metrics.

entry.title: Autonomous End-to-End SOH Prediction Services for Battery Systems via Temporal-Contrastive Representation Learning

author.name: Junting Wen, Dan Li, Qihao Quan, Xiwen Wang, Hang Yang, Zhaohong Meng, Zigui Jiang, Changlin Yang, Tianle Liu, Diego Mu\~noz-Carpintero, Jian Lou

entry.summary: Introduces TC-SOH, a modular plug-and-play service for autonomous end-to-end battery state-of-health prediction using temporal-contrastive representation learning and a cross-window prediction pretext task on raw operational data. Adds representation diagnostics for transparency.

entry.title: Fast When, Careful Who: Dual-Process Multiparty Turn-Taking with Diffusion Augmentation

author.name: Rutherford A. Patamia, Ming Liu, Wei Luo, Favour Ekong, Akan Cosgun

entry.summary: This work presents a two-stage audio-only pipeline for multiparty turn-taking that separates detecting candidate turn boundaries from verifying floor transfer, augmented with diffusion. It targets realistic multiparty dialogue with overlap and rapid speaker changes.

entry.title: Robust Dual-Signal Fusion: Hybrid Neuro-Symbolic Gating with Compressed Chain-of-Thought Refinement for Irony Detection in Social Media Texts

author.name: Ankit Bhattacharjee, Krityapriya Bhaumik

entry.summary: The Robust Dual-Signal Fusion framework is a neuro-symbolic architecture that compresses chain-of-thought reasoning without fine-tuning for zero-shot irony detection. It matches a fine-tuned BERTweet and filters out-of-distribution hallucinations on imbalanced data.

entry.title: TriAdReview: Triangular Adversarial Review Architecture for Multi-Model Technical Document Generation

author.name: Zhiqiang Zhou, Junliang Dai, Xu Ling

entry.summary: TriAdReview is a triangular adversarial review architecture using two independent reviewer models (engineering and boundary perspectives) and a triangular judge to iteratively improve a generator's technical documents. It is evaluated across five tasks and 75 experiments comparing single, dual, and triple model configurations.

entry.title: EnvShip-Bench: An Environment-Enhanced Benchmark for Short-Term Vessel Trajectory Prediction

author.name: Kun Ma, Qilong Han, Chengjing Song, Jingzheng Yao, Hao Wang, Changmao Wu

entry.summary: EnvShip-Bench is a unified benchmark for short-term vessel trajectory prediction built from large-scale AIS data with standardized protocols and environmental context annotations. It addresses inconsistent forecasting protocols and uneven data quality in maritime ML.

entry.title: Robust Neural Tucker Factorization with Bias Correction and Adaptive Initialization

author.name: Yuchao Su, Yixin Ran

entry.summary: Improves neural Tucker tensor factorization for high-dimensional incomplete tensors via bias correction and adaptive initialization, addressing non-linear, non-stationary dynamics in traffic and climate data. Targets sensitivity to parameter initialization and bias in sparse-observation completion.

entry.title: Beyond the Smile: A Hybrid Convolutional VAE for Crypto Volatility Surfaces

author.name: Sadanand Singh, Allam Reddy, Manan Chopra

entry.summary: This paper presents a convolutional variational autoencoder for cryptocurrency implied-volatility surfaces combined with a quadratic smile re-fit for surface completion. The hybrid predictor achieves an eightfold error reduction over the smile re-fit alone at 50 percent masking.

entry.title: Surrogate-Assisted Framework for SI-Compliant Interconnect Design Optimization Using the Earth Mover's Distance

author.name: Emre Ecik, Werner John, Julian With\"oft, Ralf Br\"uning, J\"urgen G\"otze

entry.summary: This work presents a deterministic surrogate-assisted framework for signal-integrity-compliant PCB interconnect design using neural surrogates, a decision-tree quality gate, and the Earth Mover's Distance for ranking. It contrasts with iterative black-box surrogate optimization via an interpretable sequential pipeline.

entry.title: Early Anomaly-Onset Detection based on Wigner--Ville Distribution Slice Spectra: A Transmission-Grid Test Case

author.name: Eduardo Jr Piedad, Eduardo Prieto-Araujo, Oriol Gomis-Bellmunt

entry.summary: Evaluates full-vector Wigner-Ville Distribution Slice spectra for sequential anomaly-onset detection in high-voltage grid waveforms, using a baseline-normalized deviation score. Compares against FFT and autoencoder baselines on a transmission-grid test case.

entry.title: p-PSO: A Penalized Particle Swarm Optimization Technique for Finding D-Optimal Designs with Mixed Factors in Generalized Linear Models

author.name: Shrabanti Chowdhury, Abhyuday Mandal

entry.summary: Proposes p-PSO, a penalized particle swarm optimization technique for finding D-optimal experimental designs in generalized linear models with mixed discrete and continuous factors. Introduces a general-purpose algorithm-agnostic penalty formulation for constrained optimization.

entry.title: Data-driven Control with Real-time Uncertainty Compensation for Multi-Fuel Engines

author.name: Rajasree Sarkar, Arunava Banerjee, Sathya Aswath Govind Raju, Ishan Berk Altiner, Zongxuan Sun, Kenneth Kim, Chol-Bum Mike Keown

entry.summary: Presents a data-driven real-time uncertainty compensation framework for combustion control in multi-fuel compression ignition engines, using Gaussian Process Regression and a pseudo-engine-speed concept for dynamic adaptation. Targets consistent combustion phasing under modeling uncertainty.

entry.title: Fusing Transferred Priors and Physics-based Decomposition for Underwater Image Enhancement

author.name: Haochen Hu, Yanrui Bin, Zhengyan Zhang, Minchen Wei, Chih-yung Wen, Bing Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a transfer-learning underwater image enhancement method that fuses transferred priors with physics-based decomposition to overcome noisy pseudo-labels common in UIE datasets. Aims to improve enhancement quality despite scarce true labels.

entry.title: Trusting Right Predictions for Wrong Reasons: A LIME Based Analysis of Deep Learning Interpretability in Lung Cancer Diagnosis

author.name: Samarpan Poudel, Vladislav D Veksler

entry.summary: A LIME-based interpretability study of CNN, ResNet50, and ViT models on lung cancer CT, finding that correct predictions can rely on wrong (non-diagnostic) regions, raising trust concerns. Adds a dual evaluation beyond accuracy.

entry.title: SP$^3$: Spherical Priors for Plug-and-Play Restoration

author.name: Sean Man, Ron Raphaeli, Matan Kleiner, Or Ronai

entry.summary: SP3 is a plug-and-play image restoration algorithm that replaces denoisers with Spherical Encoders as generative priors, projecting onto the natural image manifold via half-quadratic splitting without inference-time gradients. It enables anytime restoration producing plausible images from the first iteration.

entry.title: DifferAD-R1: A Difference-Guided IndustrialAnomaly Localization with Multimodal LargeLanguage Models

author.name: Dingrong Wang, Xian Tao, Zhen Qu, Hengliang Luo, Xinyi Gong, Fei Shen, Zhengtao Zhang, Guiguang Ding

entry.summary: DifferAD-R1 is an MLLM-augmented reinforcement learning framework for industrial anomaly localization that uses difference-guided cues and addresses the limits of QA-style paradigms and standard GRPO for subtle defects. It aims to deliver effective learning signals for localizing unseen defect categories.

entry.title: 3D Classification of Paramagnetic Rim Lesions in Multiple Sclerosis via Asymmetric QSM-FLAIR Modeling

author.name: Veronica Pignedoli, Giacomo Boffa, Nicoletta Noceti, Matilde Inglese, Francesca Odone, Matteo Moro

entry.summary: This work proposes a 3D multimodal deep learning framework for lesion-level classification of paramagnetic rim lesions in multiple sclerosis from QSM and FLAIR MRI, explicitly modeling modality asymmetry. It addresses class imbalance from the low prevalence of rim-positive lesions, an emerging biomarker for chronic active inflammation.

entry.title: Large Language Model-Driven Cooperative Operator Ensemble Evolution for Permutation Flow Shop Scheduling

author.name: Rui Xu, Yufan Liao, Haoze Lv, Shengcai Liu, Yi Mei, Ke Tang

entry.summary: This work proposes IG-DOE, a multi-operator iterated greedy algorithm for permutation flow shop scheduling that uses LLM-driven cooperative operator ensemble evolution to switch among heterogeneous destruction operators.
