entry.summary: This work investigates whether human preference for text-to-image content can be predicted before generation, given that random noise seeds strongly affect output quality especially in small local models. It examines the practical utility of pre-generation preference prediction.

entry.title: Dual Feature Decoupling for Fine-Grained OOD Detection

author.name: Xiaokun Li, Yaping Huang, Qingji Guan

entry.summary: DFDNet addresses fine-grained out-of-distribution detection through feature disentanglement, targeting subtle inter-class variations in tasks like medical and vehicle recognition that most OOD methods overlook. It separates discriminative from background-interfering features.

entry.title: ReSAGE-PAR: Representational Similarity Assessment for Generative Expansion in Pedestrian Attribute Recognition

author.name: Pablo Ayuso-Albizu, Pablo Carballeira, Juan C. SanMiguel, Paula Moral

entry.summary: ReSAGE-PAR is a generate-score-autolabel pipeline using diffusion models to expand pedestrian attribute recognition datasets, bridging the domain gap to low-resolution surveillance crops. It uses representational similarity assessment for reliable attribute verification to prevent generative hallucinations.

entry.title: Synthetic Data Generation and Vision-based Wrinkle and Keypoint Detection for Bimanual Cloth Manipulation

author.name: Ariel Herrera, Xueyang Kang, Atal Anil Kumar

entry.summary: This work develops a Blender-based synthetic pipeline with auto-annotated keypoints combined with real data to train wrinkle and keypoint detectors for bimanual cloth manipulation. A proposed algorithm uses detected wrinkles to stretch folded garments, transitioning to keypoint-based ironing as corners emerge.

entry.title: GS-NFS: Bandwidth-adaptive Streaming of Dynamic Gaussian Splats and Point Clouds

author.name: Rajrup Ghosh, Haodong Wang, Haoran Hong, Eduardo Pavez, Amartya Chaudhuri, Weiwu Pang, Harsha V. Madhyastha, Antonio Ortega, Ramesh Govindan

entry.summary: GS-NFS accelerates compression and decompression of dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting for 3D video streaming on GPUs with bandwidth adaptation. It addresses the large data footprint of dynamic 3DGS frames for real-time streaming.

entry.title: From Prediction to Self: Developmental Conditions for Agency in Minimal Neural Systems

author.name: Evan Ye

entry.summary: Traces the emergence of agency in a minimal 192-dimensional GRU through 40 controlled experiments, identifying four ordered developmental conditions for distinguishing self-caused from world-caused change. Proposes a developmental sequence for self-modeling.

entry.title: Towards a Data Flywheel for Embodied Intelligence in Logistics

author.name: Anlan Yu, Zaishu Chen, Zhiqing Hong, Daqing Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a logistics data flywheel for industrial embodied intelligence that converts daily operations into reusable data assets and uses world models to generate supervision for long-tail parcel manipulation. WM-DAgger feeds deployment feedback into policy improvement.

entry.title: Merging model-based control with multi-agent reinforcement learning for multi-agent cooperative teaming strategies

author.name: Christian Llanes, Spencer W. Jensen, Samuel Coogan

entry.summary: Combines multi-agent reinforcement learning with model-predictive control (MA-AC-MPC) to achieve safe, dynamically feasible cooperative multi-agent actions. Leverages MARL for long-horizon cooperation and MPC for short-horizon safety.

entry.title: HyFAD: Hybrid Time-Frequency Diffusion with Frequency-Aware Embedding for Time Series Imputation

author.name: Hongfan Gao, Wangmeng Shen, Bin Yang, Jilin Hu

entry.summary: HyFAD is a hybrid time-frequency diffusion model with frequency-aware embedding for time series imputation, performing reverse denoising sequentially from time to frequency domain for coarse-to-fine generation. Addresses high-frequency reconstruction and global-local balance.

entry.title: EML-CD: Causal Mechanism Recovery via EML Symbolic Trees in Structure Learning

author.name: Sota Asanuma

entry.summary: EML-CD integrates the EML operator into causal structure learning to recover interpretable closed-form causal mechanisms as gated binary trees rather than black-box neural weights. Enables analytical Jacobians and tested on Sachs protein signaling data.

entry.title: Adaptive state-action abstractions via rate-distortion

author.name: Fernando E. Rosas

entry.summary: This paper proposes a rate-distortion principle for dynamically adjusting the granularity of state-action abstractions in reinforcement learning: refine when learning error becomes comparable to abstraction error. It formalizes this with a performance certificate decomposing value error into learning and abstraction terms.

entry.title: Towards passive heart health monitoring via smartphone camera

author.name: Unknown

entry.summary: Google Research describes work toward passive heart health monitoring using only a smartphone camera, leveraging optical signals to estimate cardiovascular metrics. It points to scalable, accessible consumer health screening without dedicated hardware.

entry.title: When Should We Protect AI? A Precautionary Framework for Consciousness Uncertainty

author.name: Anna Mikeda

entry.summary: Proposes a precautionary framework mapping evidence of AI consciousness across five welfare dimensions to graduated protective obligations, combining binary triggers with continuous scaling. It matters for operationalizing AI welfare decisions under deep uncertainty.

entry.title: Predict and Reconstruct: Joint Objectives for Self-Supervised Language Representation Learning

author.name: Aimen Boukhari

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid pretraining objective combining JEPA-style latent-space prediction with standard masked language modeling over a shared encoder, balanced by a learnable scalar. Aims to learn deeper semantic representations than surface-form MLM, evaluated against a pure-MLM baseline.

entry.title: NIV: Neural Axis Variations for Variable Font Generation

author.name: Nadav Benedek, Ariel Shamir, Ohad Fried

entry.summary: Introduces NIV (Neural Axis Variations), a method to automatically convert static fonts into functional variable fonts by predicting per-point glyph displacements along design axes. Uses a Property Embedding mechanism to capture multi-axis interactions operating directly on vector geometry.

entry.title: When Surface Form Changes Moderation Decisions: A Paired Study of Code-Mixed Workflow Instability

author.name: Suraj Babu Thimma Krishnaram

entry.summary: Studies how content moderation workflow decisions (ALLOW/FLAG/REVIEW) become unstable under code-mixed (Tamil-English) inputs compared to clean English, finding a 26.5% decision flip rate and increased review burden and false-flagging. Highlights deployment fragility beyond clean-input classification accuracy.

entry.title: GenTI: Benchmarking LLMs for Autonomous IDPS Rule Generation for Unseen Attacks

author.name: Hassan Jalil Hadi, Rehana Yasmin, Ali Shoker

entry.summary: Proposes GenTI, an LLM-driven benchmark and dataset (GTI, aggregating 150k+ rules from Snort, Suricata, etc.) for autonomous generation of IDPS rules targeting unseen and zero-day attacks. Addresses the limited adaptability of manually crafted signature-driven detection rules.

entry.title: Bridging the Semantic-Collaborative Gap: An Asymmetric Graph Architecture for Cold-Start Item Recommendation

author.name: Anh Truong, John Trenkle, Yuanbo Chen, Honghong Zhao, Abdullah Alchihabi, Effy Fang, Michael Tamir

entry.summary: Shallow-RHS is an asymmetric graph link-prediction architecture for cold-start item recommendation, formulated as inductive graph completion on a temporal bipartite device-content graph, deployed in Tubi's production retrieval system. It assigns standalone embeddings to new content with no interaction history.

entry.title: Bridging Domain Expertise and Generalization for Performance Estimation

author.name: Shuxuan Li, Zhilin Zhao, Quyu Kong, Wei-Shi Zheng

entry.summary: FRAP estimates model performance under distribution shift without labels by fusing predictions from an external foundation model and the base model to build a more reliable surrogate of ground-truth labels. It improves performance estimation correlation when base-model biases are amplified by shift.

entry.title: Hyper-ICL: Attention Calibration with Hyperbolic Anchor Distillation for Multimodal In-Context Learning

author.name: Niloufar Alipour Talemi, Hossein Kashiani, Fatemeh Afghah

entry.summary: Hyper-ICL is a training-based framework that reconstructs the effect of in-context demonstrations for multimodal LLMs without requiring the demonstrations at inference time, using a low-rank logit-level adapter and hyperbolic anchor distillation. It reduces the latency and instability of multimodal in-context learning.

entry.title: OA-CutMix: Correcting the Label Bias of CutMix

author.name: Tobias Christian Nauen, Stanislav Frolov, Federico Raue, Brian B. Moser, Andreas Dengel

entry.summary: OA-CutMix corrects a label-bias flaw in CutMix, where area-based label assignment misattributes credit to background patches with no visible object; it uses precomputed segmentation masks to assign labels in proportion to visible object area. The authors quantify the bias at 21.5% mean discrepancy and zero visible-object pixels in 17% of samples.

entry.title: ProSPy: A Profiling-Driven SQL-Python Agentic Framework for Enterprise Text-to-SQL

author.name: Zhaorui Yang, Huawei Zheng, Sen Yang, Yuhui Zhang, Haoxuan Li, Zhizhen Yu, Xuan Yi, Chen Hou, Defeng Xie, Chao Hu, Minfeng Zhu, Dazhen Deng, Haozhe Feng, Danqing Huang, Yingcai Wu, Peng Chen, Wei Chen

entry.summary: ProSPy is a profiling-driven SQL-Python agentic framework for enterprise-scale text-to-SQL handling large schemas, incomplete metadata, and dialect-specific syntax via a four-stage reasoning process. It addresses real enterprise database complexity.

entry.title: ACE-SQL: Adaptive Co-Optimization via Empirical Credit Assignment for Text-to-SQL

author.name: Xiaobing Chen, Ai Jian, Eryu Guo, Zhiqi Pang

entry.summary: ACE-SQL is an RL framework that jointly optimizes schema retrieval and SQL generation under execution feedback, using an online column-set pool for empirical credit assignment rather than static gold supervision. It addresses suboptimal schema-linking targets.

entry.title: Revising Context, Shifting Simulated Stance: Auditing LLM-Based Stance Simulation in Online Discussions

author.name: Xinnong Zhang, Wanting Shan, Hanjia Lyu, Zhongyu Wei, Jiebo Luo

entry.summary: Audits LLM-based stance simulation by applying controlled counterfactual context revisions and re-inferring a user's stance, testing whether simulations reflect stable user beliefs or are over-sensitive to semantically irrelevant context changes. Includes a multimodal revision strategy.

entry.title: An Embarrassingly Simple Detector for Model Extraction Attacks in Large Language Model API Traffic

author.name: Shuze Liu, Qianwen Guo, Yushun Dong

entry.summary: Formulates LLM model-extraction monitoring as benign-calibrated traffic-window distribution testing and shows a simple maximum mean discrepancy detector over query embeddings effectively detects extraction attacks using only benign-vs-benign comparisons. A lightweight defense for hosted APIs.

entry.title: GLASS: GRPO-Trained LoRA for Acoustic Style Steering in Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech

author.name: Jaehoon Kang, Yejin Lee, Kyuhong Shim

entry.summary: GLASS uses GRPO-trained LoRA adapters to learn composable acoustic style controls (speaking rate, pitch) in zero-shot TTS from post-generation rewards rather than style labels, with WER as an intelligibility anchor. It disentangles style from speaker identity in prompts.

entry.title: Inverse Manipulation through Symbolic Planning and Residual Operator Learning

author.name: Yigit Yildirim, Giuseppe Rauso, Riccardo Caccavale, Alberto Finzi

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid framework for inverse manipulation that derives inverse-skill objectives from STRIPS-like operators extracted from demonstrations, combining symbolic planning with residual operator learning. Restores forward-execution effects under continuous dynamics.

entry.title: Causal Atlases from Entropic Inference: Bayesian Networks beyond Optimal DAGs

author.name: Hazhir Aliahmadi, Irina Babayan, Greg van Anders

entry.summary: This paper uses entropy-based inference to generate atlases of plausible Bayesian network structures rather than committing to a single optimal DAG, capturing the inherent variability and multiple causal chains in data. It offers a more data-faithful representation of causal uncertainty.

entry.title: Insurance of Agentic AI

author.name: Quanyan Zhu

entry.summary: Examines the emerging insurance market for agentic AI and develops a framework for underwriting, pricing, reinsurance, and product design given novel exposures not fitting traditional liability categories. It matters for the economic and risk-management infrastructure around autonomous AI deployment.

entry.title: Framing, Judging, Steering: An Assessable Competency Model for Teach-ing Students to Reason With Generative AI

author.name: Alexander Apartsin, Yehudit Aperstein

entry.summary: Proposes CoRe-3 (FJS), a competency model decomposing productive generative-AI use into three assessable skills: Framing, Judging, and Steering, to diagnose why AI use succeeds or fails beyond a single prompting score. It matters for education assessment in an AI-augmented world.

entry.title: TokenMizer: Graph-Structured Session Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Context Management

author.name: Shweta Mishra

entry.summary: Presents TokenMizer, an open-source proxy that models LLM session history as a typed knowledge graph (14 node types, 7 edge types) for long-horizon context management. Preserves relational structure across sessions instead of treating history as flat text.

entry.title: From Scoring to Explanations: Evaluating SHAP and LLM Rationales for Rubric-based Teaching Quality Assessment

author.name: Ivo Bueno, Babette B\"uhler, Philipp Stark, Tim F\"utterer, Ulrich Trautwein, Dorottya Demszky, Heather Hill, Enkelejda Kasneci

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for sentence-level interpretability of rubric-based teaching quality scoring, combining SHAP attributions with LLM-generated rationales on classroom transcripts. Compares fine-tuned PLMs and prompted LLMs on scoring performance and explanation faithfulness using the NCTE corpus.

entry.title: Finite Element-Based Material Learning via Automatic Differentiation: Learning constitutive neural network models from full-field deformation data

author.name: Matthias Knipper, Chenyi Ji, Malte Brand, Kevin Linka

entry.summary: Presents FE-MAD, an end-to-end differentiable framework using finite elements and automatic differentiation to learn constitutive neural network material models from heterogeneous full-field deformation data. Balances generality, robustness, and efficiency versus FE model updating and neural operators.

entry.title: Executable Schema Contracts: From Automatic Ingestion to Multi-Source Retrieval

author.name: Padmaja Jonnalagedda, Yuguang Yao, Xiang Gao, Hilaf Hasson, Kamalika Das

entry.summary: Presents a system that automatically discovers executable schemas from raw multi-source data to drive knowledge graph construction and query-time retrieval with provenance awareness. Targets the challenge of integrating evidence across inconsistent schemas without costly manual engineering.

entry.title: Metamorphic Testing with the Rashomon Set: Explanation Faithfulness in Machine Learning

author.name: Helge Spieker, J{\o}rn Eirik Betten, Arnaud Gotlieb

entry.summary: Introduces a metamorphic-testing framework that assesses faithfulness of post-hoc explanations (SHAP, LIME) without ground-truth labels, using the Rashomon effect and five metamorphic relations. It offers a way to evaluate trustworthiness of feature attributions.

entry.title: PAMF: Prior-Aware Multimodal Fusion for Incomplete Time Series Data

author.name: Ziwen Kan, Wugeng Zheng, Tianlong Chen, Song Wang

entry.summary: PAMF is a prior-aware multimodal fusion method for incomplete time-series data in healthcare, explicitly estimating missing values across both within-modality and modality-level missingness patterns rather than relying on masks alone. It targets robustness when ECG segments or respiratory channels are lost.

entry.title: Variance Reduction for Heavy-Tailed Monetization Metrics in Ranking Experiments via Post-Stratification

author.name: Neeti Pokharna, Olivier Jeunen, Yatharth Saraf, Aleksei Ustimenko

entry.summary: Presents a practical variance-reduction framework for online ranking experiments with heavy-tailed monetization metrics, combining post-stratification with CUPED to leverage pre-experiment covariates and improve A/B sensitivity without extra traffic. Deployed at ShareChat, it substantially reduces variance in revenue experiments.

entry.title: Shortcomings and capacities of real-constrained neural networks in complex spaces

author.name: Andrew Gracyk

entry.summary: This single-author theoretical paper computes the asymptotic ratio between storage capacities of complex-valued neural networks when enforcing real versus complex pre-activations, using Gardner volume comparisons and the Harish-Chandra-Itzykson-Zuber integral formula. It applies statistical mechanics tools nonstandard in ML literature.

entry.title: Worker Utility as Hysteresis: A Preisach Model of Transaction Acceptance in Gig Labour Markets

author.name: Piotr Frydrych

entry.summary: Models gig worker latent utility using a Preisach hysteresis framework, estimating acceptance and rejection utility surfaces via a dual-output neural network combined with XGBoost classification. It frames binary accept/reject transactions as emergent hysteresis from heterogeneous worker thresholds.

entry.title: VAMPS: Visual-Assisted Mathematical Problem Solving Benchmark

author.name: Amirhossein Dabiriaghdam, Shayan Vassef, Mohammadreza Bakhtiari, Yasamin Medghalchi, Ilker Hacihaliloglu, Mesrob Ohannessian, Lele Wang, Giuseppe Carenini

entry.summary: VAMPS is a bilingual benchmark of 1,168 multimodal multiple-choice math problems testing whether multimodal LLMs can externalize problems via visualization tools and reason over the tool output. It probes a gap where model performance degrades when relying on visual aids in tool-augmented reasoning.

entry.title: Global Sketch-Based Watermarking for Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Daniel Zhao

entry.summary: This paper proposes a global, sketch-based watermarking scheme for masked diffusion language models that controls a vector-valued sketch of the entire sequence rather than perturbing local token contexts. It enables detection decoupled from local contexts, yielding a more robust statistical signal.

entry.title: Distributional Approximate Nearest Neighbour Search for Uncertainty-Aware Retrieval

author.name: Olivier Jeunen

entry.summary: This paper proposes distributional approximate nearest neighbor search that models uncertainty in user/item embeddings rather than using single point estimates, to counter retrieval bias toward popular head items at the expense of long-tail niche content. It targets uncertainty-aware retrieval in recommender systems.

entry.title: AIP: A Graph Representation for Learning and Governing Agent Skills

author.name: Zachary Blumenfeld, Jim Webber

entry.summary: The Agent Instruction Protocol (AIP) models agent skills as directed execution graphs with discrete steps as nodes (backed by scripts or natural-language descriptions) connected by typed input/output edges and governed by a YAML schema. It aims to improve reliability and governability over free-form prose skill definitions.

entry.title: Bootstrapping Semantic Layer from Execution for Text-to-SQL

author.name: Youngwon Lee, Jaejin Kim, Seung-won Hwang

entry.summary: GATE bootstraps missing value groundings in text-to-SQL from execution feedback, keeping multiple grounding hypotheses open and confirming the one supported by observed query results. It addresses under-specification in expert domains.

entry.title: Towards Truly Multilingual ASR: Generalizing Code-Switching ASR to Unseen Language Pairs

author.name: Gio Paik, Hyunseo Shin, Soungmin Lee

entry.summary: Investigates whether code-switching ASR capabilities learned from limited seen language pairs can generalize to unseen pairs, addressing the combinatorial scalability problem. Aims toward truly multilingual code-switching ASR.

entry.title: Contextualized Prompting For Stance Detection On Social Media

author.name: Tilman Beck, Shakib Yazdani, Simon Kruschinski, Marcus Maurer, Iryna Gurevych

entry.summary: Systematically investigates incorporating real-world, derived, and LLM-generated context into zero-shot prompting for social media stance detection across four datasets including a new German Twitter set. Gurevych group; finds context helps but with caveats.

entry.title: Human Adults and LLMs as Scientists: Who Benefits from Active Exploration?

author.name: Mandana Samiei, Eunice Yiu, Anthony GX-Chen, Dongyan Lin, Jocelyn Shen, Blake A. Richards, Alison Gopnik, Doina Precup

entry.summary: Compares human adults and LLMs as scientists in a blicket-detector causal learning task, asking whether active exploration helps overcome the conjunctive causal handicap. Active exploration substantially improves adults' conjunctive rule learning.

entry.title: MIRAI: Prediction and Generation of High-Impact Academic Research

author.name: Alex Li, Joseph Jacobson

entry.summary: MIRAI predicts paper impact (5-year PageRank and citations) from title, abstract, and date trained on the arXiv graph, then builds a research-ideation pipeline biased toward high impact. Ideas were judged more impactful than a non-MIRAI baseline.

entry.title: Scaffold, Not Vocabulary? A Controlled, Two-Tier, Pre-Registered Study of a Popperian Code-Generation Skill

author.name: Mehmet Iscan

entry.summary: A pre-registered two-tier ablation testing whether a Popperian falsificationist prompt skill improves code generation due to its content or merely the scaffold structure, controlling for placebo, labels-only, and judge biases. It scrutinizes LLM-as-judge-reported skill gains.

entry.title: Disentangled Fine-Grained Prototype Learning for Incomplete Image-Tabular Classification

author.name: Feixiang Zhou, Jianyang Xie, Zhuangzhi Gao, Qinkai Yu, Fu Wang, Yuheng Fan, Jing Li, Zheheng Jiang, Yitian Zhao, Yanda Meng, He Zhao, Gregory Y. H. Lip, Yalin Zheng

entry.summary: This work tackles missing-modality image-tabular classification via disentangled fine-grained prototype learning, addressing semantic and distributional misalignment that coarse global features miss. It targets applications like medical diagnosis and recommendation under incomplete modalities.

entry.title: ShotCrop$^3$: Cropping Human-Centric Images into Cinematic Triple-Shot Compositions

author.name: Dehong Kong, Lina Lei, Lingtao Zheng, Chenyang Wu, Ailing Zhang, Xinran Qin, Teng Ma, Jiaqi Xu, Zhixin Wang, Zhikai Chen, Xuecheng Qi, Renjing Pei, Fan Li

entry.summary: ShotCrop introduces Triple-Shot Compositions, generating establishing, medium, and close-up cinematic crops from a single human-centric image, each with shot descriptions for visual narration. It targets multi-shot creative workflows like commercial posters with limited expert annotations.

entry.title: Two-Way Is Better Than One: Bidirectional Alignment with Cycle Consistency for Exemplar-Free Class-Incremental Learning

author.name: Hongye Xu, Bartosz Krawczyk

entry.summary: BiCyc proposes bidirectional projection with cycle consistency for exemplar-free class-incremental learning, fixing systematic bias in one-directional drift compensation of prototypes. Aims to reduce representation drift accumulation across tasks.

entry.title: Dynamic Multi-Agent Pickup and Delivery in Robotic Cellular Warehousing Systems

author.name: Cheng Ren, Ming Li, Xinping Guan, George Q. Huang

entry.summary: Formulates dynamic multi-agent pickup and delivery with internal order evolution for robotic warehouses and proposes event-triggered online replanning algorithms based on token passing. Handles SKUs appended to orders during execution.

entry.title: 3D Underwater Path Planning via Generative Flow Field Surrogates

author.name: Zachary Cooper-Baldock, Paulo E. Santos, Russell S. A. Brinkworth, Karl Sammut

entry.summary: Uses conditional GAN surrogates (PatchGAN and 2D3DGAN with self-attention) as drop-in replacements for expensive RANS CFD within a 3D energy-weighted A* path planner for AUV launch-and-recovery through propeller wakes. Avoids onboard CFD cost.

entry.title: Waypoints Matter: A Systematic Study for Sampling-Based Trajectory Planning

author.name: Josep M. Barbera, Antonio Artu\~nedo, Jorge Villagra

entry.summary: Systematically studies waypoint placement as a first-class design variable in sampling-based trajectory planning for autonomous driving, comparing uniform, augmented RDP, and curvature-conditioned strategies across 449 configurations. Quantifies how placement affects feasible trajectory quality.

entry.title: Wasserstein Exponential Smoothing

author.name: Takuo Matsubara, Peiwen Jiang, Minh-Ngoc Tran, Wilson Ye Chen

entry.summary: The authors extend classical exponential smoothing to distributional time series by formulating it in Wasserstein space, where each observation is a probability distribution rather than a scalar. They prove the smoothing parameter can be consistently estimated by minimizing Wasserstein distance, preserving the parsimony of classical ES.

entry.title: When AI Says It Feels

author.name: Shin-nosuke Ishikawa, Seiya Ikeda, Hirotsugu Ohba

entry.summary: Trains LLMs to express feelings, intentions, and self-awareness via rubric-based self-rewarding reinforcement learning with GRPO, comparing against contrastively trained models. It matters for examining whether alignment that suppresses feeling-expression conflicts with human-like intelligence goals.

entry.title: Where Should Knowledge Enter? A Layered Framework for Knowledge Infusion in Multimodal Iterative Generative Mo

author.name: Renjith Prasad, Chathurangi Shyalika, Anushka Pawar, Amit Sheth

entry.summary: Proposes a layered framework for knowledge infusion in iterative multimodal generative models, arguing it is an intervention-layer problem across four components: input/output boundary, transition function, intermediate state, and model parameters. Organizes existing methods by where they intervene.

entry.title: Towards Unified and Data-Efficient Prognostics and Health Management with Tabular Foundation Models

author.name: Raffael Theiler, Lev Telyatnikov, Leandro Von Krannichfeldt, Olga Fink

entry.summary: Applies tabular foundation models with in-context learning to industrial Prognostics and Health Management tasks, converting fragmented time-series condition-monitoring data into tabular form. Aims to enable data-efficient reusable predictive systems for maintenance planning.

entry.title: EEGDancer: Dynamic Emotion Latent Space Masked Modeling with Reinforcement Learning for EEG Continuous Emotion Prediction

author.name: Zhihao Zhou, Weishan Ye, Li Zhang, Gan Huang, Zhen Liang

entry.summary: Proposes EEGDancer, a dynamic emotional latent space learning framework for continuous EEG emotion prediction integrating vector-quantized representation learning, masked temporal modeling, and reinforcement learning. Addresses limitations of point-wise regression on noisy high-dimensional EEG features.

entry.title: DAST: A VLM-LLM Framework for Cross-Interface Anomaly Detection in O-RAN

author.name: Francesco Spinelli, Esteban Municio, Pau Baguer, Gines Garcia-Aviles, Xavier Costa-Perez

entry.summary: DAST is a VLM-LLM framework for cross-interface anomaly detection in O-RAN, targeting DoS and performance-degradation attacks where labeled baselines are scarce and telemetry is high-dimensional. It leverages multimodal reasoning over standardized open interfaces.

entry.title: Enhancing the MADDPG Algorithm for Multi-Agent Learning via Action Inference and Importance Sampling

author.name: Marc Walden, Jason Liu, Shaashwath Sivakumar, Ryan Liu, Hamza Khan

entry.summary: Enhances the MADDPG multi-agent RL algorithm with an action inference mechanism predicting other agents' actions and a geometric-distribution importance sampling strategy for replay prioritization. It evaluates on the Predator-Prey PettingZoo task.

entry.title: Spatially Grounded Concept Bottleneck Models via Part-Factorized Attention

author.name: Dhanesh Ramachandram

entry.summary: This work builds a part-factorized concept bottleneck model on frozen DINOv3 features, using a foreground gate and fixed concept-to-part routing so each attribute head reads only its assigned image region. It improves interpretability by preventing concept heads from attending to irrelevant areas.

entry.title: ReSGA: A Large Tail Risk Model for Learning Value-at-Risk and Expected Shortfall

author.name: Yichi Zhang, Ke Zhu, Zhoufan Zhu

entry.summary: ReSGA is a large tail-risk model with millions of parameters, a retrieval-enhanced self-grouping autoencoder, designed to learn Value-at-Risk and Expected Shortfall while exploiting cross-sectional and temporal dependence among assets. On US equity data from 1926-2023 it outperforms twelve econometric and ML competitors.

entry.title: Geometry-Aware Distillation for Prompt Tuning Biomedical Vision-Language Models

author.name: Tran Dinh Tien, Zhiqiang Shen

entry.summary: OGKD is a geometry-aware distillation framework for prompt/adapter tuning of biomedical vision-language models that injects inter-class relation structure into teacher targets to preserve clinically meaningful class relations. It addresses unstable decision boundaries when methods optimize only the ground-truth class under limited supervision.

entry.title: Can LLMs Be Constrained to the Past? Improving Knowledge Cutoff through Recall-Based Prompting

author.name: Michiro Asai, Ailiang Lin, Yu Kishimoto, Takao Obi, Satoshi Kosugi, Kotaro Funakoshi, Manabu Okumura

entry.summary: Proposes recall-based prompting (Self-Recall and Question-Recall) to better enforce prompted knowledge cutoffs in LLMs, especially when post-cutoff knowledge is only causally related to a query. It outperforms direct-answer and step-by-step baselines.

entry.title: CaliDist: Calibrating Large Language Models via Behavioral Robustness to Distraction

author.name: Mohammad Anas Jawad, Cornelia Caragea

entry.summary: CaliDist is a post-hoc calibration method that measures and penalizes an LLM's susceptibility to distractors, scaling confidence by behavioral robustness under semantic perturbation. It links true confidence to stability under cognitive pressure.

entry.title: RadiusFPS: Efficient Farthest Point Sampling on CPUs and GPUs via Spherical Voxel Pruning

author.name: Ziyang Yu, Xiang Li, Qiong Chang, Jun Miyazaki

entry.summary: RadiusFPS accelerates Farthest Point Sampling on CPUs and GPUs via spherical voxel pruning, addressing the latency bottleneck in real-time point-cloud processing for robotic perception. Preserves uniform coverage while reducing complexity.

entry.title: A Conversational Framework for Human-Robot Collaborative Manipulation with Distributed Generative AI models

author.name: Arash Ghasemzadeh Kakroudi, Roel Pieters

entry.summary: Presents a distributed conversational framework for human-robot collaborative manipulation that runs local language and vision-language models as separate ROS 2 nodes, generating structured pick/place/handover actions from free-form commands. Uses a VLM for visual grounding converted to metric goals.

entry.title: PAC-Bayesian Adversarially Robust Generalization for Message Passing Graph Neural Networks: A Sensitivity Analysis

author.name: Ziling Liang, Xinping Yi, Qingsong Wen, Shi Jin

entry.summary: This work develops tighter PAC-Bayesian generalization bounds for adversarially robust message-passing GNNs using anisotropic posteriors and parameter-sensitivity analysis, removing reliance on isotropic Gaussian assumptions and hidden-width-dependent terms. It advances theoretical understanding of robust generalization in graph learning.

entry.title: Assessing the Geographic Diversity of AI's Platial Representations in Image Generation

author.name: Zilong Liu, Krzysztof Janowicz, Mina Karimi

entry.summary: Assesses geographic diversity of AI image generation outputs (GPT and DALL-E) using information-theoretic diversity measures, framing diversity as a function of uncertainty and cognitive bias. Extends prior chatbot diversity analysis to the image modality.

entry.title: The Role of Instructional Guidance in Generative AI-Assisted Learning: Empirical Evidence from Construction Engineering Education

author.name: Xiaoyu Hou, Bo Xiao, Hexu Liu, Shane Mueller

entry.summary: Empirically studies how instructional guidance, via a five-step prompting framework grounded in Generative Learning Theory, shapes student-AI interaction in construction engineering education. Compares slide-based, unprompted AI, and prompted AI learning conditions in a controlled experiment.

entry.title: ATT-CR: Adaptive Triangular Transformer for Cloud Removal

author.name: Yang Wu, Ye Deng, Pengna Li, Wenli Huang, Kangyi Wu, Xiaomeng Xin, Jinjun Wang

entry.summary: Proposes ATT-CR, an Adaptive Triangular Transformer for cloud removal in remote sensing images that reduces self-attention computational cost and mitigates interference from cloudy pixels by distinguishing them from clean pixels in attention computation. Addresses scalability and disturbance issues of standard Transformer-based cloud removal.

entry.title: Towards the Readability of LLM-Generated Codes through Multitask Representation Engineering

author.name: Huifan Gao, Liuhua He, Yinghui Pan, Shenbao Yu, Yifeng Zeng, Shengchao Qin, Weidi Sun

entry.summary: Applies multitask representation engineering to control the readability of LLM-generated code without sacrificing correctness, extending single-task RepE to multiple coordinated control tasks. It targets the under-addressed dimension of code comprehensibility.

entry.title: RowNet: A Memory Transformer for Tabular Regression

author.name: Askat Rakhymbekov, Gulshat Muhametjanova

entry.summary: RowNet is a retrieval-based neural architecture for tabular regression (real estate price-per-square-meter prediction) that represents a query property via pairwise similarity features to historical observations, explicitly modeling comparable-property retrieval. It aims to combine MLP flexibility with the comparable-based logic that GBDTs lack.

entry.title: Trivium: Temporal Regret as a First-Class Objective for Causal-Memory Controllers

author.name: Edward Y. Chang

entry.summary: Trivium proposes long-horizon temporal regret as a first-class objective alongside outcome and epistemic regret for causal-memory controllers in agentic systems. It argues that current systems fail to systematically log why and when failures recur, leading to repeated errors.

entry.title: Scaling Datasets for Multi-Sensor, Multi-Agent, and Multi-Domain Learning in Autonomous Systems

author.name: R. Spencer Hallyburton, David Hunt, Miroslav Pajic

entry.summary: This work presents a modular pipeline using the AVstack framework and CARLA simulator to generate terabyte-scale, ground-truth-labeled datasets for multi-agent, multi-sensor, multi-domain autonomy (ground, aerial, infrastructure). It addresses the lack of datasets supporting large-scale collaborative autonomy learning.

entry.title: PlanBench-V: A Spatial Planning Map Benchmark for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Minxin Chen, He Zhu, Junyou Su, Wen Wang, Yijie Deng, Wenjia Zhang

entry.summary: PlanBench-V is a benchmark for evaluating vision-language models on spatial planning maps used in territorial governance and urban planning, requiring fine-grained perception and policy-informed reasoning. It targets a domain overlooked by general multimodal benchmarks.

entry.title: ReverseEOL: Improving Training-free Text Embeddings via Text Reversal in Decoder-only LLMs

author.name: Ailiang Lin, Zhuoyun Li, Yusong Wang, Keyu Mao, Kotaro Funakoshi, Manabu Okumura

entry.summary: ReverseEOL augments decoder-only LLM text embeddings by combining a forward embedding with one derived from reversed input, providing complementary context that causal attention otherwise misses. It is a simple training-free embedding improvement.

entry.title: Evaluating Stochastic Collapse and Implicit Bias in Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Huiyuan Zheng, Houtao Zhang, Boyang Wang, Qingyi Si, Hongcheng Guo

entry.summary: Introduces RandomBench and metrics to evaluate whether multimodal LLMs maintain distributionally neutral behavior when choosing among equally valid options, exposing stochastic collapse and implicit bias. It targets an underexplored logic-neutral evaluation dimension.

entry.title: Bio-plausible Neuromorphic Disturbance Observer Based on Emulation Theory: Extended Version

author.name: Hongfu Xu, Xiaoyu Guo, Shengbo Wang, Shuo Gao

entry.summary: Develops a neuromorphic disturbance observer using spike-timing encoding and integrate-and-fire dynamics with an adaptive-threshold mechanism inspired by spike-frequency adaptation. Targets event-driven, robust control inspired by biological systems.

entry.title: Learning Contact Representation for Leg Odometry

author.name: Emre Girgin, Cagri Kilic

entry.summary: Proposes a self-supervised representation learning framework for foot contact detection in legged robot odometry, avoiding reliance on force sensors and handling slippage. Improves leg phase detection for velocity estimation.

entry.title: Towards Realistic 3D Sonar Simulation

author.name: Youssef Attia (University of Genova, Italy), Davide Costa (University of Padova, Italy), Francesco Wanderlingh (University of Genova, Italy, Interuniversity Research Center on Integrated Systems for the Marine Environment, Italy), Filippo Campagnaro (University of Padova, Italy, Interuniversity Research Center on Integrated Systems for the Marine Environment, Italy), Enrico Simetti (University of Genova, Italy, Interuniversity Research Center on Integrated Systems for the Marine Environment, Italy)

entry.summary: Proposes a modular architecture for realistic 3D sonar simulation in NVIDIA Isaac Sim that incorporates acoustic phenomena like refraction and multi-path interference beyond geometric LiDAR-style rendering. Improves fidelity for underwater perception algorithm development.

entry.title: Central Description Length (CDL) Clustering Validation Index

author.name: Mahdi Shamsi, Soosan Beheshti

entry.summary: Introduces the Central Description Length clustering validation index, an MDL-based internal score for selecting clustering algorithms and hyperparameters without labels, designed to handle non-convex, irregular, and variable-density data. Aims beyond Euclidean compactness/separation indices.

entry.title: DAS-PINNs for high-dimensional partial differential equations: extending deep adaptive sampling to spacetime domains

author.name: Anshima Singh, David J. Silvester

entry.summary: DAS-PINNs extends deep adaptive sampling to high-dimensional time-dependent PDEs by treating spacetime as a unified domain and using a normalizing flow to concentrate collocation points where PDE residuals are largest. This avoids ineffective uniform sampling and explicit time marching for localized evolving solutions.

entry.title: A Motivational Architecture for Conversational AGI

author.name: Anna Mikeda, Ben Goertzel

entry.summary: Proposes a conversational reinterpretation of the OpenPsi/MetaMo motivational architecture for dialogue agents, recasting homeostasis in terms of competence, uncertainty reduction, affiliation, and aesthetic coherence rather than bodily needs. It matters as a cognitive-architecture vision for conversational AGI. Co-authored by Ben Goertzel.

entry.title: Severity-Aware Curriculum Learning with Multi-Model Response Selection for Medical Text Generation

author.name: Ahmed Alansary, Molham Mohamed, Ali Hamdi

entry.summary: Proposes a severity-aware curriculum learning framework with multi-model response selection for telehealth medical text generation, training sequentially on mild, moderate, and critical cases. It matters for adapting LLM responses to medical query complexity.

entry.title: Integrating Mechanistic and Data-Driven Models for Neurological Disorders through Differentiable Programming

author.name: Shah Pallav Dhanendrakumar, Saikat Pal, Sitikantha Roy

entry.summary: A perspective paper reviewing hybrid modeling strategies that combine deep learning with physics-based mechanistic models via differentiable programming for neurological disorders. It categorizes approaches to balance interpretability with speed in diagnostics and treatment planning.

entry.title: Geographic Bias and Diversity in AI Evaluation

author.name: Zilong Liu, Krzysztof Janowicz, Gengchen Mai, Song Gao, Rui Zhu

entry.summary: A literature-review chapter investigating the geographical nature of bias in AI evaluation and the lack of measurable benchmarks for geographic fairness in generative AI. Argues for developing measures across application domains from biodiversity to disaster mitigation.

entry.title: GOTabPFN: From Feature Ordering to Compact Tokenization for Tabular Foundation Models on High-Dimensional Data

author.name: Al Zadid Sultan Bin Habib, Md Younus Ahamed, Prashnna Kumar Gyawali, Gianfranco Doretto, Donald A. Adjeroh

entry.summary: Proposes feature ordering and compact tokenization techniques to make small tabular foundation models effective on high-dimensional low-sample-size data without retraining large backbones. Introduces graph-guided ordering and neuro-inspired subunit compression for TabPFN-style prediction.

entry.title: Agent-Orchestrated Adaptive RAG: A Comparative Study on Structured and Multi-Hop Retrieval

author.name: Anuj Maharjan, Devinder Kaur, Richard Molyet

entry.summary: Presents an agent-orchestrated adaptive RAG framework with dynamic query decomposition, iterative retrieval, and a bounded self-reflective evaluation loop, evaluated on a DevOps knowledge base and the MuSiQue multi-hop benchmark. Finds query decomposition yields consistent gains in structured domains.

entry.title: Reducing Hallucinations in Complex Question Answering using Simple Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (long version)

author.name: Christopher J. Wedge, Joshua Stutter, Danny Dixon, Jacek Ca{\l}a

entry.summary: Explores using a lightweight graph structure with a simple schema to support a RAG subsystem via a dedicated toolset for reducing hallucinations in complex question answering. Designs an agentic system leveraging graph-based retrieval to avoid expensive fine-tuning.

entry.title: Harnessing Structural Context for Entity Alignment Foundation Models

author.name: Xingyu Chen, Yuanning Cui, Zequn Sun, Wei Hu

entry.summary: ContextEA enhances entity alignment foundation models with a cross-KG interaction encoder using anchor bridges and improved candidate ranking beyond coarse similarity. It improves transferable alignment across unseen knowledge graph pairs.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Machine Learning for Short-Term Flood Prediction

author.name: Tewodros Syum Gebre, Jagrati Talreja, Leila Hashemi-Beni

entry.summary: This work embeds hydrological knowledge into an LSTM loss function via a trend-alignment constraint, penalizing directional inconsistencies between precipitation and discharge for flood prediction. The physics-informed approach improves robustness in data-scarce and extreme-weather settings.

entry.title: An Empirical Audit of Input Encoders for Multi-Channel Signal Transformers

author.name: Ossi Lehtinen

entry.summary: An empirical audit of eight input encoders for multi-channel signal transformers, comparing approaches on synthetic and real time-series benchmarks. The main finding is practical near-equivalence among many encoders, with the standard per-channel linear projection performing competitively.

entry.title: Representation Matters in Randomized Smoothing for Audio Classification

author.name: Jong-Ik Park, Shreyas Chaudhari, Jos\'e M. F. Moura, Carlee Joe-Wong

entry.summary: This work shows that randomized smoothing for certified robustness in audio classification is under-specified because the certified object depends on the preprocessing pipeline (waveform vs spectral features). It provides diagnostics and argues for representation-aware reporting in audio robustness certification.

entry.title: ANN Search: Recall What Matters

author.name: Dimitris Dimitropoulos, Nikos Mamoulis

entry.summary: This paper argues that Recall@k is the wrong metric for approximate nearest neighbor search, proposing 1/Ratio@k (the inverse approximation ratio) which measures distance quality of retrieved results rather than overlap with the true kNN set. It claims this reduces unnecessary computational overhead.

entry.title: QueryAgent-R1: Bridging Query Generation and Product Retrieval for E-Commerce Query Recommendation

author.name: Dike Sun, Zheng Zou, Jingtong Zang, Qi Sun, Huaipeng Zhaoand Tao Luo, Xiaoyi Zeng

entry.summary: QueryAgent-R1 is a memory-augmented agentic RL framework for e-commerce query recommendation that grounds query generation in real inventory retrieval to improve product conversion, not just click-through. It uses a chain-of-retrieval consistency reward.

entry.title: Automatic Labelling of Speech Translation Errors

author.name: Dominik Mach\'a\v{c}ek, Maike Z\"ufle, Ondrej Klejch

entry.summary: Proposes Speech Translation Error Labelling (STEL) with an annotation protocol and small evaluation dataset, analyzing how text-only and speech systems perform error detection. Finds direct speech processing necessary and current systems reach about half human precision.

entry.title: CHALIS: A Challenge Dataset for Language Identification in Difficult Scenarios

author.name: Michal Tich\'y, Jind\v{r}ich Libovick\'y

entry.summary: CHALIS is a benchmark targeting hard language-identification cases: mutually intelligible cousin languages and orthographic noise (transliteration, diacritic removal, homoglyphs, slang). Shows four common LID systems struggle substantially.

entry.title: Revisiting Lexicon Evaluation in Unsupervised Word Discovery

author.name: Simon Malan, Danel Slabbert, Herman Kamper

entry.summary: Revisits lexicon evaluation in unsupervised word discovery, showing the common normalized edit distance metric is biased toward large clusters and ignores class distribution. Proposes size-weighted and inverse metrics grounded in clustering theory.

entry.title: Efficient Mean Curvature Computation on High-Dimensional Data Manifolds

author.name: Alexandre L. M. Levada

entry.summary: Provides an exact algebraic identity and complementary methods to reduce mean curvature computation cost on high-dimensional manifolds from O(m^4) per point to far lower. Enables geometry-aware ML on datasets with many features.

entry.title: L-SDPPO: Policy Optimization of Spiking Diffusion Policy for Intra-vehicular Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Liwen Zhang, Dong Zhou, Guanghui Sun, Yifei Zheng, Yuhui Hu, Kaihong Ouyang, Zuoquan Zhao

entry.summary: Presents a triangular roller tip mount for high-speed vine robots that reduces internal friction during tip-eversion growth while carrying sensors, with benchmarking. Addresses sensor mounting challenges from continual material turnover.

entry.title: Dead Directions: Geometric Singular Learning

author.name: Tejas Pradeep Shirodkar

entry.summary: This paper bridges singular learning theory and information geometry via the notion of a dead direction, a vector along which the Fisher metric degenerates, and shows its KL order equals the decay rate of directional Fisher curvature. It offers a unified language for analyzing overparameterized model geometry.

entry.title: The Virtual Roundtable: Multi-Agent Personas Simulating the Dynamics of Human Brainstorming

author.name: Tim Dorn, Saara A. Khan, Julie Mumford

entry.summary: Presents a multi-agent persona architecture simulating roundtable brainstorming through divergent and convergent thinking phases with an agentic facilitator. Personas maintain private thoughts while commenting publicly to mitigate groupthink and increase idea diversity.

entry.title: From Attack Simulation to SIEM Rule: Deterministic Detection-as-Code Synthesis with Probe-Level Traceability

author.name: Alexandre Cristov\~ao Maiorano

entry.summary: Presents a deterministic synthesis function mapping breach-and-attack-simulation findings to SIEM Sigma detection rules using a locked probe corpus and template library, providing probe-level traceability. Partially automates the manual translation security teams perform.

entry.title: Multilingual Coreference Resolution via Cycle-Consistent Machine Translation

author.name: Adriana-Valentina Costache, Eduard Poesina, Silviu-Florin Gheorghe, Paul Irofti, Radu Tudor Ionescu

entry.summary: Proposes a coreference resolution pipeline that uses machine translation from English to low-resource languages to generate training data, validated via back-translation and BERT cosine similarity. Aims to close the gap in multilingual coreference resolution.

entry.title: HDST-GNN: Heterogeneous Dynamic Spatiotemporal Graph Neural Networks for Multi-Object Tracking in UAV Aerial Imagery

author.name: Phillip Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes HDST-GNN, a heterogeneous dynamic spatiotemporal graph neural network for multi-object tracking in UAV imagery, with altitude-adaptive edge construction and heterogeneous node representations for detections, tracklets, and lost targets. Addresses small, densely packed objects and frequent occlusion.

entry.title: Microskill Architecture: A Modular Skill-Driven Framework for AI-Native Code Generation

author.name: Mohammad Zare, Omid Abdolrahmani

entry.summary: Presents MicroSkill Architecture, a modular design paradigm partitioning codebase knowledge into atomic skill capsules with a dynamic router selecting relevant ones, inspired by microservices. Aims to manage context windows for AI-native code generation without accuracy loss or token blowup.

entry.title: Benchmarking Open-Source Layout Detection Models for Data Snapshot Extraction from Institutional Documents

author.name: AJ Carl P. Dy, Aivin V. Solatorio

entry.summary: Introduces a benchmark and evaluation framework for data snapshot extraction—identifying semantically meaningful figures and tables in institutional documents—and benchmarks open-source layout detection models across humanitarian and World Bank reports. It treats analytical artifacts as semantic rather than uniform objects.

entry.title: Inverse Critical Experiment Design via Gradient Optimization and a Multigroup Attention-Based Neural Network Architecture

author.name: Will Savage, Logan Burnett, Dean Price

entry.summary: Presents inverse critical-experiment design for nuclear reactor validation, using deep neural network surrogates of OpenMC sensitivity vectors and gradient optimization to generate experiment geometries maximizing neutronic similarity (correlation coefficient c_k) to target technologies. It automates designing experiments that match advanced reactor neutronics.

entry.title: Federated Learning for Multi-Center Sepsis Early Prediction with Privacy-Preserving

author.name: Xixi Tian, Di Wu, Xiang Liu, Yiziting Zhu, Yujie Li, Xin Shu, Bin Yi

entry.summary: This study systematically evaluates federated learning for multi-center sepsis early prediction using a real clinical dataset of 648 samples, assessing performance, robustness, and privacy benefits. It addresses the gap between FL's promise and its insufficiently validated real-world clinical performance.

entry.title: Nonlocal Mean Field Schr\"{o}dinger Bridge with Learned Interactions

author.name: Daisuke Inoue, Mathieu Lauri\`ere, Dante Kalise

entry.summary: This work tackles the mean-field extension of the Schrodinger Bridge problem for interacting particle systems, using neural network surrogates to approximate nonlocal interactions and reduce cost from quadratic to linear at inference. It provides stability bounds for the approach.

entry.title: NLLog: Lightweight, Explainable SOC Anomaly Detection via Log-to-Language Rewriting

author.name: Samuel Ndichu, Tao Ban, Seiichi Ozawa, Takeshi Takahashi, Daisuke Inoue

entry.summary: NLLog is a lightweight, explainable security anomaly detection pipeline that deterministically rewrites parsed log templates into WHO-WHAT-SEVERITY sentences, applies TF-IDF pooling and tree ensembles, and uses TreeSHAP to back-project evidence for analysts. It achieves low false-positive rates with commodity-hardware latency suitable for SOCs.

entry.title: Geometry Gaussians: Decoupling Appearance and Geometry in Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Hongyu Zhou, Zorah L\"ahner

entry.summary: This paper demonstrates a multilingual cross-language transfer learning approach for detecting Alzheimer's Disease from speech across English, Chinese, Arabic, and Hindi, using transformer-based binary classifiers. It achieves 82% F1 across languages with fast inference, supporting cross-linguistic generalization.

entry.title: Interpreting Style Representations via Style-Eliciting Prompts

author.name: Junghwan Kim, David Jurgens

entry.summary: Proposes interpreting learned style representations via style-eliciting prompts that steer LLMs to generate text reflecting specific stylistic attributes, curating 1,010 distinct styles. It aims to give style interpretation an explicit objective and utility.

entry.title: Multi-task Learning is Not Enough: Representational Entanglement in Dual-output Second Language Speech Recognition

author.name: Seung Hwan Cho, Young-Min Kim

entry.summary: Demonstrates that multi-task learning fails for dual-output L2 speech recognition (transcription plus intended meaning) because shared representations entangle, improving meaning but degrading surface transcription. Links degradation to encoder-level entanglement differing between Korean and English.

entry.title: IR3DE: A Linear Router for Large Language Models

author.name: Eros Fan\`i, O\u{g}uzhan Ersoy

entry.summary: IR3DE is a Ridge Regression-based router for selecting domain-expert LLMs per prompt, providing cheap fast routing without heavy training, evaluated in causal language modeling settings. It targets efficient domain-expertise routing.

entry.title: FiLM-Based Speaker Conditioning of a SpeechLLM for Pathological Speech Recognition

author.name: Fernando L\'opez, Santosh Kesiraju, Jordi Luque

entry.summary: Uses Feature-wise Linear Modulation to inject x-vector speaker information into each layer of a frozen ASR encoder for pathological speech, adapting without modifying base weights. Benchmarked against fine-tuning on Spanish and English pathological speech.

entry.title: Inverse Design of Realizable Metasurface based Absorbers using Improved Conditioning and Diversity Enhanced Progressively Growing GANs

author.name: Vineetha Joy, Mohammad Abdullah, Pramit Pal, Anshuman Kumar, Amit Sethi, Hema Singh

entry.summary: Presents a progressively-growing Wasserstein GAN with feature-wise linear modulation for inverse design of metasurface absorbers under continuous spectral constraints. Targets physically realizable EM structures while improving conditioning and diversity.

entry.title: A New Quaternion-Joint Cable-Driven Redundant Manipulator Configuration and its Control Through FABRIK and Residual Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Tanapath Pornthisan, Thanapat Kemthong, Thanyapisit Kangsathien, Pasut Aranchaiya, Paulo Garcia, Viboon Sangveraphunsiri

entry.summary: Introduces a quaternion-joint cable-driven redundant manipulator configuration controlled via FABRIK inverse kinematics and residual reinforcement learning. Aims for compact arms able to traverse obstructed workspaces with fewer motors.

entry.title: A Novel Method with Encoder-Decoder for Cross-Sensor Adaptation in Surface Shape Sensing with Sparse Strain Sensors

author.name: Shuo Wang, Heng Luo, Dian Jin, Xiaoming Tao

entry.summary: Proposes an encoder-decoder architecture with meta-learning and few-shot adaptation for cross-sensor surface shape sensing using sparse strain sensors. Avoids retraining a separate model per sensor array.

entry.title: Estimation of the sub-Gaussian parameter

author.name: Jason Liu, Min Xu, Jinchuan Xing

entry.summary: This work studies estimation of the sub-Gaussian parameter (variance proxy) of a random variable via constrained maximization of an empirical cumulant-based objective, proving consistency and convergence rates. It fills a gap given how ubiquitous sub-Gaussian assumptions are despite little prior attention to estimating this parameter.

entry.title: Where's the Structure? A Systematic Literature Review of Empirical Research on Human-AI Collaboration and Hybrid Intelligence for Learning

author.name: Luis P. Prieto, Juan I. Asensio-P\'erez, Mar\'ia Jes\'us Rodr\'iguez-Triana, Mohamed Saban, Yannis Dimitriadis

entry.summary: A systematic review of 62 empirical studies on human-AI collaboration and hybrid intelligence for learning, characterizing collaboration processes, structures, and contexts. Extracts emerging design knowledge and research gaps, emphasizing the role of interaction structure.

entry.title: Three-Dimensional Retinal Microvasculature Restoration in OCT Angiography

author.name: Yukun Guo, Min Gao, Tristan T. Hormel, Steven T. Bailey, Thomas S. Hwang, Yali Jia

entry.summary: Proposes a deep learning algorithm using an EfficientNet-B5 encoder-decoder to restore three-dimensional retinal capillary vasculature from a single OCT angiography volume, addressing imaging artifacts neglected by 2D methods. Aims to improve quantification of blood flow and nonperfusion areas.

entry.title: Noise-Aware Visual Representation Learning for Medical Visual Question Answering

author.name: I Putu Adi Pratama, Bahadorreza Ofoghi, Atul Sajjanhar, Shang Gao

entry.summary: Proposes a noise-aware Med-VQA framework that inserts a denoising autoencoder before mapping visual embeddings into an LLM, to handle noise and irrelevant changes in medical image representations. Targets clinical decision support via medical visual question answering.

entry.title: ITP-STDP: An Intrinsic-Timing Power-of-Two Learning Engine for On-Chip SNN Training

author.name: Haihang Xia, Xinyu Zhao, Xuecheng Wang, John Goodenough, Charith Abhayaratne, Panagiotis A. Panagiotou, Chunyi Song, Tiantai Deng

entry.summary: ITP-STDP presents an intrinsic-timing power-of-two learning engine for on-chip spiking neural network training, reducing weight-update computation and energy by using power-of-two arithmetic. It targets hardware-efficient STDP-based SNN training.

entry.title: Toward a Generalized Defense Across Sparse, Continuous, and Structured Parameter Attacks

author.name: Bin Duan, Zeyu Bai, Guowei Yang

entry.summary: ParDef is a generalized defense against parameter-tampering attacks (sparse, continuous, structured) on neural networks deployed across untrusted environments. It aims to handle unpredictable attack forms without retraining or major accuracy loss.

entry.title: U-Net-Accelerated Quality-Diversity Optimization for Climate-Adaptive Urban Layouts

author.name: Alexander Hagg, Tania Guerrero, Dirk Reith

entry.summary: This paper replaces a slow regulatory physics climate simulator with a U-Net spatial deep-learning surrogate inside an offline MAP-Elites quality-diversity loop to optimize climate-adaptive urban layouts. It compares the spatial surrogate against Gaussian-process surrogates under different training-data strategies.

entry.title: Learning Control-Affine Reduced-Order Models via Autoencoders

author.name: Ali Mjalled, Martin M\"onnigmann

entry.summary: This work learns control-affine reduced-order models using autoencoders that jointly transform high-dimensional states (and inputs) into reduced latent dynamics suitable for control, with a sequence-based extension for improved prediction. It motivates the framework via feedback linearization of the learned models.

entry.title: Efficient Punctuation Restoration via Weighted Lookahead Scoring Method for Streaming ASR Systems

author.name: Sungmook Woo, Hyungu Kang, Chanwoo Kim

entry.summary: This paper proposes a non-autoregressive weighted lookahead scoring method for punctuation restoration in streaming ASR, comparing punctuation-insertion hypotheses against a no-insertion baseline under bounded subword lookahead with calibrated thresholds. It avoids free-form generation, reducing latency and alignment failures in online decisions.

entry.title: Forgive or forget: Understanding the context of hate in audio retrieval systems

author.name: Arghya Pal, Sailaja Rajanala, Raphael C. -W. Phan, Shekhar Nayak

entry.summary: Proposes a post-hoc causal debiasing framework with a sentiment-controlled mediator to suppress harmful speech in text-to-audio retrieval while preserving relevance, with Forgive (re-ranking) and Forget (counterfactual) variants. Model-agnostic safety for audio retrieval.

entry.title: Nonreversible Gauge Fields in Fokker--Planck Dynamics: Supersymmetric Hamiltonians and Learned Finite Forces

author.name: Masayuki Ohzeki

entry.summary: This paper formulates nonreversible perturbations of Fokker-Planck dynamics as gauge fields that alter relaxation spectra while preserving the invariant distribution, connecting them to supersymmetric Witten-Laplacian Hamiltonians and learned finite forces. It provides a unified operator framework for accelerated sampling and hypocoercivity.

entry.title: ProSarc: Prosody-Aware Sarcasm Recognition Framework via Temporal Prosodic Incongruity

author.name: Prathamjyot Singh, Ashima Sood, Sahil Sharma, Jasmeet Singh

entry.summary: Presents ProSarc, an audio-only sarcasm detection framework modeling temporal prosodic incongruity between local dynamics and emotional baseline. It achieves SOTA on MUStARD++ and generalizes to spontaneous and cross-lingual speech.

entry.title: Risk Assessment of Autonomous Driving: Integrating Technical Failures, Ethical Dilemmas, and Policy Frameworks

author.name: Boyi Chen, Shengqin Chu, Zicheng Wang, Brian Baetz, Zhen Gao

entry.summary: Presents a risk assessment of autonomous driving integrating technical failure modes, ethical dilemmas, and regulatory frameworks using NHTSA crash data, California DMV disengagement reports, the MIT Moral Machines dataset, and a five-jurisdiction comparison. Finds perception and classification errors dominate technical failures.

entry.title: CausalPOI: Spatio-Temporal Graph-Based Causal Modeling for Cold-Start POI Check-in Forecasting

author.name: Zhaoqi Zhang, Miao Xie, Yi Li, Linyou Cai, Siqiang Luo, Gao Cong

entry.summary: Introduces cold-start POI check-in forecasting using spatio-temporal graph-based causal modeling that captures functional dependencies and causal effects of urban interventions, rather than relying on proximity-based correlation graphs. Useful for data-driven urban planning and commercial decision-making.

entry.title: TinyML-Driven Cybersecurity for Autonomous Spacecraft: Latency-Accuracy Analysis for SPARTA RF and Cyber Threat Detection

author.name: Van Le, Trevor Tran, Tan Le

entry.summary: Analyzes latency-accuracy trade-offs of TinyML-compatible classical models for onboard cyber-RF threat detection on autonomous spacecraft using the SPARTA attack model. Provides physics-informed theoretical complexity analysis and empirical measurements on adversarial RF spectrograms.

entry.title: EGTR-Review: Efficient Evidence-Grounded Scientific Peer Review Generation via Multi-Agent Teacher Distillation

author.name: Xinpeng Qiu, Wang Yihu, Zhifeng Liu, Xiaochen Wang, Jimin Wang

entry.summary: EGTR-Review proposes a framework for generating evidence-grounded, traceable scientific peer reviews by distilling a multi-agent teacher pipeline into a more efficient model. It targets reducing reviewer burden while improving source traceability and lowering inference costs.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Neural Network Modeling of Biodegradable Contaminant Transport through GCL/SL Composite Liners

author.name: Dong Li, Yapeng Cao, Haiping Zhao, Shutong Han

entry.summary: This work develops a two-domain physics-informed neural network for biodegradable contaminant transport through composite landfill liner systems, comparing soft-constrained and hard-constrained PINN formulations against analytical and finite-element references. The hard-constrained variant better captures early-time breakthrough behavior.

entry.title: An Ensembled Latent Factor Model via Differential Evolution and Gradient Descent Optimization

author.name: Rui Zhang, Jinhang Liu, Wenbo Zhang

entry.summary: This paper proposes an ensembled latent factor model for high-dimensional incomplete data that independently trains two latent factor models via differential evolution and gradient descent respectively, then combines them. It aims to overcome the insufficient and biased representations of gradient-descent-only approaches on heterogeneous data.

entry.title: Dynamic Multi-Pair Trading Strategy in Cryptocurrency Markets with Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Damian Lebied\'z, Robert \'Slepaczuk

entry.summary: This study applies deep reinforcement learning (PPO with LSTM) as an execution overlay for multi-pair statistical arbitrage trading in volatile cryptocurrency markets, with a Filter-then-Rank pair selection and a Fixed Risk Adaptive Mean execution model. It tests whether DRL can enhance pair trading beyond rigid classical implementations.

entry.title: REGAIN: REconciliation GAIN-driven Auxiliary Direction Learning

author.name: Weijia Li, Shun Hu, Yanfei Kang

entry.summary: REGAIN is a forecast reconciliation framework that learns which additional linear measurements to forecast and include, selecting auxiliary directions by their downstream loss reduction after reconciliation. It reframes reconciliation from projection onto a fixed system to actively designing the measurement system.

entry.title: AURA: Intent-Directed Probing for Implicit-Need Surfacing in Situated LLM Agents

author.name: Yang Li, Jiaxiang Liu, Jiang Cai, Mingkun Xu

entry.summary: AURA adds an inference step between perception and tool use in situated LLM agents, producing a structured estimate of implicit user needs with a gap score that controls probe budget. It improves implicit-need coverage over ReAct-style probing on a small 100-query benchmark.

entry.title: Staged Factorial Screening for Budget-Constrained Micro-Pretraining

author.name: Felipe Chavarro Polania

entry.summary: Studies staged fractional-factorial screening to triage many micro-pretraining recipes on a single GPU under tight budgets, running 613 experiments to recover stable early effect structure. It offers a workflow for budget-constrained recipe selection.

entry.title: TopoPult-SSL: Gland-Mask-Free Cross-Device Meibomian Gland Segmentation via Self-Distilled Weak Clinical Priors

author.name: Nicol\`o Savioli, Luca Del Tongo

entry.summary: TopoPult-SSL is a two-stage framework for cross-device meibomian gland segmentation that uses cheap clinical priors (eyelid outlines, Pult grades, morphometrics) instead of expensive dense masks in stage one, then self-distills teachers into a compact student. It addresses domain shift across imaging devices.

entry.title: What's Under the Skin? Estimating Swine Body Condition

author.name: Mk Bashar, Kuljit Bhatti, Gary Rohrer, Madonna Benjamin, Tami Brown-Brandl, Daniel Morris

entry.summary: PigFormer estimates swine body condition (backfat thickness, loin muscle depth) from ceiling-mounted RGB-D depth frames, replacing labor-intensive ultrasound scans. The two-stage system uses a geometric front-end to standardize raw depth before prediction.

entry.title: Multimodal Sexism Identification and Characterization using Large Language Models and Gradient Boosting

author.name: Kyriakos Chaviaras, Maria Lymperaiou, Athanasios Voulodimos

entry.summary: This is the AILS-NTUA submission to EXIST 2026 for multimodal sexism identification in memes and short videos, using a feature-engineered late-fusion pipeline with gradient-boosted models. It combines visual, textual, demographic, biometric, acoustic, and LLM-derived semantic features.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Adaptive Sensor Fusion for Autonomous Navigation

author.name: Simegnew Yihunie Alaba, Yuichi Motai

entry.summary: Combines a Vision Transformer for IMU temporal modeling and multiscale CNN for optical flow with an Unscented Kalman Filter and uncertainty-aware fusion for visual-inertial odometry. Aims to improve pose estimation robustness in autonomous navigation.

entry.title: Learning from Demonstrations over Riemannian Manifolds using Neural ODEs: An Extended Abstract

author.name: Diana Cuervo Espinosa, Mahathi Anand, Angela P. Schoellig

entry.summary: Extended abstract proposing learning from demonstrations over Riemannian manifolds using neural ODEs to estimate geodesics, encoding both position and orientation. Reduces computational overhead of prior geodesic methods.

entry.title: Attitude-Aided Linear Calibration of Triaxial Accelerometers

author.name: Yongqiang Yu, Tian Huang, Yipeng Yang

entry.summary: Presents attitude-aided linear accelerometer calibration (ALAC) that uses orientation information to construct a combined error matrix enabling linear least-squares estimation of bias and gravity. Avoids costly reference setups and nonlinear iterative optimization.

entry.title: Human Oversight and Overload: Two Hidden and Costly Burdens of AI-Assisted Software Engineering

author.name: Vahid Garousi

entry.summary: Characterizes two hidden burdens of AI-assisted software engineering: the constant need for human oversight of AI-generated artifacts and cognitive overload from excessive AI suggestions. Blends practitioner evidence to open a conversation about managing these costs.

entry.title: TPA-AD: A Two-Stage Pseudo Anomaly-Guided Method for Bearing Time-Series Anomaly Detection

author.name: Xiancheng Wang, Zhibo Zhang, Ran Li, Rui Wang, Minghang Zhao, Shisheng Zhong, Lin Wang

entry.summary: TPA-AD is a two-stage pseudo-anomaly-guided method for bearing time-series anomaly detection in the normal-only training setting, generating pseudo-anomalous windows near the normal boundary, learning anomaly-sensitive representations via contrastive learning, and scoring with KNN. It targets axle-box bearing monitoring.

entry.title: Knockoffs-based False Discovery Rate Control and Simplification for Deep Neural Networks

author.name: Huiqi Zhang, Wenyu Liao, Yiqing Shi, Xiaobo Huang, Fang Xie

entry.summary: This paper proposes three knockoff-based variable screening methods for deep neural networks that control false discovery rate while simplifying inputs and parameters. It extends FDR-controlled selection from high-dimensional regression to neural networks.

entry.title: Reconstructing Unobservable Temperature Fields via Simulation-Aided Intelligent Sensing

author.name: Monika Stipsitz, H\`elios Sanchis-Alepuz, Jacob Reynvaan, Silvester Sabathiel

entry.summary: This work reconstructs unobservable internal temperature fields from sparse embedded sensors using neural networks trained solely on randomized physics-based simulation data. It demonstrates a proof-of-concept hardware setup for high-resolution thermal monitoring where sensor placement is constrained.

entry.title: Uncertainty Aware Functional Behavior Prediction and Material Fatigue Assessment for Circular Factory

author.name: Nehal Afifi, Mehdi Khabou, Victor Mas, Jonas Hemmerich, Patric Grauberger, Stefan Dietrich, Volker Schulze, Sven Matthiesen

entry.summary: Combines uncertainty-aware functional prediction with component-level material fatigue assessment to decide reuse of returned products in circular manufacturing, demonstrated on an angle grinder. It matters for sustainable remanufacturing decisions under heterogeneous degradation.

entry.title: RAINO: Anchoring Agents in Reality, A Systematic Review and Conceptual Framework for Realism in Agent-Based Modelling

author.name: Lo\"is Vanh\'ee, Melania Borit

entry.summary: A systematic literature review of how realism is operationalized in agent-based modeling, finding it is often poorly defined. Introduces the RAINO (Reality Anchor, Input, Output) framework to structure arguments for model realism.

entry.title: PEFT of SLM for Telecommunications Customer Support: A Comparative Study of LoRA Configurations with Energy Consumption Analysis

author.name: Lucas Tamic, Ilan Jaffeux-Cheniout, Xavier Marjou

entry.summary: A comparative study of LoRA configurations for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-3B for telecom customer support, including energy consumption analysis and a synthetic data generation method from a 52-term glossary. Addresses data sovereignty and on-prem deployment needs.

entry.title: Multi-Granularity Reasoning for Natural Language Inference

author.name: Chunling Xi, Di Liang

entry.summary: Proposes a Multi-Granularity Reasoning Network for natural language inference that leverages representations across multiple transformer layers to capture lexical, phrasal, and contextual semantics rather than only final-layer tokens. Aims to improve hierarchical reasoning over premise-hypothesis pairs.

entry.title: The End of Software Engineering: How AI Agents Are Fundamentally Restructuring the Software Paradigm

author.name: Zhenfeng Cao

entry.summary: A position paper arguing that AI agents, where LLMs dynamically generate and discard code, constitute a fundamental restructuring of the software paradigm rather than incremental improvement. Formalizes the distinction between traditional code-as-decision-logic and agentic code-as-ephemeral-tooling using complexity scaling analysis.

entry.title: Deep Learning-based 3D Oral Cavity Reconstruction Using 2D Intraoral Images

author.name: Jihun Cho, Soo-Yeon Jeong, Eun-Jeong Bae, Sun-Young Ihm

entry.summary: Proposes a deep learning approach for 3D oral cavity reconstruction from 2D intraoral images, aiming to reduce patient discomfort and equipment costs associated with impression-taking and intraoral scanners. Addresses material deformation and high cost limitations in dental 3D modeling.

entry.title: Sample-efficient Low-level Motion Planning for Robotic Manipulation Tasks via Zero-shot Transfer Learning

author.name: Yuanzhi He, Victor Romero-Cano, Jos\'e J. Pati\~no, Juan David Hern\'andez, William Sawtell, Gualtiero Colombo

entry.summary: Proposes iCEM+TL, combining the sample-efficient Cross-Entropy Method with transfer learning to reuse planning parameters from simpler robotic tasks for complex manipulation like stacking and shelf placement. It improves low-level real-time motion planning sample efficiency.

entry.title: Long-Term and Short-Term Transistor Aging in Deep Neural Networks: Impact and Mitigation

author.name: Alireza Sarmadi, Virinchi Roy Surabhi, Prashanth Krishnamurthy, Hussam Amrouch, Ramesh Karri, Farshad Khorrami

entry.summary: This chapter analyzes how long-term and short-term transistor aging degrades DNN inference accuracy in hardware and discusses mitigation strategies beyond costly timing guardbands. It bridges hardware reliability and neural network deployment.

entry.title: Fog of Love: Engineering Virtuous Agent Behavior with Affinity-based Reinforcement Learning in a Game Environment

author.name: Ajay Vishwanath, Christian Omlin

entry.summary: This work introduces a two-player multi-agent environment based on the role-playing board game Fog of Love to study affinity-based reinforcement learning for instilling virtuous agent behavior beyond simple grid worlds. Agents compete to fulfill individual virtues while cooperating to satisfy shared goals.

entry.title: Analysis of the Neglect-Zero Effect in Large Language Models

author.name: Jin Tanaka, Daiki Matsuoka, Ryoma Kumon, Hitomi Yanaka

entry.summary: Examines whether LLMs exhibit the human neglect-zero cognitive bias (ignoring vacuously-true empty-set configurations) using a structural priming paradigm. It probes how LLM language processing resembles human inference patterns.

entry.title: "Chi nas dal soch el sent de legn" -- Auditing Text Corpora for Lombard

author.name: Edoardo Signoroni, Pavel Rychl\'y

entry.summary: Manually audits parallel and monolingual corpora for the under-resourced Lombard language, finding web-scraped abundance is illusory due to language misidentification, boilerplate, and noise. Analyzes orthographic composition across datasets.

entry.title: LightVesselNet: An Ultra-Lightweight Sub-100K Parameter Network for Retinal Blood Vessel Segmentation

author.name: Shadman Sobhan, Farhana Jalil

entry.summary: LightVesselNet is an ultra-lightweight sub-100K-parameter network for retinal vessel segmentation using a compact encoder-decoder with attention, multi-scale aggregation, and subpixel upsampling. It targets edge-device deployment with competitive accuracy.

entry.title: Physics in 2-Steps: Locking Motion Priors Before Visual Refinement Erases Them

author.name: Woojung Han, Seil Kang, Youngjun Jun, Min-Hung Chen, Fu-En Yang, Seong Jae Hwang

entry.summary: Comparison of CNN and transformer architectures (U-Net variants, DeepLabV3+, SegFormer) for segmenting bacterial leaf blight severity in rice from UAV multispectral imagery. U-Net++ with EfficientNet-B3 achieved the highest mIoU of 97.62% across input configurations with NDVI and NDRE.

entry.title: Emotion-Aware Image Generation from Korean Diary Text via LLM-based Prompt Translation and LoRA Fine-Tuning

author.name: Jihun Cho, Soo-Yeon Jeong, Sun-Young Ihm

entry.summary: Proposes an emotion-aware text-to-image pipeline that generates children's drawing-style images from short Korean diary entries using Qwen3-8B for sentiment recognition and LoRA-fine-tuned Stable Diffusion 3.5 with emotion trigger words. Examines the effect of emotion triggers and limitations of CLIP Score for evaluation.

entry.title: Neetyabhas: A Framework for Uncertainty-Aware Public Policy Optimization in Rational Agent-Based Models

author.name: Janani Venugopalan, Gaurav Deshkar, Rishabh Gaur, Harshal Hayatnagarkar, Jayanta Kshirsagar

entry.summary: Neetyabhas is an uncertainty-aware framework for public-policy optimization in rational agent-based models, applied to COVID-19 non-pharmaceutical interventions with explicit uncertainties in epidemic measurement and policy implementation. It simulates 1,000 individuals making real-time choices while policymakers deploy interventions.

entry.title: A Komi-Yazva--Russian Parallel Corpus and Evaluation Protocol for Zero- and Few-Shot LLM Translation

author.name: Petr Parshakov

entry.summary: Presents the first Komi-Yazva--Russian parallel corpus (457 pairs) with a leakage-aware evaluation protocol for zero- and few-shot LLM translation in an endangered, extremely low-resource setting. Includes story-level cross-validation and judge-based metrics.
