entry.summary: EMTrack automates erythrocyte detection and tracking in erythrocyte-mediated angiography to quantify capillary-level retinal blood flow, with a flow-context module distinguishing moving from paused cells and topology-aware tracking under large displacements. It enables a novel ocular biomarker.

entry.title: PairedGTA: Generating Driving Datasets for Controlled Photometric Shift Analysis

author.name: Andrea Chianese, Giulio Rossolini, Alessandro Biondi, Marco Cococcioni, Giorgio Buttazzo

entry.summary: PairedGTA generates synthetic driving datasets with perfectly paired images of identical scenes under different weather and illumination, enabling controlled analysis of photometric shifts isolated from geometry and semantics. It addresses the rarity of such paired data in real-world datasets.

entry.title: PerBite: A Curated Diagnostic Workflow for Bite-Aware Food Volume Estimation

author.name: Ahmad AlMughrabi, Farid Al-Areqi, David Fern\'andez G\'omez, Umair Haroon, Marc Bola\~nos, Ricardo Marques, Petia Radeva

entry.summary: Presents PerBite, a curated diagnostic workflow for bite-aware food volume estimation using paired before/after-consumption states, integrating SAM 3, Hunyuan3D/SAM 3D, and Blender-based processing for metric-scaled food mesh reconstruction. Submitted to a CVPR 2026 challenge.

entry.title: Training-Free Continuous Bitrate Control for Scalable Image Coding for Humans and Machines

author.name: Yui Tatsumi, Hiroshi Watanabe

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free variable-rate scalable image coding framework for humans and machines by adjusting quantization steps based on predicted scale values. Achieves continuous bitrate control across machine and enhancement layers.

entry.title: Ontology-Guided Reasoning for Affordance-Based Explanations of Robot Navigation

author.name: Amar Halilovic, Vahidin Hasic, Senka Krivic

entry.summary: Proposes ontology-guided reasoning for affordance-based explanations of robot navigation, representing nearby entities, affordances, and spatial relations to generate actionable, semantically grounded explanations when routes are blocked. Includes a lightweight benchmark.

entry.title: SoFiE: Soft Finger Exoskeleton for Intelligent Grasping

author.name: Magnus Malthe Sigsgaard Nielsen, Nicklas Nikolaj Gr{\o}nvall, Xiaofeng Xiong, Saravana Prashanth Murali Babu

entry.summary: SoFiE is a modular soft finger exoskeleton for index-finger flexion assistance, fabricated from 3D-printed flexible materials with tendon-driven actuation, a conductive-spring proprioceptive sensor (StretchSense), and a magnetic tactile sensor (MagSense). Targets assistive hand rehabilitation.

entry.title: A passive universal grasping mechanism based on an everting shell

author.name: Mythra V. S. Balakuntala, Safvan Palathingal, G. K. Ananthasuresh

entry.summary: Conceptualizes a passive monolithic compliant grasping mechanism based on the eversion of a bistable elastic shell, which envelops objects of any shape up to a size and weight limit and stays grasped until reactuated. A universal passive gripper design.

entry.title: Threading Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Model Inference in Low-Cost Smart Agricultural Manipulation

author.name: Keith Truongcao, Christopher Nhu, Zijian An, Phong Nguyen, Siwei Cai, Lifeng Zhou

entry.summary: Presents a system-level implementation of the Real-Time Action Chunking algorithm for VLA inference on low-cost robotic arms, optimizing threading for the policy inference and control pipeline to reduce end-to-end latency. Bridges pseudocode to stable real-world deployment.

entry.title: Global Convergence of a Line-Search Filter Differential Dynamic Programming Method

author.name: Ming Xu, Iman Shames

entry.summary: This article establishes global convergence properties of FilterDDP, a line-search filter differential dynamic programming method handling nonlinear state and control constraints. It proves convergence for a subset of constrained optimal control problems via backward-forward recursion analysis.

entry.title: Critique of current AI safety bug bounty programs

author.name: clickyquack

entry.summary: This post critiques current AI safety bug bounty programs, arguing they are valuable for catching post-deployment safety vulnerabilities missed by internal testing and red-teaming. It analyzes incentive design for disclosing real-world safety failures.

entry.title: Optimal Transport-based Permutation-Invariant Bayesian Optimization of Offshore Wind Farm Layouts

author.name: Antonio Candelieri, Laurens Bliek

entry.summary: This paper proposes a permutation-invariant Bayesian optimization method using optimal transport to exploit symmetry in layout problems, applied to offshore wind farm layout optimization. By treating point order as irrelevant, it improves sample efficiency on expensive black-box objectives.

entry.title: CoMIC: Collaborative Memory and Insights Circulation for Long-Horizon LLM Agents in Cloud-Edge Systems

author.name: Yannan Wang, Longli Yang, Zhen Liu, Abhishek Kumar, Carsten Maple

entry.summary: CoMIC is a parameter-update-free cloud-edge framework for long-horizon LLM agents using centralized reflection and decentralized execution, where edge agents execute with hierarchical memory and circulate insights through the cloud. It helps resource-constrained edge models handle persistent memory and subgoal tracking without fine-tuning.

entry.title: NBQ: Next-Best-Question for Dynamic Profiling

author.name: Yimin Shi, Clarice Wang, Haixun Wang, Xiaokui Xiao

entry.summary: NBQ formalizes the Next-Best-Question problem for dynamic user profiling, selecting at each turn the question with highest expected information gain given the conversation goal, and distilling dialogue into a structured profile vector. It is instantiated for reciprocal matchmaking.

entry.title: Tackling the Root of Misinformation by Teaching Laypeople about Logical Fallacies via Socratic Questioning and Critical Argumentation

author.name: Minjing Shi, Junling Wang, Jingwei Ni, Sankalan Pal Chowdhury, Mrinmaya Sachan

entry.summary: LFTutor is an intelligent tutoring system that uses LLMs with intent-driven Socratic questioning and critical argumentation principles to teach laypeople to identify logical fallacies, addressing misinformation at its root. Automatic and human evaluations show it outperforms baseline LLMs lacking these pedagogical strategies.

entry.title: Explainable Data-driven Deep Reinforcement Learning Methods for Optimal Energy Management in Buildings

author.name: Hallah Shahid Butt, Qiong Huang, G\"okhan Demirel, Kevin F\"orderer, Erfan Tajalli-Ardekani, Simnon Waczowicz, Luigi Spatafora, Veit Hagenmeyer, Benjamin Sch\"afer

entry.summary: This work addresses explainable deep reinforcement learning for optimal building energy management with PV and storage, aiming to overcome the black-box barrier to user trust and practical adoption. It studies data-driven DRL controls amid volatile generation, varying tariffs, and added assets.

entry.title: eMoT: evolving Memory-of-Thought via Symbolic Anchoring and Memory Corrosion

author.name: Xiang Li, Jiwei Wei, Ke Liu, Yitong Qin, Jinyu Guo, Malu Zhang, Peng Wang, Yang Yang

entry.summary: InKH is an interaction-native knowledge harness architecture for financial LLM agents that absorbs complexity into the system by converting user, market, portfolio, and tool events into structured operational knowledge. It addresses forgotten context, stale memory, and weak auditability in finance tasks like market analysis and trade preparation.

entry.title: DraDDP: A Multimodal Multi-Party Dialogue Discourse Parsing Dataset

author.name: Shannan Liu, Peifeng Li, Yaxin Fan, Qiaoming Zhu

entry.summary: Constructs DraDDP, the first publicly available English multimodal multi-party dialogue discourse parsing dataset built from TV dramas, with 495 segments, 6,374 utterances, and parallel video, plus benchmarks analyzing modality impact. Extends discourse parsing beyond text-only two-party settings.

entry.title: When Jokes Cross the Line: Analyzing Regular Humor and Dark Humor in YouTube Shorts

author.name: Sydney Johns, Sanjeev Parthasarathy, Shantnu Bhalla, Vaibhav Garg

entry.summary: Introduces TwistedHumor, a dataset of 1,211 YouTube Shorts with 33,041 comments annotated for humor presence, type, harm, and rhetorical devices, and presents a multi-view analysis finding dark humor frequently occupies a gray area of allowed but potentially harmful content. Uses concept induction over descriptions.

entry.title: Flow-Based Generative Modeling for Optimizing Sampling Policies in Compressed Sensing Applications

author.name: Roman Pavelkin, Luis A. Zavala-Mondragon, Christiaan G. A. Viviers, Fons van der Sommen

entry.summary: Presents a task-aware flow-based generative framework reformulating Flow Matching to optimize subsampling policies in compressed sensing, training a flow model to learn measurement operators that improve reconstruction under tight constraints. A proof-of-concept for signal/medical imaging.

entry.title: SpikeWFM: Spiking-Aided Wireless Foundation Model for Robust Channel Prediction

author.name: Liwen Jing, Yisha Lu, Tingting Yang, Li Sun, Yuxuan Shi, Yuwei Wang, Mengfan Zheng, Leiyang Xu

entry.summary: Introduces SpikeWFM, a hybrid architecture integrating spiking neural networks with transformers for wireless foundation models, aiming for noise-robust, energy-efficient channel prediction. It uses self-supervised pretraining across diverse wireless environments.

entry.title: Beyond Augmentation: Score-Guided Pathological Prior for EEG-based Depression Detection

author.name: Xiaojing Chen, Jingqi Cheng, Xu Zhao, Wan Jiang, Jingjing Wu

entry.summary: Proposes Score-Guided Classification (SGC) for EEG-based depression detection that, rather than synthesizing data, uses an unsupervised generative network to model sample anomaly degrees as a pathological prior. It challenges the data-quantity-first convention to address the small-sample dilemma.

entry.title: How Generation Architecture Shapes Code Complexity in Multi-Agent LLM Systems: A Paired Study on HumanEval

author.name: Nazmus Ashrafi

entry.summary: Studies how multi-agent LLM code generation architectures (analyst, coder, tester, debugger pipelines) affect structural code complexity beyond functional correctness, comparing six configurations across all 164 HumanEval tasks with RADON metrics. Examines which orchestration layers carry the complexity cost.

entry.title: Beyond the Mouth: Upper-Face Affective Cues in Audiovisual Sentence Recognition under Acoustic Uncertainty

author.name: Zhou Yang, Yueyi Yang

entry.summary: This study investigates whether upper-face affective cues contribute to audiovisual sentence recognition beyond audio and mouth cues, especially under acoustic degradation, using the CREMA-D corpus. It compares classifiers across audio-only, audio-plus-mouth, and additional cue conditions.

entry.title: ProductWebGen: Benchmarking Multimodal Product Webpage Generation

author.name: Zhihong Liu, Siqi Kou, Zheng Li, Ye Ma, Quan Chen, Peng Jiang, Kai Yu, Zhijie Deng

entry.summary: Introduces a benchmark for generating product display webpages from source images and layout instructions, evaluating multimodal generative models on visual consistency and instruction following. Targets e-commerce and marketing applications.

entry.title: Hybrid Imbalanced Regression Through Unified Data-Level and Algorithm-Level Balancing

author.name: Shermin Shahbazi, Hossein Mohammadi, Mohsen Afsharchi

entry.summary: Proposes a unified hybrid framework for imbalanced regression integrating data-level and algorithm-level balancing in a regressor-agnostic pipeline with adaptive bin partitioning. Addresses the underexplored problem of rare-but-important target values in regression.

entry.title: Beyond Access: Guided LLM Scaffolding for Independent Learning in Undergraduate Statistics

author.name: Mohammad Amanlou, Yasaman Amou-Jafari, Mehrad Livian, Fatemeh Boloukazari, Fereshte Bagheri, Behnam Bahrak

entry.summary: A quasi-experimental study examining whether guided LLM use in an undergraduate statistics course supports reasoning versus enabling task completion, comparing no-access, unrestricted, and guided conditions. Focuses on the gap between assigned access and actual interaction quality.

entry.title: Physics-Guided Attention in a Lightweight TCN for Efficient WiFi CSI-Based Human Activity Recognition

author.name: Chinthaka Ranasingha, Tharindu Fernando, Sridha Sridharan, Clinton Fookes, Harshala Gammulle

entry.summary: This paper proposes a compact temporal convolutional network with physics-guided attention for WiFi CSI-based human activity recognition, incorporating motion-aware inductive biases for efficiency. It argues against deep computationally intensive architectures.

entry.title: Collaborative Space Object Detection with Multi-Satellite Viewpoints in LEO Constellations

author.name: Xingyu Qu, Wenxuan Zhang, Peng Hu

entry.summary: This work investigates multi-satellite collaborative space object detection in LEO constellations, designing a multi-view pipeline and input representations for YOLO-based detectors under onboard constraints. It shows multi-view fusion enhances detection feasibility.

entry.title: Rank-Constrained Deep Matrix Completion for Group Recommendation

author.name: Mubaraka Sani Ibrahim, Lehel Csat\'o, Isah Charles Saidu

entry.summary: Group RC-DMC extends rank-constrained deep matrix completion to group recommendation, integrating group-level representation learning via a Set-Transformer aggregator with low-rank structure and attention-based modeling. It handles high-dimensional sparse rating data better than pure aggregation methods.

entry.title: CityTrajBench: A Unified Benchmark for City-Scale Vehicle Trajectory Generation

author.name: Shibo Zhu, Xiaodan Shi, Dayin Chen, Yuntian Chen, Haoran Zhang, Tianhao Wu, Jinyue Yan

entry.summary: Presents CityTrajBench, a unified benchmark and protocol standardizing data ingestion, trajectory normalization, features, and metrics for city-scale vehicle trajectory generation. Addresses fragmentation that makes cross-method comparison unreliable.

entry.title: Longitudinal Multimodal Sensing of Physical Activity and Well-Being in Older Adults

author.name: Flavio Di Martino, Mattia G. Campana, Marcello Magno, Lorenza Pratali, Franca Delmastro

entry.summary: Presents a longitudinal multimodal study of 66 older adults combining wearable sensing, behavioral monitoring, and clinical assessments in real-world conditions. Investigates how alignment between sensed signals and clinically derived targets affects predictive performance across health tasks.

entry.title: An Exploratory Study into using Machine-Learning for Fast Step-by-step Emulation of Numerical Mechanical Thrombectomy Simulations for Ischemic Stroke

author.name: Thijs Stessen (University of Amsterdam)

entry.summary: An exploratory study training ML surrogates to emulate numerical mechanical thrombectomy simulations step-by-step for ischemic stroke, enabling faster treatment-decision support. Tests three surrogate models on simplified aspiration simulations.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Calibrated Diffusion for Reliable 3D Molecular Graph Generation

author.name: Fang Wan, Jingxiang Qu, Yi Liu

entry.summary: This work analyzes how epistemic uncertainty from the learned denoiser interacts with aleatoric uncertainty in diffusion-based 3D molecular graph generation, causing variance inflation. It proposes uncertainty-calibrated diffusion to improve reliability under chemical constraints.

entry.title: Flow-Transformed Implicit Processes for Function-Space Variational Inference

author.name: Luis A. Ortega, Andr\'es R. Masegosa, Thomas D. Nielsen

entry.summary: This work proposes flow-transformed implicit processes for function-space variational inference, replacing Gaussian variational distributions over combination weights with normalizing-flow transformations. This captures asymmetric posterior uncertainty shapes.

entry.title: Beyond $\ell_2$-norm and $\ell_\infty$-norm: A Curvature-Inspired $\ell_p$-Norm Scheme for Deep Neural Networks

author.name: Jianhao Xu, Zhuang Yang

entry.summary: This paper introduces a curvature-inspired l_p-norm optimization scheme for DNNs that adapts between l_2 and l_infinity behavior to handle curvature anisotropy that changes during training. It targets faster convergence by adapting to early high-anisotropy and later flatter regimes.

entry.title: Network Learning with Semi-relaxed Gromov-Wasserstein

author.name: Charles Dufour, Ulysse Naepels, Leonardo V. Santoro

entry.summary: This work formulates network generative-structure estimation as a semi-relaxed Gromov-Wasserstein objective with probabilistic couplings, solved via block-coordinate conditional gradient. Despite relaxation, the resulting solutions are typically deterministic.

entry.title: Modeling Robotics Dataset Construction as an Artifact-Based Build Process

author.name: Leon Pohl, Lukas Beer, George Sebastian, Mirko Maehlisch

entry.summary: Models robotics dataset construction as an artifact-based build process over a dependency graph, implemented as Bagzel, a Bazel extension for reproducible incremental dataset generation. Reports large runtime speedups in iterative workflows over sequential baselines.

entry.title: KISS: Keeping it Simple and Slotted when Learning to Communicate over Wireless

author.name: Kamil Szczech, Maksymilian Wojnar, Krzysztof Rusek, Katarzyna Kosek-Szott, Szymon Szott

entry.summary: Investigates whether off-policy multi-agent RL can autonomously discover efficient and fair random channel access strategies in wireless networks under minimal assumptions. Aims to gain MAC design insights rather than propose a deployable protocol.

entry.title: On Median of Incomplete U-Statistics

author.name: Nong Minh Hieu

entry.summary: Establishes finite-sample concentration rates for the Median-of-Incomplete-U-Statistics, a robust efficient estimator for expectations of symmetric kernels. Contributes to robust estimation theory.

entry.title: Context-aware child-directed speech detection from long-form recordings

author.name: Th\'eo Charlot, Tarek Kunze, Kaveri K. Sheth, Alejandrina Cristia, Marvin Lavechin

entry.summary: Develops context-aware detection of child-directed speech from long-form multilingual recordings of 182 children, showing in-domain self-supervised pretraining and surrounding context substantially improve classification. It supports scalable analysis of children's language environments.

entry.title: Real-Time Physics Simulation with Dynamic Mesh-Gaussian Reconstructions

author.name: Adrian Ramlal, John S. Zelek

entry.summary: This work proposes a dual-representation framework combining fixed-topology meshes for physics with Gaussian splatting for rendering, enabling real-time physics simulation of dynamic 3D reconstructions. It achieves a 4.65x speedup over varying-topology baselines via runtime vertex buffer updates.

entry.title: An explainable hierarchical self attention-based approach for tremor detection in the time domain

author.name: Timothy Odonga, Jeanne M. Powell, Mark Saad, Richa Tripathi, Christine D. Esper, Stewart A. Factor, Hyeokhyen Kwon, J. Lucas Mckay

entry.summary: This work presents an explainable two-stage hierarchical framework for tremor detection that learns directly from 3D kinematic time-series in the time domain, combining CNN-LSTM segment representations with a vision-transformer aggregator. It targets Parkinson's and essential tremor diagnosis without relying on hand-crafted frequency features.

entry.title: Wavelet-Fusion Diffusion Model for Multimodal Brain MRI Synthesis with Modality and Metadata Conditioning

author.name: Muhammad Nabi Yasinzai, Remika Mito, Mangor Pedersen

entry.summary: A wavelet-fusion diffusion model synthesizes missing brain MRI modalities conditioned on modality type and metadata, addressing uneven modality coverage across neuroimaging datasets. It aims to balance datasets for downstream AI applications.

entry.title: CoSTL: Comprehensive Spatial-Temporal Representation Learning for Moment Retrieval and Highlight Detection

author.name: Xin Dong, Wenjia Geng, Wenfeng Deng, Yansong Tang

entry.summary: CoSTL is a comprehensive spatial-temporal representation learning framework for video moment retrieval and highlight detection that incorporates frame-level visual information related to text queries, which prior temporal-focused methods neglect. It aims for more accurate grounding.

entry.title: Reusing Fusion-Time Spectral Reliability for Adaptive Fusion and Expert Routing in RGB-Infrared Object Detection

author.name: Yefeng Wu

entry.summary: This work extracts a parameter-free 7-dimensional spectral reliability descriptor during RGB-infrared fusion and reuses it to drive both adaptive spectral fusion and reliability-conditioned expert routing. It improves mAP by making downstream modules aware of fusion reliability.

entry.title: CanonCGT: Reference-Based Color Grading via Canonical Pivot Representation

author.name: Jinwon Ko, Keunsoo Ko, Chang-Su Kim

entry.summary: CanonCGT performs reference-based color grading via a style-neutral canonical pivot representation, first removing intrinsic tonal bias then color-grading to match the reference, trained with a dual-phase supervised-plus-self-supervised scheme. It produces stable, photorealistic tone mappings.

entry.title: Contrastive Augmented Transformer with Domain-specific Enhancement for Robust Multi-scenario Metal Surface Defect Detection

author.name: Yiyao Liua, Wenxiao He, Liyuan Ren, Huan Wang

entry.summary: Presents a Contrastive Augmented Transformer with a Swin backbone and redesigned feature pyramid for robust multi-scenario metal surface defect detection, plus domain-specific droplet augmentation for noise robustness. Targets limited annotation and subtle multi-scale defects.

entry.title: DisFlow: Scene Flow from Distance Field for Object Pose, Velocity Tracking, and Dynamic Object Reconstruction

author.name: Lan Wu, Sheila Sutjipto, Jennifer Wakulicz, Teresa Vidal-Calleja

entry.summary: DisFlow estimates scene flow from a distance field built on Gaussian Process Implicit Surfaces, enabling 6DoF dynamic object pose estimation, velocity tracking, and surface reconstruction online. It unifies several perception tasks within a single uncertainty-aware representation, which is useful for manipulation and dynamic scene understanding.

entry.title: We Need Breadth-First AI Safety Plans

author.name: MichaelDickens

entry.summary: This post argues AI safety needs breadth-first plans that prepare for many possible scenarios rather than depth-first plans that assume a specific chain of conditions, critiquing Google's 2025 safety plan for assuming no discontinuous capability jumps. It highlights the fragility of plans depending on chained assumptions.

entry.title: Geodesic Flow Matching for Denoising High-Dimensional Structured Representations

author.name: Karim Habashy, Chris Eliasmith

entry.summary: This paper applies Geodesic Flow Matching to denoise Spatial Semantic Pointers in Vector Symbolic Algebras, showing that Euclidean flow matching cuts through the toroidal manifold and destroys decoding-relevant phase structure. Riemannian transport respects the geometric constraints of valid states.

entry.title: TravelEval: A Comprehensive Benchmarking Framework for Evaluating LLM-Powered Travel Planning Agents

author.name: Weiyi Chen, Shuaixiong Wang, Ziyun Gao, Kaichun Hu, Wangze Ni, Shimin Di, Chen Jason Zhang, Lei Chen

entry.summary: TravelEval is a realistic benchmark for LLM-powered travel planning agents featuring a six-dimensional evaluation framework that goes beyond constraint compliance to assess spatio-temporal cost, accuracy, and whole-plan quality including accommodation and pacing. It addresses authenticity and coverage gaps in prior benchmarks.

entry.title: MOC: Multi-Order Communication in LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Yao Guan, Lin Wang, Zhihu Lu, Ziyi Wang, Wenzhu Yan, Qiang Duan

entry.summary: MOC reconstructs inter-agent communication in LLM multi-agent systems to capture multi-hop dependencies and consolidate messages efficiently, addressing the underexplored problem of how messages are transmitted rather than just topology. It tackles dilution of insights over multi-hop paths.

entry.title: Toward Robust In-Context Learning: Leveraging Out-of-distribution Proxies for Target Inaccessible Demonstration Retrieval

author.name: Hao Xu, Rite Bo, Fausto Giunchiglia, Yingji Li, Rui Song

entry.summary: Proposes DOPA, a demonstration retrieval framework using an out-of-distribution proxy to approximate inaccessible target domains and guide in-context learning demonstration selection under severe distribution shift. Addresses robustness when the target domain is unavailable.

entry.title: Tracing GenAI Literacy: Uncovering Student-AI Interaction Patterns in Academic Writing through Epistemic Network Analysis

author.name: Angxuan Chen, Jiyou Jia

entry.summary: Uses Epistemic Network Analysis on interaction logs from 162 students in a GenAI-assisted writing task to model questioning strategies by literacy level, finding high-literacy students engage in iterative refinement while low-literacy students rely on direct generation. Moves beyond self-report scales.

entry.title: Generative AI and Digital Ecosystem Resilience: A Proactive Lifecycle-Based Survey

author.name: Jonghyun Chung, Rishabh Chaddha, Sanket Badhe, Debanshu Das, Nathan Huang, Amanpreet Kaur

entry.summary: Surveys the shift from reactive to proactive detection of AI-generated inauthentic narratives, proposing a lifecycle-based C5 Interaction Model taxonomy (Context, Causes, Content, Cycle of Amplification, Consequences). It integrates machine learning and social science perspectives on digital ecosystem resilience.

entry.title: Regime-Adaptive Continual Learning for Portfolio Management

author.name: Chaofan Pan, Lingfei Ren, Linbo Xiong, Yonghao Li, Wei Wei, Xin Yang

entry.summary: Proposes ReCAP, a regime-aware continual learning framework for portfolio management that accumulates and transfers knowledge across market regimes to handle non-stationarity. It addresses limitations of rolling-window retraining and naive online fine-tuning.

entry.title: DiffCrossGait: Trajectory-Level Alignment for 2D-3D Cross-Modal Gait Recognition via Latent Diffusion

author.name: Zhiyang Lu, Ming Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes DiffCrossGait, reformulating cross-modal 2D-3D gait recognition as trajectory-level alignment in a latent diffusion space using shared Gaussian noise. A Tri-Phase Alignment Strategy enforces identity anchoring, dynamics consistency, and structural recoverability.

entry.title: Agentic Authoring of Interactive Multiview Visualizations in Genomics

author.name: Astrid van den Brandt, Kiroong Choe, Sehi L'Yi, Devin Lange, Nils Gehlenborg

entry.summary: Presents an agentic LLM approach for authoring interactive multiview genomics visualizations through natural-language conversational interfaces, aiming to democratize complex visualization creation for users lacking expertise. It addresses genomics-specific challenges in integrating heterogeneous data views.

entry.title: Bayesian Inference of Nonlinear Malaria Dynamics in Ghana via an Ensemble Markov Chain Monte Carlo Sampler

author.name: T. Ansah-Narh, Y. Asare Afrane, J. Bremang Tandoh

entry.summary: This study develops a Bayesian nonlinear inference framework with a cubic baseline and damped oscillatory kernel, estimated via ensemble MCMC, to model age-specific malaria admission dynamics in Ghana with credible uncertainty bounds. It addresses short, noisy surveillance records.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Deep Learning for Entropy Prediction in Heterogeneous Systems: Thermodynamic and Information-Theoretic Case Studies

author.name: Biswajeet Sahoo, Debadutta Patra

entry.summary: Introduces a unified physics-informed deep learning framework enforcing both differential equation residuals and information-theoretic bounds for entropy prediction across thermodynamic and information systems. Aims at domain-invariant entropy representations.

entry.title: DeepIPCv3: Event-Aware Multi-Modal Sensor Fusion for Sudden Pedestrian Crossing Avoidance

author.name: Oskar Natan, Andi Dharmawan, Aufaclav Zatu Kusuma Frisky, Jazi Eko Istiyanto, Jun Miura

entry.summary: Proposes a physics-informed active learning framework for optimizing GaN tri-gate FinFET designs for vertical power delivery, replacing computationally intensive TCAD with ML-guided simulation. Efficiently explores key structural parameters like the GaN-to-AlGaN thickness ratio.

entry.title: A Framework for Graph-Conditioned Hierarchical Shapley Attribution in Patent Valuation

author.name: Joy Bose

entry.summary: PatentXAI treats patent valuation as explainable AI, computing Shapley values for individual patents within products embodying thousands of patents. It restricts coalitions to Markov Blankets in a knowledge graph for tractability and scales experiments to 100 patents.

entry.title: RPCASSM: Robust PCA State Space Model For Infrared Small Target Detection

author.name: Pingping Liu, Aohua Li, Yubing Lu, Jin Kuang, Tongshun Zhang, Qiuzhan Zhou

entry.summary: RPCASSM proposes an infrared small target detection network based on robust PCA, with separate background and target state space modules. It addresses the inefficiency of mainstream visual state space models for tiny, low-occupancy targets.

entry.title: KliniskVestBERT: BERT Model Specialised to Norwegian Clinical Texts

author.name: Christian Autenried, Cosimo Persia

entry.summary: KliniskVestBERT is a suite of three BERT-based encoders pretrained on de-identified Norwegian clinical texts covering discharge summaries, surgical reports, and nursing notes in both bokmal and nynorsk. It continues pretraining existing Norwegian and ModernBERT models on specialized clinical data.

entry.title: Gate the Filter, Not the Message: Node-Channel Mixtures for Pre-Propagation GNNs

author.name: Zichao Yue, Zhiru Zhang

entry.summary: This paper revisits pre-propagation GNNs through a graph-filter perspective, finding MLP aggregators learn channel-dependent node-shared filters that explain why simpler aggregators match hop-attention. It proposes node-channel mixtures gating filters rather than messages.

entry.title: G2LoRA: Gradient Orthogonal Low-Rank Adaptation Framework for Graph Continual Learning on Text-Attributed Graphs

author.name: Yuhan Wang, Yibo Ding, Yutong Ye, Mufan Zhao, Wenbo Zhang, Ruijie Wang, Jianxin Li

entry.summary: G2LoRA is a gradient-orthogonal low-rank adaptation framework for graph continual learning on text-attributed graphs, addressing catastrophic forgetting in sequentially fine-tuned LLM-as-Aligner models. It mitigates task interference while promoting positive transfer.

entry.title: A Closer Look at In-Distribution vs. Out-of-Distribution Accuracy for Open-Set Test-time Adaptation

author.name: Zefeng Li, Evan Shelhamer

entry.summary: This paper benchmarks open-set test-time adaptation methods (SAR, OSTTA, UniEnt, SoTTA) on corruption benchmarks, focusing on the underexplored ability to detect out-of-distribution unknown classes rather than just in-distribution accuracy. It reveals a trade-off between InD accuracy and OOD detection.

entry.title: Realistic noise synthesis reduces bias and improves tissue microstructure estimation with supervised machine learning

author.name: Bradley G. Karat, Ma\"eliss Jallais, Ali R. Khan, Santiago Aja-Fern\'andez, Jelle Veraart, Marco Palombo

entry.summary: This work proposes realistic noise synthesis incorporating Rician expectation and post-processing noise variance into simulated diffusion MRI training data, reducing covariate shift between training and inference. It improves tissue microstructure parameter estimation in supervised ML.

entry.title: Hybrid Neural Ordinary Differential Equations for Data-Efficient Polymerization Modeling with Incomplete Kinetics

author.name: Marah Almanasreh, Alexander Mitsos, Eike Cramer

entry.summary: This work proposes a hybrid Neural ODE framework for data-efficient free-radical polymerization modeling that retains mechanistic mass balances explicitly and learns only the partially characterized effective radical concentration. It uses MMA polymerization as a case study.

entry.title: Closing the Alignment-Maturity Gap in Federated Prototype Learning

author.name: Mario Casado-Diez, Alejandro Dopico-Castro, Ver\'onica Bol\'on-Canedo, Bertha Guijarro-Berdi\~nas

entry.summary: FedSAP addresses an alignment-maturity gap in federated prototype learning, where alignment pressure on immature global prototypes during early rounds suppresses local discriminative structure. It stabilizes federated representation learning under severe non-IID conditions.

entry.title: LastAct: Trajectory-Guided Latest-Activity Localization for Real-Time Smart-Home Activity Recognition

author.name: Zishuai Liu, Ruili Fang, Jin Lu, Fei Dou

entry.summary: Introduces LastAct, a trajectory-centric framework for streaming smart-home activity recognition that targets the most recent activity in mixed sliding windows and models spatial sensor context. Addresses boundary contamination in realistic ambient sensor deployments.

entry.title: KDH-CAD: Knowledge-data hybrid CAD learning under data scarcity

author.name: Ziqin Gao, Zhijie Yang, Qiang Zou

entry.summary: Presents IstGPT, an LLM-plus-graph-learning tool for real-time anomaly detection in industrial control systems, modeling spatial-temporal sensor-actuator dependencies using multimodal industrial knowledge. It targets ICS cyberattack detection.

entry.title: FlatVPR: Plug-and-play Geo-linear Residual Adapter for Geometric Rectification of Foundation Model Feature Manifolds

author.name: Rai Hisada, Kanji Tanaka

entry.summary: Introduces FlatVPR, a plug-and-play geo-linear residual adapter that rectifies foundation-model feature manifolds so that descriptors interpolate linearly between anchors. It improves the map-lightweightness versus accuracy tradeoff in visual place recognition.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Graph Neural Reconstruction of Urban Temperature Fields from Sparse Sensors under Deployment Constraints

author.name: Reda Snaiki, Abdelatif Merabtine

entry.summary: Proposes an uncertainty-aware graph neural network to reconstruct daily maximum urban temperature fields from sparse sensors under spacing and budget constraints, predicting both fields and spatially varying uncertainty via Gaussian negative log-likelihood. It also optimizes sensor placement using proper orthogonal decomposition.

entry.title: FigSIM: A Dataset for Fine-grained Suicide Severity and Figurative Language in Suicide Memes

author.name: Liuliu Chen, Elise R. Carrotte, Brian E. Chapman, Jo Robinson, Mike Conway

entry.summary: FigSIM is the first dataset for fine-grained analysis of suicide memes, with 1049 memes annotated for suicide severity levels and figurative language. It aims to support content moderation strategies for harmful social media content.

entry.title: The Harsh Truth: Segment-Level Analysis of Harsh Driving Events in Milan Using Large-Scale Telematics, Street Networks, and Google Street View

author.name: Andrea La Grotteria, Paolo Santi, Titus Venverloo, Umberto Fugiglando, Carlo Ratti

entry.summary: This study analyzes harsh driving events (acceleration/braking as crash surrogates) across Milan's road network by fusing telematics from 4.2M vehicles with street-network attributes and Google Street View streetscape features via semantic segmentation. It enables fine-grained urban road-safety intervention design.

entry.title: TAP-JEPA: Frozen Future-Latent Probing and Two-Stage Score Fusion for EPIC-KITCHENS-100 Action Anticipation

author.name: Chaoyang Wang, Lexuan Xu

entry.summary: TAP-JEPA is a competition runner-up for the EPIC-KITCHENS-100 action anticipation challenge that builds a compact anticipation model on frozen V-JEPA 2.1 features, using the pretrained latent predictor to estimate near-future tokens fused with attentive task-specific probes. It avoids fine-tuning a large video backbone.

entry.title: DINO-GFSA: Geo-Localization via Semantic Gated Fusion and Mamba-based Sequential Aggregation

author.name: Beier Hu, Yuanshen Guo, Jialu Cai, Chengwei Li, Yong Wang, Shunan Wu, Zhigang Wu

entry.summary: DINO-GFSA addresses cross-view geo-localization for UAVs using a LoRA-adapted DINOv3 backbone, a semantic gated residual fusion module, and a Mamba-based sequential aggregation head. It targets GNSS-denied self-positioning.

entry.title: hZACH-ViT: Curved Latent Geometry for Compact Vision Transformers in Low-Data Medical Imaging

author.name: Athanasios Angelakis

entry.summary: hZACH-ViT extends a compact zero-token Vision Transformer with curved latent geometries (hyperbolic, spherical) for low-data medical imaging, comparing Euclidean, Poincare, Klein, and spherical representation spaces in a controlled setup. It isolates the role of latent geometry.

entry.title: Deformable Wiener Filter for Future Video Coding

author.name: Xuewei Meng, Chuanmin Jia, Xinfeng Zhang, Shanshe Wang, Siwei Ma

entry.summary: This work proposes a Deformable Wiener Filter as an in-loop filter for future video coding, combining local and non-local sample characteristics with supervised Wiener-theory-based coefficient training. It overcomes the performance limits of unsupervised non-local filter parameter estimation in VVC.

entry.title: Co-training with Ego-centric Video and Demonstration for Robot Navigation Task

author.name: Shoya Kuno, Yumo Ouchi, Kanata Suzuki

entry.summary: This work converts egocentric human walking videos into training data for mobile robot navigation by estimating camera motion and mapping it to robot action representations. Co-training a VLA model on human-derived and demonstration data helps address the data scarcity of navigation tasks.

entry.title: IMAC-AgriVLN: Can Agricultural Vision-and-Language Navigation Agents be Aware of Instruction Mistakes?

author.name: Xiaobei Zhao, Xingqi Lyu, Xin Chen, Xiang Li

entry.summary: IMAC-AgriVLN extends agricultural vision-and-language navigation to handle erroneous instructions via the A2A-MI benchmark that injects three types of instruction mistakes. It tests whether navigation agents can detect and recover from incorrect human instructions in realistic farm settings.

entry.title: Model-Native Computing Architecture: Envisioning Future System Architecture Through the Lens of Computer Architecture

author.name: Hai Lin

entry.summary: This visionary survey maps classical computer architecture concepts onto an emerging model-native stack, framing recurring agent engineering problems like caching, context management, and scheduling as analogues of OS and systems problems. It reviews LLM-as-OS, memory management, agent frameworks, and safety governance.

entry.title: PropLLM: Propagation-Aware Scene Reconstruction for Network Fault Diagnosis

author.name: Zongzong Wu, Ming Zhao, Fengxiao Tang, Nei Kato

entry.summary: PropLLM integrates hop-by-hop scene reconstruction with LLM generative reasoning for network fault diagnosis, tracing back from end-point alerts along propagation chains rather than mapping alerts to diagnoses in a single pass. This resolves end-point ambiguity where distinct root causes produce similar symptoms.

entry.title: Deft Scheduling of Dynamic Cloud Workflows with Varying Deadlines via Mixture-of-Experts

author.name: Ya Shen, Gang Chen, Hui Ma, Mengjie Zhang

entry.summary: DEFT applies a deadline-perceptive Mixture-of-Experts deep RL architecture to dynamic cloud workflow scheduling, with experts specialized for different deadline tightness levels. It claims to be the first MoE-based DRL scheduler for this domain.

entry.title: Motif-based morphology signatures for interpretable ECG screening and monitoring

author.name: Nivedita Bijlani, Mauricio Villarroel

entry.summary: Introduces a motif-based framework for interpretable ECG screening that defines beat-aligned cardiac signatures and quantifies morphological drift over short and long-term monitoring. It aims to detect subtle progressive changes that manual interpretation may miss.

entry.title: Multimodal Music Recommendation System using LLMs

author.name: Srikar Prabhas Kandagatla, Sreehitha R. Narayana, Chandana Magapu, Swetha Mohan, Shamanth Kuthpadi, Hongjie Chen, Ryan A. Rossi, Franck Dernoncourt, Nesreen Ahmed

entry.summary: Proposes a multimodal LLM-based session music recommendation framework enriching LastFM-1K with audio, lyric, and engagement signals for unified sequential reasoning. It grounds recommendations in actual song content rather than treating songs as opaque tokens.

entry.title: Digital-to-Physical Transfer of Adversarial Patches for Aerial Vehicle Detection

author.name: Jung Heum Woo, Eun-Kyu Lee

entry.summary: Evaluates physical adversarial patch attacks against aerial vehicle detectors by bridging digital optimization with real-world printing, using non-printability and total-variation constraints. It assesses the digital-to-physical transfer of attacks on aerial/satellite imagery detectors.

entry.title: DRL-Based Pose Control for Double-Ackermann Robots Under Actuation Uncertainties

author.name: Oussama Zaim, M\'elodie Daniel, Aly Magassouba, Miguel Aranda, Olivier Ly

entry.summary: Extends the ManeuverNet DRL framework from position to full pose control for double-Ackermann-steering robots, investigating sim-to-real transfer under actuation uncertainties. Shows simplified actuation models during training cause poor generalization, with success dropping from 100% in simulation to 25% in Gazebo.

entry.title: Hybrid Probabilistic Forecasting of Under-Five Malaria Admissions in Ghana: A Gaussian Process Regression with Holt-Winters Smoothing

author.name: T. Ansah-Narh, Y. Asare Afrane, J. Bremang Tandoh

entry.summary: This study proposes a hybrid forecasting framework combining Gaussian Process Regression with Holt-Winters smoothing for under-five malaria admissions in Ghana, where GPR captures nonlinearity and uncertainty while Holt-Winters preserves seasonality. It uses ten years of district-level data.

entry.title: Cross-Axis Feature Fusion with Joint-Wise Motion Difference Prediction for Text-Based 3D Human Motion Editing

author.name: Gyojin Han, Junmo Kim

entry.summary: Addresses text-based 3D human motion editing with a cross-axis feature fusion architecture that learns both when edits occur and which joints are responsible. Uses joint-wise motion difference prediction as an auxiliary task.

entry.title: AMP: A Vendor-Neutral Wire Format for Agent Memory Operations

author.name: Thamilvendhan Munirathinam

entry.summary: Presents memorywire, a vendor-neutral JSON-Schema wire format for agent memory operations (remember, recall, forget, merge, expire) across semantic, episodic, procedural, and emotional memory types. Includes a reference implementation with multiple backend adapters and optional human-in-the-loop governance.

entry.title: Digital Twin-Assisted Adaptive Multi-Agent DRL for Intelligent Spectrum and Resource Management in Open-RAN UAV-Enabled 6G Networks

author.name: Marwan Dhuheir, Thang X. Vu, Symeon Chatzinotas

entry.summary: Proposes a digital-twin-assisted adaptive multi-agent DRL framework for spectrum sharing and resource allocation in Open-RAN UAV-enabled 6G networks. Addresses nonlinear interactions, mobility-induced topology changes, and latency/energy constraints.

entry.title: Agent Operating Systems (AOS): Integrating Agentic Control Planes into, and Beyond, Traditional Operating Systems

author.name: Ankur Sharma, Deep Shah

entry.summary: This conceptual paper proposes an Agent Operating System (AOS) that integrates agentic control planes into traditional OS abstractions, arguing that probabilistic, long-lived agents stress scheduling, memory, security, and governance boundaries. It outlines a systems architecture for managing agentic execution.

entry.title: ProbeScale: Probing Analysis to Optimize Neural Scaling Laws for Efficient Small Language Model Inference

author.name: Sourav Das

entry.summary: ProbeScale unifies neural scaling laws with probing analysis to identify parameter-efficient subnetworks within pretrained small language models. It uses task-specific probes to quantify each layer's relevance for efficient inference under resource constraints.

entry.title: MASER: Modality-Adaptive Specialist Routing for Embodied 3D Spatial Intelligence

author.name: Hilton Raj, Vishnuram AV

entry.summary: Proposes MASER, a modality-adaptive specialist routing framework for embodied 3D spatial QA that trains five modality adapters over a shared VLM and learns a routing policy to select the best modality per question. Addresses the limitation of single-modality fine-tuning ignoring question semantics.

entry.title: AdaKernel: Learning Adaptive Kernel Parameters for Spatiotemporal Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Zhongyue Zhang, Guangyin Jin, Yuxuan Liang, Suwan Yin, Yuankai Wu

entry.summary: AdaKernel learns adaptive kernel parameters within spatiotemporal GNNs, proving theoretically that misspecified kernels introduce unavoidable approximation errors. It aims to combine the geometric structure of distance-based kernels with the flexibility of adaptive mechanisms, especially for data-sparse settings.

entry.title: FAiT: Frequency-Aware Inverted Transformer for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Peng He, Yao Liu, Yanglei Gan, Run Lin, Yuxiang Cai, Qiao Liu

entry.summary: FAiT is a frequency-aware inverted transformer for multivariate time series forecasting that addresses self-attention's low-pass filtering bias with time-varying spectral modulation. It captures evolving spectral characteristics rather than assuming a time-invariant frequency response.

entry.title: Segment-driven Structural Induction and Semantic Alignment for Heterogeneous Tabular Representation

author.name: Woojun Jung, Susik Yoon

entry.summary: NAVI is a segment-centric pretraining framework treating each header-value pair as a unit to aggregate schema-level structure and column-level distributions across heterogeneous tables. It uses masked segment modeling and entropy-driven alignment to induce shared semantics from varying headers.

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning for Optimal Experiment Design in Parameter Identification of Mechatronic Systems

author.name: Julian Langschwert, Georg Schaefer, Jakob Rehrl, Stefan Huber, Simon Hirlaender

entry.summary: Uses reinforcement learning to design informative excitation signals for system identification of a mechatronic testbed while enforcing safety constraints via reward shaping. Outperforms classical baselines with minimal safety violations.

entry.title: How (and when) can you fit examples to logic-based hypothesis classes over infinite structures?

author.name: Michael Benedikt, Alessio Mansutti

entry.summary: This theoretical paper studies the computational complexity of fitting problems for logically-defined hypothesis classes over infinite structures like the real ordered field and Presburger arithmetic. It connects learning theory with descriptive complexity and decidability, providing query-language criteria for when a sample is fittable.

entry.title: Spatially Distributed Task-Oriented Compression for Multi-Emitter Localization and Characterization with Spectral Overlap

author.name: H. Nazim Bicer, J. Nick Laneman

entry.summary: Proposes a task-oriented distributed compression framework for joint multi-emitter localization and characterization using spatially distributed receivers. Each receiver encodes IQ samples into compact latents that a permutation-invariant fusion decoder combines to estimate emitter sets.

entry.title: It does what it says on the tin: safe synthetic data from coarsened margins

author.name: Gillian M Raab

entry.summary: Proposes a synthetic-data method based on coarsened margins that offers transparency about which variable relationships are preserved and guarantees the data derives from disclosure-controlled information. It applies statistical disclosure control to defined margins before synthesis.

entry.title: Graph-Augmented Retrieval for Cross-Entity Financial Sentiment Analysis: A Comparative Study

author.name: Rajan Bastakoti, Sagar Bhetwal, Nirajan Acharya, Gaurav Kumar Gupta

entry.summary: Presents a comparative study of a two-hop Graph-RAG architecture versus vector-only RAG for cross-entity financial sentiment analysis, building a sentiment-weighted knowledge graph of equities and augmenting dense retrieval with intensity-filtered graph traversal. It surfaces relational evidence across entities.

entry.title: Challenger at MultiPRIDE: Is It Hate Speech or Reclaimed?

author.name: Hadi Bayrami Asl Tekanlou, Mahdi Bakhtiyarzadeh, Jafar Razmara

entry.summary: This shared-task submission distinguishes genuine hate speech from reclaimed language using dense semantic embeddings, Cleanlab-based label-noise filtering with logistic regression, and an MLP classifier. It targets the context-dependent challenge of reclaimed expressions.

entry.title: Pramana: Fine-Tuning Large Language Models for Epistemic Reasoning through Navya-Nyaya

author.name: Sharath Sathish

entry.summary: Pramana fine-tunes LLMs on Navya-Nyaya, an ancient Indian epistemic logic framework, to teach structured six-phase reasoning aimed at grounding claims in traceable evidence. It targets reducing confident hallucinations and brittle pattern-matching.

entry.title: Structure-Aware Consistency Priors for Shape from Polarization in Complex Media

author.name: Kaimin Yu, Puyun Wang, Huayang He, Xianyu Wu

entry.summary: IceSfP proposes a structure-aware polarization prior based on autocorrelation functions to recover surface normals from single-view polarization images in complex media like ice. It uses a dual-branch network with cross-modal attention and contributes the first real-world ice shape-from-polarization dataset.

entry.title: Response-Aware Multimodal Learning for Post-Treatment Visual Acuity Forecasting

author.name: Phuoc-Nguyen Bui, Van-Vi Vo, Duc-Tai Le, Van-Nguyen Pham, Ki-Young Kim, Seung-Young Yu, Hyunseung Choo

entry.summary: This study assembles a real-world cohort of 188 anti-VEGF-treated diabetic macular edema patients with paired baseline and month-1 OCT scans to forecast multi-timepoint visual acuity trajectories from early observations. It uses response-aware multimodal learning combining OCT imaging and tabular clinical data.

entry.title: Head-Pose-Aware Visual Speech Recognition with FiLM Modulation

author.name: Matthew Kit Khinn Teng, Haibo Zhang, Takeshi Saitoh

entry.summary: HP-VSR-ResFiLM incorporates head-pose information via FiLM modulation into visual speech recognition, using a pose-conditioned encoder followed by a pretrained NLLB language model for phoneme-to-text reconstruction. It targets robustness to non-frontal views.

entry.title: R^3: Composed Video Retrieval via Reasoning-Guided Recalling and Re-ranking

author.name: Zixu Li, Yupeng Hu, Zhiheng Fu, Zhiwei Chen, Weili Guan, Liqiang Nie

entry.summary: R^3 is a zero-shot composed video retrieval method using reasoning-guided recalling and re-ranking, combining scalable embedding-based candidate recall with a pairwise multimodal reranker to verify target-side state changes and temporal consistency. It balances recall scalability with verification accuracy.

entry.title: Edge-directed geometric partitioning for versatile video coding

author.name: Xuewei Meng, Xinfeng Zhang, Chuanmin Jia, Xia Li, Shanshe Wang, Siwei Ma

entry.summary: This work proposes an edge-directed geometric partitioning scheme for Versatile Video Coding that builds a Most Probable Mode list from spatio-temporal edge information to reduce the signaling overhead of GEO mode indices. It exploits correlation between partition modes and object boundaries.

entry.title: Spatio-Temporal Correlation Guided Geometric Partitioning for Versatile Video Coding

author.name: Xuewei Meng, Chuanmin Jia, Xinfeng Zhang, Shanshe Wang, Siwei Ma

entry.summary: Proposes a spatio-temporal correlation guided geometric partitioning scheme for Versatile Video Coding that reduces side-information signaling bits while preserving motion field description. Improves coding efficiency over standard VVC geometric partitioning.

entry.title: Detecting Pen-In-Air States from Video: A Proof-of-Concept Toward Complementary Handwriting Analysis

author.name: Lauren Sismeiro, Remy Plastre, Binbin Xu, Frederic Puyjarinet, Gerard Dray

entry.summary: Investigates detecting pen-in-air states from top-view video as a complementary signal to tablet-based handwriting analysis for assessing developmental disorders like dysgraphia. Uses an interpretable YOLO pen-tip tracking pipeline with kinematic features and ML classification on a pilot dataset.

entry.title: Evolving to the Aesthetics of a Vision-Language Model

author.name: Stephen James Krol, Jon McCormack

entry.summary: Explores two VLM-based methods (CLIP-IQA scoring and pairwise VLM tournaments with Glicko ratings) as fitness functions for evolutionary generation of abstract aesthetic outputs. Addresses the open problem of defining aesthetic fitness.

entry.title: Closed-Form Pose Estimation of Endoluminal Medical Devices via Gradiometer-Based Electromagnetic Localization System

author.name: Zhiwei Wu, Jiahao Luo, Yubo Pu, Siyi Wei, Yuankai Chen, Jinhui Zhang

entry.summary: GELS presents a closed-form electromagnetic localization system for tracking endoluminal medical devices using a compact magnetometer array as a quasi-gradiometer, avoiding pre-calibrated field maps or iterative optimization. It enables 6DoF pose recovery via Procrustes registration for medical navigation.

entry.title: PliableBVS: A flexible Bayesian variable selection method for modeling interactions with mandatory modifying variables

author.name: Theophilus Quachie Asenso, Zhi Zhao, Maren-Helene Langeland Degnes, Marie Cecilie Paasche Roland, Trond Melbye Michelsen, Manuela Zucknick

entry.summary: PliableBVS extends the pliable lasso into a Bayesian variable selection method using spike-and-slab priors to model interactions between high-dimensional features and modifying variables while preserving hierarchical structure. It targets applications like gene-by-clinical-covariate interactions.

entry.title: A Multi-AI-agent Framework Enabling End-to-end Finite Element Analysis for Solid Mechanics Problems

author.name: Titu Ranjan Sarker, Muhammed Jawaad Zulqernine, Ling Yue, Shaowu Pan, Chenxi Wang, Shiyao Lin

entry.summary: AbaqusAgent is a multi-agent LLM framework that converts natural-language instructions into executed finite element analysis using Abaqus, addressing the steep learning curve and error-proneness of FEA setup. It automates case generation and execution for solid mechanics problems.

entry.title: Doing What They Say, Not What They Reason: Locating the Faithfulness Gap in LLM Agents

author.name: Yufeng Wang

entry.summary: This paper studies process fidelity in LLM agents—whether agents act on the reasoning they state—using a Texas Poker simulator with verifiable reference actions, decomposing the faithfulness gap into reasoning-conclusion and conclusion-action steps. It finds these two steps behave oppositely.

entry.title: EnergyMamba: An Uncertainty-Aware Graph-Enhanced Selective State Space Model for Energy Consumption Prediction

author.name: Dahai Yu, Rongchao Xu, Lin Jiang, Guang Wang

entry.summary: EnergyMamba is an uncertainty-aware, graph-enhanced selective state space model for energy consumption prediction that models spatial dependencies among regions and provides calibrated uncertainty under abnormal conditions like extreme weather. It addresses two key limitations of prior time-series-only approaches.

entry.title: Property Prediction of Stacked Bilayer Materials: A Multimodal Learning Approach

author.name: An Vuong, Minh-Hao Van, Chen Zhao, Xintao Wu

entry.summary: This paper proposes a multimodal learning approach to predict properties of stacked bilayer 2D materials, modeling the stacking configuration to enable discovery of new bilayers with novel functions. It addresses the gap in AI methods for modeling bilayer van der Waals stacking despite available databases.

entry.title: TrafficRAG: A Multimodal RAG Framework for Traffic Accident Liability Determination

author.name: Xu Li, Zedong Fu, Xinyi Li, Xun Han

entry.summary: TrafficRAG is a multimodal retrieval-augmented framework for automated traffic accident liability analysis and report generation, using a vision-language model to produce structured scene descriptions as retrieval queries with hybrid retrieval over legal knowledge. It targets efficiency and consistency in legal-assistance workflows.

entry.title: An NLP-Driven Framework for Curriculum-Labor Market Alignment: Schema-Constrained LLM Extraction, ESCO-Anchored Semantic Matching, and Multi-Dimensional Gap Quantification

author.name: Sherzod Turaev, Mary John, Mamoun Awad, Nazar Zaki, Khaled Shuaib

entry.summary: This paper proposes a four-stage NLP framework for curriculum-labor market alignment combining schema-constrained LLM extraction, SBERT-based ESCO-anchored semantic matching, and multi-dimensional gap quantification. It addresses recovery of implicit competencies and taxonomy grounding missing from lexical-surface pipelines.

entry.title: Bridging the Sim-to-Real Gap in Semiconductor Visual Program Synthesis via Input Binarization

author.name: Yusuke Ohtsubo, Kota Dohi, Koichiro Yawata, Koki Takeshita, Tatsuya Sasaki

entry.summary: Proposes a visual program synthesis framework where a VLM converts semiconductor inspection images into editable DSL code for exact geometric control, using input binarization to bridge the sim-to-real gap when models trained on synthetic data process real images. Targets nanometer-scale metrology.

entry.title: Algorithmic Authority and the Clinical Standard of Care

author.name: Aizierjiang Aiersilan

entry.summary: Applies Lessig's Code is Law framework to argue clinical AI architecture already functions as de facto medical regulation, reshaping liability and standard of care, and proposes a dialectical standard treating the AI-physician dyad as the unit of care. Reframes AI hallucination as analogous to human cognitive failures.

entry.title: V2I Work Zone Geometry Reconstruction with Pose-Conditioned UWB Range Denoising

author.name: Jiaxi Liu, Hangyu Li, Yang Cheng, Rui Gana, Junwei You, Weizhe Tang, Peng Zhang, Steven T. Parker, Xiaopeng Li, Bin Ran

entry.summary: Proposes a pose-conditioned, permutation-equivariant denoiser for ultra-wideband V2I ranging to reconstruct work zone geometry for autonomous vehicles. It handles outliers, non-line-of-sight errors, and anchor ordering issues in field deployments.

entry.title: UF-AMA: A unified framework for cross-domain emotion recognition via adaptive multimodal alignment

author.name: Zheng Wang, Shuo Wang, Junhong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes UF-AMA, a unified framework with adaptive multimodal alignment for cross-subject and cross-session emotion recognition from physiological signals like EEG. It addresses distribution shifts and varying sample quality across modalities.

entry.title: MiCU: End-to-End Smart Home Command Understanding with Large Language Model

author.name: Haowei Han, Kexin Hu, Weiwei Cai, Debiao Zhang, Bin Qin, Yuxiang Wang, Jiawei Jiang, Xiao Yan, Bo Du

entry.summary: Builds MiCU, a domain-specific LLM for smart home command understanding that handles ambiguous commands like making a room cozy, using an automated training-data synthesis workflow from user logs. Improves on rule-based systems for misaligned utterances.

entry.title: AI From the Margins (AIM): Rethinking Participatory AI Design Through the Lived Experience of Minoritized Communities

author.name: Tijs Portegies, Laureanne Willems, Maaike Harbers, Giovanni Sileno, Roland van Dierendonck, Mayesha Tasnim, Lotte Willemsen, Sennay Ghebreab

entry.summary: Proposes AI From the Margins, a methodological stance for participatory AI design that articulates preconditions for centering minoritized communities' lived experiences before problem definitions are set. Applied in a Dutch healthcare context.

entry.title: FedMTFI: Feature Importance Based Optimized Multi Teacher Knowledge Distillation in Heterogeneous Federated Learning Environment

author.name: Nazmus Shakib Shadin, Aaron Cummings, Xinyue Zhang, Bobin Deng

entry.summary: FedMTFI combines multi-teacher knowledge distillation with feature importance for heterogeneous federated learning, clustering clients by similarity. It aims to maintain consistent performance across devices with non-IID data and varying compute.

entry.title: Understanding Identity Continuity in Thermal Video through Scene-Level Consistency

author.name: Wei-Chieh Sun, Gyungmin Ko, Heejae Kwon, Hsiang-Wei Huang, Jenq-Neng Hwang

entry.summary: This work studies identity continuity in thermal pedestrian tracking via lightweight post-processing, adding online short-gap remapping and offline tracklet relinking to a YOLOv8/SORT baseline. It improves IDF1 from 82.25 to 84.93 on the PBVS thermal benchmark.

entry.title: Network Distributed Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Consensus Control of Quadcopters

author.name: Youssef Mahran, Zeyad Gamal, Aamir Ahmad, Ayman El-Badawy

entry.summary: Proposes ND-MARL, a network-distributed multi-agent RL framework for quadcopter consensus control where each agent observes only two neighbors and embeds the communication graph into decision-making. Uses Multi-Agent Soft Actor-Critic in a hierarchical planner-controller stack.

entry.title: Feature to Dynamics: Feature-space to Autoregression strategy for Zero-shot Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Yifan Wu, Junjie Wu, Kai Wu, Xiaoyu Zhang, Jian Lou

entry.summary: FSA proposes a feature-to-strategy framework for zero-shot time series forecasting that maps an interpretable feature space to autoregressive strategies rather than directly modeling raw sequences. The goal is better generalization when source and target domains are disjoint or data is scarce.

entry.title: Learning-based Directed Graph Abstraction of Combinatorial Spaces for Order-Preserving Search in Mixed-Combinatorial Nonlinear Optimization

author.name: Gishnu Madhu, Feng Liu, Souma Chowdhury

entry.summary: This paper presents a learned directed-graph abstraction of combinatorial spaces using GNNs for order-preserving search in mixed-combinatorial nonlinear optimization. It avoids spurious relations from integer/binary encodings in engineering design and planning problems.

entry.title: RobustModelMaker: Coupling Bootstrap Stability Selection with Leakage-Safe Nested Cross-Validation for Scientific Machine Learning

author.name: Amanda S Barnard

entry.summary: RobustModelMaker couples bootstrap stability selection with strict nested cross-validation for scientific ML on small datasets, addressing both unstable feature selection and optimistic performance bias jointly. It is provided as a Python framework.

entry.title: Continual Learning as a Multiphase Moving-Boundary Problem

author.name: Snigdha Chandan Khilar

entry.summary: Stefan-CL frames continual learning as a multiphase moving-boundary (Stefan) problem, treating consolidated knowledge as a protected solid and unused capacity as adaptable liquid governed by a latent-heat parameter. It claims near-zero forgetting without storing raw data.

entry.title: Edge-aware Decoding for Neural Asymmetric Routing

author.name: Li Liang, Jinbiao Chen, Zizhen Zhang

entry.summary: This paper proposes an edge-aware decoder for neural asymmetric routing that exposes transition-level quantities matching cost-to-go structure, addressing a representation-decision mismatch where pairwise cost is encoded upstream but final logits use context-node compatibility. It improves directed routing decisions.

entry.title: A Doeblin-Anchored Contrastive Chart for Learning Markov Transition Kernels

author.name: Ao Xu

entry.summary: This paper introduces a Doeblin-anchored contrastive chart for learning valid Markov transition kernels from contrastive objectives, ensuring the learned object is a valid transition kernel before iteration. It mixes the target transition with a restart law to obtain a minorized, invertible coordinate.

entry.title: Spectra-Guided Neural Tucker Factorization

author.name: Fusheng Wang, Yikai Hou

entry.summary: Proposes Spectra-Guided Neural Tucker Factorization for high-dimensional incomplete tensor completion, mapping scalar timestamps into continuous spectral space and using a spatio-temporal co-gating mechanism. Achieves competitive accuracy with parameter efficiency.

entry.title: Autopilot-Preserving Residual Q-Learning with HJB-Inspired Finite-Action Risk Filtering for Fixed-Wing UAV Command Supervision

author.name: Mehmet Iscan, Batuhan Temiz

entry.summary: Proposes a residual Q-learning supervisor that sits above an unchanged fixed-wing UAV autopilot, selecting bounded reference adjustments filtered by an HJB-inspired risk mechanism. It keeps exploration risk away from actuators while improving disturbance rejection.

entry.title: MidSurfNet: Learnable Face Pairing and Interference Implicit Fields for Generalized Mid-surface Abstraction

author.name: Li Ye, Xinhang Zhou, Xingyu Yang, Ruofeng Tong, Hailong Li, Peng Du, Min Tang

entry.summary: Proposes MidSurfNet, a learning-augmented framework for mid-surface abstraction of thin-walled CAD models, using a neural face-pairing module and an interference implicit field to handle multi-thickness and self-matching configurations where rule-based methods fail. It targets finite-element preprocessing.

entry.title: Peacemaker at ATE-IT: Automatic term extraction from Italian text for waste management data using encoder model

author.name: Mahdi Bakhtiyarzadeh, Hadi Bayrami Asl Tekanlou, Jafar Razmara

entry.summary: This shared-task submission presents a low-cost interpretable encoder-based method for automatic term extraction from Italian waste-management text, using fine-tuning strategies for the ATE Shared Task. It addresses challenges of limited annotated data and multi-word expression extraction.

entry.title: Towards Multidisciplinary Summarization of Hospital Stays: Efficient Sentence-Level Clinical Provenance Categorization

author.name: Baris Karacan, Vaibhav Bhargava, Barbara Di Eugenio, Natalie Parde, Mary Khetani, Yu-Shan Tseng, Vanessa Barbosa, Julie Vignato, Lindsey Knake, Rajashree Dahal, Emily Spellman, Danielle Hitzel, Janine Petitgout, Kristi Haughey, Amanda Karstens, Brianna Clarahan, Rachel Dawson, Lauren Boyd, Mackenzie Weis, Angie Tipton, Jaewon Bae, Catherine K. Craven, Karen Dunn Lopez, Andrew D. Boyd

entry.summary: This pilot study fine-tunes Llama-3 models (8B and 70B) to categorize sentence-level clinical provenance across multi-source NICU notes as a prerequisite for multidisciplinary hospital-stay summarization. It adapts to MedSecId, a corpus of MIMIC-III notes annotated with provenance headers.

entry.title: SN-WER: Script-Normalized WER for Multi-Script Indic ASR Evaluation

author.name: Priyaranjan Pattnayak

entry.summary: SN-WER proposes a training-free script-normalized word error rate that transliterates reference and hypothesis into a canonical script before scoring, correcting WER inflation in multilingual Indic ASR where the same words appear in different scripts. It reduces spurious model gaps by up to 12%.

entry.title: Training-Free Object-Agnostic Jam Detection in Fulfillment Centers

author.name: Ruiliang Liu, Tina Dongxu Li, Joshua Migdal, Fernando Ruch, Kenneth Meszaros, Moses Trevor Dardik

entry.summary: This paper presents a training-free, object-agnostic jam detection method for fulfillment centers that uniformly samples reference points in the monitoring region rather than relying on object detection and tracking. It eliminates the thousands of manual annotations and class limitations of traditional pipelines.

entry.title: Beyond Static Gaussians: An Empirical Investigation of Architectural Paradigms for Dynamic 3D Scene Reconstruction

author.name: Adrian Ramlal, John S. Zelek

entry.summary: This paper provides a comprehensive empirical comparison of dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting methods, categorizing them into structure-guided (deformation fields, canonical spaces) and gaussian-centric paradigms. It finds structure-guided methods achieve superior fidelity and compactness on the D-NeRF benchmark.

entry.title: MUSCLE-NET: Predicted-Multiscale-Aware Network for Pedestrian Trajectory Forecasting

author.name: Yu Liu, Ming Huang, Xiao Ren, Zhijie Liu, Youfu Li, He Kong

entry.summary: MUSCLE-NET is a predicted-multiscale-aware network for pedestrian trajectory forecasting that integrates multimodal cues with scale-adaptive prediction mechanisms, accounting for scale dependency of future motion. It aims to improve robustness across diverse pedestrian behaviors for autonomous driving.

entry.title: Improving Visual Grounding in Remote Sensing via Cluster-Guided Refinement and Model Ensemble Voting

author.name: Panav Shah, Geet Sethi, Ashutosh Gandhe

entry.summary: This work proposes two grounding pipelines (Sequential and Cluster-Aware Grounding Refinement) for remote sensing visual grounding that combine the complementary strengths of RemoteSAM and the general-purpose SAM3 via cluster-guided refinement and ensemble voting. It addresses challenges of complex scenes, small objects, and scale variation.

entry.title: The Right Inference Strategy Is All You Need: Nearly Training-Free Domain-Wise Inference for EgoCross Challenge

author.name: Leyi Wu, Yifan Zhao, Jinjie Zhang, Yinchuan Li, Ying-Cong Chen

entry.summary: This challenge submission for EgoCross shows that with a frozen Qwen3-VL-4B and only 20 support samples, the right inference strategy (exposing better visual, temporal, and answer-selection cues) substantially improves cross-domain egocentric video QA. It emphasizes inference over training.

entry.title: GABI: Geometry-Aware Boundary Integration for Spacecraft Segmentation

author.name: Iason Georgios Velentzas, Dhruv Ahuja, Panagiotis Tsiotras

entry.summary: GABI is a lightweight boundary-aware multi-task segmentation network for spacecraft, augmenting a convolutional backbone with an auxiliary distance-field prediction head to provide geometric supervision near boundaries. It targets robustness to harsh space illumination.

entry.title: MixerSENet: A Lightweight Framework for Efficient Hyperspectral Image Classification

author.name: Mohammed Q. Alkhatib, Swalpa Kumar Roy, Ali Jamali

entry.summary: Introduces MixerSENet, a lightweight MLP-Mixer-style framework with squeeze-and-excitation blocks for efficient hyperspectral image classification under limited labeled data and resource constraints. Decouples spatial and channel mixing to reduce parameters.

entry.title: Time-Optimal Collision Avoidance Via a Greedy Polynomial Backward Sweep

author.name: Zeno Pavanello, Frank De Veld, Roberto Armellin

entry.summary: This paper introduces a greedy time-optimal backward-sweep method to find the latest possible maneuver initiation time for spacecraft collision avoidance, using differential algebra to propagate state sensitivities. It is validated on a large dataset of conjunctions using miss distance and collision probability metrics.

entry.title: Acting with AI: An Interaction-Based Framework for Agentic Tort Liability

author.name: Yiheng Yao

entry.summary: This paper proposes an interaction-based framework for agentic tort liability, drawing on Bratman's planning theory and common-law concerted action to distinguish autonomous drift, pure tool use, and collaborative planning. It maps these onto existing doctrines like product defect and independent contractor control tests.

entry.title: Topological texture analysis of microscopy images of dynamic casein gelation and its relation to rheological properties

author.name: Zahra Tabatabaei, Diana Soto Aguilar, Jose C. Bonilla, Mathias P. Clausen, Jon Sporring

entry.summary: This work proposes a computational toolbox integrating topological data analysis, differential box counting, multifractal partition, and local binary patterns applied to time-lapse STED microscopy of casein gelation, relating texture to rheological properties. TDA max-Betti-1 curves track network percolation and sol-gel transition.

entry.title: DAStatFormer: A Hybrid Multibranch Transformer with Statistical Feature Integration for DAS-Based Pattern Recognitions

author.name: Michel Dione (CERI SN - IMT Nord Europe), Jerry Lonlac (CERI SN - IMT Nord Europe), H\'el\`ene Louis (CERI SN - IMT Nord Europe), Anthony Fleury (CERI SN - IMT Nord Europe), Stephane Lecoeuche

entry.summary: DAStatFormer is a hybrid multibranch Transformer for Distributed Acoustic Sensing pattern recognition that extracts 24 ANOVA-selected statistical features per channel across temporal, waveform, and spectral domains instead of raw signals, combined with Gated Transformer Networks. Reduces data size while preserving discriminative information.

entry.title: Geodesics with Unified Tangent-constrained Priors and Curvature Regularization

author.name: Chong Di, Li Liu, Jinglin Zhang, Zhenjiang Li, Da Chen, Laurent D. Cohen

entry.summary: Proposes a unified geodesic framework integrating tangent-constrained shape priors with curvature penalization for image segmentation, restricting path tangents to angular sectors derived from skeletons or interior landmarks. It reduces shortcut errors when delineating complex shapes.

entry.title: ResNet-34 with Lightweight Decoder for Accurate and Efficient Segmentation of Fetal Brain MRI

author.name: Ashiqur Rahman, Muhammad E. H. Chowdhury, Md. Abu Sayed, Md. Sharjis Ibne Wadud, Abu Naser Md. Arafat, Mehedi Hasan Prince

entry.summary: Proposes a fetal brain MRI segmentation model combining a ResNet-34 encoder with a lightweight MLP-based decoder for adaptive feature refinement, targeting challenging tissues amid fetal motion and low contrast. Aims for accurate yet efficient prenatal segmentation.

entry.title: TechGraphRAG: An Agentic Graph-Augmented RAG Framework for Technical Literature Reasoning

author.name: Kanwar Bharat Singh

entry.summary: TechGraphRAG is an agentic graph-augmented RAG framework for technical literature reasoning over ~2,100 papers on intelligent tires and vehicle dynamics, using a 13-step autonomous pipeline. It includes evidence-sufficiency scoring, agentic retry, external database search, and Neo4j knowledge graph traversal.

entry.title: Multimodal Approaches for Visually-Rich Document Type Classification: A Comparative Analysis

author.name: Catyana Heyne, J\"urgen Frikel, Filippo Riccio

entry.summary: Provides a structured comparative analysis of multimodal design strategies for visually-rich document type classification across transformer- and LLM-based architectures, with a controlled empirical comparison. Aims to standardize fragmented evaluation setups in the field.

entry.title: Evaluating Real-World Generalizability of Algorithm Selection Models

author.name: Gjorgjina Cenikj, Jakub Kudela, Eva Tuba, Tome Eftimov

entry.summary: This study evaluates generalizability of algorithm selection models across synthetic benchmarks (BBOB, CEC) and real-world problems (robotics trajectory, UAV path planning). It systematically analyzes where cross-domain transfer succeeds or fails.

entry.title: Behavior Cloning of MPC for 3-DOF Robotic Manipulators

author.name: Theo Guegan, Dexter Wen Jie Teo

entry.summary: Investigates behavior cloning of model predictive control policies for real-time control of a 3-DOF manipulator, comparing MLP and RNN surrogates against an IK+MPC baseline. Analyzes generalization, stability, and architecture tradeoffs.

entry.title: Bridging Topology and Deep Representation Learning: A TDA-ViT Fusion Model for Four-Class Brain Tumor Classification

author.name: Faisal Ahmed

entry.summary: This work fuses Topological Data Analysis features with pretrained Vision Transformer representations for four-class brain tumor MRI classification, capturing structural and topological patterns ViTs often miss. It targets improved diagnostic accuracy.

entry.title: Adaptive Dense Evidence Refinement for Video Relational Reasoning for VRR-QA Challenge

author.name: Yuyang Sun, Yongliang Wu, Xingyu Zhu, Yuxia Chen, Zhenxiang Jiang, Yangguang Ji, Wenbo Zhu, Yanxi Shi, Jay Wu, Shuo Wang, Xu Yang

entry.summary: This VRR-QA challenge system uses adaptive test-time computation: it answers questions directly then routes only unstable, difficult questions to a high-budget dense evidence module for relational reasoning over spatial, temporal, viewpoint, and depth relations. It separates finding alternatives from deciding among them.

entry.title: Temporal Evidence Routing with Structured Visual Evidence for TimeLogicQA

author.name: Yuyang Sun, Yongliang Wu, Xingyu Zhu, Yuxia Chen, Zhenxiang Jiang, Yangguang Ji, Wenbo Zhu, Yanxi Shi, Jay Wu, Shuo Wang, Xu Yang

entry.summary: This TimeLogicQA system separates perception from symbolic temporal reasoning, parsing questions into temporal operators and routing videos by duration before producing structured visual evidence verified by programmatic verifiers. It targets temporal relations like ordering, persistence, and overlap.

entry.title: Market-Based Replanning for Safety-Critical UAV Swarms in Search and Rescue Missions

author.name: Luiz Giacomossi, Andrea Haglund, Claire Namatovu, Emily Zainali, Esaias M{\aa}lqvist, Yonatan M. Beyene, Ivan Tomasic, Baran \c{C}\"ur\"ukl\"u, H{\aa}kan Forsberg

entry.summary: IRDS is a distributed coordination architecture for UAV swarms in search-and-rescue, using a reverse-auction market mechanism for task allocation and a geometric consensus protocol for target verification under agent failures. Simulations show fault-tolerant task reallocation in resource-constrained settings.

entry.title: MindGames Arena Generalization Track: In2AI Solution with Delayed Per-Step Reward Attribution

author.name: Aliaksei Korshuk, Alexander Buyantuev, Ilya Makarov

entry.summary: This competition solution introduces delayed per-step reward attribution with eligibility gating for training LLM agents in multi-agent strategic games, computing rewards at episode end and propagating them to originating steps while excluding ill-defined steps. It addresses entangled, delayed rewards in multi-agent RL.

entry.title: On Wednesdays, We Ask Questions: Optimizing "Active Listening" in Automated Legal Triage and Referral

author.name: Quinten Steenhuis, Jacqueline Harvey

entry.summary: This paper evaluates LLM-generated follow-up questions for automated legal intake and referral, finding that cheap LLMs classify well but generating high-quality plain-language questions needs more expensive models. It proposes an attorney-informed rubric and shows prompt engineering alone is insufficient.

entry.title: GovAI-Pipe: A Layered AI Governance Pipeline for Citizen-Facing AI in Turkey's e-Government Gateway

author.name: Ahmet Kaplan
