entry.summary: Presents a neuro-inspired Inverter framework with paired forward/inverse models for embodied planning and control, formalizing Inverse Learning as bridging RL amortization and OC sequence planning.

entry.title: Partner-Aware Hierarchical Skill Discovery for Robust Human-AI Collaboration

author.name: Adnan Ahmad, Bahareh Nakisa, Mohammad Naim Rastgoo

entry.summary: Partner-Aware Skill Discovery uses contrastive intrinsic rewards conditioned on partner behavior to avoid shortcut learning in human-AI coordination. Companion paper to position 52.

entry.title: SPACE: Unifying Symmetric and Asymmetric Routing Problems for Generalist Neural Solver

author.name: Rongsheng Chen, Changliang Zhou, Canhong Yu, Yuanyao Chen, Yu Zhou, Zhuo Chen, Zhenkun Wang

entry.summary: SPACE unifies symmetric and asymmetric vehicle routing problems via pivot-based spatial position embeddings, enabling a single generalist neural solver across both settings.

entry.title: Measuring Reasoning Quality in LLMs: A Multi-Dimensional Behavioral Framework

author.name: Ali \c{S}enol, Garima Agrawal, Huan Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a six-dimensional behavioral evaluation framework for LLM reasoning quality (Correctness, Consistency, Robustness, Logical Coherence, Efficiency, Stability) tested across 7 LLMs and 4 benchmarks.

entry.title: ProActor: Timing-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Proactive Task Scheduling Agents

author.name: Lei Ding, Bin He, Chenguang Wang, Yang Liu

entry.summary: ProActor is an RL framework for timing-aware proactive task scheduling agents with domain-agnostic annotation generating opportunity time windows and systematic proactiveness metrics for anticipatory behavior.

entry.title: RECTOR: Priority-Aware Rule-Based Reranking for Compliance-Aware Autonomous Driving Trajectory Selection

author.name: Hadi Hajieghrary, Benedikt Walter, Chaitanya Shinde, Paul Schmitt, Miguel Hurtado

entry.summary: RECTOR is a post-generation trajectory reranking layer that scores autonomous driving candidate trajectories against a tiered rulebook (Safety > Legal > Road > Comfort) with deterministic epsilon-lexicographic selection.

entry.title: Agent-Centric Social Trajectory Prediction: A Free Energy Principle Perspective

author.name: Yanping Wu, Ji Zhang, Hao Chen, Edmond S. L. Ho, Chongfeng Wei

entry.summary: FEP-Diff is an agent-centric trajectory prediction framework based on the Free Energy Principle with dual-branch spatiotemporal encoder for ego-motion and social interactions, addressing partial observability and physical plausibility.

entry.title: PEDESTRIANQA: A Benchmark for Vision-Language Models on Pedestrian Intention and Trajectory Prediction

author.name: Naman Mishra, Shankar Gangisetty, C. V. Jawahar

entry.summary: PedestrianQA is a large-scale video QA benchmark for pedestrian intention and trajectory prediction with structured rationales. Formulates the autonomous driving task as VLM-friendly QA.

entry.title: How Many Tools Should an LLM Agent See? A Chance-Corrected Answer

author.name: Vyzantinos Repantis, Ameya Gawde, Harshvardhan Singh, Joey Blackwell II

entry.summary: Applies Bits-over-Random, a chance-corrected metric, to evaluate optimal shortlist size when retrieving tools for LLM agents. Evaluated across 3 benchmarks and registries from 20 to thousands of tools.

entry.title: Mix-MoE: Improving Multilingual Machine Translation of Large Language Models through Mixed MoEs

author.name: Bo Li, Tianyu Dong, Shaolin Zhu, Deyi Xiong

entry.summary: Mix-MoE proposes specialized Language Model Experts and Machine Translation Experts in a mixed MoE framework for multilingual machine translation. Addresses parameter interference in fine-tuning.

entry.title: 'Si'multaneous 'S'patial-'T'emporal Message Passing for Dynamic Graph Representation Learning

author.name: Shubhajit Roy, Anirban Dasgupta

entry.summary: SiST-GNN performs simultaneous spatial-temporal message passing for dynamic graphs, allowing neighbor contributions to be weighted by their past trajectories. Addresses rigid sequencing limitation in DGNNs.

entry.title: Profiling-Driven Adaptive Distributed Transformer Inference on Embedded Edge Deployment

author.name: Muhammad Azlan Qazi, Alexandros Iosifidis, Qi Zhang

entry.summary: Hardware prototype study of distributed transformer inference on Jetson Orin Nano clusters over WiFi, finding CPU-GPU staging via GLOO is the dominant bottleneck rather than network bandwidth. Practical edge deployment insights.

entry.title: CMAP: Cross-Modal Adaptive Prompting for Multi-Domain Task-Incremental Learning

author.name: Sriram Mandalika

entry.summary: Introduces CMAP for multi-domain task-incremental learning by leveraging CLIP text embeddings for task routing rather than relying solely on visual features. Uses text-space cosine similarity for order-independent routing at zero parameter cost.

entry.title: CoReVAD: A Contextual Reasoning Framework for Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection

author.name: Hyeongmuk Lim, Youngbum Hur

entry.summary: CoReVAD is a training-free video anomaly detection framework leveraging VLMs without requiring additional instruction tuning or external LLMs. Provides both detection and human-interpretable reasoning.

entry.title: Occlusion-Aware Physics-Semantic Keyframe Selection for Robust Video Editing

author.name: Lin Liu, Zhihan Xiao, Haohang Xu, Rong Cong, Zhibo Zhang, Xiaopeng Zhang, Qi Tian

entry.summary: Proposes occlusion-aware physics-semantic keyframe selection for video editing, automatically identifying optimal anchor frames for robust editing under occlusion and motion. Targets diffusion-based video editing failures from unreliable visual observations.

entry.title: Spatio-Temporal Similarity Volume Aggregation for Open-Vocabulary Action Recognition

author.name: Yerim So, Jiyeong Kim, Jiwon Yoon, Dongbo Min

entry.summary: SimVA constructs a dense 4D spatio-temporal similarity volume between patch-level visual and text similarities for open-vocabulary action recognition. Uses class sampling and motion-aware aggregation for scalable fine-grained matching.

entry.title: RS2AD-LiDAR: End-to-End Autonomous Driving LiDAR Data Generation from Roadside Sensor Observations

author.name: Runyi Huang, Ni Ding, Ruidan Xing, Yuheng Shi, Lei He, Keqiang Li

entry.summary: RS2AD-LiDAR generates vehicle-mounted LiDAR data from roadside sensor observations for end-to-end autonomous driving training. Addresses high data acquisition costs and data silos through cross-perspective reconstruction.

entry.title: Rethinking Transfer Learning for Industrial Inspection: DINOv3 vs. ImageNet Pretraining Across RGB and X-ray Tasks

author.name: Mehdi Gharbage, C\'eline Teuli\`ere, Pierre Bouges, Thierry Chateau

entry.summary: Compares DINOv3 distillation pretraining against ImageNet supervised pretraining and ResNet-50 baselines for industrial visual inspection across RGB and X-ray tasks. Evaluates transfer effectiveness for fine-grained dense prediction on industrial data.

entry.title: MDS-DETR: DETR with Masked Duplicate Suppressor

author.name: Chanho Lee, Seunghee Koh, Yunho Jeon, Junmo Kim

entry.summary: MDS-DETR leverages both one-to-one and one-to-many supervision within a single decoder via a Masked Duplicate Suppressor that uses confidence-based causal masking. Avoids auxiliary decoders discarded at inference.

entry.title: PixIE: Prompted Pixel-Space Low-Light Image Enhancement

author.name: Ruirui Lin, Guoxi Huang, David Bull, Nantheera Anantrasirichai

entry.summary: PixIE is a feed-forward pixel-space low-light image enhancement framework semantically prompted by DINOv3 features through patch-conditioned per-pixel modulation. Includes Spatial-Channel Compaction for efficient bounded-cost pixel attention.

entry.title: GlowGS: Generative Semantic Feature Learning for 3D Gaussian Splatting in Nighttime Glow Scenes

author.name: Beibei Lin, Xiao Cao, Jingyuan Guo, Robby T. Tan

entry.summary: GlowGS uses diffusion models and vision foundation models to compensate for missing structural cues in nighttime glow regions for 3DGS reconstruction. Combines semantic feature generation with novel-view semantic learning.

entry.title: Weierstrass Positional Encoding for Vision Transformers

author.name: Zhihang Xin, Rui Wang, Xitong Hu, Xiaojun Wu

entry.summary: Weierstrass Positional Encoding (WePE) maps 2D patch coordinates onto the complex domain via Weierstrass elliptic functions for vision transformers, preserving monotonic distance relationships. Provides geometrically constrained positional encoding.

entry.title: PhotoFlow: Agentic 3D Virtual Photography Missions

author.name: Jiarui Guo, Haojia Wei, Yiming Zhang, Yifei Liu, Yuning Gong, Hongjie Zhang, Xue Yang, Zhihang Zhong

entry.summary: PhotoFlow proposes a Director-Reviewer-Reflector agent for closed-loop virtual photography in 3D scenes, requiring spatial understanding and aesthetic judgment. Targets the underexplored intersection of VLM-based agents and 3D camera control.

entry.title: RADAR: Relative Angular Divergence Across Representations

author.name: Xavier Cadet, Mateusz Nowak, Peter Chin

entry.summary: RADAR is a geometric metric for cross-domain transferability in foundation models, analyzing layer-wise angular alignment to predict negative transfer.

entry.title: Commutator-Induced Uncertainty in VAEs

author.name: Tahereh Dehdarirad, Michael Felsberg, Gabriel Eilertsen, Ziliang Xiong

entry.summary: Lie Group VAE framework explicitly diagnoses non-commutativity in latent spaces rather than suppressing it via algebraic regularization. Combines geometric and algebraic uncertainty perspectives.

entry.title: Leveraging Foundation Models for Causal Generative Modeling

author.name: Aneesh Komanduri, Xintao Wu

entry.summary: FM-CGM is a modular framework for visual causal reasoning composing concept extractors, manipulators, and counterfactual generators atop pretrained foundation models.

entry.title: Micro-Swarm Locomotion Optimization in Dynamic Flow using Multi-Objective Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Josef Berman, Oren Gal

entry.summary: Couples high-fidelity Navier-Stokes CFD with multi-objective multi-agent RL using PCGrad for micro-swarm robot control in pulsatile arterial flow.

entry.title: A Decentralized LiDAR-SLAM System with Certifiably Optimal Pose Graph Optimization

author.name: Baoshan Song, Feng Huang, Li-Ta Hsu

entry.summary: Decentralized multi-robot LiDAR-SLAM system integrating Riemannian Block Coordinate Descent for certifiably optimal pose graph optimization without good initialization.

entry.title: Beyond Normal References: Discriminative Few-Shot Anomaly Detection

author.name: Huan Wang, Jun Shen, Jun Yan, Guansong Pang

entry.summary: IDEAL is a discriminative few-shot anomaly detection framework using both normal and anomalous references through intrinsic deviation learning. Decomposes learning into a Normal Variation Eraser and an intrinsic deviation pattern learner.

entry.title: MEMOR-E: In-Context and Fine-Tuned LLM Personalization for Alzheimer's Assistive Robotics

author.name: Maissa Abir Smaili, Eren Sadikoglu, Ransalu Senanayake

entry.summary: MEMOR-E is a quadruped robot with tablet interface for Alzheimer assistive care, evaluating in-context and fine-tuned LLMs for stage-consistent cognitive emulation. Trained on transcripts from 235 Alzheimer patients.

entry.title: EvoSci: A Bio-Inspired Multi-Agent Framework for the Evolution of Scientific Discovery

author.name: Xiaoyu Xiong, Yuqi Ren, Deyi Xiong

entry.summary: EvoSci is a bio-inspired multi-agent framework integrating evolution with knowledge graph modeling for scientific discovery, using mentor, researcher, and reviewer roles. One of many recent AI scientist proposals.

entry.title: Market Regime Council for Dynamic Credit Assignment in Multi-Agent LLM Decision Systems

author.name: Yunhua Pei, Zerui Ge, Jin Zheng, John Cartlidge

entry.summary: Market Regime Council uses exact Shapley credits across agent coalitions for online weighting in multi-agent LLM portfolio management, with regime-dependent multipliers and Bayesian mixture for cold-start stability.

entry.title: Associations between echocardiographic traits and AI-ECG predictions of heart failure

author.name: Elias Stenhede, Eivind Bj{\o}rkan Orstad, Torbj{\o}rn Omland, Henrik Schirmer, Arian Ranjbar

entry.summary: Investigates whether AI-ECG model predictions of heart failure align with echocardiographic phenotypes across 8147 patients, using Spearman correlation. Clinical validation study.

entry.title: Hylos: Operability Contracts for Model-Native Spatial Intelligence

author.name: Christopher Da Silva

entry.summary: Hylos is a systems architecture for operable 3D spatial intelligence with contract-bounded scene representation including entities, frames, surfaces, constraints, action candidates, and effect diffs for agents.

entry.title: CoRe-Code: Collaborative Reinforcement Learning for Code Generation

author.name: Zhihao Dou, Qinjian Zhao, Zhongwei Wan, Xiaoyu Xia, Sumon Biswas

entry.summary: CoRe-Code is a multi-agent RL framework with specialized role agents for code generation, addressing coordination and specialization gaps in multi-agent code generation systems.

entry.title: Privacy-Preserving Local Language Models for Longitudinal Data Retrieval in Chronic Dermatologic Disease: Implementation in Pemphigus Patients

author.name: Abdurrahim Yilmaz, Ay\c{s}e Esra Koku Aksu, Duygu Yamen, Vefa Asli Erdemir, Mehmet Salih Gurel, Gulsum Gencoglan, Joram M. Posma, Burak Temelkuran

entry.summary: Evaluates locally deployed small language models for privacy-preserving longitudinal clinical retrieval in pemphigus dermatology records (89k words from 30 patients, 56 expert-annotated features).

entry.title: Second Guess: Detecting Uncertainty Through Abstention and Answer Stability in Small Language Models

author.name: Ashwath Vaithinathan Aravindan, Mayank Kejriwal

entry.summary: Second Guess is a parameter-free prompting technique for SLM abstention in MCQA that exploits the insight that confident answers stay stable when an I-don't-know option is added while uncertain ones shift, tested on four 2B-8B models.

entry.title: LECTOR: Joint Optimization of Scientific Reasoning Graphs and Introduction Generation

author.name: Jiabei Xiao, Yizhou Wang, Chen Tang, Pengze Li, Wanli Ouyang, Shixiang Tang

entry.summary: Proposes LECTOR, a logic-expression co-reinforcement learning framework for generating scientific paper introductions grounded in core evidence. Targets reducing citation hallucinations in AI-assisted scientific writing.

entry.title: VeriTrace: Evolving Mental Models for Deep Research Agents

author.name: Haolang Zhao, Yunbo Long, Lukas Beckenbauer, Alexandra Brintrup

entry.summary: VeriTrace introduces a cognitive-graph framework with three regulatory feedback loops for deep research agents to maintain accurate mental models. Addresses error propagation in evolving intermediate representations.

entry.title: LETS Forecast: Learning Embedology for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Abrar Majeedi, Viswanatha Reddy Gajjala, Satya Sai Srinath Namburi GNVV, Nada Magdi Elkordi, Yin Li

entry.summary: DeepEDM combines empirical dynamic modeling with deep neural networks for time series forecasting, learning latent spaces from time-delayed embeddings. Grounded in Takens theorem with kernel regression.

entry.title: High-Risk AI Systems and the Problem of Identity in the European AI Act

author.name: Andrea Ferrario

entry.summary: Argues the EU AI Act lacks an internal auditable criterion for synchronic identity of AI systems, proposing the function+ framework for AI artifact identity. Addresses lifecycle governance challenges around substantial modification.

entry.title: TriVAL: A Tri-Validation Framework for Faithful Automatic Optimization Modeling

author.name: Ziyang Fang, JinXi Wang, Jinghui Zhong, Yew-Soon Ong

entry.summary: TriVAL adds explicit validation at semantic, mathematical, and code stages of LLM-based optimization modeling. Addresses error propagation in automatic optimization pipeline.

entry.title: Metacognition Should Be the Scientific Framework for Bounded and Effective Self-Governance in Generative AI

author.name: Eugene Yu Ji, Igor Grossmann, Amir-Hossein Karimi

entry.summary: Position paper arguing metacognition should be the scientific framework for self-governance in generative AI, spanning computational, algorithmic, and ecological levels. Frames output evaluation as inseparable from generation regulation.

entry.title: RAW: Robust Avatar Watermarking -- Benchmarking and Baseline

author.name: Jack Parry, Jack Saunders, Vinay Namboodiri

entry.summary: RAW benchmarks digital avatar watermarking with 50 synthetic avatar videos across 5 commercial providers and 6 attacks. Proposes WALT which embeds watermarks in UV texture space achieving 92.4% robustness to zoom attacks.

entry.title: Truthful Online Preference Aggregation for LLM Fine-Tuning in Mobile Crowdsourcing

author.name: Shugang Hao, Lingjie Duan

entry.summary: Studies truthful online preference aggregation for LLM fine-tuning in mobile crowdsourcing where workers may misreport feedback. Formulates strategy-proof aggregation with sublinear regret bounds.

entry.title: Generative Representation Learning on Hyper-relational Knowledge Graphs via Masked Discrete Diffusion

author.name: Jaejun Lee, Seheon Kim, Joyce Jiyoung Whang

entry.summary: KREPE is a generative representation learning method for hyper-relational knowledge graphs using masked discrete diffusion. Addresses fact generation where multiple components may be missing.

entry.title: CRISP -- Clustering-Based Redundancy-Reduced Instance Sampling for Pathology Case Representation and Retrieval

author.name: Zahra Rahimi Afzal, Wataru Uegami, Saghir Alfasly, Saba Yasir, Judy C. Boughey, Matthew P. Goetz, Krishna R. Kalari, H. R. Tizhoosh

entry.summary: CRISP is an unsupervised clustering-based framework for case-level pathology representation using all whole-slide images per case rather than a single selected slide. Addresses multi-WSI tumor heterogeneity.

entry.title: An Empirical Evaluation of LLM-Generated Code Security Across Prompting Methods

author.name: Mohammed Kharma, Ahmed Sabbah, Mohammad Alkhanafseh, Mohammad Hammoudeh, David Mohaisen

entry.summary: Empirical evaluation of LLM-generated code security across 5 models and 4 languages with multiple prompting strategies. Introduces a weakness-aware zero-shot CoT prompting strategy using CWE mappings.

entry.title: Enhancing Reliability in LLM-Based Secure Code Generation

author.name: Mohammed F. Kharma, Mohammad Alkhanafseh, Ahmed Sabbah, David Mohaisen

entry.summary: Mitigation-Aware Chain-of-Thought (MA-CoT) embeds CWE mitigation guidance and language-aware safeguards into prompts for secure LLM code generation. Evaluated on GPT-5, Claude-4.5, Gemini-2.5.

entry.title: Assessing the Operational Viability of Foundation Models for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Kavin Soni, Debanshu Das, Vamshi Guduguntla

entry.summary: Compares time-series foundation models against supervised baselines across four operational regimes (human-centric, physical, financial, demand). Characterizes when each approach is optimal.

entry.title: Generative OOD-regularized Model-based Policy Optimization

author.name: Aysin Tumay, Jiahe Huang, Elise Jortberg, Rose Yu

entry.summary: GORMPO is a density-regularized offline model-based RL algorithm that uses generative density modeling to constrain policy updates to high-density data regions. Mitigates OOD actions in sparse offline RL.

entry.title: PILOT: Policy-Informed Learned Optimization for Adaptive Deep Network Training

author.name: Sattam Altuuaim, Lama Ayash, Muhammad Mubashar, Naeemullah Khan

entry.summary: PILOT is an online learned optimizer that conditions update rules on gradient-direction agreement as a stability signal. Dynamically balances momentum, normalization, and sign-based updates during training.

entry.title: Guarded Repair for Harm-Aware Post-hoc Replacement of LLM Mathematical Reasoning

author.name: Haizhou Xia

entry.summary: GuardedRepair is a best-of-N repair framework for LLM math reasoning that diagnoses cached traces and only replaces them when deterministic verifier guards support the change. Addresses asymmetric risk of harmful repairs.

entry.title: VaaWIT: Visual-Aware Adaptation of Large Language Models for Multilingual Web Image Translation

author.name: Bo Li, Ronghao Chen, Ningyuan Deng, Huacan Wang, Shaolin Zhu, Lijie Wen

entry.summary: VaaWIT adapts LLMs for multilingual web image translation using a Dual-Stream Attention mechanism that captures fine-grained character morphology. Addresses visual representation gap in LVLMs.

entry.title: Spectral Retrieval: Multi-Scale Sinc Convolution over Token Embeddings for Localized Retrieval in LLM Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Andrea Morandi

entry.summary: Spectral Retrieval is a plug-in re-ranking stage that interpolates between per-token MaxSim and mean-pool retrieval via multi-scale sinc convolution over token embeddings. Targets localized relevance in long documents.

entry.title: From Theory to Decision Rule: Calibrating the Noisy-Label Crossover for Vision-Language Model Weak Supervision Across Three Medical-Imaging Benchmarks

author.name: Bruce Changlong Xu, Jose James, Alexander Ryu

entry.summary: Calibrates the noisy-label crossover prediction for BiomedCLIP weak supervision across PCAM, ISIC, and NIH-CXR benchmarks. Determines instance-level thresholds where weak labels start hurting performance.

entry.title: Quaternion Self-Attention with Shared Scores

author.name: Shogo Yamauchi, Tohru Nitta, Hideaki Tamori

entry.summary: Quaternion self-attention with a single shared real-valued score across components, cutting score multiplications by 75% with theoretical equivalence guarantees under product quaternion structure. Modest architectural efficiency gain.

entry.title: Cross-Domain Generalization Limits of Vision Foundation Models in Facial Deepfake Detection

author.name: Ibrahim Delibasoglu

entry.summary: Cross-domain evaluation of vision foundation models as feature extractors for facial deepfake detection across unseen generators. Findings on representation collapse and generalization limits.

entry.title: OSDTW: Optimal Shared Depth and Task Weighting for Long-Tailed Recognition

author.name: Chang Chu, Qingyue Zhang, Shao-Lun Huang, Junxiong Zheng

entry.summary: OSDTW is a task-decomposition framework for long-tailed recognition with shared encoder and head/tail decoders, with optimal sharing depth and task weighting. Principled treatment of head-tail trade-off.

entry.title: TGFormer: Towards Temporal Graph Transformer with Auto-Correlation Mechanism

author.name: Hongjiang Chen, Pengfei Jiao, Ming Du, Xuan Guo, Zhidong Zhao, Di Jin, Xiao Liu

entry.summary: TGFormer is a Transformer for temporal graphs with auto-correlation mechanism for periodic and long-term dependencies. Architectural contribution to temporal GNNs.

entry.title: Metropolis-Scale Resilient and Trustworthy Traffic Flow Inference Using Multi-Source Data

author.name: Qishen Zhou, Yifan Zhang, Michail A. Makridis, Anastasios Kouvelas, Yibing Wang, Simon Hu

entry.summary: TA-ANP is a task-aware attentive neural process for fusing floating car data with sparse fixed detectors for metropolis-scale traffic state inference with uncertainty quantification. Solid applied probabilistic ML.

entry.title: K-U-KAN: Koopman-Enhanced U-KAN for 3D Dental Reconstruction from a Single Panoramic X-ray Radiograph

author.name: Bikram Keshari Parida, Abhijit Sen, Wonsang You

entry.summary: K-U-KAN combines Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with Koopman operator theory to reconstruct 3D dental volumes from 2D panoramic X-rays. Architectural contribution to medical imaging.

entry.title: Grow-Prune-Freeze Networks: Adaptive & Continual Learning Technique for Olfactory Navigation

author.name: Kordel K. France, Ovidiu Daescu

entry.summary: Grow-Prune-Freeze networks adaptively grow, prune, and freeze early layers for continual olfactory navigation, with extension of random matrix theory to multi-layer continual learning. Novel architecture for a niche task.

entry.title: Mimir: Large-scale Multilingual Concept Modeling

author.name: Elio Musacchio, Lucia Siciliani, Pierpaolo Basile

entry.summary: Proposes Mimir, a multilingual concept modeling approach that predicts next-concept rather than next-token, exploring higher-granularity language modeling. Extends prior concept modeling work to multilingual settings.

entry.title: Neuromorphic LiDAR-based Bird's Eye View Object Detection using Energy-efficient Spiking Neural Networks

author.name: Sambit Mohapatra, Senthil Yogamani, Heinrich Gotzig, Patrick Mader

entry.summary: Spiking neural network for LiDAR bird's-eye-view 3D object detection in autonomous driving, targeting energy-efficient neuromorphic platforms. End-to-end encoder-decoder trained with surrogate gradients.

entry.title: Parameter-Efficient CT Reconstruction via Deep Graph Laplacian Regularization

author.name: Veera Varuni Radhakrishnan, Chinthaka Dinesh, Qurat-ul-Ain Azim

entry.summary: Deep GLR integrates graph Laplacian regularization with proximal splitting for low-dose CT reconstruction using only lightweight CNN modules. Achieves notable PSNR gains with far fewer parameters than SOTA.

entry.title: Test-Time Self-Adaptive Conditioning for Stable Audio-Driven Talking-Head Generation

author.name: Zhicheng Zhang, Lei Wang, Yu Zhang, Yongsheng Gao

entry.summary: TT-SAC enables pretrained talking-head generators to adapt conditioning during inference without retraining, addressing identity drift in audio-driven video synthesis. Parameter-free test-time adaptation.

entry.title: BC Protocol: Structured Dual-Expert Dialogue for Eliciting High-Quality Chain-of-Thought Post-Training Data

author.name: Bo Zou, Chao Xu

entry.summary: BC Protocol pairs domain experts with knowledge engineers to externalize implicit reasoning steps for CoT post-training data. Addresses expert blind spots in solo writing.

entry.title: Fine-Tuning and Serving Gemma 4 31B on Google Cloud TPU: A Technical Comparison with GPU Baselines

author.name: Jatin Kishnani, Mayank Goel, Amit Singh, Pulkit Agrawal, Sairanjan Mishra

entry.summary: Empirical comparison of fine-tuning and serving Gemma 4 31B on TPU v5p/v6e vs GPU baselines. Documents JAX+Tunix/Qwix adaptations and Orbax checkpoint merging procedures.

entry.title: DeGRe: Dense-supervised Generative Reranking for Recommendation

author.name: Chaotian Song, Jingyao Zhang, Chenghao Chen, Zisen Sang, Dehai Zhao, Guodong Cao, Boxi Wu, Deng Cai, Jia Jia

entry.summary: DeGRe is a dense-supervised generative reranking framework addressing heuristic label bias and credit assignment in recommendation reranking. Replaces sparse list-level rewards with denser signals.

entry.title: Adaptive Graph Refinement and Label Propagation with LLMs for Cost-Effective Entity Resolution

author.name: Hongtao Wang, Renchi Yang, Haoran Zheng, Xiangyu Ke

entry.summary: Adaptive graph refinement and label propagation with LLMs for cost-effective entity resolution, unifying matching and clustering as graph construction. Addresses error propagation in cascaded ER pipelines.

entry.title: MuNet: A Mutualistic Network for Joint 3D Human Mesh Recovery and 3D Clothed Human Reconstruction from Single Images

author.name: Yunqi Gao, Leyuan Liu, Yuhan Li, Changxin Gao, Jingying Chen

entry.summary: MuNet jointly recovers 3D human mesh and reconstructs 3D clothed human from single images via unified 2-manifold graph representation. Exploits mutual dependencies between previously isolated tasks.

entry.title: From Latent Space to Training Data: Explainable Specialization in Minimal MLPs

author.name: Enrique Alba, Ezequiel Lopez-Rubio

entry.summary: Studies whether training biases cause hidden neuron specialization in minimal MLPs and if such specialization aids reconstruction of training data from weights. Coverage regularization minimizes reconstruction error.

entry.title: QUIET: A Multi-Blank Cascaded Story Cloze Benchmark for LLM Creative Generation Capability

author.name: Bo Zou, Chao Xu

entry.summary: QUIET benchmark uses multi-blank cascaded story cloze (10-20 blanks) to evaluate LLM creative generation rather than discrimination. Aims for objective automated scoring of creativity.

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented Detection of Potentially Abusive Clauses in Chilean Terms of Service

author.name: Christoffer Loeffler, Tom\'as Rey Pizarro, Daniel Ignacio Miranda V\'asquez, Andrea Mart\'inez Freile

entry.summary: Retrieval-augmented framework for detecting abusive clauses in Chilean Terms of Service, designed for local execution with open-weight models. Introduces Chilean Abusive Terms dataset.

entry.title: CAFD: Concept-Aware DNN Fault Detection using VLMs

author.name: Amin Abbasishahkoo, Mahboubeh Dadkhah, Lionel Briand

entry.summary: CAFD combines model-based and distance-based signals with VLM features for DNN fault detection, balancing performance with computational efficiency.

entry.title: GEESE: Genotype-aware End-to-End Spatio-temporal Embedding for Behavioral Phenotyping

author.name: Yiran Ding, Yuen Gao, Chunqi Qian, Zijun Cui

entry.summary: GEESE end-to-end framework learns behavioral representations from 3D pose dynamics for autism-associated genetic model phenotyping (CNTNAP2, CHD8, FMR1).

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning for Reachability: Guaranteeing Asymptotic Optimality

author.name: Amogh Palasamudram, Jakub Svoboda, Suguman Bansal, Krishnendu Chatterjee

entry.summary: Presents a PAC-learning approach to RL for reachability specifications with iterative refinement of MDP parameters. Provides theoretical convergence guarantees with deeper insight into convergence dynamics.

entry.title: Cluster Frequency Conformal Prediction for Local Coverage

author.name: Tomer Lavi, Bracha Shapira, Nadav Rappoport

entry.summary: Proposes Cluster Frequency Conformal Prediction for many-class classification with local coverage guarantees. Uses learned embedding clusters and softly mixed local distributions with shrinkage regularization.

entry.title: BandVQ: Band-Wise Vector-Quantized EEG Foundation Model

author.name: Jamiyan Sukhbaatar, Satoshi Imamura, Toshihisa Tanaka

entry.summary: Proposes BandVQ, a band-wise vector-quantized EEG foundation model that decomposes signals into frequency bands and trains separate VQ-VAE tokenizers per band. Targets transferable EEG representations.

entry.title: Mitigating Gradient Pathology in PINNs through Aligned Constraint

author.name: Yichen Luo, Peiyu Zhu, Dongxiao Hu, Jia Wang, Tailin Wu, Dapeng Lan, Yu Liu, Zhibo Pang

entry.summary: Proposes Constraint-Aligned loss with Manifold Lifting (CAML) to address gradient pathology in PINNs by reformulating zeroth-order terms into aligned manifold lifting. Addresses opposing PDE residual and boundary gradients.

entry.title: Rethinking Feature Alignment in Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection: A Relational Fingerprint-based Approach

author.name: Yujing Liu, Yixin Liu, Yu Zheng, Alan Wee-Chung Liew, Xiaofeng Cao, Shirui Pan

entry.summary: Proposes ReFi-GAD, a generalist graph anomaly detection method using semantics-aware Relational Fingerprints to encode both contextual and structural anomaly cues. Addresses negative transfer of PCA-based projection methods.

entry.title: Missing Pattern Recognized Diffusion Imputation Model for Missing Not At Random

author.name: Gyuwon Sim, Sumin Lee, Heesun Bae, Byeonghu Na, Doyun Kwon, Ju-Hee Hwang, Jae-Young Lim, Il-Chul Moon

entry.summary: Introduces PRDIM, a diffusion imputation model that explicitly captures missing patterns under MNAR. Uses EM algorithm with pattern recognizer to maximize joint likelihood of observed values and missing mask.

entry.title: Relative Repairability: A Calibration-Based Diagnostic for High-Sparsity Post-Pruning Allocation

author.name: Qishi Zhan, Liang He, Minxuan Hu, Ziheng Chen

entry.summary: Introduces Relative Repairability, a calibration-based diagnostic comparing layerwise pruning damage with residual distortion after channelwise variance-matching repair. Enables sparsity allocation for high-sparsity pruning.

entry.title: RotMoLE: Enhancing Mixture of Low-Rank Experts through Rotational Gating Mechanism

author.name: Mengyang Sun, Maochuan Dou, Tao Feng, Dan Zhang, Yihao Wang, Junpeng Liu, Yifan Zhu, Jie Tang

entry.summary: Introduces RotMoLE, a Mixture of Low-rank Experts approach using rotational gating mechanisms beyond scalar reweighting. Enhances representation and generalization for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of LLMs.

entry.title: Closed-Form Node Classification with Exact Graph Unlearning

author.name: Aditya Gaur, Charu Sharma

entry.summary: Introduces routed closed-form node classification framework with SGC-based ridge regression for assortative graphs and LCF-Net for heterophilous graphs. Enables exact graph unlearning via deterministic solvers.

entry.title: Opportunistic Target Selection: Early Directional Commitment for Query-Efficient Black-Box Adversarial Attacks

author.name: Florent Tariolle, Florian Yger

entry.summary: Proposes Opportunistic Target Selection wrapping untargeted black-box attacks to switch to targeted objectives early using current leading non-true class. Reduces query waste from class drift in untargeted attacks.

entry.title: Stochastic Estimation of the Layer-wise Hessian Trace for Monitoring Neural-network Training

author.name: Maxim Bolshim (ITMO University, Saint Petersburg, Russia), Alexander Kugaevskikh (ITMO University, Saint Petersburg, Russia)

entry.summary: Develops stochastic estimator for layer-wise Hessian trace using Hutchinson with single Hessian-vector product over the parameter vector. Enables monitoring training pathology at parameter counts of 10^6 to 10^8.

entry.title: Invariant-Based Weight Sharing for Message Passing

author.name: Florian Seiffarth

entry.summary: Introduces invariant-based weight sharing for message-passing networks, indexing weights by user-chosen graph invariants to enable systematic reuse across structurally equivalent subgraphs. Yields ShareGNNs with learnable adjacency.

entry.title: Conformalised imprecise inference for robust extrapolation under limited data

author.name: Yu Chen, Scott Ferson

entry.summary: Proposes conformalized imprecise inference framework producing probability boxes that maintain coverage under distributional shift. Adaptively expands uncertainty in extrapolation regimes with limited data.

entry.title: Mapping the Schedule x Bit-Width Boundary in Sub-100M Quantisation-Aware Training

author.name: Christian Brandt Thomassen

entry.summary: Empirically tests whether optimal learning rate schedules depend on bit-width in quantization-aware training of sub-100M decoder language models. Finds a constant 33% warmdown is optimal across FP16/INT8/INT6/INT4 regimes, falsifying the hypothesis.

entry.title: Active Query Synthesis for Preference Learning

author.name: Namrata Nadagouda, Nauman Ahad, Maegan Tucker, Mark A. Davenport

entry.summary: Introduces Info-Synth, an active query synthesis framework for preference learning that generates queries directly rather than selecting from a pool. Adds a confidence-aware response model handling ambiguous pairwise comparisons.

entry.title: Prism: A Plug-in Reproducible Infrastructure for Scalable Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning

author.name: Jun-Tao Tang, Yu-Cheng Shi, Zhen-Hao Xie, Da-Wei Zhou

entry.summary: Releases Prism, a plug-in reproducible codebase for multimodal continual instruction tuning that decouples methods from base MLLM modifications. Aims to standardize MCIT research.

entry.title: TSFLora: Token-Compressed Split Fine-Tuning for Wireless Edge Networks

author.name: Xianke Qiang, Zheng Chang, Li Wang, Ying-Chang Liang

entry.summary: TSFLora combines attention-guided token selection, token merging, low-bit activation quantization, and LoRA in a split federated fine-tuning pipeline for edge devices. Targets communication efficiency for large model personalization.

entry.title: MGVQ: Synergizing Multi-dimensional Sensitivity-Aware and Gradient-Hessian Fusion for Vector Quantization

author.name: Zhong Wang, Zukang Xu, Xing Hu, Dawei Yang

entry.summary: MGVQ combines multi-dimensional sensitivity-aware allocation with gradient-Hessian fusion for vector quantization of vision-language models. Targets ultra-low-bit deployment on edge devices.

entry.title: Causality as the Statistical Conscience of Artificial Intelligence: From Pearl's Ladder to Trustworthy Machines

author.name: Ernest Fokou\'e

entry.summary: Position paper arguing causal inference is AI's indispensable statistical conscience, presenting a Statistical Necessity Theorem for causal generalization. Frames OOD generalization as requiring causal structure.

entry.title: Learning dynamical systems with biochemically informed neural ordinary differential equations

author.name: Luis L. Fonseca, Reinhard C. Laubenbacher, Lucas B\"ottcher

entry.summary: BINODEs combines neural networks with stoichiometric structure of biochemical reaction models, mapping NN outputs through a stoichiometric matrix layer. Allows incorporating biological side information.

entry.title: Discovering Lexical Gaps Using Embeddings from Multilingual LLMs

author.name: Yoonwon Jung, Aaron S. Cohen, Benjamin K. Bergen

entry.summary: Data-driven framework for identifying cross-lingual lexical gaps using contextual embeddings from bilingual LLMs. Applied to Korean-English with 4000 embedding spaces analyzed.

entry.title: A Matched Spectral Benchmark of Quantum Inspired Feature Maps

author.name: Toheeb Ogunade, Taofeek Kassim, Etinosa Osaro

entry.summary: Benchmarks quantum-inspired data-encoding feature maps (amplitude, angle, basis) against classical baselines under matched dimensionality. Analyzes representation geometry and effective rank.

entry.title: Fermi-Dirac machines as quantizations of neurons

author.name: Alexander He, Nana Liu, Mark M. Wilde

entry.summary: Reinterprets Fermi-Dirac machines as canonical quantizations of classical neurons, defining quantum activation observables. Shows reduction to classical neurons in the commuting case.

entry.title: Vision-Guided Outdoor Flight and Obstacle Evasion via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Shiladitya Dutta, Aayush Gupta, Varun Saran, Avideh Zakhor

entry.summary: End-to-end sensorimotor policy for outdoor drone navigation using stereo depth and VIO, trained via RL and privileged learning. Pre-trained autoencoder perception head feeds an LSTM planner.

entry.title: AnnotateMissense: a genome-wide annotation and benchmarking framework for missense pathogenicity prediction

author.name: Muhammad Muneeb, David B. Ascher

entry.summary: AnnotateMissense provides a scalable framework integrating dbNSFP, ANNOVAR, AlphaMissense, ESM features, and conservation metrics for genome-wide missense pathogenicity prediction. Benchmarking and annotation infrastructure.

entry.title: EMA: Effort Metric Attention for Anatomical Effort-Guided Human Motion Diffusion

author.name: Joshua Siy, Huakun Liu, Yutaro Hirao, Monica Perusquia-Hernandez, Hideaki Uchiyama, Kiyoshi Kiyokawa

entry.summary: EMA is a cross-attention module conditioning motion diffusion on numerical effort signals derived from Laban Movement Analysis (Time and Weight factors). Enables fine-grained intensity control beyond ambiguous adverbs.

entry.title: WINO: A Weak-Form Physics Informed Neural Operator for Hyperelasticity on Variable Domains

author.name: Bokai Zhu, Qinghui Zhang, Timon Rabczuk

entry.summary: WINO combines neural operators with phi-FEM weak-form physics-informed training for hyperelasticity on variable domains. Data-free framework handling unfitted geometric variations.

entry.title: Affinity Graph Connectivity in Convex Clustering

author.name: Sam Rosen, Jason Xu

entry.summary: Generalizes finite-sample bounds for convex clustering to arbitrary connected affinity graphs, providing random-walk-based theory and new centroid recovery rates. Formalizes the connectivity-performance relationship.

entry.title: Sum of Costs Diffusion with Dynamic Guidance for Motion Planning

author.name: Aysu Aylin Kaplan, \"Ozg\"ur Erkent

entry.summary: Diffusion-based motion planning method using gradient guidance from total collision costs, with dynamic selection of guidance start step. Targets robotic manipulation with high generalization.

entry.title: CALIBURN: A Regime-Sensitivity Study of Operationally Calibrated Streaming Intrusion Detection

author.name: Michel A. Youssef

entry.summary: CALIBURN is a five-component streaming alerting pipeline combining Bayesian change-point detection, isotonic calibration, cost-sensitive thresholds, conformal risk control, and memory-bounded operation. Targets operational network intrusion detection.

entry.title: Estimating Mixture Distributions via Stochastic Mirror Descent

author.name: Mohammadreza Ahmadypour, Tara Javidi, Farinaz Koushanfar

entry.summary: Family of mixture distribution estimators derived from stochastic mirror descent with various Bregman divergences. Scales efficiently with number of candidate components, generalizing classical estimators.

entry.title: TRACE: A taxonomy-grounded synthetic dataset for teaching-program generation and session interpretation in Applied Behavior Analysis

author.name: Festus Kahunla

entry.summary: TRACE is a 2,999-example taxonomy-grounded synthetic dataset for instruction-tuning models on Applied Behavior Analysis tasks, addressing HIPAA limitations on real clinical data. Covers teaching-program generation and multi-session behavioral interpretation.

entry.title: A Multimodal Framework for Dementia Detection via Linguistic and Acoustic Representation Learning

author.name: Loukas Ilias, Dimitris Askounis

entry.summary: Multimodal deep learning framework for dementia detection that maximizes dependency between linguistic and acoustic representations rather than relying on simple fusion or attention. Targets early Alzheimer's diagnosis from spontaneous speech.

entry.title: Branched Signature Kernel Solvers for ODEs with rough Single-Trajectory signals

author.name: Munawar Ali, Qi Feng, Charlie Pyle, George Xu

entry.summary: Branched signature kernel solver for ODEs driven by a single observed rough trajectory, using count-sampling to create a hierarchical family of nested training paths. Targets earthquake engineering, finance, and structural monitoring.

entry.title: The Timing Dependencies of Trust: Speed, Accuracy, and cBCI Neuro-Decoupling in Human-AI Teams

author.name: Christopher Baker, Stephen Hinton, Akashdeep Nijjar, Riccardo Poli, Caterina Cinel, Tom Reed, Stephen Fairclough

entry.summary: Investigates how AI assistant speed and accuracy affect human-AI team performance using a 2D Adaptive Riemannian Oracle in a VR drone task with cBCI integration. Shows AI timing determines failure mechanisms in cognitive teaming.

entry.title: How Much Structure Do LLMs Need? Evaluating LLMs for Bibliometric Cluster Description

author.name: Abraham Camelo-Guerrero, Jairo Diaz-Rodriguez

entry.summary: Evaluates six LLM pipelines for bibliometric cluster description across 100 published bibliometric analyses, finding LLMs produce semantically aligned descriptions but are unreliable at inferring bibliometric structure. Assesses alignment, coverage, clustering, graph quality, and reference grounding.

entry.title: Phonetic Modeling of Dialectal Variation in Vietnamese Speech

author.name: Quan Ngoc Hoang, Long Hoang Huu Nguyen, Nghia Hieu Nguyen, Kiet Van Nguyen, Ngan Luu-Thuy Nguyen

entry.summary: Dialect-aware phonetic framework for Vietnamese ASR explicitly modeling phonological structure and dialectal variation at vowel and tone levels across Northern, Central, and Southern dialects. Addresses limitations of word-level dialect modeling.

entry.title: HiMed: Incentivizing Hindi Reasoning in Medical LLMs

author.name: Dingfeng Jiang, Han Yan, Chenze Ma, Amit Kumar Jaiswal, Ang Li, Yunxiang Jiang, Xinlei Xiong, Juhao Liang, Hongru Xiao, Xiang Li, Fan Bu, Jiale Han, Ruchir Gupta, Prayag Tiwari, Benyou Wang

entry.summary: HiMed introduces a Hindi medical reasoning corpus and benchmark covering Western and Indian medicine, plus an 8B model trained with a decaying scaffolding reward to reduce the English-Hindi accuracy gap. Addresses underrepresentation of Hindi in medical LLMs.

entry.title: StepGap: A Hybrid NLI-LLM Checker for Step-Level Evidence-Gap Detectionin Multi-Hop Question Answering

author.name: Yuelyu Ji, Zhuochun Li, Hui Ji, Daqing He

entry.summary: StepGap is a hybrid NLI-LLM decision tree for detecting step-level evidence gaps in multi-hop QA, classifying issues as contradicted claim, irrelevant evidence, or missing bridge. Reveals competing-error cancellation in monolithic LLM baselines.

entry.title: MultiHaluDet: Multilingual Hallucination Detection via LLM Hidden State Probing

author.name: Riasad Alvi, Nurul Labib Sayeedi, Md. Faiyaz Abdullah Sayeedi

entry.summary: MultiHaluDet probes full hidden state trajectories of frozen LLMs across multiple layers via a three-stage stacking framework for multilingual hallucination detection without language-specific fine-tuning.

entry.title: Locality Matters for Training-Free Audio Token Compression in Audio-Language Models

author.name: Jiale Luo, Xiaoyu Liang, Haoji Hu

entry.summary: LTBM is a training-free local temporal bipartite merging method for compressing audio tokens in audio-language models, preserving local acoustic context better than score-based pruning or fixed pooling.

entry.title: P1SCO: Social Dimensions from a Perspectivist Lens

author.name: Amanda Cercas Curry, Gianmarco de Francisci Morales, Luca Maria Aiello

entry.summary: P1SCO dataset of social media comments from three platforms annotated across ten social dimensions with rich annotator metadata including demographics and Big Five personality, preserving perspectivist diversity.

entry.title: GeoMathCode: Understanding Interleaved Math-Code Reasoning for Geometry Problem Solving

author.name: Yingji Zhang, Yong Dai, Andr\'e Freitas

entry.summary: GeoMathCode introduces programmatic representations as intermediate visual outputs for geometry problem solving in multimodal LLMs, analyzing the disentanglement of reasoning from code generation.

entry.title: Proactive for Uncertainty: Cause-Aware Error Diagnosis and Interactive Clarification for Spoken Dialogue Systems

author.name: Yizhou Peng, Ziyang Ma, Changsong Liu, Yi-Wen Chao, Xie Chen, Eng Siong Chng

entry.summary: Cause-aware error diagnosis for cascaded ASR-LLM spoken dialogue systems that distinguishes acoustic vs linguistic mismatches and triggers targeted clarification strategies rather than relying on simple confidence filtering.

entry.title: GeoSVG-RL: Geometry-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Layout-Constrained Text-to-SVG Diagram Generation

author.name: Sifan Li, Yujun Cai, Hongkai Chen, Yiwei Wang

entry.summary: GeoSVG-RL is a reinforcement learning framework for layout-constrained text-to-SVG diagram generation that optimizes geometric validity beyond token-level likelihood to avoid misaligned connectors and out-of-canvas drift.

entry.title: CRPO: Character-centric Group Relative Policy Optimization for Role-aware Reasoning in Role-playing Agents

author.name: Yihong Tang, Kehai Chen, Liang Yue, Benyou Wang, Min Zhang

entry.summary: CRPO is a character-centric GRPO variant for role-playing agents that decouples task logic from stylistic rewards to address persona collapse and style loss in standard RL.

entry.title: Multilingual Phonological Feature Recognition with Self-Supervised Speech Models

author.name: Abner Hernandez, Tom\'as Arias-Vergara, Daiqi Liu, Andreas Maier, Paula Andrea P\'erez-Toro

entry.summary: PhonoQ-2.0 is a multilingual frame-level phonological feature recognizer on self-supervised speech models with a manner-conditioned gating mechanism for valid feature groups, achieving 91.3% macro-F1.

entry.title: Can LoRA Fusion Support Cross-Domain Tasks in Cloud-Edge Collaboration?

author.name: Yatong Wang, Fali Wang, Naibin Gu, Zheng Lin, Zhengxiao Liu, Dingyu Yao, Zhiwei Zhang, Jianxin Shi, Weiping Wang

entry.summary: Prune-train-recover framework enabling local LoRA training on pruned models in edge devices for privacy-preserving cloud-edge collaborative LLM adaptation across cross-domain tasks.

entry.title: Neural Router: Semantic Content Matching for Agentic AI

author.name: Lauri Lov\'en, Abhishek Kumar, Alexander Engelhardt, Alaa Saleh, Roberto Morabito, Xiaoli Liu, Naser Hossein Motlagh, Sasu Tarkoma

entry.summary: Proposes using LLMs as semantic-matching engines for content-based publish/subscribe brokers in edge-cloud agentic AI systems. Identifies two cost-accuracy crossover points that characterize when LLM-based routing is viable versus when accuracy collapses.

entry.title: Millimeter-wave Imaging for Anthropometric Body Measurement

author.name: Miriam Senne, Benjamin D. Killeen, Christoph Baur, Nassir Navab, Azade Farshad

entry.summary: Uses millimeter-wave radar to recover 3D human body shape and anthropometric measurements without requiring undressing or sustained poses. Targets clinical workflows where conventional methods exclude older adults and those with limited mobility.

entry.title: SLIP-RS: Structured-Attribute Language-Image Pre-Training for Remote Sensing Object Detection

author.name: Chenxu Wang, Yuxuan Li, Yunheng Li, Xiang Li, Jingyuan Xia, Qibin Hou

entry.summary: SLIP-RS proposes structured-attribute decoupling for remote sensing object detection, mapping open-ended categories into a finite attribute space. Uses structured-attribute contrastive learning to enforce decoupled visual logic.

entry.title: PhenoYieldNet: Learning Crop-Aware Phenological Responses for Multi-Crop Yield Prediction

author.name: Yu Luo, Xiaogang Zhu, Shan Zeng, Wei Xiang, Thomas Francis Bishop, Zhiyong Wang, Kun Hu

entry.summary: PhenoYieldNet is a multi-crop yield prediction framework with crop-aware phenological response modeling using a Crop Phenology Bank and Crop Phenology Attention module. Targets generalization across diverse crop types via temporal driver modeling.

entry.title: Generator-Refiner-Examiner: A Tri-Module Data Augmentation Framework for 3D Human Avatar Learning from Monocular Videos

author.name: Gangjian Zhang, Jian Shu, Sicheng Yu, Wenhao Shen, Yu Feng, Hao Wang

entry.summary: TrioMan is a tri-module framework (Generator, Refiner, Examiner) for data augmentation in 3D human avatar learning from monocular videos. Combines Gaussian perturbations, one-step diffusion refinement, and subject-consistency selection.

entry.title: ExpOS: Explainable Open-Surgery Skills Assessment Using 3D Hand Reconstruction

author.name: Roi Papo, Idan Smoller, Shlomi Laufer

entry.summary: ExpOS is an explainable framework for open-surgery skill assessment using 3D hand reconstruction, trained on 221 videos across three tasks. Learns discriminative temporal patterns directly from motion data rather than expert-defined metrics.

entry.title: Turning Adaptation into Assets: Cross-Domain Bridging for Online Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Zixuan Hu, Xuantuo Huang, Yancheng Li, Yichun Hu, Shengyong Xu, Ling-Yu Duan

entry.summary: IDEA accumulates soft prompts as composable assets for online test-time adaptation in vision-language navigation, mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: What Linear Probes Miss: Multi-View Probing for Weight-Space Learning

author.name: Eunwoo Heo, Kyeongkook Seo, Jaejun Yoo

entry.summary: MVProbe extends weight-space probing methods with multi-view designs that capture higher-order row-column correlations in model weights, useful for analyzing open-source model repositories.

entry.title: Cost-Effective Model Evaluation with Meta-Learning

author.name: Trinh Pham, Viet Huynh, Hongzhi Yin, Quoc Viet Hung Nguyen, Thanh Tam Nguyen

entry.summary: MetaEvaluator uses meta-learning over a reference model pool to provide cost-effective label-free evaluation of unseen models across architectures and modalities.

entry.title: Debiased Negative Mining Improves Out-of-distribution Detection with Pre-trained Vision-Language Models

author.name: Bo Peng, Jie Lu, Guangquan Zhang, Zhen Fang

entry.summary: Debiased negative mining for VLM-based out-of-distribution detection, addressing biases in heuristic negative label selection.

entry.title: Memory Uncertainty Relation and Harmonic Memory in Random Recurrent Networks

author.name: Taichi Haruna, Kohei Nakajima

entry.summary: Derives an uncertainty relation bounding short-term memory capacity in recurrent dynamical systems, with achievability conditions for harmonic memory.

entry.title: AcroRL: Learning Aggressive Quadrotor Inversion using Bidirectional Thrust

author.name: Gabriel Rodriguez, Henri Sayag, Abhishek Rathod, John Stecklein, Siddharth Saha, Christopher Barngrover, Wennie Tabib

entry.summary: AcroRL learns aggressive bidirectional-thrust quadrotor inversions and inverted flight via RL-modulated reference trajectories.

entry.title: PACT: Proactive Asking for Continual Task Assistance in Human-Robot Collaboration

author.name: Chengbo He, Sheng Li, Chenyang Ma, Bochao Zou, Li Sun, Jiansheng Chen, Junliang Xing, Yuanchun Shi, Huimin Ma

entry.summary: PACT is an ask-or-act framework for proactive clarification in long-term human-robot collaboration, leveraging accumulated cross-day interaction history.

entry.title: Polymander II: an amphibious salamander-inspired robot with contact and flow sensors

author.name: Qiyuan Fu, Sudong Lee, Andrea Grillo, Jonathan Arreguit, Louis Gevers, Josie Hughes, Auke J. Ijspeert

entry.summary: Polymander II is an amphibious salamander-inspired robot with embedded Hall-effect sensors for contact and flow sensing in both terrestrial and aquatic settings. From Ijspeert's EPFL group.

entry.title: Towards Low-Gravity Planetary Exploration using Reinforcement Learning for Walking, Jumping, and In-flight Attitude Control

author.name: J{\o}rgen Anker Olsen, Kostas Alexis

entry.summary: RL policies for walking, jumping, and in-flight attitude control on a Mars-suited quadruped, with sim-to-real attitude control validated on the Olympus platform.

entry.title: MuJoCoUni:Persistent Batched Runtime Primitives for MuJoCo

author.name: Yufei Jia, Junzhe Wu

entry.title: ParkingWorld: End-to-End Autonomous Parking Reinforcement Learning from Corrective Experience in 3DGS Simulation

author.name: Zhengcheng Yu, Changze Li, Haoran Liu, Tong Qin

entry.title: InvariantCloud: A Globally Invariant, Uniquely Indexed Point Cloud Framework for Robust 6-DoF Tactile Pose Tracking

author.name: Pengfei Ye, Yuxiang Ma, Yi Zhou, Wei Chen, Wenzhen Dong, Molong Duan

entry.title: OPAL: Omnidirectional Path-efficient Aerial 3D expLoration

author.name: Yoga Satwik Chappidi, Avideh Zakhor

entry.title: Action-Prior Denoising for Smooth Real-Time Chunking

author.name: Dongyang Liu, Zhaowen Zheng, Yu Sun, Longxu Zhang, Yixuan Liu, Hao Wan

entry.title: HoLoArm: Deformable Arms for Collision-Tolerant Quadrotor Flight

author.name: Quang Ngoc Pham, Jonas Eschmann, Yang Zhou, Alejandro Ojeda Olarte, Giuseppe Loianno, Van Anh Ho

entry.summary: HoLoArm is a compliant quadrotor with deformable arms inspired by dragonfly wing structures, integrated with RL control for collision-tolerant flight and rapid recovery.

entry.title: RePlan-Bot: Multi-Level Replanning for Embodied Instruction Following

author.name: Xicheng Gong, Guozheng Sun, Peiran Xu, Yadong Mu

entry.title: AgentGrounder: Zero-Shot 3D Visual Pointcloud Grounding using Multimodal Language Models

author.name: Cuong Huynh, Maxim Popov, Denis Gridusov, Sergey Kolyubin

entry.title: Error estimates for tamed Euler and Randomized Euler schemes for SDEs with locally Lipschitz drift with applications to non-logconcave sampling and optimization

author.name: Iosif Lytras, Angelos Ntousis

entry.title: Debiasing Random Oblique Projections for Subsampled OLS and Fast CUR in High Dimensions

entry.title: Boosted Stochastic Frank-Wolfe for Constrained Nonconvex Optimization

author.name: Navil Nandhan, Abbas Khademi, Antonio Silveti-Falls

entry.title: BoxLitE: A Faithful Knowledge Base Embedding Based on Convex Optimization

author.name: Bruno F. Louren\c{c}o, Hesham Morgan, Ana Ozaki, Aleksandar Pavlovi\'c, Emanuel Sallinger

entry.title: Uncertainty Decomposition via Cyclical SG-MCMC and Soft-label Learning for Subjective NLP

author.name: Keito Inoshita, Takato Ueno

entry.summary: Combines cyclical SG-MCMC Bayesian inference with soft-label learning on a frozen RoBERTa head for subjective NLP emotion classification, outperforming MC Dropout and Deep Ensembles on annotator-distribution fidelity.

entry.title: PRIMA: Operational Patterns for Resilient Multi-Agent Research with Verifiable Identity and Convergent Feedback

author.name: Sasank Annapureddy

entry.title: GRAIL: AI translation for scientists application workflow on satellite data

author.name: Zhuocheng Shang, Ahmed Eldawy

entry.title: Geo-Expert: Towards Expert-Level Geological Reasoning via Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning

author.name: Chenyou Guo, Zongqi Liu, Yizhou Zhang, Zhaorui Jiang, Ze Liu

entry.title: Evolutionary Enhanced Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Cooperative Air Combat

author.name: Chengwei Li, Junlin Liu, Yang Gao

entry.title: ADMFormer: An Adaptive-Decomposition Transformer with Time-Varying Masked Spatial Attention for Traffic Forecasting

author.name: Ruiwen Gu, Qitai Tan, Yahao Liu, Xiao-Ping Zhang

entry.title: PHGNet: Prototype-Guided Hypergraph Construction for Heterogeneous Spatiotemporal Forecasting

author.name: Ruiwen Gu, Yahao Liu, Zhenyu Liu, Qitai Tan, Xiao-Ping Zhang

entry.title: Improving Labeling Consistency with Detailed Constitutional Definitions and AI-Driven Evaluation

author.name: Konstantin Berlin, Adam Swanda

entry.title: Benchmarking Patent Embeddings: A Multi-Task Evaluation of 22 Models Across Retrieval, Classification, and Clustering

author.name: Amirhossein Yousefiramandi, Ciaran Cooney

entry.title: Temporal Concept Drift in Legal Judgment Prediction: Neural Baselines Across Three Epochs of Ukrainian Court Decisions

entry.title: FoodMonitor: Benchmarking MLLMs for Explainable Compliance Analysis

entry.title: Catching MRI outliers: unsupervised detection and localization of MRI artefacts and clinical anomalies using deep learning

author.name: Mustafa Kadhim, Viktor Rogowski, Emilia Persson, Camila Gonzalez, Andr\'e Haraldsson, Sofie Ceberg, Mikael Nilsson, Malin K\"ugele, Sven B\"ack, Christian Jamtheim Gustafsson

entry.title: DisDop: Distillation with Domain Priors for Open-Vocabulary Aerial Object Detection

author.name: Ruihao Xu, Yong Liu, Yansong Tang, Sule Bai, Xubing Ye, Bingyao Yu, Yutao Guo, Jiwen Lu, Jie Zhou

entry.title: Anatomy-Anchored Self-Supervision: Distilling Vision Foundation Models for Invariant Ultrasound Representation

entry.title: PennySynth: RAG-Driven Data Synthesis for Automated Quantum Code Generation

entry.title: MDGMIX: Boundary-Aware Subgraph Mixing for Multi-Domain Graph Pre-Training

entry.title: GFSR: Geometric Fidelity and Spatial Refinement for Reliable Lane Detection

author.name: Kakia Panagidi, Stathes Hadjieftymiadis

entry.title: Semantic-Aware Guided Drone Exploration for Language-Conditioned 3D Indoor Mapping

author.name: Nitin Vegesna, Avideh Zakhor

entry.title: Discontinuous Galerkin Neural Operator for Pathology Defocus Deblurring

author.name: Shaoqing Duan, Haofei Song, Xintian Mao, Qingli Li, Yan Wang

entry.title: RED: Adaptive Real-Time DAG Scheduling for Robotic Inference under Environmental Dynamics

author.name: Zexin Li, Tao Ren, Johnathan Liu, Xiaoxi He, Cong Liu

entry.title: RoboHitch: Learning Visual Affordance from Disordered Keypoints for Hitch Knots Tying

author.name: Jiahui Zuo, Boyang Zhang, Fumin Zhang

author.name: Jianzhu Huai, Yiwen Chen, Binliang Wang

author.name: Imesh Ekanayake, Elham Naghizade, Jeffrey Chan

entry.title: SEP-Attack: A Simple and Effective Paradigm for Transfer-Based Textual Adversarial Attack

entry.title: Trust-Aware Joint Feature-Prediction Discrepancy for Robust Domain Adaptation

author.name: Xi Ding, Lei Wang, Syuan-Hao Li, Yongsheng Gao

entry.title: Theoretical Analysis of Sparse Optimization with Reparameterization, Weight Decay, and Adaptive Learning Rate

author.name: Huangyu Xu, Jingqin Yang, Qianqian Xu, Jiaye Teng

author.name: Muslim Chochlov, Michael English, Jim Buckley

author.name: Alexander Apartsin, Omri Sason, Yehudit Aperstein

author.name: Rustem Takhanov, Zhenisbek Assylbekov

entry.title: DriftingMol: Decoder-Coupled Drift for One-Pass Property-Conditional Molecular Generation

author.name: Zeyu Shen, Zhuoyuan Wang, Laixi Shi

entry.title: MedMamba: Multi-View State Space Models with Adaptive Graph Learning for Medical Time Series Classification

entry.title: Evolving Causal Regulatory Networks (ECR-Net)

entry.summary: Applies cooperative ensemble learning with SHAP-based feature selection to forecast electricity consumption at university campuses. Compares LSTM, RF, SVR, and XGBoost with seven years of historical data.

entry.title: Evaluating passing decision-making in professional football: An enhanced MPNN approach to Receiver Selection

author.name: Gabriel Masella, Giuseppe Alessio D'Inverno, Max Goldsmith, Gianluigi Rozza

entry.summary: Develops a message-passing GNN framework for predicting optimal pass receivers in professional football using positional, distance, angle, and pressure features. Uses synchronized tracking and event data.

entry.title: Predicting Stock Price Direction on Earnings Announcement Days using Multi-modal Deep Learning

author.name: Manuel Noseda, Nathan Soldati, Marco Paina

entry.summary: Evaluates multimodal deep learning combining FinBERT-derived news sentiment with fundamentals and technical indicators for predicting earnings announcement directional movements. Compares LSTM and Transformer with logistic baseline.

entry.title: From Index to Equity: Pre-Training Transformers for Stock Return Prediction

author.name: Marie Soehl Coolsaet, Roberto Gallardo, Zhen Gao

entry.summary: Investigates transformer pre-training on stock index data and fine-tuning on individual stocks, benchmarking against LSTM and XGBoost. Shows pre-training improves binary cross-entropy.

entry.title: Physics-Guided Concentration Inference from Resistance Transients in a Mixed-Phase SnO-SnO$_2$ Carbon Monoxide Sensor with p-n Switching

author.name: Sani Biswas, Preetam Singh, Amit Kumar Gangwar

entry.summary: Physics-guided ML framework for inferring carbon monoxide concentration from gas sensor resistance transients in mixed-phase SnO-SnO2 materials. Combines descriptors with FFT/wavelet features.

entry.title: Clustering based on Stochastic Dominance with application for risk averters and risk seekers

author.name: Hua Li, Xue Jia, Yilin Kang, Wing-Keung Wong

entry.summary: Clustering framework using stochastic dominance test statistics rather than geometric distances for stocks aligned to investor risk preferences. Tailored for risk-averse and risk-seeking allocations.

entry.title: ROC Analysis for Evaluating Translation Quality Estimation Systems

author.name: Evelyn Y. Garland (Acta-Transphere), Carola F. Berger (CFB Scientific Translations LLC)

entry.summary: Proposes using ROC analysis as a decision-oriented evaluation method for machine translation quality estimation systems. Argues it provides actionable business insights consistent with current methods.

entry.title: Online Hand Gesture Recognition Using 3D Convolutional Neural Networks

author.name: Yinghao Qin, Tijana Timotijevic

entry.summary: Online hand gesture recognition system using 3D CNNs with sliding window refinement, achieving 98%+ detector accuracy and 90%+ classifier accuracy on Jester database. Targets real-time human-computer interaction.

entry.title: Extending Deep Event Visual Odometry with Sparse Point-Cloud Export

author.name: Alireza Safdari, Sajad Ashraf

entry.summary: Extends Deep Event Visual Odometry with a sparse point-cloud export pipeline, enabling visualization of internal 3D structure.

entry.title: Anarchy in the swarm: Testing informed and uninformed diversity-enhancing mechanisms within PSO framework

author.name: Piotr Urba\'nczyk, Aleksandra Urba\'nczyk

entry.summary: Compares informed vs uninformed diversity-enhancing strategies in Particle Swarm Optimization to combat premature convergence.

entry.title: A Scalable Benchmark Test Suite for Dynamic Multi-Objective Optimization with a Changing Number of Objectives

author.name: Ke Shang, Zhiyun Xiao, Yuxuan Liu, Jianguo Li, Shaojiang Wang, Wei Sun

entry.summary: Proposes a benchmark suite for dynamic multi-objective optimization with changing numbers of objectives, addressing flaws in prior benchmarks.

entry.title: Investigating the Effect of a Series Elastic Actuation Retrofit to Black-Box Actuators

author.name: Ivan Tregear, Ayhan Aktas, Ferdinando Rodriguez y Baena

entry.summary: Investigates retrofitting series elastic actuation to black-box actuators to add compliance and improve force control bandwidth.

entry.title: Soft Pneumatic Actuators for Soft Robotics: A Motion-Based Review of Actuation Mechanisms and Performance Trade-offs

author.name: Mohammed Abboodi

entry.summary: Motion-based review of soft pneumatic actuator design strategies and trade-offs in soft robotics.

entry.title: SEIDM: A Safe and Efficient Intelligent Driver Model for Autonomous Driving Behavior

author.name: Yuyang Yao, Shaocheng Luo

entry.summary: Safe and Efficient Intelligent Driver Model adds an adaptive safety factor to IDM for improved traffic flow without compromising safety in ACC applications.

entry.title: Memory, Roughness, and Information Persistence in Financial Markets: A Structural Approach to Volatility Forecasting

author.name: Akash Deep, Nicholas Appiah, Svetlozar T. Rachev

entry.summary: Empirical study of long-memory and rough volatility dynamics in 115 S&P500 stocks (2001-2026), finding persistence measures contain economically meaningful forecasting information.

entry.title: Shared Keyboard: An improved Bayesian design for phase I clinical trials via Beta kernel process

author.name: Jiangyan Zhao, Xian Shi, Jin Xu

entry.summary: Bayesian model-assisted clinical trial design using Beta kernel processes to share information across neighboring dose levels in phase I oncology trials.

entry.title: Announcing the Frontier Biodefense Fellowship (deadline 2 June)

author.name: Tobias H

entry.summary: Announcement of the Frontier Biodefense Fellowship at pivotal in London, covering AIxBio, biohardening, governance, and pandemic preparedness with mentorship from SecureBio, Blueprint, and others.

entry.title: A Dynamical Framework for Cognitive Processes Based on Transformations and Semantic Equivalence

author.name: Carlo Cattani, Dioneia Motta Monte-Serrat

entry.summary: Proposes a dynamical and categorical framework modeling cognitive processes as iterative transformations with semantic equivalence stabilization. Highly abstract theoretical work.

entry.title: A Novel Approach for the Counting of Wood Logs Using cGANs and Image Processing Techniques

author.name: Jo\~ao VC Mazzochin, Giovani Bernardes Vitor, Gustavo Tiecker, Elioenai MF Diniz, Gilson A Oliveira, Marcelo Trentin, \'Erick O Rodrigues

entry.summary: Uses cGANs and image processing to count eucalyptus wood logs from images, releasing a 466-image dataset. Practical application for forestry/materials management.

entry.title: Machine learning applied to emerald gemstone grading: framework proposal and creation of a public dataset

author.name: FB Pena, D Crabi, Sandro C Izidoro, \'Erick O Rodrigues, G Bernardes

entry.summary: Proposes a machine learning framework for emerald gemstone grading with a public dataset, automating an otherwise subjective manual process.

entry.title: Terrain-Adaptive Grouser Wheel for Optimal Planetary Exploration: Design and Experimental Investigation

author.name: Vincent Griffo, Yashwanth Kumar Nakka

entry.summary: Multimodal wheel design with adjustable grouser height for planetary rover terrain adaptation.

entry.title: Multi-market value-stacking: Battery control for combined imbalance participation and non-uniform FCR bidding

author.name: Celle Hendrickx, Fabio Pavirani, Chris Develder

entry.summary: Two-stage control framework for battery storage participating in non-uniform FCR bidding and imbalance arbitrage in European markets. Energy systems optimization paper.

entry.title: Cultivating Machine Intelligence: The OMEGA Shift from Top-Down Optimization to Autopoietic Cognitive Ecologies

author.name: Ata G. Zare

entry.summary: RECLAIM is a theoretical framework proposing autopoietic cognitive ecologies as an alternative to top-down gradient-descent AI training. Position paper with little empirical content.

entry.title: Path Following Control System of Line-of-Sight Guidance for Robotic Dolphin with Multi-Link Mechanism in Underwater Simulator

author.name: Takumi Asada, Takao Oki, Hideo Furuhashi, Kenta Tabata, Renato Miyagusuku, Koichi Ozaki

entry.summary: Path-following control system for biomimetic underwater dolphin robots with multi-link mechanisms, evaluated in simulation. Domain-specific contribution.

entry.title: Applications open for the Secure Program Synthesis Fellowship

author.name: eitan sprejer

entry.summary: Announcement for Apart Research and Atlas Computing's Secure Program Synthesis Fellowship focused on formal methods, AI systems, and security.

entry.title: Spacetime Formation under Requirements: Contextual Realization and Form-Dependent Probability

author.name: Song-Ju Kim

entry.summary: Reinterprets quantum probability in cognition as fixed-spacetime projection of contextual spacetime formation under finite-state requirements. Highly speculative cross-disciplinary work.

entry.title: Posture Clip: Sit properly or I wont let you work

author.name: Arka Majhi, Aparajita Mondal

entry.summary: Hardware device that blacks out laptop screens when poor posture is detected via collar-clipped sensors. User study with 165 participants on intervention effectiveness.

entry.title: Research Summary: May 25, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research is dominated by safety/red-teaming findings on frontier models and foundational advances in training, retrieval, and RL.

Safety, Alignment & Red-Teaming:

  • Test-Time Training is shown to break safety guardrails, achieving 95% ASR under LoRA with cross-model transfer
  • Evaluation awareness is decomposed into environment recognizability and propensity via 8 trigger factors and CoT monitoring
  • PoisonForge compromises 11/12 instruction-tuned LLMs at just 1% poison budget in supply-chain attacks
  • Cross-lingual multimodal red-teaming of Claude Sonnet 4.5, GPT-5, Pixtral Large, Qwen Omni finds non-uniform vulnerability shifts between en-US and es-MX
  • Geopolitical bias is empirically traced to post-training, not pretraining, amplified by prompt language

Foundations & Systems:

  • Inductive Deductive Synthesis (IDS) from Stoica/Zaharia/Ratnasamy jointly synthesizes implementation and proof for formally verified distributed systems, beating Codex/Gemini agents
  • Unextractable Protocol Models enable collaborative training where no participant ever holds extractable weights
  • New approximate attention algorithms approach I/O-optimality with almost-linear cost in n, improving on FlashAttention
  • Shannon Scaling Law reframes LLM training as noisy-channel transmission, mapping params to bandwidth and tokens to signal power

RL & Evaluation Methodology:

  • LEO enables all-goals off-policy RL via single-forward-pass value/action prediction over every goal
  • Seeing without Looking shows VLM benchmarks barely degrade when image tokens are removed, questioning whether they test vision at all
entry.content:
Today's research is dominated by safety/red-teaming findings on frontier models and foundational advances in training, retrieval, and RL.

Safety, Alignment & Red-Teaming:

  • Test-Time Training is shown to break safety guardrails, achieving 95% ASR under LoRA with cross-model transfer
  • Evaluation awareness is decomposed into environment recognizability and propensity via 8 trigger factors and CoT monitoring
  • PoisonForge compromises 11/12 instruction-tuned LLMs at just 1% poison budget in supply-chain attacks
  • Cross-lingual multimodal red-teaming of Claude Sonnet 4.5, GPT-5, Pixtral Large, Qwen Omni finds non-uniform vulnerability shifts between en-US and es-MX
  • Geopolitical bias is empirically traced to post-training, not pretraining, amplified by prompt language

Foundations & Systems:

  • Inductive Deductive Synthesis (IDS) from Stoica/Zaharia/Ratnasamy jointly synthesizes implementation and proof for formally verified distributed systems, beating Codex/Gemini agents
  • Unextractable Protocol Models enable collaborative training where no participant ever holds extractable weights
  • New approximate attention algorithms approach I/O-optimality with almost-linear cost in n, improving on FlashAttention
  • Shannon Scaling Law reframes LLM training as noisy-channel transmission, mapping params to bandwidth and tokens to signal power

RL & Evaluation Methodology:

  • LEO enables all-goals off-policy RL via single-forward-pass value/action prediction over every goal
  • Seeing without Looking shows VLM benchmarks barely degrade when image tokens are removed, questioning whether they test vision at all

entry.title: Inductive Deductive Synthesis: Enabling AI to Generate Formally Verified Systems

author.name: Shubham Agarwal, Alexander Krentsel, Shu Liu, Mert Cemri, Audrey Cheng, Rui Meng, Tomas Pfister, Chun-Liang Li, Sylvia Ratnasamy, Aditya Parameswaran, Matei Zaharia, Ion Stoica, Mohsen Lesani

entry.summary: Inductive Deductive Synthesis (IDS) jointly synthesizes implementation and proof for formally verified distributed systems, where SOTA agents (Codex/GPT-5.4, Claude Opus 4.6) succeed on only 2/7 tasks. Strong author list and significant capability gap addressed.

entry.title: Test-Time Training Undermines Safety Guardrails

author.name: Simone Antonelli, Sadegh Akhondzadeh, Aleksandar Bojchevski

entry.summary: Demonstrates that Test-Time Training enables new jailbreak attacks with 95% Attack Success Rate over 10 trials under LoRA, transferring across model families. Important safety finding for adaptive inference.

entry.title: Decomposing and Measuring Evaluation Awareness

author.name: Changling Li, Terry Jingchen Zhang, Jie Zhang, Zhijing Jin, Sahar Abdelnabi, Maksym Andriushchenko

entry.summary: Decomposes evaluation awareness into environment recognizability and model propensity, operationalizing through 8 trigger factors and CoT monitoring across 9 frontier models and 4 benchmarks. Important framework for studying evaluation gaming.

entry.title: Unextractable Protocol Models: Collaborative Training and Inference without Weight Materialization

author.name: Alexander Long, Chamin Hewa Koneputugodage, Thalaiyasingam Ajanthan, Yan Zuo, Gil Avraham, Violetta Shevchenko, Hadi Mohaghegh Dolatabadi, Sameera Ramasinghe

entry.summary: UPMs introduce time-varying invertible transforms at participant boundaries in distributed model training so that no participant ever holds extractable weights, while preserving network function. Tested on Qwen-2.5 and Llama-3.2 with negligible perplexity loss.

entry.title: Goal-Conditioned Agents that Learn Everything All at Once

author.name: Michael Matthews, Matthew Jackson, Michael Beukman, Thomas Foster, Alistair Letcher, Scott Fujimoto, C\'edric Colas, Jakob Foerster

entry.summary: LEO enables efficient all-goals off-policy learning by jointly outputting values and actions for every goal in a single forward pass, avoiding naive relabelling cost. Significantly outperforms baselines on goal-conditioned Craftax. Authors include Jakob Foerster and others from established RL groups.

entry.title: It's the humans, not the data: Geopolitical bias in LLMs originates in post-training, amplified by the language of the prompt

author.name: Stuart Bladon, Brinnae Bent

entry.summary: Empirical study showing that geopolitical bias in LLMs originates from post-training (not pretraining), with developer-aligned shifts after instruction tuning. Strongest in Qwen 2.5 (China-favorability shifts dramatically). Important finding for alignment research.

entry.title: Seeing without Looking: Do Vision-Language Benchmarks Really Test Vision?

author.name: Zixuan Lan, Luzhe Sun, Matthew R. Walter, Jiawei Zhou

entry.summary: Investigates whether VLM benchmarks actually test visual understanding by showing that removing image tokens barely degrades performance on hallucination benchmarks. Reveals significant disconnect between benchmark accuracy and grounded visual reasoning.

entry.title: Sparse Autoencoders Map Brain-LLM Alignment onto Cortical Semantic Topography

author.name: Dongxin Guo, Jikun Wu, Siu Ming Yiu

entry.summary: Uses sparse autoencoders to decompose GPT-2 XL and Llama-3.1-8B and shows semantic features alone recover 94% of brain encoding performance, mapping LLM features onto cortical semantic topography. Strong mechanistic evidence linking SAE features to neuroscience.

entry.title: Same Model, Different Weakness: How Language and Modality Reshape the Jailbreak Attack Surface in Frontier MLLMs

author.name: Casey Ford, Madison Van Doren, Sicheng Jin, and Emily Dix

entry.summary: Cross-lingual multimodal red-teaming of Claude Sonnet 4.5, GPT-5, Pixtral Large, Qwen Omni in en-US vs es-MX, finding language non-uniformly shifts vulnerability surface (52K ratings, 9 annotators per group).

entry.title: PoisonForge: Task-Level Targeted Poisoning Benchmark for Instruction-Tuned LLMs

author.name: Luze Sun, Anshuman Suri, Harsh Chaudhari, Cristina Nita-Rotaru, Alina Oprea

entry.summary: PoisonForge: 4-dimensional task-level poisoning benchmark for instruction tuning showing 11/12 models compromised at 1% poison budget. Strong adversarial ML team (Oprea, Nita-Rotaru).

entry.title: FastKernels: Benchmarking GPU Kernel Generation in Production

author.name: Gabriele Oliaro, Yichao Fu, May Jiang, Owen Lu, Junli Wang, Zhihao Jia, Hao Zhang, and Samyam Rajbhandari

entry.summary: FastKernels: production-aligned benchmark of 46 architectures for LLM-agent GPU kernel generation, exposing how existing benchmarks reward sandbox tricks rather than real systems performance. Includes Zhihao Jia, Samyam Rajbhandari.

entry.title: Are Frontier LLMs Ready for Cybersecurity? Evidence for Vertical Foundation Models from Dual-Mode Vulnerability Benchmarks

author.name: Vivek Dahiya, Sunny Nehra, Vipul Dholariya, Bhavik Shangari, Chandra Khatri

entry.summary: Dual-mode benchmark (white-box vulnerability detection + black-box web app pentesting) finding all six frontier models (GPT-5.4, Codex-5.3, Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Gemini 3 Flash) produce 10-50% FP rates and only 4-19% GT coverage—argues for vertical foundation models.
