entry.title: Convergence Without Understanding: When Language Models Agree on Representations but Disagree on Reasoning

author.name: Muhammad Usama and Dong Eui Chang

entry.summary: Tests Platonic Representation Hypothesis at reasoning level: 16 LLMs across 8 families show high representational convergence (CKA=0.897) on problems they collectively fail, but disagree on reasoning. Provocative dissociation finding.

entry.title: Socially fluent AI decouples conversational signals from source identity in online interaction

author.name: Lixiang Yan, Yueqiao Jin, Xibin Han, and Dragan Ga\v{s}evi\'c

entry.summary: Empirical study with 786 participants and 1,572 identity judgments showing socially fluent AI agents are not distinguished from humans above chance in synchronous group interactions, despite robust behavioral cues being present.

entry.title: ARES: Automated Rubric Synthesis for Scalable LLM Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Xiaoyuan Li, Keqin Bao, Moxin Li, Yubo Ma, Yichang Zhang, Wenjie Wang, Fuli Feng, Dayiheng Liu

entry.summary: ARES automatically synthesizes question-specific weighted rubrics from raw pretraining documents for rubric-based RL of LLMs, scaling beyond expert-written rubrics. Addresses a real bottleneck in extending RLVR to open-ended tasks.

entry.title: Is Dimensionality a Barrier for Retrieval Models?

author.name: Kiril Bangachev, Guy Bresler, Jonathan Kogan, Yury Polyanskiy

entry.summary: Theoretical study of why low-dimensional embeddings (~1000d) scale to billions/trillions of documents in retrieval, building on classical communication complexity. Authors include Polyanskiy (well-known information theorist) at MIT.

entry.title: Less Effort, Shorter Proofs: Reinforcement Learning for Security Protocol Analysis in Tamarin

author.name: Matthias Cosler, Cas Cremers, Bernd Finkbeiner, Mohamed Ghanem, Niklas Medinger

entry.summary: RL framework inspired by AlphaZero/AlphaProof for security protocol analysis in Tamarin, using MCTS with neural heuristics learned from completed subproofs. Evaluated on 16 case studies including 5G/EMV/WPA2-style protocols. Authors include Cas Cremers (well-known protocol analysis researcher).

entry.title: Approaching I/O-optimality for Approximate Attention

author.name: P\'al Andr\'as Papp, Aleksandros Sobczyk, Anastasios Zouzias

entry.summary: Presents I/O-efficient algorithms for approximate attention with almost-linear (rather than quadratic) I/O cost in sequence length n, improving on FlashAttention's complexity. Theoretically significant for scaling LLMs to long contexts.

entry.title: LLMs as Noisy Channels: A Shannon Perspective on Model Capacity and Scaling Laws

author.name: Xu Ouyang, Deyi Liu, Yuhang Cai, Jing Liu, Yuan Yang, Chen Zheng, Thomas Hartvigsen, Yiyuan Ma

entry.summary: Proposes a Shannon Scaling Law modeling LLM training as transmission over a noisy channel, mapping parameters to bandwidth and tokens to signal power. Explains non-monotonic phenomena like catastrophic overtraining and quantization degradation that monotonic power laws miss.

entry.title: Weisfeiler-Leman Is Incomplete on Simple Spectrum Graphs, so Canonicalize Them

author.name: Snir Hordan, Nadav Dym and Tim Seppelt

entry.summary: Proves that k-Weisfeiler-Leman tests cannot distinguish all non-isomorphic simple-spectrum graphs, limiting GNN expressivity, and introduces PRiSM, the first provably complete canonicalization for such graphs. Resolves an open problem in GNN expressivity theory.

entry.title: Asymmetric Scaling Laws from Sparse Features

author.name: John Sous and Michael Winer

entry.summary: Theoretical model for scaling laws under sparse activations, showing test loss is dominated by rare unseen coordinates and exhibits double-descent with two distinct scaling exponents. Derives compute-optimal frontier favoring data over parameters.

entry.title: Transcoders Trace Visual Grounding and Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Dimitrios Damianos, Leon Voukoutis, Georgios Skyrianos, Vassilis Katsouros, Georgios Paraskevopoulos

entry.summary: Uses Transcoders (sparse MLP approximations) instead of SAEs to trace how visual inputs are transformed to text in VLMs, applied to Gemma 3-4B-IT. Shows stronger causal effects on grounded tokens and better hallucination detection than SAE-based methods.

entry.title: VideoOdyssey: A Benchmark for Ultra-Long-Context and Omni-Modal Video Understanding

author.name: Haichen He, Jiayi Zhou, Sifeng Shang, Yihan Hu, Yuanhan Zhang, Kaiyang Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces VideoOdyssey benchmark for ultra-long-context video understanding using 'continuous certificate length' to measure cognitive load. Targets the gap in benchmarks that have long videos but short answer-relevant segments.

entry.title: Learnability-Informed Fine-Tuning of Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Shubham Parashar, Atharv Chagi, Jacob Helwig, Lakshmi Jotsna, Sushil Vemuri, James Caverlee, Dileep Kalathil, Shuiwang Ji

entry.summary: Proposes LIFT, a learnability-aware fine-tuning method for diffusion language models that learns easy tokens under heavy masking and hard tokens with more context. Addresses why vanilla SFT can hurt DLM performance.

entry.title: Learned Relay Representations for Forward-Thinking Discrete Diffusion Models

author.name: Benjamin Rozonoyer, Jacopo Minniti, Dhruvesh Patel, Neil Band, Avishek Joey Bose, Tim G. J. Rudner, Andrew McCallum

entry.summary: Introduces Learned Relay Representations for masked diffusion models, allowing them to propagate latent information across denoising steps via differentiable channels with truncated BPTT. Scales to SOTA DLMs.

entry.title: Worse than Random: The Importance of a Baseline for Unsupervised Feature Selection

author.name: Muhammad Rajabinasab, Michael E. Houle, Oussama Chelly, Arthur Zimek

entry.summary: Demonstrates that random feature selection outperforms many SOTA unsupervised feature selection methods on standard benchmarks, advocating random selection as essential baseline. Important methodological critique.

entry.title: When AI Takes Sides on Questions of Faith: Persistent Asymmetries in AI-Mediated Faith Guidance

author.name: Brett Israelsen, Sheryl Carty, Josh Coates, Nancy Fulda, Julie Park, Pete Whiting

entry.summary: Tests 20 LLMs across 182 religion pairings showing systematic asymmetries in faith conversion advice—Catholic, Bahá'í, Sikh favored while Atheist, Agnostic, Jehovah's Witness disfavored. Grok 4.20 showed strongest asymmetries.

entry.title: Brain-LLM Alignment Tracks Training Data, Not Typology

author.name: Dongxin Guo, Jikun Wu, Siu Ming Yiu

entry.summary: Tests brain-LLM alignment using fMRI from 112 subjects across English/Chinese/French and 7 LLMs, finding training-language dominance (not English-specific properties) drives alignment patterns. Chinese-dominant model reverses gradient.

entry.title: Model Collapse as Cultural Evolution

author.name: Dongxin Guo, Jikun Wu, Siu Ming Yiu

entry.summary: Reframes LLM model collapse using iterated learning theory from cultural evolution, deriving 5 falsifiable predictions tested on LLaMA-2-7B and Mistral-7B. Finds non-monotonic compositionality trajectory unique to the theory.

entry.title: Anytime Training with Schedule-Free Spectral Optimization

author.name: Anuj Apte, Pranav Deshpande, Niraj Kumar, Shouvanik Chakrabarti, Junhyung Lyle Kim

entry.summary: SF-NorMuon schedule-free spectral optimizer matches/exceeds tuned AdamW on 125M and 772M language models across 1-8x Chinchilla horizons with single hyperparameter. Includes stationarity guarantee proof.

entry.title: Orbax: Distributed Checkpointing with JAX

author.name: Colin Gaffney, Shutong Li, Daniel Ng, Anastasia Petrushkina, Niket Kumar, Adam Cogdell, Mridul Sahu, Yaning Liang, Nikhil Bansal, Justin Pan, Angel Mau, Abhishek Agrawal, Marco Berlot, Ruoxin Sang, Kiranbir Sodhia, Rakesh Iyer

entry.summary: Orbax: Google's modular JAX-native distributed checkpointing library, achieving up to 3.5x faster saving and 2x faster loading than PyTorch counterparts. Important infrastructure release from Google.

entry.title: Infra-Bayesian Reinforcement Learning Agents Outperform Classical RL For Worst-Case Robustness

author.name: Manish Aryal, Faiyaz Azam, Agnivo Banerjee, Sai Sidhanth Manoharan Jayanthi, Allegra Laro, Cl\'ement Legentilhomme, Andrew Lin, Florian Lorkowski, Radman Rakhshandehroo, Patric Rommel, Emanuel Ruzak, Nathan Theng, Paul Yushin Rapoport

entry.summary: Empirical study of infra-Bayesian RL agents showing they outperform classical RL under non-realizable environments where actors anticipate the agent—relevant to AI safety.

entry.title: What Does the Server See? Understanding Privacy Leakage from Large Language Models in Split Inference

author.name: Mingyuan Fan, Yu Liu, Fuyi Wang, Cen Chen

entry.summary: ActInv reconstructs client inputs from intermediate activations in LLM split inference, defeating Gaussian noise and sparsification defenses. Important privacy finding.

entry.title: Positional Failures in Long-Context LLMs: A Blind Spot in Reasoning Benchmarks

author.name: Chuyifei Zhang, Hongyu Cui, Xiaowen Huang, Jitao Sang

entry.summary: Audit of 11 long-context benchmarks finding none control task position, filler, and length jointly for reasoning. Proposes Context Rot Evaluation showing positional sensitivity in 9 LLMs on GSM8K/ARC.

entry.title: AutoResearch AI: Towards AI-Powered Research Automation for Scientific Discovery

author.name: Guiyao Tie, Jiawen Shi, Dingjie Song, Yixiao Huang, Ziji Sheng, Xueyang Zhou, Daizong Liu, Pan Zhou, Yongchao Chen, Ran Xu, Lifang He, Qingsong Wen, Manling Li, Cong Lu, Shuai Li, Pengtao Xie, Yixuan Yuan, Rui Meng, Lei Xing, Lichao Sun, Caiming Xiong, Philip S. Yu, Jianfeng Gao

entry.summary: Survey of AutoResearch—AI workflow-level scientific research automation—with substantial author list across many institutions covering literature, hypothesis, experimentation, validation phases.

entry.title: Learning Individual Dynamics from Sparse Cross-Sectional Snapshots

author.name: Christian Lagemann, Kai Lagemann, Steven L. Brunton, Sach Mukherjee

entry.summary: CADENCE recovers continuous individual trajectories from sparse cross-sectional snapshots by anchoring latent dynamics, breaking the dichotomy between sequence models and population-level methods. Authors include Steven Brunton (well-known dynamical systems researcher).

entry.title: Non-normal spectral signatures of instability in neural network training dynamics

author.name: Souvik Ghosh

entry.summary: Provides operator-theoretic explanation for training instabilities by showing Adam and SGD-momentum update operators are non-normal, with pseudospectral bounds serving as early-warning indicators. Connects non-normal stability theory to deep learning training pathologies.

entry.title: Understanding Goal Generalisation in Sequential Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Jason Ross Brown, Edward James Young

entry.summary: Studies how RL agents trained sequentially generalize to OOD environments using over 100 training pipelines and 250 OOD tests. Introduces latent policy gradients to predict generalization, with safety implications for goal misgeneralization.

entry.title: Preisach Attention: A Hysteretic Model of Sequential Memory

author.name: Piotr Frydrych

entry.summary: Preisach Attention Layer replaces softmax attention with hysteretic relay operators, achieving Turing-completeness with O(1) depth (vs O(log n) for hard attention) and computing function classes incomparable to standard transformers. Novel theoretical architecture.

entry.title: DiLaDiff: Distilled Latent-Augmented Diffusion for Language Modeling

author.name: Jean-Marie Lemercier, Tomas Geffner, Karsten Kreis, Morteza Mardani, Arash Vahdat, Ante Juki\'c

entry.summary: DiLaDiff combines latent autoencoder, latent masked diffusion, and consistency distillation for language modeling, addressing token correlation failures in diffusion LMs. Authors include researchers from NVIDIA (Karsten Kreis, Arash Vahdat).

entry.title: How Hard is it to Rig a Benchmark? A Social Choice Analysis of Leaderboard Robustness

author.name: Polina Gordienko and Georg Schollmeyer and Frauke Kreuter and Christoph Jansen

entry.summary: Frames benchmark gaming as election manipulation, proving NP-hardness under Borda count and mean win rate. Applies computational social choice theory to ML benchmark robustness.

entry.title: DDX-TRACE: A Benchmark for Medical Diagnostic Trajectories in VLMs

author.name: Jiazhen Pan, Weixiang Shen, Jun Li, Julian Canisius, Felix Bitzer, Paula Ro{\ss}m\"uller, Jiancheng Yang, Virginie Kreutzinger, Daniel Rueckert, and Benedikt Wiestler

entry.summary: DDX-TRACE is a physician-adjudicated benchmark for multimodal neuroradiology evaluating diagnostic trajectories—not just final answers—including evidence requests, differential diagnosis updates, and stopping decisions. Addresses real clinical workflow gaps in medical AI evaluation.

entry.title: Learning Through Noise: Why Subliminal Learning Works and When It Fails

author.name: Vincent C. Brockers, Roman D. Ventzke, Valentin Neuhaus, Bel\'en Hidalgo-Ogalde, Viola Priesemann

entry.summary: Shows subliminal learning is governed by compatible output heads rather than matched initialization, using controlled MNIST experiments with auxiliary and class heads. Updates the explanation of an important alignment-relevant phenomenon.

entry.title: Agentic Proving for Program Verification

author.name: Alessandro Sosso, Akhil Arora, Bas Spitters

entry.summary: Evaluates Claude Code as an agentic theorem prover on CLEVER (Lean 4 verifiable code generation benchmark), achieving 98.1% end-to-end success on entries with self-consistent premises. Strong empirical result for AI-assisted formal verification.

entry.title: Strong Teacher Not Needed? On Distillation in LLM Pretraining

author.name: Taiming Lu and Zhuang Liu

entry.summary: Empirical study of teacher-student dynamics in LLM pretraining distillation, finding that strong teachers aren't necessary—small undertrained teachers can improve larger students with proper loss mixing, and stronger teachers can saturate or reverse gains. Counterintuitive findings for distillation practice.

entry.title: Training-Free Looped Transformers

author.name: Lizhang Chen, Jonathan Li, Chen Liang, Ni Lao, Qiang Liu

entry.summary: Training-free looped transformers wrap a frozen pretrained model with mid-stack layer looping at inference time, motivated by viewing pre-norm blocks as Euler ODE steps. Works across dense, MoE, and MLA+MoE families without retraining.

entry.title: Complete-muE: Optimal Hyperparameter Transfer and Scaling for MoE Models

author.name: Hongwu Peng, Ohiremen Dibua, Yuanjun Xiong, Yifan Gong, Jianming Zhang, Yan Kang

entry.summary: Complete-muE extends muP/SDE hyperparameter transfer to MoE architectures with a two-bridge system handling dense-to-MoE and MoE expert scaling transitions. Important for hyperparameter-free MoE scaling.

entry.title: From Activation to Causality: Discovery of Causal Visual Representations in the Human Brain

author.name: Yuval Golbari, Navve Wasserman, Matias Cosarinsky, Roman Beliy, Aude Oliva, Antonio Torralba, Michal Irani, Tamar Rott Shaham

entry.summary: BrainCause is an automated framework combining generative and brain models to synthesize controlled stimuli for causal testing of neural visual representations, going beyond activation-based localization. Authors from MIT (Oliva, Torralba) and Weizmann (Irani).

entry.title: PiD: Fast and High-Resolution Latent Decoding with Pixel Diffusion

author.name: Yifan Lu, Qi Wu, Jay Zhangjie Wu, Zian Wang, Huan Ling, Sanja Fidler, Xuanchi Ren

entry.summary: PiD reformulates latent-to-pixel decoding as conditional pixel diffusion, unifying decoding and upsampling. Authors include Sanja Fidler (NVIDIA) and the Trellis/NVIDIA team. Enables 4x and 8x super-resolution decoding in one module.

entry.title: Encrypted Neural Networks without Overflows

author.name: Philipp Kern, Lorenzo Rovida, Samuel Teuber, Edoardo Manino, Carsten Sinz, Alberto Leporati

entry.summary: Demonstrates first overflow attacks against CKKS-based homomorphic encryption neural networks, where benign-looking inputs cause polynomial activations to corrupt outputs, and proposes formal mitigation. Important security finding for private inference.

entry.title: VINS-120K: Ultra High-Resolution Image Editing with A Large-Scale Dataset

author.name: Zhizhou Chen, Shanyan Guan, Zhanxin Gao, En Ci, Yanhao Ge, Wei Li, Zhenyu Zhang, Jian Yang, Ying Tai

entry.summary: VINS-120K is the first large-scale dataset (120K triplets ≥4K resolution) for instruction-based ultra-high-resolution image editing, with a high-frequency-aware adaptation strategy. Includes the VINS-4KEval benchmark.

entry.title: CRONOS: Benchmarking Counterfactual Physical Consistency in Video Models

author.name: Le\'on Begiristain, Olaf D\"unkel, Adam Kortylewski

entry.summary: CRONOS is an intervention-based benchmark in Unreal Engine to test counterfactual physical consistency in video models—whether predictions respond appropriately to controlled changes in viewpoint, scene, appearance, and category. Important for assessing whether video models learn causal physics or surface correlations.

entry.title: The Misattribution Gap: When Memory Poisoning Looks Like Model Failure in Agentic AI Systems

author.name: Tanzim Ahad, Ismail Hossain, Md Jahangir Alam, Sai Puppala, Syed Bahauddin Alam, Sajedul Talukder

entry.summary: Identifies 'Misattribution Gap' in agentic AI security: memory-poisoning attacks (Semantic Norm Drift) appear identical to model misalignment, fooling safety classifiers across 64 documented failures.

entry.title: Latent Cache Flow: Model-to-Model Communication Without Text

author.name: Maximillian Rossi, Prajwal Raghunath, Eugene Wu

entry.summary: Latent Cache Flow enables LLM-to-LLM communication via compressed translated KV caches, reducing adapter size to ~4% of Cache-to-Cache while handling differing contexts.

entry.title: The Readout Shortcut: Positional Number Copying Dominates Arithmetic CoT Readout in Small Language Models

author.name: Ming Liu

entry.summary: Identifies a 'positional copying shortcut' in small LLMs doing arithmetic CoT: the model copies whichever number is in the trailing position rather than reasoning, accounting for 54-92pp of accuracy.

entry.title: When Do LLMs Reason? A Dynamical Systems View via Entropy Phase Transitions

author.name: Wei Xia, Haoqing Wang, Zhi-Hong Deng, Yehui Tang

entry.summary: Frames LLM reasoning as a dynamic decoding state via entropy phase transitions, showing early-stage entropy reduction reliably predicts when CoT helps vs hurts.

entry.title: How Far Will They Go? Red-Teaming Online Influence with Large Language Models

author.name: Daniel C. Ruiz, Anna Serbina, Ashwin Rao, Emilio Ferrara, Luca Luceri

entry.summary: Red-teams 30+ open-source LLMs to measure their political 'Overton Windows' on controversial topics and how natural-language jailbreaks expand them for influence campaign use.

entry.title: GEM-4D: Geometry-Enhanced Video World Models for Robot Manipulation

author.name: Kaichen Zhou, Yuzhen Chen, Fangneng Zhan, Hang Hua, Grace Chen, Xinhai Chang, Ao Qu, Yilun Du, Zhuang Liu, Paul Pu Liang, Mengyu Wang

entry.summary: GEM-4D is a geometry-grounded video world model that injects dense 4D correspondence supervision distilled from a pretrained geometry foundation model, improving point-level motion consistency for robot manipulation.

entry.title: Tensor Cache: Eviction-conditioned Associative Memory for Transformers

author.name: Kabir Swain, Sijie Han, Daniel Karl I. Weidele, Mauro Martino, Antonio Torralba

entry.summary: Tensor Cache pairs sliding-window attention (L1) with fixed-size outer-product fast-weight memory (L2) holding evicted tokens, enabling access to context beyond the window via linear-attention identity.

entry.title: ImProver 2: Iteratively Self-Improving LMs for Neurosymbolic Proof Optimization

author.name: Riyaz Ahuja, Tate Rowney, Jeremy Avigad, Sean Welleck

entry.summary: ImProver 2 trains a 7B model via expert iteration for automated proof optimization in Lean 4, outperforming much larger models with novel structural proof metrics.

entry.title: EVE-Agent: Evidence-Verifiable Self-Evolving Agents

author.name: Yamato Arai, Yuma Ichikawa

entry.summary: Proposes EVE-Agent, a self-evolving search agent that requires evidence-verifiable spans for each generated training instance, addressing reliability issues in data-free self-evolution. Aims to prevent fluent-but-unsupported examples from corrupting training signals.

entry.title: MARGIN: Runtime Confidence Calibration for Multi-Agent Foundation Model Coordination

author.name: Joss Armstrong

entry.summary: MARGIN provides online runtime confidence calibration for multi-agent foundation model coordination, learning per-agent calibration factors from task streams. Addresses miscalibration without requiring model access.

entry.title: Certification from Examples is Hard for Circuits and Transformers under Minimal Overparametrization

author.name: Artur Back de Luca, Kimon Fountoulakis

entry.summary: Proves exact certification (smallest set of examples to certify learned hypothesis equals target) is exponentially hard for threshold circuits and log-precision Transformers under minimal overparametrization. Theoretical hardness result.

entry.title: Robots That Know What to Ask: Recovering Misaligned Rewards through Targeted Explanations

author.name: Helena Merker, Nick Walker, Andreea Bobu

entry.summary: Framework for robots to detect underspecified features in demonstrations and actively solicit targeted corrective demonstrations. Addresses misalignment from incomplete demonstrations in IRL.

entry.title: CoMoGen: COntrollable MOtion Dynamics and Interactions with Mask-Guided Video GENeration

author.name: Adil Meric, Lin Geng Foo, Mert Kiray, Benjamin Busam, Rishabh Dabral, Christian Theobalt

entry.summary: CoMoGen generates controllable interactive video dynamics from a single binary mask sequence using MaskAdapter on MMDiT architecture. Identifies 'Motion Layers' for targeted LoRA fine-tuning.

entry.title: Scene Reconstruction as Mapping Priors for 3D Detection

author.name: Yang Fu, Yuliang Zou, Hao Xiang, Xin Huang, Yijing Bai, Chen Song, Weijing Shi, Govind Thattai, Dragomir Anguelov, Mingxing Tan, Yingwei Li

entry.summary: Automates creation of dense mapping priors from aggregated sensor data to improve 3D object detection in autonomous driving without manual HD map curation. Scalable approach to leveraging maps for perception.

entry.title: PACE: Two-Timescale Self-Evolution for Small Language Model Agents

author.name: Chen Ling, Pei Chen, Albert Guan, Jiaming Qu, Shayan Ali Akbar, Madhu Gopinathan, Erwin Cornejo

entry.summary: PACE enables small language model agents to self-evolve via two-timescale prompt and control logic refinement under resource constraints. Avoids reliance on frontier models for self-evolution.

entry.title: Multilingual Steering by Design: Multilingual Sparse Autoencoders and Principled Layer Selection

author.name: Yusser Al Ghussin, Daniil Gurgurov, Tanja Baeumel, Josef van Genabith, Patrick Schramowski, Simon Ostermann

entry.summary: Shows multilingual SAE training improves cross-lingual representations and proposes principled steering layer selection rule based on multilingual alignment and language separability. Improves multilingual control.

entry.title: Do Language Models Know What Not to Say? Causal Evidence for Statistical Preemption in LLMs

author.name: Dongxin Guo, Jikun Wu, Siu Ming Yiu

entry.summary: Computational study dissociating statistical preemption from entrenchment in LLMs across 120 verb-construction pairings. Shows LLM surprisal correlates strongly with human acceptability (r=0.79) and provides causal evidence for preemption.

entry.title: The TIME Machine: On The Power of Motion for Efficient Perception

author.name: Mantas Skackauskas, Xinyue Hao, Laura Sevilla-Lara

entry.summary: Proposes using motion (point-tracks) as central modality for video representation learning via masked autoencoder, departing from scale and language-driven approaches. Targets temporal understanding limitations.

entry.title: ThriftAttention: Selective Mixed Precision for Long-Context FP4 Attention

author.name: Joe Sharratt

entry.summary: ThriftAttention: selective mixed-precision FP4 attention for long contexts that keeps a few high-importance blocks at higher precision. Delivers near-FP16 quality at FP4 efficiency on Blackwell GPUs.

entry.title: The Implicit Bias of Depth: From Neural Collapse to Softmax Codes

author.name: Connall Garrod, Jonathan P. Keating, Christos Thrampoulidis

entry.summary: Theoretical analysis showing depth induces implicit low-rank bias in deep unconstrained feature models without regularization, leading to softmax codes as alternatives to neural collapse. Identifies softmax codes as max-margin solutions.

entry.title: $\pi_0$-EqM: Equilibrium Matching for Closed-Loop Vision-Language-Action Control

author.name: Huanming Liu, Congsheng Xu, Jianmin Ji, Yao Mu

entry.summary: π0-EqM replaces flow-matching expert in π0 VLA with Equilibrium Matching decoder, improving RoboTwin from 40.4% to 50.2% under matched compute. Clean drop-in upgrade for VLA control.

entry.title: VisAnalog: A Diagnostic Suite for Visual Concept Transfer on Natural Images

author.name: Zhaonan Li, Kyle R. Chickering, Bangzheng Li, Jacob Dineen, Xiao Ye, Zhikun Xu, Shijie Lu, Yuxi Huang, Ming Shen, Bach Nguyen, Jaya Adithya Pavuluri, Mau Son Nguyen, Sanika Chavan, Ngoc Minh Thu Le, Muhao Chen, Ben Zhou

entry.summary: VisAnalog: 617 human-validated A:B::C:? visual analogy questions on natural images testing concept transfer in VLMs across rotations, swaps, hue shifts. Diagnostic benchmark exposing VLM weaknesses.

entry.title: As X, Do Y: How Persona and Task Combine in Instruction-Tuned LLMs

author.name: Eric Xu

entry.summary: Mechanistic study showing 'As X, do Y' role prompts decompose linearly into orthogonal persona and task directions in residual stream of Gemma-2-2B and Qwen-2.5, suggesting compressibility.

entry.title: Any-Dimensional Invariant Universality

author.name: Shengtai Yao, Eitan Levin, Mateo D\'iaz

entry.summary: Theoretical framework for any-dimensional universality of models like graph and point-cloud networks, identifying them with functions on infinite-dimensional limit spaces.

entry.title: Fast-dDrive: Efficient Block-Diffusion VLM for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Kewei Zhang, Jin Wang, Sensen Gao, Chengyue Wu, Yulong Cao, Songyang Han, Boris Ivanovic, Langechuan Liu, Marco Pavone, Song Han, Daquan Zhou, Enze Xie

entry.summary: Fast-dDrive: block-diffusion VLA for autonomous driving leveraging structured JSON outputs to enable section-aware causal masking and KV-cache reuse, balancing AR efficiency with diffusion quality.

entry.title: DRIVESPATIAL: A Benchmark for Spatiotemporal Intelligence in VLMs for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Hao Vo, Khoa Vo, Phu Loc Nguyen, Sieu Tran, Duc Minh Nguyen, Ngo Xuan Cuong, Gladys Gawugah, Sreevenkata Anjani Tishita Godavarthi, Chase Rainwater, Nghi D. Q. Bui, Anh Nguyen, Duy Minh Ho Nguyen, Ngan Le

entry.summary: DriveSpatial: 15.6K human-verified spatiotemporal QA pairs across 20 tasks evaluating multi-view, temporal, and relational reasoning in VLMs for autonomous driving.

entry.title: Self-Improving In-Context Learning

author.name: Baturay Saglam, Dionysis Kalogerias

entry.summary: Self-improving in-context learning via test-time zeroth-order optimization of prompt embeddings using log-prob signal of demonstrations as self-supervised confidence proxy. No fine-tuning or external data.

entry.title: Adaptive Mass-Segmented KV Compression for Long-Context Reasoning

author.name: Junzhe Yang, Xiaoyu Shen

entry.summary: AMS KV compression: region-aware quota allocation based on attention mass distribution to prevent 'Region Wipe-out' from global Top-k eviction in long-context reasoning.

entry.title: Lipschitz Optimization for Formal Verification of Homographies

author.name: Jean-Guillaume Durand, Panagiotis Kouvaros, Maxime Gariel, Alessio Lomuscio

entry.summary: Lipschitz optimization for formal verification of vision NN robustness to 3D camera motion via closed-form pose-to-pixel homographies. Published from Imperial group (Lomuscio).

entry.title: Foundation Protocol: A Coordination Layer for Agentic Society

author.name: Bang Liu, Yongfeng Gu, Jiayi Zhang, Zhaoyang Yu, Sirui Hong, Maojia Song, Xiaoqiang Wang, Mingyi Deng, Zijie Zhuang, Ronghao Wang, Mingzhe Cao, Yutong Zhu, Xingjian Li, Yifan Wu, Jianhao Ruan, Yiran Peng, Shuangrui Chen, Jinlin Wang, Yizhang Lin, Dongjie Zhang, Dekun Wu, Chen Ma, Lizi Liao, Han Yu, Jian Pei, Heng Ji, Qiang Yang, Yuyu Luo, Chenglin Wu

entry.summary: Foundation Protocol: graph-first coordination layer unifying agents, tools, humans, and institutions with economic primitives for an emerging human-AI society. Massive author list including Heng Ji, Qiang Yang, Jian Pei.

entry.title: WMAttack: Automated Attack Search for Adversarial Evaluation of World-Model Agents

author.name: Zhixiang Guo, Siyuan Liang, Shi Fu, Cheng Guo, Andras Balogh, Mark Jelasity, Dacheng Tao

entry.summary: WMAttack: automated finite-budget attack-search framework for adversarial evaluation of world-model agents, addressing the prohibitive cost of brute-force hyperparameter sweeps over closed-loop rollouts.

entry.title: EvalVerse: Pipeline-Aware and Expert-Calibrated Benchmarking for Professional Cinematic Video Generation

author.name: Songlin Yang, Haobin Zhong, Ruilin Zhang, Xiaotong Zhao, Shuai Li, Kai Zheng, Xuyi Yang, Zhe Wang, Zhenchen Tang, Yang Li, Bohai Gu, Zhengwei Peng, Yidan Huang, Mengzhou Luo, Yihang Bo, Dalu Feng, Yujia Zhang, Juntao Ma, Ruiqi Wang, Lvmin Zhang, Yuwei Guo, Frank Guan, Maneesh Agrawala, Hongbo Fu, Alan Zhao, Anyi Rao

entry.summary: EvalVerse is a pipeline-aware, expert-calibrated benchmark for cinematic video generation that goes beyond prompt-following to evaluate aesthetic and acting quality. Includes prominent authors (Stanford, etc.).

entry.title: XWind: A Cross-site Router for Large Language Model Inference Serving at Renewable Energy Farms

author.name: Tella Rajashekhar Reddy, Atharva Deshmukh, Liangcheng Yu, Chaojie Zhang, Mike Shepperd, Rohan Gandhi, Anjaly Parayil, Srinivasan Iyengar, Ajay Manchepalli, Debopam Bhattacherjee

entry.summary: XWind: cross-site router for serving LLM inference at renewable energy farms, with 890+ GW of wind capacity within 50ms of Azure data centers. Microsoft authors.

entry.title: Instance-Optimal Estimation with Multiple LLM Judges on a Budget

author.name: Junghyun Lee and Sanghwa Kim and Yassir Jedra and Alexandre Prouti\`ere and Se-Young Yun

entry.summary: Theoretical framework for budgeted heteroskedastic multi-judge LLM evaluation, analyzing inverse-variance weighted estimators to optimally allocate queries across heterogeneous judges.

entry.title: Metacognition as Reward: Reinforcing LLM Reasoning via Knowledge and Regulation Signals

author.name: Sirui Chen, Lei Xu, Yuying Zhao, Yutian Chen, Yu Wang, Beier Zhu, Hanwang Zhang, Shengjie Zhao, Chaochao Lu

entry.summary: Metacognition-as-Reward (MaR) framework for RL training of LLM reasoning, using metacognitive knowledge and regulation signals as general process dimensions instead of instance-specific rubrics.

entry.title: Every Component is a Lookup: Token Attribution and Composition from a Single Decomposition

author.name: Po-Kai Chen, Niki van Stein, Aske Plaat

entry.summary: Unpack: backward recursion for mechanistic interpretability that decomposes credit through attention and MLP via shared key-value template, producing token attribution and composition labels in single forward pass. Recovers GPT-2 IOI circuit findings.

entry.title: AI Security Research Should Better Incentivize Defense Research

author.name: Youqian Zhang

entry.summary: A position paper documenting the imbalance in AI security research between attack and defense work across multiple subfields, arguing for incentive reforms. Highlights how attack papers benefit from favorable conditions while defenses are held to stricter standards.

entry.title: CoSPlay: Cooperative Self-Play at Test-Time with Self-Generated Code and Unit Test

author.name: Zhangyi Hu, Chenhui Liu, Tian Huang, Jindong Li, Yang Yang, Jiemin Wu, Zining Zhong, Menglin Yang, Yutao Yue

entry.summary: CoSPlay is a GT-free, training-free test-time scaling framework that jointly improves code and unit tests via cooperative self-play. Addresses the bottleneck of unreliable self-generated unit tests in code generation.

entry.title: Asking For An Old Friend: Diagnosing and Mitigating Temporal Failure Modes in LLM-based Statutory Question Answering

author.name: Max Prior, Andreas Schultz, Matthias Grabmair

entry.summary: Benchmark of 312 expert-validated German statutory QA pairs diagnosing temporal failure modes (post-cutoff staleness, recency bias) in LLMs for legal research. Evaluates major models from OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek under multiple inference settings.

entry.title: Precise: SDE-Consistent Stochastic Sampling for RL Post-Training of Flow-Matching Models

author.name: Jade Zou, Tao Huang, Weijie Kong, Junzhe Li, Yue Wu, Qi Tian, Jiangfeng Xiong, Jianwei Zhang, Liefeng Bo, Zhao Zhong

entry.summary: Precise designs SDE-consistent stochastic samplers for RL post-training of flow-matching models, decomposing sampler design into stochasticity choice and faithful discretization. Aimed at improving reward optimization for diffusion/flow generators.

entry.title: Push Your Agent: Measuring and Enforcing Quantitative Goal Persistence in Long-Horizon LLM Agents

author.name: Yuandao Cai, Yuzhang Zhu, Liyou Gao, Wensheng Tang, Shengchao Qin

entry.summary: PushBench measures Quantitative Goal Persistence in long-horizon LLM agents—whether agents persist until verifier-confirmed completion. Reveals gap between local tool calls and quantitative completion.

entry.title: Learning Kernel-Based MDPs from Episodic Preferential Feedback

author.name: Nikola Pavlovic, Sattar Vakili, Qing Zhao

entry.summary: Theoretical study of preference-only learning in episodic kernel MDPs, developing preference-based value estimation and confidence sets for Bradley-Terry-Luce trajectory comparisons. Rigorous RLHF theory paper.

entry.title: Relevant Walk Search for Explaining Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Ping Xiong, Thomas Schnake, Michael Gastegger, Gr\'egoire Montavon, Klaus-Robert M\"uller, Shinichi Nakajima

entry.summary: Polynomial-time algorithms for finding top-K relevant walks in GNN-LRP, drastically reducing exponential complexity. Authors include Müller (well-known explainability researcher).

entry.title: Is a Document Educational or Just Wikipedia-Style? -- Pitfalls of Classifier-Based Quality Filtering

author.name: Mateusz Klimaszewski, Piotr Andruszkiewicz

entry.summary: Demonstrates a vulnerability in classifier-based pretraining quality filters: simple Wikipedia-style reformatting can flip ~7% of FineWeb-Edu filtering decisions, admitting low-quality content. Important finding for pretraining data curation.

entry.title: MemAudit: Post-hoc Auditing of Poisoned Agent Memory via Causal Attribution and Structural Anomaly Detection

author.name: Zhewen Tan, Yilun Yao, Huiyan Jin, Wenhan Yu, Guoan Wang, Mengyuan Fan, liang lu, Feng Liu, Xiangzheng Zhang, Duohe Ma, Tong Yang, Lin Sun

entry.summary: MemAudit is a post-hoc causal auditing framework for memory-poisoned LLM agents, using causal attribution and structural anomaly detection to identify malicious stored memories after harmful behavior occurs. Addresses growing concern about agent memory security.

entry.title: The physics of AI weather models

author.name: George Craig, Tobias Selz, Matthias Beylich, Kirsten I. Tempest

entry.summary: Argues that AI weather models implicitly solve physical equations through latent particle dynamics with gradient flow. Uses Centered Kernel Alignment to show different architectures converge to similar representations of atmospheric physics.

entry.title: Not Too Generative, Not Too Discriminative: The Human Alignment Sweet Spot

author.name: Jorge Chang Ortega, Bastien Le Lan, Thomas Serre, Victor Boutin

entry.summary: Uses Joint Energy-Based Models to interpolate between discriminative and generative training within a fixed architecture, isolating the effect of learning objective on human visual alignment. Finds intermediate (not pure) regimes best match human perception.

entry.title: Human Decision-Making with Persuasive and Narrative LLM Explanations

author.name: Laura R. Marusich, Mary Grace Kozuch Dhooghe, Jonathan Z. Bakdash, Murat Kantarcioglu

entry.summary: Large-scale human behavioral experiment finding that the persuasiveness of LLM-generated narrative explanations does not meaningfully affect objective decision-making performance, despite affecting beliefs/trust. Important nuance for human-AI collaboration.

entry.title: Move on Muon : A Hamiltonian probability gradient flow perspective of Muon optimizer

author.name: Aratrika Mustafi, Soumya Mukherjee and Bharath K. Sriperumbudur

entry.summary: Develops a Hamiltonian probability gradient flow perspective on the Muon optimizer, identifying its update as a mirror/prox step with momentum as dual coordinate. Theoretical analysis with mean-field neural network connections.

entry.title: GenRecon: Bridging Generative Priors for Multi-View 3D Scene Reconstruction

author.name: Katharina Schmid, Nicolas von L\"utzow, Jozef Hladk\'y, Angela Dai, Matthias Nie{\ss}ner

entry.summary: GenRecon couples high-fidelity multi-view 3D scene reconstruction with a generative 3D prior (Trellis.2) via projection-based conditioning over overlapping chunks. From Niessner/Dai's lab at TUM.

entry.title: Diffusion Domain Expansion: Learning to Coordinate Pre-trained Diffusion Models

author.name: Egor Lifar, Semyon Savkin, Timur Garipov, Shangyuan Tong, Tommi Jaakkola

entry.summary: Diffusion Domain Expansion (DDE) extends pretrained diffusion models to larger objects/complex conditioning via a compact coordinator network. Authors include Tommi Jaakkola (MIT).

entry.title: An Open-Source Training Dataset for Foundation Models for Black-box Optimization

author.name: Aaron Klein, Herilalaina Rakotoarison, Luca Thale-Bombien, David Salinas

entry.summary: BBO-Pile: first open-source dataset of 500K+ optimization trajectories for training foundation models for black-box optimization, addressing reproducibility gap.

entry.title: One-Forcing: Towards Stable One-Step Autoregressive Video Generation

author.name: Jiaqi Feng, Justin Cui, Yuanhao Ban, Cho-Jui Hsieh

entry.summary: One-Forcing augments DMD with auxiliary GAN loss for stable one-step autoregressive video generation, addressing weak dynamics and blur in existing few-step methods. Targets real-time interactive video generation.

entry.title: EDGE-OPD: Internalizing Privileged Context with Evidence Guided On-Policy Distillation

author.name: Aristotelis Lazaridis, Dylan Bates, Aman Sharma, Brian King, Vincent Lu, Jack FitzGerald

entry.summary: EDGE-OPD internalizes privileged context (personas, private facts, worked solutions) via on-policy self-distillation while preserving general capabilities. Addresses behavioral drift from privileged training signals.

entry.title: EM-Vid: Training-Free Entity-Centric Memory for Efficient and Consistent Multi-Shot Video Generation

author.name: Jente Vandersanden, Matheus Gadelha, Chun-Hao P. Huang, Hyeonho Jeong, Yulia Gryaditskaya

entry.summary: EM-Vid introduces training-free entity-centric memory using indexed latent patches for multi-shot video generation, with sparse token conditioning and budgeted memory updates. Addresses entity consistency across shots.

entry.title: Vision-Based Agile Landing on Turbulent Waters

author.name: Dimosthenis Angelis, Leonard Bauersfeld, Davide Scaramuzza, Evangelos Boukas

entry.summary: RL-based approach for autonomous multirotor landing on moving maritime platforms using only local visual keypoints and descriptors, enabling zero-shot transfer across feature extractors. From Scaramuzza's lab (top robotics researcher).

entry.title: Point Tracking Improves World Action Models

author.name: Jiarui Guan, Wenshuai Zhao, Yue Pei, Ziliang Chen, Arno Solin and Juho Kannala

entry.summary: JOPAT jointly predicts pixel observations, 2D point tracks, and actions in a single denoising diffusion transformer for robot world-action models. Tracks provide motion robustness against visual nuisance factors.

entry.title: PGT: Procedurally Generated Tasks for improving visual grounding in MLLMs

author.name: Rim Assouel, Amir Bar, Michal Drozdzal, Adriana Romero-Soriano

entry.summary: PGT is a procedurally generated visual grounding training framework using geometric primitive overlays to provide dense supervision and diagnose perception failures in MLLMs. Authors include researchers from Meta/FAIR.

entry.title: SkillOpt: Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills

author.name: Yifan Yang, Ziyang Gong, Weiquan Huang, Qihao Yang, Ziwei Zhou, Zisu Huang, Yan Li, Xuemei Gao, Qi Dai, Bei Liu, Kai Qiu, Yuqing Yang, Dongdong Chen, Xue Yang and Chong Luo

entry.summary: SkillOpt treats agent skills as the external state of a frozen agent and optimizes them via a separate optimizer model performing bounded edits on a skill document, accepting only validation-improving changes. Disciplined text-space optimizer for agent skills.

entry.title: CRONOS: Enhancing Deep Learning with Scalable GPU Accelerated Convex Neural Networks

author.name: Miria Feng, Zachary Frangella, Mert Pilanci

entry.summary: Introduces CRONOS, a convex optimization algorithm for two-layer neural networks that scales to ImageNet, with theoretical convergence guarantees and an extension to multi-layer networks via alternating minimization.

entry.title: Insulin Resistance Prediction From Wearables and Routine Blood Biomarkers

author.name: Ahmed A. Metwally, A. Ali Heydari, Daniel McDuff, Alexandru Solot, Zeinab Esmaeilpour, Anthony Z Faranesh, Menglian Zhou, David B. Savage, Conor Heneghan, Shwetak Patel, Cathy Speed, Javier L. Prieto

entry.summary: Largest-to-date dataset (N=1,165) combining wearable time series and blood biomarkers to predict insulin resistance via deep neural networks, enabling more accessible early diabetes screening.

entry.title: GENIUS: An Agentic AI Framework for Autonomous Design and Execution of Simulation Protocols

author.name: Mohammad Soleymanibrojeni, Roland Aydin, Diego Guedes-Sobrinho, Alexandre C. Dias, Maur\'icio J. Piotrowski, Wolfgang Wenzel, Celso Ricardo Caldeira R\^ego

entry.summary: GENIUS uses an agentic LLM workflow with knowledge graphs and a finite-state error-recovery machine to autonomously set up Quantum ESPRESSO simulations, succeeding on ~80% of 295 benchmarks.

entry.title: ObjectCache: Layerwise Object-Storage Retrieval for KV Cache Reuse

author.name: Yu Zhu, Aditya Dhakal, Yunming Xiao, Dejan Milojicic, Gustavo Alonso

entry.summary: ObjectCache stores LLM KV caches in S3-compatible object storage with co-designed transfer scheduling, enabling cheap large-capacity caching while preserving TTFT.

entry.title: Reading Calibrated Uncertainty from Language Model Trajectories

author.name: Aliai Eusebi, Alexander Herzog, Xiaoyu Liang, Marie Vasek, Enrico Mariconti, Lorenzo Cavallaro

entry.summary: Extracts scale-invariant geometric features from per-layer LLM activation trajectories to provide better calibrated uncertainty than maximum softmax probability via a sparse linear probe.

entry.title: FuRA: Full-Rank Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning with Spectral Preconditioning

author.name: Yequan Zhao, Ruijie Zhang, Liyan Tan, Niall Moran, Tong Qin, Zheng Zhang

entry.summary: FuRA is a full-rank parameter-efficient fine-tuning method using SVD-based spectral preconditioning and block tensor-train factorization, outperforming full FT at same parameter count.

entry.title: RMA: an Agentic System for Research-Level Mathematical Problems

author.name: Zelin Zhao, Bo Yuan, Jaemoo Choi, Yongxin Chen

entry.summary: Research Math Agents (RMA) is an agentic framework targeting research-level (not competition) mathematics via specialized modules for analysis, literature search, and verification.

entry.title: Pointwise Metrics Mislead: An Evaluation Protocol for Multimodal Inverse Problems

author.name: Mads H. Baattrup, J\"orn Bach, Laurids Jeppe, Finn Labe, Alexander Grohsjean, Christian Schwanenberger, Peer Stelldinger

entry.summary: Argues pointwise metrics like RMSE structurally fail for multimodal inverse problems and proposes a three-part evaluation protocol targeting distinct failure modes for scientific reconstruction.

entry.title: Diffusion-based Denoising Beats Vanilla Score Matching in Parameter Estimation: A Theoretical Explanation

author.name: Benedikt L\"utke Schwienhorst, Nadja Klein and Johannes Lederer

entry.summary: Provides theoretical guarantees showing diffusion-based denoising score matching outperforms vanilla score matching for multimodal distributions with separated modes. Bridges score matching and parameter estimation theory.

entry.title: A mathematical theory of balancing relational generalization and memorization

author.name: Luke Cheng, Samuel Lippl

entry.summary: Develops theoretical framework for transitive inference with exceptions, characterizing how learning systems balance generalization vs memorization of exceptions. Provides analytical model and empirical validation.

entry.title: Memorization Dynamics of Fill-in-the-Middle Pretraining

author.name: Tobias von Arx, Tanguy Dieudonn\'e

entry.summary: Studies how fill-in-the-middle pretraining affects verbatim memorization compared to standard left-to-right pretraining in Llama 3.2. Finds different memorization patterns and that suffix context alone is insufficient.

entry.title: Whose Good, Whose Place? The Moral Geography of Agentic AI for Social Good

author.name: Poli Nemkova, Haeshitha Indukuri, Jaedon Charles

entry.summary: Survey of 112 papers on agentic AI for social good (2015-2026) finds 73% specify no geographic context, with asymmetries by SDG type. Critical analysis of accountability gaps in social-good AI claims.

entry.title: RADAR: Relative Angular Divergence Across Representations

author.name: Xavier Cadet, Mateusz Nowak, Peter Chin

entry.summary: RADAR provides geometric metric for cross-domain transferability in foundation models by analyzing layer-wise angular alignment trajectories. Estimates whether expanding training data will help or hurt downstream performance.

entry.title: Uncovering the Latent Potential of Deep Intermediate Representations

author.name: Arnesh Batra, Arush Gumber, Aniket Khandelwal, Jashn Khemani, Anubha Gupta

entry.summary: Layer-wise Optimal Embedding Selection (LOES) spectral method identifies task-discriminative subspaces across foundation model layers, showing task information is non-monotonically distributed and requires careful aggregation.

entry.title: Steered Generation via Gradient-Based Optimization on Sparse Query Features

author.name: Sumanta Bhattacharyya and Pedram Rooshenas

entry.summary: Prototype-Based Sparse Steering applies SAEs specifically to attention query activations and uses gradient-based optimization to align with class prototypes. Argues queries are higher-fidelity steering site than residual stream.

entry.title: ModeSwitch-LLM: A Lightweight Phase-Aware Controller for Cross-Mode LLM Inference on a Single GPU

author.name: Aman Sunesh, Ali Alshehhi, and Hivansh Dhakne

entry.summary: Lightweight request-boundary controller routing each LLM inference request to appropriate fixed mode (FP16, quantized, speculative, hybrid) based on workload features. Achieves 2.10x latency speedup with 51.7% lower energy on Llama-3.1-8B.

entry.title: Dithering Defense: Adversarial Robustness of Vision Foundation Models via Multi-Level Floyd-Steinberg Dithering

author.name: Yury Belousov, Brian Pulfer, Vitaliy Kinakh and Slava Voloshynovskiy

entry.summary: Multi-level Floyd-Steinberg dithering as input transformation defense against adversarial attacks on vision foundation models. Evaluated across 6 tasks, 2 model families (DINOv2, PaliGemma), and 3 attacks including adaptive.

entry.title: What Training Data Teaches RL Memory Agents: An Empirical Study of Curriculum Effects in Memory-Augmented QA

author.name: Xinjie He, Zhiyuan Lin, Su Liu, Jialun Wu, Qiyang Xie, Weikai Zhou, Shuai Xiao

entry.summary: Controlled empirical study showing curriculum composition (in-domain, mixed, out-of-domain) acts as fine-grained specialization lever rather than uniform scaling factor for memory-augmented RL agents. Tested across LoCoMo and LongMemEval.

entry.title: Flow Mismatching: Unsupervised Anomaly Detection via Velocity Discrepancies in Flow Matching Models

author.name: Shengzhe Chen, Mehrdad Moradi, Kamran Paynabar, Hao Yan

entry.summary: Flow Mismatching: unsupervised anomaly detection comparing learned normal flow velocity with geometric path velocity in flow matching models. Avoids reconstruction-based paradigm by leveraging flow geometry.

entry.title: PathCal: State-Aware Reflection-Marker Calibration for Efficient Reasoning

author.name: Lingyu Jiang, Zirui Li, Shuo Xing, Peiran Li, Tsubasa Takahashi, Dengzhe Hou, Zhengzhong Tu, Kazunori Yamada, Fangzhou Lin

entry.summary: PathCal calibrates reflection markers ('wait', 'but', 'alternatively') in long CoT trajectories by distinguishing their distinct functional roles. Improves test-time reasoning control and efficiency.

entry.title: GEMQ: Global Expert-Level Mixed-Precision Quantization for MoE LLMs

author.name: Jianing Deng, Song Wang, Dongwei Wang, Zijie Liu, Tianlong Chen, Huanrui Yang, Jingtong Hu

entry.summary: GEMQ: Global Expert-level Mixed-precision Quantization for MoE LLMs using global linear programming for bit allocation and router fine-tuning. Addresses limitations of layer-wise importance estimation.

entry.title: Security of LLM-generated Code: A Comparative Analysis

author.name: Srivathsan G Morkonda, Mahmoud Selim, Hala Assal

entry.summary: Empirical security evaluation of code from 7 popular LLMs showing all generate code with vulnerabilities, building on prior developer-mimicking methodology. Documents real risks in LLM code generation.

entry.title: UfM*: Uncertainty from Motion* for DNN Depth Estimation Using Gaussians

author.name: Soumya Sudhakar, Sertac Karaman, Vivienne Sze

entry.summary: Proposes UfM*, a single-inference uncertainty estimation method for monocular depth DNNs using Gaussian mixtures to capture multiview disagreement. Efficient alternative to ensembles for safety-critical robotics.

entry.title: Operationalizing Individual Fairness via Gradient Descent and Bradley-Terry Models

author.name: Conlan Olson, Linjun Zhang, Zhun Deng, Pragya Sur

entry.summary: Algorithm for learning Mahalanobis similarity metrics for individual fairness from triplet queries via Bradley-Terry with spectral init plus gradient descent, with theoretical guarantees.

entry.title: Generative AI and the Reorganization of Labor Demand

author.name: Fangyan Wang, Zaiyan Wei, Yang Wang

entry.summary: Large-scale labor-economics study using LLM pipeline on US job postings to decompose generative AI exposure changes into between-firm and within-job-content margins.

entry.title: Composing People Together: Iterative Pose-Image Generation for Multi-Person Interaction Scenes

author.name: Wenxuan Peng, Bharath Hariharan, Hadar Averbuch-Elor

entry.summary: Dual pose-image diffusion model for multi-person interaction generation, jointly predicting 2D pose and RGB to improve compositional accuracy. Cornell/Hariharan group.

entry.title: IntentionNav: A Benchmark for Intent-Driven Object Navigation from Implicit Human Instruction

author.name: Lin Qian, Shijie Li, Sihao Lin, Xuan Zhang, Bangya Liu, Yanran Li, and Hujun Yin

entry.summary: IntentionNav: 500-intent benchmark with 4 controlled rewrites per intent for intent-driven object navigation from implicit instructions like 'I need to warm food.' 176 Isaac Sim scenes.

entry.title: Hidden Human-Like Nature of Machine-Generated Texts: Theory and Detection Enhancement

author.name: Chenwang Wu, Yiu-ming Cheung, Bo Han, Defu Lian

entry.summary: Reveals that even fully machine-generated text contains human-like spans that increase detection difficulty; proposes detection enhancement using this insight.

entry.title: CaST-Bench: Benchmarking Causal Chain-Grounded Spatio-Temporal Reasoning for Video Question Answering

author.name: Mingfang Zhang, Jingjing Pan, Ashutosh Kumar, Rajat Saini, Mustafa Erdogan, Hsuan-Kung Yang, Caixin Kang, Yifei Huang, Yoichi Sato, Quan Kong

entry.summary: CaST-Bench: 2,066 questions over 1,015 videos with bounding-box and temporal-segment annotations of causal chains for grounded spatio-temporal video reasoning evaluation.

entry.title: Entropy Equivalence Testing

author.name: Cl\'ement L. Canonne, Yash Pote, Jonathan Scarlett, Joy Qiping Yang

entry.summary: Introduces entropy equivalence testing (distinguish p=q vs |H(p)-H(q)|≥ε) with sample-efficient algorithm and application to closeness testing of Bayesian networks.

entry.title: GENSTRAT: Toward a Science of Strategic Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Vartan Shadarevian, Kia Ghods, Alex Kenich, Anany Kotawala

entry.summary: GENSTRAT: procedurally generated two-player zero-sum imperfect-info card games for evergreen evaluation of strategic reasoning in LLM agents, resistant to contamination and saturation.

entry.title: Convex Optimization for Alignment and Preference Learning on a Single GPU

author.name: Miria Feng, Mert Pilanci

entry.summary: COALA: convex reformulation of preference optimization eliminating reference model and reducing GPU memory, with theoretical guarantees on a single GPU. Pilanci group.

entry.title: A Simple Plug-in for Improving Eviction-Based KV Cache Compression

author.name: Yuping Lin, Jiayuan Ding, Yue Xing, Pengfei He, Jiliang Tang, Subhabrata Mukherjee

entry.summary: VECTOR augments KV cache eviction with three-way routing (retain/approximate/evict) using reconstructability signals, recovering value information that binary eviction would lose. Useful for long-context LLM inference.

entry.title: Design and Report Benchmarks for Knowledge Work

author.name: Yining Hua, Hongbin Na, Cyrus Ayubcha, Levi Lian

entry.summary: Proposes a three-step approach (define work activity, specify setting, score work product) for designing knowledge-work AI benchmarks that better reflect real deployment. Critiques current benchmark practices.

entry.title: ChainFlow-VLA: Causal Flow Planning with Vision-Language Models

author.name: Xiyang Wang, Xinlin Wang, Tingguang Zhou, Gong Chen, Xingtai Gui, Zhi Xu, Xiaolei Wu, Feiyang Tan, Hangning Zhou, and Mu Yang

entry.summary: ChainFlow-VLA unifies causal autoregressive reasoning with diffusion-based global trajectory optimization for autonomous driving, addressing the AR vs diffusion dichotomy in trajectory generation.

entry.title: LangFlash: Feed-forward 3D Language Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Unposed Images

author.name: Yilong Liu, Wanhua Li, Chen Zhu-Tian, Hanspeter Pfister

entry.summary: LangFlash is a feed-forward 3D Language Gaussian Splatting framework for sparse unposed images, predicting geometry and language-aligned semantics in single forward pass. Authors from Harvard (Pfister).

entry.title: Parallel Context Compaction for Long-Horizon LLM Agent Serving

author.name: Musa Cim, Burak Topcu, Chita Das, Mahmut Taylan Kandemir

entry.summary: Parallel context compaction for long-horizon LLM agents addresses the blocking nature of summarization-based context management. Characterized across multiple backbones.

entry.title: Contrastive Distribution Matching for Amortized Sequential Monte Carlo in Discrete Diffusion

author.name: Jaihoon Kim, Taehoon Yoon, Prin Phunyaphibarn, Seungjun Kim, Morteza Mardani, Minhyuk Sung

entry.summary: Contrastive Distribution Matching amortizes Twisted SMC inference for discrete diffusion models by learning parameterized twist functions. Authors include Morteza Mardani (NVIDIA).

entry.title: Score-Based One-step MeanFlow Policy Optimization

author.name: Kyungyoon Kim, Donghyeon Ki, Hee-Jun Ahn, Byung-Jun Lee

entry.summary: Score-Based One-step MeanFlow Policy Optimization (SOM) constructs target velocity field from Q-function via score estimation, enabling one-step diffusion-style policies in online RL without target samples.

entry.title: From Correctness to Preference: A Framework for Personalized Agentic Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ranxu zhang, zeyang li, Jiacheng Huang, Rui Zhang, Xiaozhou Xu, sun zhe, Yanyong Zhang and Chao Wang

entry.summary: PARPO: Personalized Anchor Reward-Decoupled Policy Optimization for agentic RL with user-conditioned behaviors, decoupling task-quality from preference rewards.

entry.title: Coupling-Robust Accuracy in Multiphysics Physics Informed Neural Networks via Kronecker-Preconditioned Optimization

author.name: Youngjae Park, Jaemin Kim, Junghwa Hong

entry.summary: NTK-based theoretical analysis of PINNs in coupled multiphysics systems, showing standard NTK spectral radius grows as Ω(γ²) with coupling but block-diagonal Gauss-Newton preconditioning bounds it independent of γ.

entry.title: When Planning Fails Despite Correct Execution: On Epistemic Calibration for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Zehao Wang, Shilong Jin, Zhao Cao, Lanjun Wang

entry.summary: EPC-AW addresses 'epistemic miscalibration' in LLM multi-agent planning where agents misjudge their knowledge despite correct execution. Assesses plan support under varying information.

entry.title: DFSAttn: Dynamic Fine-grained Sparse Attention for Efficient Video Generation

author.name: Jie Hu, Zixiang Gao, Yutong He, Kun Yuan

entry.summary: DFSAttn proposes dynamic fine-grained sparse attention for video diffusion transformers based on theoretical lower bound on attention recall, addressing block-sparse degradation at high sparsity.

entry.title: Semantically Structured Mixture-of-Experts for Compositional Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Chengyu Deng, Guanqi Chen, Yizhou Chen, Zejia Liu, Zhiwen Ruan, Guanhua Chen, Jia Pan

entry.summary: SMoDP routes mixture-of-experts based on semantic structure rather than low-level noise statistics for compositional robotic manipulation. Aims to align expert specialization with reusable behaviors.

entry.title: B-GRTO: Bootstrapped Group Relative Tool Optimization for Referring Segmentation

author.name: Mario Markov, Stefan Maria Ailuro, Mohammad Mahdi, Luc Van Gool, Danda Pani Paudel (INSAIT, Sofia University "St. Kliment Ohridski")

entry.summary: B-GRTO integrates trainable tools like segmentation decoders into reinforcement learning for vision-language systems via group relative tool optimization. Addresses principled integration of differentiable tools with RL.

entry.title: DrawVideo: Generating Long Video from Storyboard Keyframe Sketches

author.name: Chuanzhi Xu, Huiqi Liang, Bang Shi, Huiming Zhang, Yifan Xiao, Guangcheng Lin, Haodong Chen, Qiang Qu, Zhicheng Lu, Weidong Cai

entry.summary: DrawVideo enables sketch-guided storyboard-driven long video generation with shot-level control via sketches, appearance prompts, and motion prompts. Addresses controllability gap in long video synthesis.

entry.title: Learning partially observed systems with neural Hamiltonian ordinary differential equations

author.name: Sunniva Meltzer, S{\o}lve Eidnes, Alexander Johannes Stasik

entry.summary: NHODE combines Hamiltonian neural networks with neural ODEs for partially observed dynamical systems, enforcing energy conservation while inferring unobserved state variables. Extends physics-informed learning to partial observation regimes.

entry.title: PathNavigate: A Training-Free Pathology Agent with Surprise-Guided Scan and Shared Slide Memory for Whole-Slide Image VQA

author.name: Chunze Yang, Qidong Liu, Wenjie Zhao, Yue Tang, Jiusong Ge, Di Zhang, Jiashuai Liu, Lei Wu, Junbo Lu, Ni Zhang, Xian Wu, Zeyu Gao, Chen Li

entry.summary: PathNavigate is a training-free pathology agent for whole-slide VQA using surprise-guided scanning and shared slide memory to handle gigapixel slides. Avoids retraining costs of supervised pathology MLLMs.

entry.title: ARMS: Automatic Reward Shaping for Sparse-Reward Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Elie Abboud, Oren Gal

entry.summary: ARMS is a self-supervised reward shaping framework for sparse-reward MARL using trajectory ranking, with conditional best-response reasoning to preserve policy invariance. Addresses key bottleneck in MARL.

entry.title: Co-ReAct: Rubrics as Step-Level Collaborators for ReAct Agents

author.name: Jiazheng Kang, Bowen Zhang, Zixin Song, Jiangwang Chen, Xiao Yang, Da Zhu, Guanjun Jiang

entry.summary: Co-ReAct uses rubrics as step-level guidance during inference for ReAct agents, contrasting with prior evaluative-only uses. Practical agent action-selection framework.

entry.title: Adversarial Vulnerability Under Temporal Concept Drift: A Longitudinal Study of Android Malware Detection

author.name: Ahmed Sabbah, Mohammed Kharma, Radi Jarrar, Samer Zein, David Mohaisen

entry.summary: Decade-long longitudinal study of adversarial robustness for Android malware detection under temporal concept drift, with new metrics for adversarial-temporal coupling. Substantial empirical scope.

entry.title: Valid and Expressive Copulas for Irregular Multivariate Time Series

author.name: Christian Kl\"otergens, Tom Hanika, Lars Schmidt-Thieme, Vijaya Krishna Yalavarthi

entry.summary: CopFITi combines normalizing flows for marginals with Gaussian Mixture Copula for joint dependencies in irregular multivariate time series, marginalization-consistent by construction. Establishes new SOTA in IMTS density modeling.

entry.title: DualMem: Bypassing the Objectness Bottleneck for Calibrated Unknown-Stream Filtering in Open-World Object Detection

author.name: Yingjun Xiao (a), Xi Chen (b), Gang Fang (c), Siyuan Chen (b) ((a) School of Artificial Intelligence, Guangzhou University, Guangzhou, China, (b) School of Computer Science and Cyber Engineering, Guangzhou University, Guangzhou, China, (c) Institute of Computing Science and Technology, Guangzhou University, Guangzhou, China)

entry.summary: DualMem identifies an objectness-head information bottleneck in OWOD detectors, where decoder features have AUROC 0.908 but final scalar drops to 0.642. Addresses unknown-stream pollution in open-world detection.

entry.title: CVSearch: Empowering Multimodal LLMs with Cognitive Visual Search for High-Resolution Image Perception

author.name: Liupeng Li, Haoqian Kang, Zhenyu Lu, Jinpeng Wang, Bin Chen, Ke Chen, Yaowei Wang

entry.summary: CVSearch is a training-free adaptive framework dynamically scheduling expert-assisted vs scan-based visual search for high-resolution image perception with MLLMs. Addresses coverage-efficiency trade-off.

entry.title: Recursive Block-Diagonal Coupling for Resource-Efficient Training of Vision Models

author.name: Maxim Henry and Adrien Deli\`ege and S\'ebastien Pi\'erard and Marc Van Droogenbroeck

entry.summary: RBDC builds wide vision models by recursively coupling independently trained narrower models in a parameter-free block-diagonal fashion, achieving 30% FLOPs reduction on ImageNet with DeiT/ResNet. Practical training efficiency contribution.

entry.title: OpenSkillEval: Automatically Auditing the Open Skill Ecosystem for LLM Agents

author.name: Jiahao Ying, Boxian Ai, Wei Tang, Siyuan Liu, Yixin Cao

entry.summary: OpenSkillEval automatically evaluates skill-augmented agent systems and skill quality using dynamically constructed task instances from real-world artifacts. Addresses gaps in static benchmarks for the growing skill ecosystem.

entry.title: RiGS: Rigid-aware 4D Gaussian Splatting from a Single Monocular Video

author.name: Chenyu Wu, Wanhua Li, Zhu-Tian Chen, Hanspeter Pfister

entry.summary: RiGS introduces three Gaussian primitive types (static, rigid, transient) for monocular video reconstruction across multiple temporal scales, with object-wise dynamic mask aggregation. Addresses long-term smooth vs short-term complex motion trade-off.

entry.title: Operator Learning for Reconstructing Flow Fields from Sparse Measurements: a Language Model Approach

author.name: Qian Zhang and George Em Karniadakis

entry.summary: Reformulates flow-field reconstruction from sparse measurements as a sequence-to-sequence task using language model architectures, evaluated on vortex streets, climate, and other datasets. Co-authored by George Karniadakis (prominent in scientific ML).

entry.title: Any2Any: Efficient Cross-Embodiment Transfer for Humanoid Whole-Body Tracking

author.name: Ming Yang, Tao Yu, Feng Li, Hua Chen

entry.summary: Any2Any efficiently transfers pretrained whole-body tracking models across humanoid embodiments via kinematic alignment plus minimal data adaptation. Reduces the cost of deploying motion imitation policies on new humanoids.

entry.title: Hierarchical Concept Geometry in Language Models Emerges from Word Co-occurrence

author.name: Andres Nava and Matthieu Wyart

entry.summary: Provides a distributional theory showing that hypernymy hierarchies emerge in word embeddings due to word co-occurrence patterns, with leading eigenvectors progressively separating taxonomic branches. Theoretical insight into embedding geometry.

entry.title: Learning a Particle Dynamics Model with Real-world Videos

author.name: Chanho Kim, Suhas V. Sumukh, Li Fuxin

entry.summary: Trains particle-based physics dynamics models from real-world videos by leveraging recent point tracking methods to extract pseudo-state information, bridging the sim-to-real gap for world models.

entry.title: LaMo: Self-Supervised Latent Motion Priors for Physical Realism in Video Generation

author.name: Bo Jiang, Depu Meng, Yihan Hu, Yichen Xie, Tianshuo Xu, Wei Zhan

entry.summary: LaMo extracts self-supervised motion priors from unlabeled training videos for video diffusion, using Motion Drift Loss in training and Motion Prior Guidance at sampling time. Improves physical/motion consistency without external simulators or teachers.

entry.title: Multilingual Knowledge Transfer under Data Constraints via Lexical Interventions

author.name: Anastasiia Sedova, Natalie Schluter, Skyler Seto, Maartje ter Hoeve

entry.summary: LINK improves multilingual knowledge transfer during pretraining via lexical substitutions in high-resource data, without requiring parallel corpora or auxiliary models. Authors from Apple.

entry.title: Good Token Hunting: A Hitchhiker's Guide to Token Selection for Visual Geometry Transformers

author.name: Shuhong Zheng, Michael Oechsle, Erik Sandstr\"om, Marie-Julie Rakotosaona, Federico Tombari, Igor Gilitschenski

entry.summary: Two-stage token selection (inter-frame + intra-frame) for visual geometry transformers, restricting key/value tokens during global attention to address quadratic scaling. Authors from Google.

entry.title: SPACENUM: Revisiting Spatial Numerical Understanding in VLMs

author.name: Jianshu Zhang, Yijiang Li, Huifeixin Chen, Haoran Lu, Letian Xue, Bingyang Wang, Han Liu

entry.summary: SpaceNum benchmark systematically evaluates whether VLM numerical outputs (action magnitudes, coordinates) are genuinely grounded in spatial perception via bidirectional Num2Space and Space2Num tasks. Reveals weaknesses in current VLMs for embodied applications.

entry.title: From Raw Experience to Skill Consumption: A Systematic Study of Model-Generated Agent Skills

author.name: Zisu Huang, Jingwen Xu, Yifan Yang, Ziyang Gong, Qihao Yang, Muzhao Tian, Xiaohua Wang, Changze Lv, Xuemei Gao, Qi Dai, Bei Liu, Kai Qiu, Xue Yang, Dongdong Chen, Xiaoqing Zheng, Chong Luo

entry.summary: Systematic study of the full lifecycle of model-generated agent skills (experience generation, extraction, consumption) with a utility-grounded evaluation framework. Asks when and why such skills succeed or fail.

entry.title: Geo-Align: Video Generation Alignment via Metric Geometry Reward

author.name: Zizun Li, Haoyu Guo, Runzhe Teng, Chunhua Shen, Tong He

entry.summary: Geo-Align is the first RL framework for camera-controlled video re-rendering, using metric geometry rewards to improve adherence to physical scales and camera trajectories on out-of-distribution real-world videos.

entry.title: A (Slightly) Mechanistic Theory for Exponentially Increasing AI Time Horizons?

author.name: Oliver Sourbut

entry.summary: Thoughtful LessWrong analysis suggesting the METR AI 'time horizons' metric is mostly about data rather than time, proposing a mechanistic theory for the exponential trend. Tries to expose deeper structure underlying widely-cited AI progress chart.

entry.title: Convex Compositional Reasoning Models

author.name: Meir Roketlishvili, Semyon Semenov, Maksim Bobrin, Viktor Kovalchuk, Albert Baichorov, Abduragim Shtanchaev, Fakhri Karray, Dmitry V. Dylov, Martin Tak\'a\v{c}, Arip Asadulaev

entry.summary: Convex Compositional Energy Minimization (CCEM) parameterizes factor energies with input-convex networks for compositional reasoning, enabling deterministic projected first-order optimization.

entry.title: Efficient One-Step Diffusion Restoration Model with Compact Token Compression and Linear Attention

author.name: Bingtian Qiao, Yue Shi, Yingjie Zhou, Yong Guo, Guangtao Zhai, Jiezhang Cao

entry.summary: SANA-SR proposes one-step real-world image super-resolution using token compression and linear attention to eliminate quadratic costs at high resolution. Targets practical deployment efficiency.

entry.title: TactileReflex: Noise-Statistics-Driven Vision-Tactile Reflex Control for Force-Sensitive Manipulation

author.name: Ziyan Feng, Yulong Fu, Zheng Li, Yuxin He, Jieji Ren, Lujia Wang, Jinni Zhou, Yudong Zhong and Qiang Nie

entry.summary: TactileReflex uses noise-statistics-based calibration from sensor noise alone to derive controller thresholds for fragile container manipulation, eliminating force calibration and trial-and-error tuning. Practical robotic manipulation contribution.

entry.title: Cost-Effective Model Evaluation with Meta-Learning

author.name: Trinh Pham, Viet Huynh, Hongzhi Yin, Quoc Viet Hung Nguyen, Thanh Tam Nguyen

entry.summary: MetaEvaluator uses meta-learning over reference models for label-free, model-agnostic evaluation of unseen models without per-model retraining. Addresses growing evaluation cost in expanding model ecosystem.

entry.title: Direct Dynamic Retargeting for Humanoid Imitation Learning from Videos

author.name: Constant Roux, Ludovic De Matte\"is, Armand Jordana, Valentin Guillet, Nicolas Mansard, Olivier Stasse, Philippe Sou\`eres

entry.summary: Direct Dynamic Retargeting (DDR) generates dynamically feasible humanoid trajectories directly from monocular videos in task space using sampling-based MPC, avoiding biases from intermediate kinematic projections.

entry.title: HorizonStream: Long-Horizon Attention for Streaming 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Chong Cheng, Peilin Tao, Nanjie Yao, Guanzhi Ding, Xianda Chen, Yuansen Du, Xiaoyang Guo, Wei Yin, Weiqiang Ren, Qian Zhang, Zhengqing Chen, Hao Wang

entry.summary: HorizonStream is a long-horizon Transformer for streaming 3D reconstruction that formalizes geometric propagation as evidence influence kernels, addressing drift, jitter, and collapse in online reconstruction.

entry.title: ETCHR: Editing To Clarify and Harness Reasoning

author.name: Beichen Zhang, Yuhong Liu, Jinsong Li, Yuhang Zang, Jiaqi Wang, Dahua Lin

entry.summary: ETCHR uses a dedicated image editing model coupled with an understanding model for 'think with images' multimodal reasoning, addressing language-side and generation-side gaps. From Shanghai AI Lab/CUHK.

entry.title: POTR: Post-Training 3DGS Compression

author.name: Bert Ramlot, Martijn Courteaux, Peter Lambert, Glenn Van Wallendael

entry.summary: POTR is a post-training compression codec for 3D Gaussian Splatting using a novel pruning approach that achieves 2-4x fewer splats and 1.5-2x faster inference.

entry.title: From Abstraction to Instantiation: Learning Behavioral Representation for Vision-Language-Action Model

author.name: Bing Hu, Zaijing Li, Rui Shao, Junda Chen, April Hua Liu, Wei-Shi Zheng, Liqiang Nie

entry.summary: BehaviorVLA learns temporally coherent behavioral representations using causal Mamba-based encoder for VLA robotic manipulation, addressing distribution shift issues.

entry.title: Evaluating Large Language Models in a Complex Hidden Role Game

author.name: Niklas Bauer

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs in the social deduction game Secret Hitler, introducing metrics for deception, role identification, and game state impact, finding CoT and memory don't help much.

entry.title: From Simulation to Discovery: AI Enabled Probabilistic Emulation of Mechanistic Crop Systems

author.name: Mojdeh Saadati, Juan Panelo, Gustavo Visentini, Soumik Sarkar, Carlos Messina, Baskar Ganapathysubramanian

entry.summary: Probabilistic neural emulator of the APSIM crop model trained on 2M simulations, achieving R²=0.93 across 13 outputs while reducing computation by orders of magnitude.

entry.title: Expressive Power of Deep Homomorphism Networks over Relational Databases

author.name: Moritz Sch\"onherr, Balder ten Cate, Maurice Funk, Benny Kimelfeld, Carsten Lutz, Arie Soeteman

entry.summary: Establishes precise expressive power results for Deep Homomorphism Networks over relational databases by relating them to fragments of first-order logic.

entry.title: BOHM: Zero-Cost Hierarchical Attribution for Compound AI Systems

author.name: Joss Armstrong

entry.summary: BOHM extracts hierarchical attribution trees directly from routing weights of compound AI systems, providing zero-cost alternative to Shapley-based attribution methods.

entry.title: MedExpMem: Adapting Experience Memory for Differential Diagnosis

author.name: Qianhan Feng, Zhongzhen Huang, Yakun Zhu, Yannian Gu, Winnie Chiu Wing Chu, Xiaofan Zhang, and Qi Dou

entry.summary: MedExpMem equips medical VLMs with experience memory of past diagnostic failures organized as pairwise differential notes, accumulating differential diagnosis expertise.

entry.title: SciAtlas: A Large-Scale Knowledge Graph for Automated Scientific Research

author.name: Shuofei Qiao, Yunxiang Wei, Jiazheng Fan, Bin Wu, Busheng Zhang, Mengru Wang, Yuqi Zhu, Ningyu Zhang, Keyan Ding, Qiang Zhang, Huajun Chen

entry.summary: SciAtlas is a large-scale multidisciplinary academic knowledge graph integrating 43M+ papers for automated scientific research, addressing limitations of keyword and vector retrieval.

entry.title: SCRIPT: Scalable Diffusion Policy with Multi-stage Training for Language-driven Physics-Based Humanoid Control

author.name: Jingyan Zhang, Han Liang, Ruichi Zhang, Bin Li, Juze Zhang, Xin Chen, Jingya Wang, Lan Xu, and Jingyi Yu

entry.summary: SCRIPT is a scalable diffusion policy with multi-stage training using a Joint Action-State-Text Diffusion Transformer for language-driven physics-based humanoid control.

entry.title: Agentic-VLA: Efficient Online Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Ruofan Jin and Zaixi Zhang

entry.summary: Agentic-VLA enables online adaptation of Vision-Language-Action models via adaptive reward synthesis, language-guided exploration, and curriculum learning for novel environments.

entry.title: From Residuals to Reasons: LLM-Guided Mechanism Inference from Tabular Data

author.name: Mohammad R. Rezaei, Rahul G. Krishnan

entry.summary: MARICL uses LLM agents to analyze base-model residuals, hypothesize missing structure, and refine predictions iteratively, anchoring LLM predictions to narrow the search space.

entry.title: Suicide Risk Assessment from AI-powered Video Surveillance: An Interpretable Framework for Prevention in Metro Stations

author.name: Safwen Naimi, Wassim Bouachir, Guillaume-Alexandre Bilodeau, Brian Mishara

entry.summary: Introduces an interpretable framework for suicide risk assessment from metro station surveillance video, jointly modeling passenger behavior, spatial context, and temporal dynamics. First formalization of this task with applied societal impact.

entry.title: Graph Alignment Topology as an Inductive Bias for Grounding Detection

author.name: Paul Landes, Pranav Herur, Adam Cross, Jimeng Sun

entry.summary: Constructs aligned bipartite graphs between reference documents and LLM outputs, training graph neural networks to detect hallucinations. Uses alignment topology as inductive bias.

entry.title: Verified Task-Space Motion Planning Under Joint-Space Constraints

author.name: Hanjiang Hu, Changliu Liu, Yebin Wang

entry.summary: Computes certifiably reachable Cartesian hyperrectangles for manipulator motion planning under joint constraints using SDP and S-procedure. Provides safety guarantees for reactive planners.

entry.title: MadEvolve: Evolutionary Optimization of Trading Systems with Large Language Models

author.name: Yurii Kvasiuk, Tianyi Li, Owen Colegrove, Moritz M\"unchmeyer

entry.summary: Applies LLM-driven evolutionary algorithm optimization (MadEvolve, inspired by Alpha-Evolve) to algorithmic Bitcoin trading strategies, evolving features and execution strategy. Shows significant backtesting improvements.

entry.title: Smoothed Elicitation Complexity for Approximate $\Gamma$-calibration of Discrete Classification Tasks

author.name: Jessica Finocchiaro, Victor Ganson, Drona Khurana

entry.summary: Develops smoothed elicitation complexity for approximate Γ-calibration of multiclass classifiers, reducing complexity from exponential in classes to polynomial in property dimension. Theoretical calibration advance.

entry.title: The Deterministic Horizon: Impossibility Results as Design Specifications for Trustworthy AI Systems

author.name: Dongxin Guo

entry.summary: Thesis claims architecture alone sets a 'Deterministic Horizon' (~19-31 reasoning depth) ceiling on transformer accuracy that training cannot exceed. Bold theoretical claim with empirical measurements across 12 architectures.

entry.title: PIMbot: A Self-Adaptive Attack Framework for Adversarial Manipulation of Multi-Robot Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zexin Li, Ziliang Zhang, Hyoseung Kim, and Cong Liu

entry.summary: PIMbot adversarial attack framework for multi-robot reinforcement learning combining incentive manipulation and policy manipulation with adaptive multi-objective controller. Studies social dilemma manipulation.

entry.title: A measurement substrate for agentic Kubernetes operations: Methodology and a case study in retrieval-compounding falsification

author.name: Joshua Odmark, Gideon Rubin, Deon van der Vyver

entry.summary: Closed-loop measurement framework injecting faults into Kubernetes clusters to evaluate autonomous operations agents against ground truth. Addresses verification gap for ops agents.

entry.title: Millimeter-wave Imaging for Anthropometric Body Measurement

author.name: Miriam Senne, Benjamin D. Killeen, Christoph Baur, Nassir Navab, Azade Farshad
