entry.summary: Presents CUGA's policy-as-code governance system for enterprise LLM agents, providing modular runtime policy enforcement at every execution stage without model fine-tuning. Enables predictable, auditable, compliance-aware behavior.

entry.title: Evaluating multimodal emotion recognition in proactive conversational agents: A user study

author.name: Adnana Dragut, Raquel Lacuesta, F. Xavier Gaya-Morey, Jose M. Buades-Rubio

entry.summary: User study reveals that automated facial emotion recognition fails in AI interactions due to a 'poker face' effect - users display serious expressions regardless of internal state - while linguistic analysis better captures true emotions.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Safe Autonomous Driving Under Pedestrian Behavioral Uncertainty

author.name: Prakash Aryan, Kaushik Raghupathruni, Timo Kehrer, Sebastiano Panichella

entry.summary: Uses multi-agent RL to jointly train pedestrians and self-driving cars, producing more realistic interaction scenarios with heterogeneous pedestrian behaviors governed by latent personality traits.

entry.title: SDM: A Powerful Tool for Evaluating Model Robustness

author.name: Xinlei Liu, Tao Hu, Jichao Xie, Peng Yi, Hailong Ma, Baolin Li

entry.summary: SDM introduces a novel gradient-based adversarial attack that maximizes the difference between non-ground-truth label probability upper bound and ground-truth probability, addressing the 'high-loss non-adversarial examples' issue in prior methods like APGD.

entry.title: Causal Unlearning in Collaborative Optimization: Exact and Approximate Influence Reversal under Adversarial Contributions

author.name: Ali Mahdavi, Azadeh Zamanifar, Amirfarhad Farhadi, Omid Kashefi

entry.summary: HF-KCU removes a federated learning client's contribution via influence function approximation in Krylov subspaces, reducing complexity from O(d³) to O(kd). Includes causal weighting to prevent spurious updates and handles adversarial perturbations.

entry.title: ConceptSeg-R1: Segment Any Concept via Meta-Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yuan Zhao, Youwei Pang, Jiaming Zuo, Wei Ji, Kailai Zhou, Bin Fan, Yunkang Cao, Lihe Zhang, Xiaofeng Liu, Huchuan Lu, Weisi Lin, Dacheng Tao, Xiaoqi Zhao

entry.summary: ConceptSeg-R1 proposes a three-level taxonomy for concept segmentation (context-independent, context-dependent, context-reasoning) and uses meta-reinforcement learning for rule-induced concept grounding to handle increasing cognitive complexity.

entry.title: Axiomatizing Neural Networks via Pursuit of Subspaces

author.name: Mehmet Yamac, Mert Duman, Ugur Akpinar, Felix Rojas Casadiego, Serkan Kiranyaz, Marcel van Gerven, Moncef Gabbouj

entry.summary: Introduces the Pursuit of Subspaces (PoS) hypothesis as an axiomatic framework for neural network behavior through geometric postulates, providing unified perspective on representation, computation, and generalization.

entry.title: Multi-agent Collaboration with State Management

author.name: Mengyang Liu, Taozhi Chen, Zhenhua Xu, Xue Jiang, Yihong Dong

entry.summary: STORM manages multi-agent collaboration on shared codebases by mediating agent-workspace interactions to ensure consistent views and detect conflicting edits proactively, rather than deferring to post-hoc merge.

entry.title: Beyond Routing: Characterising Expert Tuning and Representation in Vision Mixture-of-Experts

author.name: Gene Tangtartharakul, Katherine R. Storrs

entry.summary: Characterizes expert specialization in Vision MoE models using neuroscience tools beyond routing analysis, measuring per-expert category separability and tuning via most exciting inputs and human behavioral similarity judgements.

entry.title: Distributional Alignment as a Criterion for Designing Task Vectors in In-Context Learning

author.name: Jihoon Kwon, Jiwon Choi, Jy-yong Sohn

entry.summary: Introduces d_NTP metric measuring distributional alignment between task vector-based inference and full ICL, and uses it as a criterion for designing better task vector extraction methods for in-context learning.

entry.title: TASTE: A Designer-Annotated Multi-Dimensional Preference Dataset for AI-Generated Graphic Design

author.name: Haonan Zhu, Elad Hirsch, Alexandria Minetti, Allison Nulty, Purvanshi Mehta

entry.summary: TASTE is a dataset of professional designer rankings of AI-generated graphic designs across 9 criteria (typography, visual hierarchy, color harmony, etc.) from 10 designers on 4 text-to-image models, revealing that models vary substantially across dimensions.

entry.title: Tunable MAGMAX: Preference-Aware Model Merging for Continual Learning

author.name: Kei Hiroshima, Kento Uchida, Shinichi Shirakawa

entry.summary: Proposes Tunable MAGMAX, a model merging framework for continual learning that allows preference-aware control of task-specific performance through a preference vector, enabling deployment customization.

entry.title: Beyond Text-to-SQL: An Agentic LLM System for Governed Enterprise Analytics APIs

author.name: Gundeep Singh, Parsa Kavehzadeh, Jing Xia, Xue-Yong Fu, Julien Bouvier Tremblay, Md Tahmid Rahman Laskar, Vincent Lum, Shashi Bhushan TN

entry.summary: Presents Analytic Agent, an LLM-based agentic system for enterprise analytics that interfaces with governed APIs rather than raw databases, ensuring consistency, auditability, and security in enterprise settings.

entry.title: Divide et Calibra: Multiclass Local Calibration via Vector Quantization

author.name: Cesare Barbera, Lorenzo Perini, Giovanni De Toni, Andrea Passerini, Andrea Pugnana

entry.summary: Proposes a compositional approach to multiclass calibration using Vector Quantization to partition representation space and indexed Dirichlet concentrations for region-specific calibration maps.

entry.title: SymbolicLight V1: Spike-Gated Dual-Path Language Modeling with High Activation Sparsity and Sub-Billion-Scale Pre-Training Evidence

author.name: Ting Liu

entry.summary: Presents SymbolicLight V1, a spike-gated dual-path language model combining binary spiking dynamics with continuous residual stream, achieving high activation sparsity on a 194M parameter bilingual model.

entry.title: Quality and Security Signals in AI-Generated Python Refactoring Pull Requests

author.name: Mohamed Almukhtar, Anwar Ghammam, Hua Ming

entry.summary: Empirically studies quality and security of AI-generated Python refactoring pull requests on GitHub. Analyzes how agent-authored edits affect maintainability, code quality, and security using static analysis tools.

entry.title: HITL-D: Human In The Loop Diffusion Assisted Shared Control

author.name: Riley Zilka, Sergey Khlynovskiy, Allie Wang, Martin Jagersand

entry.summary: Proposes HITL-D, a shared control framework combining diffusion-based policies with human control for manipulation tasks. Reduces joystick control axes needed by providing autonomous orientation updates, lowering mental workload in a 12-participant user study.

entry.title: OmniISR: A Unified Framework for Centralized and Federated Learning via Intermediate Supervision and Regularization

author.name: Wei-Bin Kou, Guangxu Zhu, Ming Tang, Chen Zhang, Lisheng Wu, Lei Zhou, Yujiu Yang

entry.summary: Proposes OmniISR, a unified framework bridging centralized learning, federated learning, and hybrid modes through intermediate supervision and regularization signals at multiple hidden layers.

entry.title: The General Theory of Localization Methods

author.name: Congwei Song

entry.summary: Proposes localization methods as a general ML framework built on localization kernels and local means, connecting to kernel methods, Hopfield networks, self-attention, and many other methods.

entry.title: ShapeBench: A Scalable Benchmark and Diagnostic Suite for Standardized Evaluation in Aerodynamic Shape Optimization

author.name: Shaghayegh Fazliani, Krissh Chawla, Jack Guo, Yiren Shen, Matthias Ihme, Madeleine Udell

entry.summary: Introduces ShapeBench, an open-source aerodynamic shape optimization benchmark with unified API spanning 103 tasks across eight shape categories with validated surrogates and CFD verification.

entry.title: Learning fMRI activations dictionaries across individual geometries via optimal transport

author.name: Sonia Mazelet, R\'emi Flamary, Bertrand Thirion

entry.summary: Introduces optimal transport-based dictionary learning for fMRI data that explicitly accounts for individual brain geometry variability using Fused Gromov-Wasserstein distance.

entry.title: Choose Wisely and Privately: Proactive Client Selection for Fair and Efficient Federated Learning

author.name: Adda Akram Bendoukha, Heber Hwang Arcolezi, Nesrine Kaaniche, Aymen Boudguiga

entry.summary: Proposes proactive client selection for federated learning that finds optimal federation before training, matching combined client data to utility requirements while preserving privacy.

entry.title: Efficient Banzhaf-Based Data Valuation for $k$-Nearest Neighbors Classification

author.name: Guangyi Zhang, Lutz Oettershagen, Lixu Wang, Aristides Gionis

entry.summary: Develops efficient algorithms for computing Banzhaf values in k-NN classifiers for data valuation. Proves the problem is #P-hard but exploits locality properties to create practical exact algorithms via dynamic programming.

entry.title: Divide and Contrast: Learning Robust Temporal Features without Augmentation

author.name: Abdul-Kazeem Shamba, Kerstin Bach, Gavin Taylor

entry.summary: Introduces Di-COT, an unsupervised time-series representation framework that avoids data augmentation by contrasting informative substructures within windows rather than individual timesteps.

entry.title: Corrected Integrated Laplace Approximation for Bayesian Inference in Latent Gaussian Models

author.name: Jinlin Lai, Charles C. Margossian, Daniel R. Sheldon

entry.summary: Proposes importance sampling correction for the Integrated Laplace Approximation used in Latent Gaussian Models, providing a way to correct posterior approximation errors while maintaining computational efficiency.

entry.title: Does Slightly Mean Somewhat? Measuring Vague Intensity Words in LLM Numeric Actions

author.name: Daniel Tabach (Georgia Institute of Technology)

entry.summary: Studies whether LLMs preserve ordinal meaning of intensity words (slightly to drastically) when producing numeric actions, finding compression of 10 words into 3-5 clusters and strong starting-state effects.

entry.title: Energy-Gated Attention: Spectral Salience as an Inductive Bias for Transformer Attention

author.name: Athanasios Zeris

entry.summary: Proposes Energy-Gated Attention inspired by turbulent fluid dynamics, where informationally dense tokens (morphological boundaries, syntactic heads) receive proportionally more attention via spectral energy-based gating.

entry.title: HyLoVQA: Dynamic Hypernetwork-Generated Low-Rank Adaptation for Continual Visual Question Answering

author.name: Yiran Wang, Chenyi Xiong, Ziyue Qin, Miao Zhang, Kui Xiao, Zhifei Li

entry.summary: Proposes HyLoVQA for continual VQA using hypernetwork-generated LoRA adapters conditioned on a drift-resilient memory bank. Addresses cross-level task interference in non-stationary visual question answering.

entry.title: MRecover: A Conditional Generative Model for Recovering Motion-Corrupted MR images Using AI Generated Contrast

author.name: Jinghang Li, Tales Santini, Courtney Clark, Bruno de Almeida, Cong Chu, Salem Alkhateeb, Andrea Sajewski, Jacob Berardinelli, Hecheng Jin, Tobias Campos, Jeremy J. Berardo, Joseph Mettenburg, Ariel Gildengers, Howard J. Aizenstein, Minjie Wu, Tamer S. Ibrahim

entry.summary: Develops MRecover, a conditional generative model synthesizing TSE MRI from T1w images for hippocampal segmentation. Achieves 31.8% more analyzable subjects in motion-affected ADNI3 dataset.

entry.title: SDGBiasBench: Benchmarking and Mitigating Vision--Language Models' Biases in Sustainable Development Goals

author.name: Zihang Lin, Huaiyuan Qin, Muli Yang, Hongyuan Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes SDGBiasBench, a large-scale benchmark (500K MCQ + 50K regression tasks) for evaluating VLM biases in Sustainable Development Goal reasoning. Reveals systematic biases when models substitute priors for evidence.

entry.title: FRED: A Multi-Modal Autonomous Driving Dataset for Flooded Road Environments

author.name: Connor Malone, Sebastien Demmel, Sebastien Glaser

entry.summary: FRED is the first multi-modal autonomous driving dataset targeting flooded road scenarios, containing camera, LiDAR, and IMU/GNSS data from locations captured during and after flooding events, with semantic labels for training flood detection models.

entry.title: Physiology and Anatomy Aware Inverse Inference of Myocardial Infarction for Cardiac Digital Twin

author.name: Mengxiao Wang, Yilin Lyu, Julia Camps, Ching Hui Sia, Mark Yan-Yee Chan, Yanrui Jin, Shuzhi Sam Ge, Chengliang Liu, Lei Li

entry.summary: A cardiac digital twin framework for noninvasive myocardial infarction localization that bridges simulation-reality domain gaps through anatomy-aware stochastic infarct synthesis and integrates cine MRI with ECG for detailed infarct characterization.

entry.title: MotionDPS: Motion-Compensated 3D Brain MRI Reconstruction

author.name: Antonio Ortiz-Gonzalez, Erich Kobler, Lukas Schletter, Alexander Effland

entry.summary: MotionDPS proposes a unified Bayesian framework for motion-compensated 3D MRI that jointly estimates anatomy, rigid-body motion, and coil sensitivity maps, addressing phase inconsistencies from patient movement during acquisition.

entry.title: One Sentence, One Drama: Personalized Short-Form Drama Generation via Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Yufei Shi, Weilong Yan, Naixuan Huang, Yucheng Chen, Chenyu Zhang, Tao He, Si Yong Yeo, Ming Li

entry.summary: A hierarchical multi-agent framework transforms a user's single-sentence idea into a fully produced short drama with structured narrative pacing, spatial consistency, and production quality control through iterative refinement.

entry.title: Enhancing Multimodal Large Language Models for Safety-Critical Driving Video Analysis

author.name: Tomaso Trinci, Henrique Pi\~neiro Monteagudo, Leonardo Taccari

entry.summary: A pipeline that enhances MLLMs for safety-critical driving video analysis by fusing downsampled video with synchronized telematics data (IMU/GPS) and specialized CV model outputs to generate high-quality training pseudo-labels for collision detection.

entry.title: D3Seg: Dependency-Aware Diffusion for Brain Tumor Segmentation with Missing Modalities

author.name: Danish Ali, Ajmal Mian, Naveed Akhtar, Ghulam Mubashar Hassan

entry.summary: D3Seg proposes brain tumor segmentation robust to missing MRI modalities through Multi-hop Modality Graph Fusion for inter-modality dependencies and a diffusion-based imputation mechanism to compensate for missing data.

entry.title: Robustness of breast lesion segmentation under MRI undersampling improves with k-space-aware deep learning

author.name: Lukas T. Rotkopf, Marco Schlimbach, Julius C. Holzschuh, Heinz-Peter Schlemmer, Jens Kleesiek, Moritz Rempe

entry.summary: Demonstrates that breast lesion segmentation learned directly from MRI k-space data improves robustness under accelerated acquisition and noise compared to image-space baselines, with a hybrid k-space-to-image model showing best results.

entry.title: From Recognition to Reasoning: Benchmarking and Enhancing MLLMs on Real-World Receipt Document Understanding

author.name: Yandi Wang, Libin Zhan, Ziwei Huang, Tiancheng Luo, Yuxuan Jiang, Wang Dong, Leilei Gan, Jun Chen

entry.summary: ReceiptBench is a large-scale benchmark of 10K diverse receipts with four hierarchical sub-tasks from basic perception to semantic reasoning, designed to evaluate MLLMs on real-world document understanding beyond simple text extraction.

entry.title: Moment-Reenacting: Inverse Motion Degradation with Cross-shutter Guidance

author.name: Ji Xiang, Lin Guixu, Yin Zhengwei, Zhao Jiancheng, Zheng Yinqiang

entry.summary: Proposes a unified framework for inverting motion degradation by jointly leveraging complementary characteristics of global shutter blur and rolling shutter distortion through a novel dual-shutter capture setup.

entry.title: SADGE: Structure and Appearance Domain Gap Estimation of Synthetic and Real Data

author.name: Patryk Bartkowiak, Bartosz Kotrys, Dominik Michels, Soren Pirk, Wojtek Palubicki

entry.summary: SADGE proposes a metric combining appearance and geometric similarity scores to predict synthetic dataset quality for downstream CV tasks without model training, finding that both structural and appearance similarity matter differently for different tasks.

entry.title: Matching with Deliberation: Test-Time Evolutionary Hierarchical Multi-Agents for Zero-Shot Compositional Image Retrieval

author.name: Xingtian Pei, Yukun Song, Changwei Wang, Shunpeng Chen, Rongtao Xu, Shibiao Xu

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical multi-agent framework for zero-shot compositional image retrieval that introduces experience self-evolution and test-time scaling, using perception-to-deliberation stages to handle visual continuity and semantic modifications.

entry.title: Case-Aware Medical Image Classification with Multimodal Knowledge Graphs and Reliability-Guided Refinement

author.name: Yiming Xu, Yixuan Liu, Yuhang Zhang, Ling Zheng, Yihan Wang, Qi Song

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for medical image classification that constructs multimodal knowledge graphs from retrieved similar cases and uses knowledge propagation to inject clinical reasoning patterns. Simulates how clinicians use historical cases and symptoms for diagnosis.

entry.title: AtomicMotion: Learning Human Motion From Different Human Parts

author.name: Runzhen Liu, Chuhua Xian, Fa-Ting Hong

entry.summary: Presents AtomicMotion for reconstructing full-body poses from sparse head and hand trajectories (AR/VR use case). Decomposes the skeleton into 5 functional clusters and re-integrates them to capture fine-grained atomic intents.

entry.title: Mapping Tomato Cropping Systems in California Using AlphaEarth Geospatial Embeddings and Deep Learning Analysis

author.name: Mohammadreza Narimani, Alireza Pourreza, Parastoo Farajpoor

entry.summary: Evaluates Google DeepMind's AlphaEarth geospatial embeddings for mapping processing tomato fields in California, demonstrating these analysis-ready embeddings as alternatives to hand-engineered spectral feature pipelines.

entry.title: Learning A Unified Risk Map for Autonomous Driving in Partially Observable Environments

author.name: Jie Jia, Yaofeng Su, Zeyu Bao, Yun Hong, Bingzhao Gao, Zhongxue Gan, Wenchao Ding

entry.summary: Proposes a unified risk map framework for autonomous driving in partially observable environments that integrates traffic flow risk and collision risk through spatiotemporal modeling. Includes a diffusion-based scenario generation framework for producing adversarial occlusion scenarios.

entry.title: Do Not Trust The Auctioneer: Learning to Bid in Feedback-Manipulated Auctions

author.name: Luigi Foscari, Matilde Tullii, Vianney Perchet

entry.summary: Studies repeated first-price auctions with shilling (artificial bids that affect feedback but not allocation) and develops an algorithm combining robust interval estimation with low-shill event exploitation, with matching upper and lower regret bounds.

entry.title: Protein Thoughts: Interpretable Reasoning with Tree of Thoughts and Embedding-Space Flow Matching for Protein-Protein Interaction Discovery

author.name: Kingsley Yeon, Xuefeng Liu, Promit Ghosal

entry.summary: Presents Protein Thoughts, a framework combining Tree of Thoughts reasoning with embedding-space flow matching for interpretable protein-protein interaction discovery, decomposing binding evidence into four biologically meaningful signals.

entry.title: Causal Discovery in Structural VAR Models Under Equal Noise Variance

author.name: SeyedSina Seyedi HasanAbadi, Fahimeh Arab, Erfan Nozari, AmirEmad Ghassami

entry.summary: Studies causal discovery in linear Gaussian structural VAR models under equal noise variance, showing that unlike the DAG setting, time-series causal discovery yields equivalence classes rather than unique identification.

entry.title: Plug-in Losses for Evidential Deep Learning: A Simplified Framework for Uncertainty Estimation that Includes the Softmax Classifier

author.name: Berk Hayta, Hannah Laus, Simon Mittermaier, Felix Krahmer

entry.summary: Shows that Evidential Deep Learning objectives can be approximated by plug-in losses evaluated at the Dirichlet mean, recovering the standard softmax classifier as a special case and simplifying implementation.

entry.title: Enhancing Visual Token Representations for Video Large Language Models via Training-Free Spatial-Temporal Pooling and Gridding

author.name: Bingjun Luo, Tony Wang, Hanqi Chen, Xinpeng Ding

entry.summary: Proposes ST-GridPool, a training-free method for Video LLMs that enhances visual token representations through Pyramid Temporal Gridding for multi-grained spatiotemporal interactions and Norm-based Spatial Pooling for preserving high-information regions.

entry.title: OSCToM: RL-Guided Adversarial Generation for High-Order Theory of Mind

author.name: Sharmin Sultana Srishty, Kazi Mahathir Rahman, Malaika Parizat Sakkhi, Samia Shahid Prianna, Shaikhul Islam Sinat

entry.summary: OSCToM introduces a framework for testing LLMs on higher-order Theory of Mind tasks involving nested belief conflicts, where an observer's view conflicts with their own belief state. It combines RL with a domain-specific language for generating challenging ToM scenarios.

entry.title: COAgents: Multi-Agent Framework to Learn and Navigate Routing Problems Search Space

author.name: Oleksandr Yakovenko, Mahdi Mostajabdaveh, Cheikh Ahmed, Abdullah Ali Sivas, Xiaorui Li, Zirui Zhou, Mao Kun

entry.summary: COAgents is a cooperative multi-agent framework for Vehicle Routing Problems that models the search process as a graph, with agents learning node selection and move selection policies to navigate between solutions and escape local minima.

entry.title: Diverge to Induce Prompting: Multi-Rationale Induction for Zero-Shot Reasoning

author.name: Po-Chun Chen, Hen-Hsen Huang, Hsin-Hsi Chen

entry.summary: Diverge-to-Induce Prompting (DIP) generates multiple diverse high-level rationales for each question, elaborates them into step-by-step plans, then induces a final plan, improving zero-shot reasoning without resource-intensive sampling.

entry.title: Under Pressure: Emotional Framing Induces Measurable Behavioral Shifts and Structured Internal Geometry in Small Language Models

author.name: Rana Muhammad Usman

entry.summary: Studies whether emotionally framed follow-ups change both behavior and internal representations of small language models, finding that pressure induces shortcuts while calm/curiosity preserve honesty, with effects visible in layer-wise representations.

entry.title: Governance by Design: Architecting Agentic AI for Organizational Learning and Scalable Autonomy

author.name: Nelly Dux, Cristina Alaimo, Philippe Roussiere, Abhishek Kumar Mishra

entry.summary: Qualitative case study of enterprise agentic AI governance, showing how governance is implemented through concrete architectural decisions during development and staged rollout of an agentic system integrated with enterprise tools.

entry.title: Generation of Heterogeneous PET Images from Uniform Organ Activity Maps Using a Pretrained Domain-Adapted Diffusion Model

author.name: Suya Li, Kaushik Dutta, Debojyoti Pal, Jingqin Luo, Kooresh I. Shoghi

entry.summary: Develops a pretrained domain-adapted diffusion model for generating heterogeneous PET images from uniform organ activity maps, enabling scalable synthetic medical imaging for training and virtual trials.

entry.title: Tiny-Engram: Trigger-Indexed Concept Tables for Generative Vision

author.name: Runyuan Cai, Yiming Wang, Yu Lin, Xiaodong Zeng

entry.summary: Tiny-Engram is a compact trigger-indexed concept table for personalization in image/video generators, giving visual memories explicit lexical addresses that only activate within matched trigger regions while keeping the base model frozen.

entry.title: Collocational bootstrapping: A hypothesis about the learning of subject-verb agreement in humans and neural networks

author.name: Claire Hobbs, R. Thomas McCoy

entry.summary: Studies 'collocational bootstrapping' - how statistical regularities in word co-occurrence can provide cues to syntactic dependencies like subject-verb agreement. Tests on neural networks with synthetic datasets and validates against child-directed language.

entry.title: SAVER: Selective As-Needed Vision Evidence for Multimodal Information Extraction

author.name: Miaobo Hu, Shuhao Hu, Bokun Wang, Rui Chen, Xin Wang, Xiaobo Guo, Daren Zha, Jun Xiao

entry.summary: SAVER selectively decides whether to consult vision for each entity span in multimodal information extraction, using a Conformal Groundability Gate to estimate visual groundability and avoid noise from weakly related images.

entry.title: USV: Towards Understanding the User-generated Short-form Videos

author.name: Haoyue Cheng, Su Xu, Liwei Jin, Wayne Wu, Chen Qian, Limin Wang

entry.summary: Presents USV, a 224K video dataset of user-generated short-form videos for high-level semantic understanding, establishing tasks for topic recognition and video virality prediction.

entry.title: How to Build Marcus's Algebraic Mind: Algebro-Deterministic Substrate over Galois Fields

author.name: Hiroyuki Chuma, Kanji Otsuk, Yoichi Sato

entry.summary: Implements Gary Marcus's 'Algebraic Mind' requirements using a hyperdimensional computing architecture based on XOR-and-shift over GF(2), claiming to provide operations over variables, recursive structures, and individual/kind distinction.

entry.title: On the Regularity and Generalization of One-Step Wasserstein-guided Generative Models for PDE-Induced Measures

author.name: Likun Lin, Zhongjian Wang, Jack Xin, Zhiwen Zhang

entry.summary: Develops theory for one-step Wasserstein-guided generative models for PDE-induced measures, proving transport map regularity and generalization bounds under doubling conditions.

entry.title: HiRes: Inspectable Precedent Memory for Reaction Condition Recommendation

author.name: Shreyas Vinaya Sathyanarayana, Raja Sekhar Pappala, Deepak Warrier

entry.summary: Presents HiRes, a retrieval-augmented reaction condition recommendation system for chemistry that provides both predictions and inspectable precedents. Achieves state-of-the-art on USPTO-Condition benchmarks for catalyst, solvent, and reagent prediction.

entry.title: WikiVQABench: A Knowledge-Grounded Visual Question Answering Benchmark from Wikipedia and Wikidata

author.name: Basel Shbita, Pengyuan Li, Anna Lisa Gentile

entry.summary: Introduces WikiVQABench, a knowledge-grounded VQA benchmark requiring external knowledge from Wikipedia/Wikidata that is not directly observable in images. Human-curated with LLM-generated candidates.

entry.title: CASCADE Conformal Prediction: Uncertainty-Adaptive Prediction Intervals for Two-Stage Clinical Decision Support

author.name: Ricardo Diaz-Rincon, Muxuan Liang, Adolfo Ramirez-Zamora, Benjamin Shickel

entry.summary: Introduces CASCADE, a conformal prediction framework for Parkinson's Disease medication management that propagates uncertainty from screening to adapt downstream prediction intervals.

entry.title: Ada2MS: A Hybrid Optimization Algorithm Based on Exponential Mixing of Elementwise and Global Second-Moment Estimates

author.name: Meng Zhu, Quan Xiao, Weidong Min

entry.summary: Proposes Ada2MS, an optimization algorithm achieving smooth transition between AdamW-like and momentum SGD-like behavior through exponential mixing of elementwise and global second-moment estimates.

entry.title: Memory-Efficient Partitioned DNN Inference on Resource-Constrained Android Crowds

author.name: Lakshani Manamperi, Disumi Pathirana, Thiwanka Pathirana, Nipun Premarathna, Kutila Gunasekera

entry.summary: Presents a DNN pipeline scheduling system for partitioned ONNX inference across memory-constrained Android devices, achieving practical inference without model modification through five memory management mechanisms.

entry.title: Robust Personalized Recommendation under Hidden Confounding in MNAR

author.name: Zongyu Li, Wanting Su, Tianyu Xia

entry.summary: Addresses hidden confounding in recommender systems under missing-not-at-random data by proposing personalized sensitivity bounds that account for heterogeneity across user-item interactions, avoiding the need for costly RCTs.

entry.title: Optimized Federated Knowledge Distillation with Distributed Neural Architecture Search

author.name: Chaimaa Medjadji, Sylvain Kubler, Yves Le Traon, Guilain Leduc, Sadi Alawadi, Feras M. Awaysheh

entry.summary: Introduces FedKDNAS combining federated knowledge distillation with distributed neural architecture search to handle both statistical and system heterogeneity by adapting client architectures to local data and hardware.

entry.title: Spectral bandits for smooth graph functions with applications in recommender systems

author.name: Tom\'a\v{s} Koc\'ak, Michal Valko, R\'emi Munos, Branislav Kveton, Shipra Agrawal

entry.summary: Studies bandit problems where arm payoffs are smooth functions on a graph, proposes algorithms with regret scaling with effective dimension rather than node count, applicable to content recommendation.

entry.title: Time-Dependent PDE-Constrained Optimization via Weak-Form Latent Dynamics

author.name: April Tran, Terry Haut, David Bortz, Youngsoo Choi

entry.summary: Presents a weak-form latent-space reduced-order modeling framework for accelerating PDE-constrained optimization, building on WLaSDI to avoid explicit numerical differentiation.

entry.title: Scale-Calibrated Median-of-Means for Robust Distributed Principal Component Analysis

author.name: Kisung You

entry.summary: Proposes a scale-calibrated median-of-means estimator for distributed PCA on the product geometry of Euclidean space and Grassmann manifold, with robustness guarantees.

entry.title: GHI: Graphormer over Conditioned Hypergraph Incidence for Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis

author.name: Yu Du, Wenlong Zhu, Xingze Li, Chenglong Cao, Jing Wang, Yukun Ma

entry.summary: Introduces GHI, a Graphormer-over-Conditioned-Hypergraph-Incidence framework for aspect-based sentiment analysis that models token-hyperedge relations for structural reasoning.

entry.title: Assisted Counterspeech Writing at the Crossroads of Hate Speech and Misinformation

author.name: Genoveffa Martone, Helena Bonaldi, Marco Guerini

entry.summary: Studies LLM-assisted counterspeech generation for contexts where hate speech and misinformation co-occur, testing knowledge-driven generation strategies with fact-checker and NGO guidelines.

entry.title: Scene Abstraction for Lexical Semantics: Structured Representations of Situated Meaning

author.name: Yejin Cho, Katrin Erk

entry.summary: Proposes Scene Abstraction, a framework for constructing structured representations of situational meanings of words, capturing contextual scenes and expression profiles through LLM prompting.

entry.title: BEiTScore: Reference-free Image Captioning Evaluation with an Efficient Cross-Encoder Model

author.name: Gon\c{c}alo Gomes, Bruno Martins, Chrysoula Zerva

entry.summary: Proposes BEiTScore, a reference-free image captioning evaluation metric based on a lightweight cross-encoder initialized from a VQA model. Balances computational efficiency with fine-grained sensitivity.

entry.title: Look-Closer-Then-Diagnose: Confidence-Aware Ultrasound VQA via Active Zooming

author.name: Yue Zhou, Erxuan Wu, Yikang Sun, Hongjoo Lee, Yuan Bi, Huixiong Xu, Zhongliang Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes a confidence-aware ultrasound VQA framework that mimics sonographer workflow - first zooming into lesion regions, then diagnosing. Accounts for annotation subjectivity in medical AI training.

entry.title: Dual-Integrated Low-Latency Single-Lens Infrared Computational Imaging for Object Detection

author.name: Xuquan Wang, Guishuo Yang, Dapeng Yan, Yujie Xing, Xuanyu Qian, Kai Zhang, Xiong Dun, Jiande Sun, Zhanshan Wang, Xinbin Cheng

entry.summary: PDI-Net integrates infrared image reconstruction with object detection while embedding optical priors, achieving low-latency inference by sharing encoder features directly with a YOLO detector instead of full reconstruction. This bridges computational imaging and detection.

entry.title: SO-Mamba: State-Ownership Mamba for Unrolled MRI Reconstruction

author.name: Pengcheng Fang, Hongli Chen, Fangfang Tang, Feng Liu, Xiaohao Cai, Shanshan Shan

entry.summary: SO-Mamba introduces state-ownership concepts for Mamba-based MRI reconstruction, distinguishing between persistent resident-carrier evidence and stage-dependent non-resident evidence in unrolled optimization, preventing their conflation in recurrent state-space models.

entry.title: Distributed Image Compression with Multimodal Side Information at Extremely Low Bitrates

author.name: Guojun Xu, Mingyang Zhang, Jianwen Xiang, Cheng Tan, Yanchao Yang, Junwei Zhou

entry.summary: MDIC proposes the first multimodal distributed image compression framework that leverages side information in multiple modalities for extremely low bitrate (<0.1 bpp) multi-view transmission, preserving fine-grained details and global perceptual quality.

entry.title: TWINGS: Thin Plate Splines Warp-aligned Initialization for Sparse-View Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Hyeseong Kim, Geonhui Son, Deukhee Lee, Dosik Hwang

entry.summary: TWINGS uses Thin Plate Splines to align backprojected depth points with triangulated control points for sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting initialization, providing geometrically accurate point clouds that improve reconstruction quality.

entry.title: AesFormer: Transform Everyday Photos into Beautiful Memories

author.name: Tianxiang Du, Hulingxiao He, Yuxin Peng

entry.summary: AesFormer formulates Aesthetic Photo Reconstruction (APR) to improve photo aesthetics through structural reconstruction while preserving identity, using a two-stage framework that decouples aesthetic planning from image editing.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Temporal Action Localization Through Textual Guidance

author.name: Benedetta Liberatori, Alessandro Conti, Lorenzo Vaquero, Paolo Rota, Yiming Wang, Elisa Ricci

entry.summary: A zero-shot temporal action localization approach that uses textual guidance from VLMs without requiring labeled training data, addressing limitations of fine-grained action classification in vision-language models.

entry.title: REACH: Hand Pose Estimation from Room Corners

author.name: Shu Nakamura, Ryo Kawahara, Genki Kinoshita, Ryosuke Hirai, Yasutomo Kawanishi, Shohei Nobuhara, Ko Nishino

entry.summary: REACH introduces a Transformer-based 3D hand pose estimator for room-corner cameras that leverages hand-body coordination and temporal progression from extremely low-resolution, frequently occluded views, with a new dataset.

entry.title: 4D-GSW: Kinematic-Aware Spatio-Temporal Consistent Watermarking for 4D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Sifan Zhou, Hang Zhang, Yuhang Wang, Ming Li

entry.summary: 4D-GSW proposes kinematic-aware watermarking for 4D Gaussian Splatting that embeds copyright information while preserving spatio-temporal consistency, addressing non-physical artifacts like temporal flickering in naively watermarked dynamic reconstructions.

entry.title: QuantSR+: Pushing the Limit of Quantized Image Super-Resolution Networks

author.name: Haotong Qin, Xudong Ma, Xianglong Liu, Jie Luo, Jinyang Guo, Michele Magno, Yulun Zhang

entry.summary: QuantSR+ is a unified framework for ultra-low-bit (2-4 bit) quantization of super-resolution models with three contributions: redistribution-driven bit determination, network design improvements, and training optimization for better accuracy-efficiency tradeoffs.

entry.title: AgroTools: A Benchmark for Tool-Augmented Multimodal Agents in Agriculture

author.name: Zi Ye, Yibin Wen, Xiaoya Fan, Xinyu Zhang, Jing Wu, Kun Zeng, Zurong Mai, Jiarui Zhang, Bohan Shi, Juepeng Zheng, Jianxi Huang, Yutong Lu, Haohuan Fu

entry.summary: AgroTools is a benchmark for evaluating tool-augmented multimodal agents in agriculture with 539 instances, 1,097 images, 14 tools, and structured tool-use traces enabling dual evaluation of tool selection and execution accuracy.

entry.title: SceneAligner: 3D-Grounded Floorplan Localization in the Wild

author.name: Junhyeong Cho, Ruojin Cai, Hadar Averbuch-Elor

entry.summary: Presents SceneAligner for floorplan localization in the wild by grounding the task in reconstructed 3D scene representations. Projects gravity-aligned 3D reconstructions into 2D density maps for matching against rasterized floorplans in large-scale buildings.

entry.title: From Baseline to Follow-Up: Counterfactual Spine DXA Image Synthesis in UK Biobank Using a Causal Hierarchical Variational Autoencoder

author.name: Yilin Zhang, Nicholas C. Harvey, Nicholas R. Fuggle, Rahman Attar

entry.summary: Proposes a causal hierarchical VAE for generating counterfactual spine DXA images conditioned on participant metadata, using abduction-action-prediction to simulate aging effects on bone structure from UK Biobank data.

entry.title: ST-SimDiff: Balancing Spatiotemporal Similarity and Difference for Efficient Video Understanding with MLLMs

author.name: Bingjun Luo, Tony Wang, Chaoqi Chen, Xinpeng Ding

entry.summary: Proposes ST-SimDiff, a training-free framework for efficient video understanding that uses similarity for identifying redundancy and difference for capturing key events, constructing a spatio-temporal graph for token processing.

entry.title: Guiding Multi-Objective Genetic Programming with Description Length Improves Symbolic Regression Solutions

author.name: Gabriel Kronberger, Fabricio Olivetti de Franca, Deaglan J. Bartlett, Harry Desmond, Pedro G. Ferreira

entry.summary: Evaluates description length and fractional Bayes factor as principled alternatives to heuristics for selecting compact expressions in genetic programming symbolic regression. Studies three search/selection strategies across noisy benchmarks.

entry.title: Flying Together: Human-Guided Immersive Shared Control for Aerial Robot Teams in Unknown Environments

author.name: Lou De Bel-Air, Luca Morando, Ruitao Chen, Keru Wang, Benjamin Jarvis, Charbel Toumieh, Yang Zhou, Ken Perlin, Dario Floreano, Giuseppe Loianno

entry.summary: Presents a VR-based shared control framework for drone teams in unknown environments with a motion-primitive-based planner computing collision-free trajectories while integrating real-time operator input through admittance control.

entry.title: Auction-Consensus Algorithm with Learned Bidding Scheme for Multi-Robot Systems

author.name: Jose Rodriguez, Constantine Tarawneh, Sven Koenig, Wenjie Dong, Qi Lu

entry.summary: Proposes replacing hand-crafted bidding functions in the Consensus-Based Bundle Algorithm (CBBA) for multi-robot task allocation with a neural bidding policy trained via reinforcement learning. Uses centralized training with decentralized execution to improve task allocation quality.

entry.title: Branch-Stochastic Model Predictive Control for Motion Planning under Multi-Modal Uncertainty with Scenario Clustering

author.name: Zekun Xing, Ramkrishna Chaudhari, Marion Leibold, Dirk Wollherr, Martin Buss

entry.summary: Combines stochastic MPC with branching structure for autonomous driving motion planning under multi-modal uncertainty, with a novel scenario clustering method to manage computational complexity while maintaining intention-specific trajectory planning.

entry.title: Departure from Regularity: Degree Heterogeneity and Eigengap as the Structural Drivers of ASE-LSE Latent Subspace Disagreement

author.name: Minh Triet Pham, Ian Gallagher

entry.summary: Shows that regularity (equal node degrees) is a sufficient condition for Adjacency Spectral Embedding and Laplacian Spectral Embedding to produce identical latent subspaces, and provides bounds quantifying how degree heterogeneity and eigengap control their disagreement.

entry.title: Finite-Particle Convergence Rates for Conservative and Non-Conservative Drifting Models

author.name: Krishnakumar Balasubramanian

entry.summary: Proposes and analyzes a conservative drifting method for generative modeling that replaces displacement-based velocity with KDE-gradient velocity, proving continuous-time finite-particle convergence bounds.

entry.title: Frequency-Domain Regularized Adversarial Alignment for Transferable Attacks against Closed-Source MLLMs

author.name: Leitao Yuan, Qinghua Mao, Daizong Liu, Kun Wang, Wenjie Wang, Yan Teng, Jing Shao, Dongrui Liu

entry.summary: Proposes FRA-Attack, a frequency-domain regularized adversarial alignment method for improving transferability of targeted attacks against closed-source multimodal LLMs by addressing spatial-domain feature redundancy and surrogate-specific gradient signals.

entry.title: Truncated Neural Likelihood Estimation for Simulation-Based Inference in State-Space Models

author.name: Kostas Tsampourakis, V\'ictor Elvira

entry.summary: Introduces truncated neural likelihood estimation for parameter inference in state-space models, addressing limitations of sequential neural likelihood (poor scaling with sequence length, high sample requirements).

entry.title: Slimmable ConvNeXt: Width-Adaptive Inference for Efficient Multi-Device Deployment

author.name: Janek Haberer, Jon Eike Wilhelm, Olaf Landsiedel

entry.summary: Shows that ConvNeXt's design (LayerNorm, inverted bottlenecks) makes it naturally suited for channel-width slimming without switchable batch normalization, enabling a single model to serve multiple computational budgets across devices.

entry.title: Mind the Gaps: Multi-Robot Feedback-Driven Ergodic Coverage in Unknown Environments

author.name: Thales Costa Silva, Nora Ayanian

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive multi-robot coverage strategy combining ergodic search with real-time feedback for unknown environments, enabling robots to explore effectively without prior knowledge of environmental distributions.

entry.title: Mahjax: A GPU-Accelerated Mahjong Simulator for Reinforcement Learning in JAX

author.name: Soichiro Nishimori, Shinri Okano, Keigo Habara, Sotetsu Koyamada, Eason Yu, Masashi Sugiyama

entry.summary: Mahjax is a GPU-accelerated Riichi Mahjong simulator in JAX enabling large-scale RL training. Demonstrates tabula rasa learning in this complex multi-player imperfect-information game.

entry.title: GraphDiffMed: Knowledge-Constrained Differential Attention with Pharmacological Graph Priors for Medication Recommendation

author.name: Krati Saxena, Tomohiro Shibata

entry.summary: GraphDiffMed combines dual-scale differential attention with pharmacological graph priors (drug-drug interactions) for medication recommendation from EHRs, filtering noise at both intra-visit and inter-visit levels.

entry.title: PolycubeNet: A Dual-latent Diffusion Model for Polycube-Based Hexahedral Mesh Generation

author.name: Lu He, Qitao Deng, Junjiang Deng, Liangbin Deng, Yanjun Liang, Wenting Yang, Guoqiang Wang, Na Lei

entry.summary: PolycubeNet uses a dual-latent diffusion model to generate polycube-based hexahedral meshes from point clouds, eliminating explicit surface segmentation for automatic hex meshing of complex geometries.

entry.title: Plug-and-Play Spiking Operators: Breaking the Nonlinearity Bottleneck in Spiking Transformers

author.name: Xinzhe Yuan (IASM, Harbin Institute of Technology), Xiang Peng (IASM, Harbin Institute of Technology), Bin Gu (School of Artificial Intelligence, Jilin University), Huan Xiong (IASM, Harbin Institute of Technology)

entry.summary: Proposes plug-and-play spike-friendly approximations for Transformer nonlinearities to enable ANN-to-SNN conversion of large language models on neuromorphic hardware. Addresses the gap where current pipelines support linear operations but not key nonlinear operators.

entry.title: Agentic Agile-V: From Vibe Coding to Verified Engineering in Software and Hardware Development

author.name: Christopher Koch

entry.summary: Proposes Agentic Agile-V framework arguing that the central problem in AI coding is engineering process control, not prompt engineering. Synthesizes evidence from controlled studies showing heterogeneous productivity effects.

entry.title: EPC-3D-Diff: Equivariant Physics Consistent Conditional 3D Latent Diffusion for CBCT to CT Synthesis

author.name: Alzahra Altalib, Chunhui Li, Haytham Al Ewaidat, Khaled Alawneh, Ahmad Qendel, Alessandro Perelli

entry.summary: EPC-3D-Diff is a conditional 3D latent diffusion framework for CBCT-to-CT synthesis that enforces physics-consistent equivariance in the projection domain, exploiting the relationship between in-plane rotations and angular shifts in projections.

entry.title: Dynamic TMoE: A Drift-Aware Dynamic Mixture of Experts Framework for Non-Stationary Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Jiawen Zhu, Shuhan Liu, Di Weng, Yingcai Wu

entry.summary: Dynamic TMoE uses MMD-based distribution shift detection to dynamically instantiate/prune heterogeneous experts and a temporal memory router for non-stationary time series forecasting.

entry.title: DIVE: Embedding Compression via Self-Limiting Gradient Updates

author.name: Dongfang Zhao

entry.summary: DIVE proposes embedding compression via self-limiting gradient updates, using a hinge-based triplet loss that produces zero gradient once margins are satisfied, addressing overfitting in existing compression adapters under data scarcity.

entry.title: SCRIBE: Diagnostic Evaluation and Rich Transcription Models for Indic ASR

author.name: Kavya Manohar, Arghya Bhattacharya, Kush Juvekar, Kumarmanas Nethil

entry.summary: SCRIBE is a diagnostic framework for Indic ASR providing categorical error decomposition (lexical, punctuation, numeral, domain-entity) through sandhi-tolerant alignment, addressing WER's failures for agglutinative languages.

entry.title: CAdam: Context-Adaptive Moment Estimation for 3D Gaussian Densification in Generative Distillation

author.name: SeungJeh Chung, Geonho Park, Misong Kim, HyeongYeop Kang

entry.summary: Introduces Context-Adaptive Moment Estimation (CAdam) for 3D Gaussian Splatting densification in generative distillation, treating densification as a statistical estimation problem to separate geometric signals from noise.

entry.title: Single-Pass, Depth-Selective Reading for Multi-Aspect Sentiment Analysis

author.name: Yan Xia, Zhuangzhuang Pan, Amirrudin Kamsin, Chee Seng Chan

entry.summary: Proposes DABS, a single-pass inference framework for aspect-term sentiment analysis that encodes sentences once to construct a reusable depth-ordered substrate, which each aspect then queries selectively.

entry.title: SURGE: An Event-Centric Social Media Sentiment Time Series Benchmark with Interaction Structure

author.name: Chen Su, Pengsen Cheng, Yuanhe Tian, Yan Song

entry.summary: Introduces SURGE, a multi-event social media benchmark pairing event-level sentiment time series with text and interaction structure, enabling study of how social interactions shape collective dynamics.

entry.title: DeCoR: Design and Control Co-Optimization for Urban Streets Using Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Bibek Poudel, Lei Zhu, Kevin Heaslip, Sai Swaminathan, Weizi Li

entry.summary: Introduces DeCoR, a two-stage RL framework co-optimizing crosswalk placement and signal control for urban streets using flow observations from video and WiFi sensing.

entry.title: TempGlitch: Evaluating Vision-Language Models for Temporal Glitch Detection in Gameplay Videos

author.name: Yakun Yu, Ashley Wiens, Adri\'an Barahona-R\'ios, Benedict Wilkins, Saman Zadtootaghaj, Nabajeet Barman, Cor-Paul Bezemer

entry.summary: Introduces TempGlitch, a benchmark for evaluating VLMs on temporal glitch detection in gameplay videos. Shows that temporal glitches (only visible across ordered frames) are substantially harder for VLMs than spatial ones.

entry.title: AirfoilGen: A valid-by-construction and performance-aware latent diffusion model for airfoil generation

author.name: Zhijie Yang, Min Tang, Peng Du, Qiang Zou

entry.summary: Proposes AirfoilGen, a latent diffusion model for airfoil generation using a novel circle sweeping representation that guarantees geometric validity by construction while conditioning on aerodynamic performance.

entry.title: Can Conversational XAI Improve User Performance? An Experimental Study

author.name: Sven Kruschel, Julian Rosenberger, Lasse Bohlen, Mathias Kraus, Patrick Zschech

entry.summary: Proposes an experimental design for evaluating conversational XAI assistants through prediction accuracy, model understanding, and error identification. Compares conversational vs. Q&A-based assistance.

entry.title: ReversedQ: Opportunities for Faster Q-Learning in Episodic Online Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Sofia R. Miskala-Dinc, Aviva Prins

entry.summary: Studies model-free Q-learning in finite-horizon episodic MDPs, identifying three opportunities for faster learning: value-function update order, update frequencies, and initialization. Shows empirical improvements.

entry.title: A Unified Framework for Uncertainty-Aware Explainable Artificial Intelligence: A Case Study in Power Quality Disturbance Classification

author.name: Yinsong Chen, Samson S. Yu, Zhong Li, Chee Peng Lim

entry.summary: Formalizes the explanation distribution from Bayesian neural networks as a push-forward measure and proposes uncertainty-aware relevance attribution operators (UA-RAO) that summarize explanation distributions for XAI.

entry.title: A New Framework to Analyse the Distributional Robustness of Deep Neural Networks

author.name: Divij Khaitan, Subhashis Banerjee

entry.summary: Proposes a framework analyzing distributional robustness of DNNs by modeling interactions between layer weights and activations using Bernoulli distributions, using class separation as a diagnostic proxy.

entry.title: WildRoadBench: A Wild Aerial Road-Damage Grounding Benchmark for Vision-Language Models and Autonomous Agents

author.name: Bingnan Liu, Chenhang Cui, Rui Huang, Jiani Luo, Zhirong Shen, Tinghao Wang, Xiande Huang, Lingbei Meng, Fei Shen, An Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces WildRoadBench, a benchmark for aerial road-damage detection that evaluates both VLM direct grounding and autonomous agent research capabilities on UAV imagery.

entry.title: Motion-Robust Deep Reconstruction for Free-Breathing Cardiac Cine MRI

author.name: Mahmut Yurt, Kanghyun Ryu, Zhitao Li, Xucheng Zhu, Xianglun Mao, Martin Janich, Marcus Alley, Kawin Setsompop, John Pauly, Shreyas Vasanawala, Ali Syed

entry.summary: Proposes Cine-DL for free-breathing cardiac cine MRI reconstruction combining k-space preprocessing with model-based deep learning for pediatric and non-compliant patients.

entry.title: Neural Negative Binomial Regression for Weekly Seismicity Forecasting: Per-Cell Dispersion Estimation and Tail Risk Assessment

author.name: Alim Igilik

entry.summary: Proposes EarthquakeNet, a neural architecture for weekly seismicity forecasting that estimates per-cell overdispersion parameters, strongly rejecting the standard Poisson assumption used in earthquake forecasting.

entry.title: Moral Semantics Survive Machine Translation: Cross-Lingual Evidence from Moral Foundations Corpora

author.name: Maciej Skorski

entry.summary: Investigates whether LLM-based translation preserves moral semantics, using Polish as test case with 50k annotated social media posts. Validates through four methods that moral foundations survive machine translation, enabling cross-lingual moral analysis.

entry.title: AnyMo: Geometry-Aware Setup-Agnostic Modeling of Human Motion in the Wild

author.name: Baiyu Chen, Zechen Li, Wilson Wongso, Lihuan Li, Xiachong Lin, Hao Xue, Benjamin Tag, Flora Salim

entry.summary: Introduces AnyMo, a geometry-aware framework for setup-agnostic human motion modeling from wearable IMUs. Uses physics-grounded simulation over body-surface placements for setup-independent motion representations.

entry.title: AVI-HT: Adaptive Vision-IMU Fusion for 3D Hand Tracking

author.name: Ziyi Kou, Ankit Kumar, Mia Huang, Taylor Niehues, Vatsal Mehta, Ergys Ristani, Li Guan

entry.summary: Presents AVI-HT for adaptive visual-IMU fusion in 3D hand tracking, using cross-sensor attention to modulate trust between vision and IMU signals during hand-object interaction with heavy occlusion.

entry.title: Virtual 3D H&E Staining from Phase-contrast Back-illumination Interference Tomography

author.name: Anthony Song, Boyan Zhou, Mayank Golhar, Marisa Morakis, Alex Baras, Nicholas Durr

entry.summary: HistoBIT3D presents the first voxel-wise paired dataset for Back-illumination Interference Tomography and fluorescence-labeled nuclei, enabling quantitative evaluation of virtual H&E staining for 3D histopathology without tissue processing.

entry.title: Diverse Yet Consistent: Context-Guided Diffusion with Energy-Based Joint Refinement for Multi-Agent Motion Prediction

author.name: Lei Chu, Yuhuan Zhao

entry.summary: A diffusion-based framework for multi-agent motion prediction that uses rich contextual information from historical trajectories as guidance to improve diversity while maintaining joint consistency among interacting agents.

entry.title: EventGait: Towards Robust Gait Recognition with Event Streams

author.name: Senyan Xu, Shuai Chen, Chuanfu Shen, Kean Liu, Zhijing Sun, Chengzhi Cao, Xueyang Fu

entry.summary: EventGait proposes an end-to-end dual-stream framework for gait recognition using event cameras, separately modeling motion and shape while preserving fine-grained temporal dynamics that traditional event image aggregation discards.

entry.title: Flow-based Gaussian Splatting for Continuous-Scale Remote Sensing Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Jiangwei Mo, Xi Lu, Hanlin Wu

entry.summary: FlowGS combines flow matching with Gaussian splatting for arbitrary-scale super-resolution of remote sensing images, modeling high-frequency details between resolution levels with fast inference (few steps) compared to diffusion models.

entry.title: Event-Illumination Collaborative Low-light Image Enhancement with a High-resolution Real-world Dataset

author.name: Senyan Xu, Zhijing Sun, Kean Liu, Xin Lu, Ruixuan Jiang, Mingyang Huang, Xueyang Fu, Zheng-Jun Zha

entry.summary: EIC-LIE proposes event-illumination collaborative low-light image enhancement with a novel interaction module and illumination-aware event filter, accompanied by a high-resolution real-world dataset for evaluation.

Emre Kavur, Pierre-Henri Conze, Haz{\i}m Kemal Ekenel, O\u{g}uz Dicle, Mustafa Ege \c{S}eker, Mustafa Said Kartal, Ariorad Moniri, Orhan \"Ozkan, Osman Faruk Bayram, Hakan Polat, Musa Balc{\i}, Ece Tu\u{g}ba Cebeci, Baran C{\i}lga, Kardelen Pe\c{c}enek, M. Alper Selver

entry.title: Translating Signals to Languages for sEMG-Based Activity Recognition

author.name: Ming Wang, Haoxuan Qu, Qiuhong Ke, Wei Zhou, Hossein Rahmani, Jun Liu

entry.summary: Proposes translating surface EMG signals into language representations for activity recognition using LLMs, leveraging the implicit knowledge of LLMs about actions learned from linguistic descriptions.

author.name: Laziz Hamdi, Amine Tamasna, Pascal Boisson, Thierry Paquet

entry.summary: FastTab is a grid-centric table structure recognition model that avoids autoregressive HTML decoding by using a Tiny Recursive Module for global reasoning and axial 1D Transformers for row/column dependencies, achieving competitive performance at low latency.

entry.title: Making the Discrete Continuous: Synthetic RAW Augmentations for Fine-Grained Evaluation of Person Detection Performance in Low Light

author.name: Valeria Pais, Malena Mendilaharzu, Daniele Faccio, Luis Oala, Christoph Clausen, Bruno Sanguinetti

entry.summary: Shows how synthetic low-light RAW image augmentations can provide continuous characterization of pedestrian detection performance as a function of scene illumination, filling gaps in sparse real-world test data distributions.

entry.title: FashionLens: Toward Versatile Fashion Image Retrieval via Task-Adaptive Learning

author.name: Haokun Wen, Xuemeng Song, Xinghao Xie, Xiaolin Chen, Xiangyu Zhao, Weili Guan

entry.summary: Introduces FashionLens, a unified framework for versatile fashion image retrieval supporting diverse query formats, along with U-FIRE benchmark that consolidates fragmented fashion datasets. Addresses the practical need for a single system handling multiple retrieval scenarios in e-commerce.

entry.title: A Task-Agnostic Algebraic Integrity Metric for Event-Camera Streams Toward SOTIF-Compliant Perception using Pearson Correlation Coefficient

author.name: Arthur de Miranda Neto

entry.summary: Proposes a task-agnostic algebraic quality metric for event camera streams based on Pearson Correlation Coefficient, addressing SOTIF/ISO certification requirements for automated driving that current task-dependent proxies cannot satisfy.

entry.title: Distributed Multi-Coverage for Robot Swarms

author.name: Mariem Guitouni, Aaron T. Becker

entry.summary: Presents a distributed multicoverage algorithm for robot swarms operating with local sensing and communication, where each asset requires observation by multiple robots with varying requirements based on importance.

entry.title: Scout-Assisted Planning for Heterogeneous Robot Teams under Partially Known Environments

author.name: Hoang-Dung Bui, Abhish Khanal, Raihan Islam Arnob, Gregory J. Stein

entry.summary: Proposes Scout-Assisted Planning for heterogeneous UAV-UGV teams where scout UAVs proactively gather environmental information. Uses a GNN-based model to efficiently predict information gain for prioritizing scouting actions.

entry.title: Adaptive RBF-KAN: A Comparative Evaluation of Dynamic Shape Parameters in Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks

author.name: Roberto Cavoretto, Alessandra De Rossi, Adeeba Haider, Amir Noorizadegan

entry.summary: Extends RBF-based Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks by introducing a broader family of radial basis kernels with shape parameters initialized via leave-one-out cross-validation. First study integrating LOOCV-based kernel scale estimation with deep KAN training.

entry.title: From Sequential Nodes to GPU Batches: Parallel Branch and Bound for Optimal $k$-Sparse GLMs

author.name: Jiachang Liu, Andrea Lodi

entry.summary: Proposes a CPU-GPU framework for parallel branch and bound for optimal k-sparse GLMs, processing multiple BnB nodes in batches on GPUs with padding and custom kernels to overcome sequential processing bottlenecks.

entry.title: SDPM: Survival Diffusion Probabilistic Model for Continuous-Time Survival Analysis

author.name: Stanislav R. Kirpichenko, Andrei V. Konstantinov, Lev V. Utkin

entry.summary: Proposes SDPM, a denoising diffusion model for continuous-time survival analysis that models the joint distribution of observed time and censoring indicator, transforming generated samples into survival function estimates.

entry.title: Evaluating Temporal Semantic Caching and Workflow Optimization in Agentic Plan-Execute Pipelines

author.name: Alimurtaza Mustafa Merchant, Krish Veera, Sajal Kumar Goyla, Shambhawi Bhure, Dhaval Patel, Kaoutar El Maghraoui

entry.summary: Evaluates temporal semantic caching and workflow optimization for industrial asset operations, proposing a cache that respects time/asset/sensor parameters and MCP workflow optimizations for plan-execute pipelines.

entry.title: AI-Assisted Competency Assessment from Egocentric Video in Simulation-Based Nursing Education

author.name: Hanchen David Wang, Yilin Liu, Madison J. Lee, Surya Chand Rayala, Gautam Biswas, Daniel T. Levin, Meiyi Ma

entry.title: SegGuidedNet: Sub-Region-Aware Attention Supervision for Interpretable Brain Tumor Segmentation

entry.title: HyperBench: Standardizing and Scaling Synthetic Evaluation for Hyperspectral Super-Resolution

author.name: Ritik Shah, Marco F. Duarte

entry.summary: Presents HyperBench, a standardized benchmark for hyperspectral super-resolution that addresses inconsistent evaluation practices across research works by systematically varying PSFs, SRFs, and downsampling factors.

entry.title: OCELOT: Odometry and Contact Estimation for Legged Robots

author.name: Emre Girgin, Cagri Kilic

entry.summary: Presents OCELOT, a complete leg odometry pipeline using Error-State EKF with fused contact detection and uncertainty quantification for legged robots using only proprioceptive sensors (IMU, joint encoders, force sensors).

entry.summary: As first reported in Research yesterday, Proves that the equivalence between DPO and RLHF is conditional, not universal, depending on an implicit assumption that is frequently violated in practice. Characterizes failure modes where DPO converges to preferring dispreferred responses.

entry.title: Improving Viewpoint-Invariance and Temporal Consistency for Action Detection

author.name: Yannick Porto, Renato Martins, Thomas Chalumeau, Cedric Demonceaux

entry.summary: Proposes a method for zero-shot action recognition that handles domain shifts from viewpoint changes by using multiview motion representations and textual descriptions for cross-domain generalization.

entry.title: Declarative Data Services: Structured Agentic Discovery for Composing Data Systems

entry.title: Improving Quantized Model Performance in Qualitative Analysis with Multi-Pass Prompt Verification

author.name: Aisvarya Adeseye, Jouni Isoaho, Adeyemi Adeseye

entry.title: JUDO: A Juxtaposed Domain-Oriented Multimodal Reasoner for Industrial Anomaly QA

It addresses the gap between general-purpose LMMs and domain-specific industrial inspection needs.

entry.title: Tippett-minimum Fusion of Representation-space Diffusion Models for Multi-Encoder Out-of-Distribution Detection

entry.title: Pareto-Enhanced Portrait Generation: Vision-Aligned Text Supervision for Alignment, Realism, and Aesthetics

author.name: Yunlong Wang, Jinjin Shi, Wenbin Gao, Xuran Xu, Runyu Shi, Ying Huang

entry.title: Manga109-v2026: Revisiting Manga109 Annotations for Modern Manga Understanding

author.name: Jeonghun Baek, Atsuyuki Miyai, Shota Onohara, Hikaru Ikuta, Kiyoharu Aizawa

author.name: Wanying Tan, Shuo Yan, Dazhi Huang, Yazheng Liu, Zili Shao, Rufeng Chen, Hechang Chen, Mude Shi, Tianxing Ji, Sihong Xie

author.name: Austin Braniff (Department of Chemical and Biomedical Engineering, West Virginia University), Fengqi You (R.F. Smith School of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering, Cornell University), Yuhe Tian (Department of Chemical and Biomedical Engineering, West Virginia University)

author.name: Junghyun Lee, Hyunseo Kim, Hanna Jang, Junhyug Noh

author.name: Qinwu Xu, Yifan Jiang

author.name: Xiangyu Yang, Feng Xu, Jian-Qiang Hu, Jiaqiao Hu

entry.title: Oracle Supervision Transfers for Hyperparameter Prediction in Model-Based Image Denoising

author.name: Jianmin Liao, Lixin Shen, Yuesheng Xu

author.name: Mouhamed Amine Bouchiha, Abdelaziz Amara Korba, Yacine Ghamri-Doudane

entry.summary: Proposes ABC-DFL, a Byzantine-resilient decentralized federated learning framework for connected electric vehicles, using blockchain-based aggregation and dynamic fault tolerance for battery intelligence applications.

author.name: Chaogui Gou, Jiarui Liang

entry.summary: Proposes Psy-Chronicle, a framework for synthesizing long-horizon campus psychological counseling dialogues with semester-spanning stress event graphs to model how psychological distress accumulates over time.

entry.title: Improving 3D Labeling in Self-Driving by Inferring Vehicle Information using Vision Language Models

author.name: Steven Chen, Shivesh Khaitan, Nemanja Djuric

entry.summary: Uses Vision Language Models for zero-shot vehicle identification and 3D bounding box estimation in self-driving labeling pipelines. Evaluates VLMs on make/model/generation recognition for improved labeling efficiency.

author.name: Inpyo Song, Jangwon Lee

entry.title: AgroVG: A Large-Scale Multi-Source Benchmark for Agricultural Visual Grounding

author.name: Haocheng Li, Juepeng Zheng, Zenghao Yang, Kaiqi Du, Guilong Xiao, Gengmeng Pu, Haohuan Fu, Jianxi Huang

entry.title: GenHAR: Generalizing Cross-domain Human Activity Recognition for Last-mile Delivery

author.name: Zhiqing Hong, Zelong Li, Xiubin Fan, Guang Yang, Baoshen Guo, Haotian Wang, Tian He, Desheng Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces NMCA-aligned LULC classification schemes and a benchmark multispectral LiDAR dataset, evaluating seven deep learning models for 3D point cloud semantic segmentation with spectral ablation studies.

entry.title: Tackle CSM in JPEG Steganalysis with Data Adaptation

entry.title: Motion Design for Grasp-Based Dynamic Locomotion in Microgravity

author.name: Chaerim Moon, Joohyung Kim, Justin K. Yim

entry.summary: Presents design insights for grasp-based dynamic locomotion in microgravity for multi-limbed robots, investigating gait patterns, stride length, speed, and posture parameters with a parameterizable planning framework.

author.name: Shiying Dong, Haoyang Yang, Qiwei Liu, Wen-Hua Chen

entry.summary: Develops a support-aware offline decision framework for reserve-price policy selection in advertising that outputs certified policies, flagged policies needing validation, and rejected policies, rather than just a point-estimate winner.

entry.title: Engineering Hybrid Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Next-Generation Electricity Systems: A State-of-the-Art Review

author.name: Joseph Nyangon

entry.summary: Reviews hybrid physics-informed ML architectures for electricity systems including PINNs, DeepONets, Fourier Neural Operators, and graph-based PINNs for Industry 4.0 applications in power grid design, monitoring, and control.

entry.title: Parallel LLM Reasoning for Bias-Resilient, Robust Conceptual Abstraction

author.name: Aisvarya Adeseye, Jouni Isoaho, Adeyemi Adeseye

entry.summary: Proposes parallel chunk-level processing with evidence-anchored consolidation to reduce contextual reasoning limitations of LLMs on long documents, addressing cumulative bias and conceptual drift.

entry.title: Leveraging Vision-Language Models to Detect Attention in Educational Videos

author.name: Gabriel Becquet (LIP6, CNRS, SU), S\'ebastien Lall\'e (CNRS, LIP6, SU), Vanda Luengo (LIP6, CNRS, SU), Ali Abou-Hassan (SU, CNRS, PHENIX, IUF)

entry.summary: Uses vision-language models to detect attention/engagement in educational videos from eye tracking data, moving beyond engineered features to foundation model representations.

entry.title: Efficient Table QA via TableGrid Navigation and Progressive Inference Prompting

author.name: Amritansh Maurya, Navjot Singh, Mohammed Javed, Omar Moured

entry.summary: Proposes two training-free prompting frameworks for Table QA: TableGrid Navigation (iterative row/column navigation) and Progressive Inference Prompting (structured column-first reasoning).

entry.title: WaveGraphNet: Physics-Consistent Guided-Wave Damage Localization through Coupled Inverse-Forward Graph Learning

author.name: Vinay Sharma, Aditya Bharade, Olga Fink

entry.summary: Proposes WaveGraphNet, a coupled inverse-forward graph learning framework for guided-wave damage localization in composite plates, explicitly modeling the sensing layout as a graph.

entry.title: Decision-Path Patterns as Tree Reliability Signals: Path-based Adaptive Weighting for Random Forest Classification

author.name: Youngjoon Park

entry.summary: Proposes path-based adaptive weighting for Random Forests using decision-path patterns as tree reliability signals, exploiting class label flip patterns along root-to-leaf paths.

entry.title: Audience Engagement with Arabic Women's Social Empowerment and Wellbeing: A Decadal Corpus

author.name: Wajdi Zaghouani, Mabrouka Bessghaier, MD. Rafiul Biswas, Shimaa Amer Ibrahim

entry.summary: Presents a decade-long corpus of 252K Arabic Facebook posts on women's empowerment with engagement metrics from 77 countries, enabling analysis of gender discourse and emotional engagement patterns.

entry.title: Cell Phantom Video Generation in Elliptical Fourier Descriptor Domain

author.name: Francesco Benedetto, Roberto Basla, Luca Magri, Giacomo Boracchi

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for generating synthetic cell tracking videos using Elliptical Fourier Descriptors to ensure temporal consistency of cell shapes. Addresses data scarcity in biomedical cell tracking by generating realistic phantom cells that replicate biological processes.

entry.title: An Evidence Hierarchy for Bayesian Object Classification via OSINT-Aided Heterogeneous Sensor Fusion

author.name: Jan Nausner, Michael Hubner

entry.summary: Proposes a context-aware Bayesian fusion framework with a novel evidence hierarchy for heterogeneous sensor classification of CBRNE threats, using OSINT data to mitigate sensor shortcomings.

entry.title: Time-varying rPPG signal separation via block-sparse signal model

author.name: Kosuke Kurihara, Yoshihiro Maeda, Daisuke Sugimura, Takayuki Hamamoto

entry.summary: Proposes an rPPG signal extraction method exploiting quasi-periodic characteristics modeled as block-sparse structure in time-frequency domain, with adaptive signal separation under illumination fluctuations.

entry.title: Pseudo-Siamese Network for Planning in Target-Oriented Proactive Dialogues

author.name: Xinyue Kang, Maodong Li, Yibin Zheng, Fang Kong

entry.summary: FF-BPSN uses a pseudo-Siamese network with forward and backward planning decoders for dialogue path planning in target-oriented proactive dialogue systems.

entry.title: Security Document Classification with a Fine-Tuned Local Large Language Model: Benchmark Data and an Open-Source System

author.name: Ivan Dobrovolskyi

entry.summary: TorchSight is an open-source local system for security document classification using a fine-tuned Qwen 3.5 27B model, achieving 95% accuracy vs 75-79% for commercial models on security document categorization across 7 categories.

entry.title: Latent Space Guided Scenario Sampling for Multimodal Segmentation Under Missing Modalities

author.name: Irem Ulku, \"O. \"Ozg\"ur Tanr{\i}\"over, Erdem Akag\"und\"uz

entry.summary: Proposes a training strategy for multimodal segmentation that learns scenario sampling distributions from pretrained latent spaces, rather than uniform random modality dropout, to handle missing modalities in remote sensing.

entry.title: Automated ICD Classification of Psychiatric Diagnoses: From Classical NLP to Large Language Models

author.name: Fernando Ortega, Ra\'ul Lara-Cabrera, Jorge Due\~nas-Ler\'in, Alejandro de la Torre-Luque, Merc\'e Salvador Robert, Enrique Baca-Garc\'ia

entry.summary: Proposes automating psychiatric ICD diagnosis coding from Spanish free-text descriptions using NLP, comparing classical methods to transformer-based embeddings on 145K psychiatric descriptions.

entry.title: RePCM: Region-Specific and Phenotype-Adaptive Bi-Ventricular Cardiac Motion Synthesis

author.name: Xuan Yang, Xiaohan Yuan, Hao Li, Lingyu Chen, Yanan Liu, Lei Li

entry.summary: Proposes RePCM for synthesizing full cardiac cycle motion from a single end-diastolic frame, using region-aware and phenotype-adaptive approaches to handle disease-specific differences in bi-ventricular motion.

entry.title: FedCritic: Serverless Federated Critic Learning-based Resource Allocation for Multi-Cell OFDMA in 6G

author.name: Amin Farajzadeh, Melike Erol-Kantarci

entry.summary: Proposes FedCritic, a serverless federated multi-agent actor-critic framework for distributed resource management in 6G networks. Addresses inter-cell interference in OFDMA scheduling without requiring centralized critics.

entry.title: OpenSeisML: Open Large-Scale Real Seismic and well-log Dataset for Generative AI

author.name: Ipsita Bhar, Huseyin Tuna Erdinc, Thales Souza, Charles Jones, Felix J. Herrmann

entry.summary: Releases OpenSeisML, a collection of real seismic datasets curated from UK public repositories for generative AI workflows in seismic inversion, with time-to-depth conversion pipeline.

entry.title: Prism: Structural Symmetry Scanning via Duality-Constrained Laplacian Projection

author.name: Jiatong Xie

entry.summary: Introduces Prism, a framework for structural symmetry diagnosis in networks using duality defect metrics based on graph Laplacians and symmetric involutions.

entry.title: Understanding Deterioration Random Effects for Causal Discovery in Infrastructure Management

author.name: Takato Yasuno

entry.summary: Combines Bayesian hierarchical hazard modeling with causal discovery (DirectLiNGAM) to identify operational patterns driving heterogeneous deterioration rates in pump equipment.

entry.title: Genetic Programming with Transformer-Based Mutation for Approximate Circuit Design

author.name: Ondrej Galeta, Lukas Sekanina

entry.summary: Proposes using transformer-based mutation operators in Cartesian genetic programming for designing approximate arithmetic circuits. A hybrid scheme alternates between standard and learned mutations to prevent stagnation.

entry.title: Broadening Access to Transportation Safety Data with Generative AI: A Schema-Grounded Framework for Spatial Natural Language Queries

author.name: Mahdi Azhdari, Eric J. Gonzales

entry.summary: Presents a schema-grounded natural language interface for transportation safety analysis, enabling non-technical stakeholders to query crash data, roadway attributes, and geospatial information using natural language.

entry.title: A Tutorial on Diffusion Theory: From Differential Equations to Diffusion Models

author.name: Jiayi Fu, Yuxia Wang

entry.summary: A tutorial developing diffusion models from the differential equations viewpoint, covering forward/reverse SDEs, probability-flow ODEs, score matching, and various design choices in modern architectures.

entry.title: VISTA: Validation-Guided Integration of Spatial and Temporal Foundation Models with Anatomical Decoding for Rare-Pathology VCE Event Detection -- after competition results

author.name: Bo-Cheng Qiu, Fang-Ying Lin, Ming-Han Sun, Yu-Fan Lin, Chia-Ming Lee, Chih-Chung Hsu

entry.summary: VISTA combines temporal and spatial foundation models (EndoFM-LV and DINOv3) for capsule endoscopy event detection with validation-guided fusion and anatomy-aware temporal decoding, achieving strong results on the RAREVISION challenge.

entry.title: GALAR-TemporalNet v2: Anatomy-Guided Dual-Branch Temporal Classification with Bidirectional Mamba and Dual-Graph GCN for Video Capsule Endoscopy -- after competition results

author.name: Jiye Won (Kyungpook National University), Seangmin Lee (Kyungpook National University), Soon Ki Jung (Kyungpook National University)

entry.summary: GALAR-TemporalNet v2 addresses video capsule endoscopy classification with a hierarchical temporal model combining windowed self-attention, dual-graph GCN, and bidirectional Mamba for handling class imbalance and long-range dependencies.

entry.title: Entropy-Guided Self-Supervised Learning for Medical Image Classification

author.name: Joao Florindo, Viviane Moura

entry.summary: Introduces a synergistic framework combining ImageNet-pretrained and entropy-guided MAE-pretrained ConvNeXt-Tiny models for medical image classification, leveraging complementary representations from natural and medical image pretraining.

entry.title: Impact of Atmospheric Turbulence and Pointing Error on Earth Observation

author.name: Celia S\'anchez-de-Miguel, Antonio M. Mercado-Mart\'inez, Beatriz Soret, Antonio Jurado-Navas, Miguel Castillo-V\'azquez

entry.title: Industrial Dual-Arm Box Handling via Online Inertial Estimation and Convex Wrench Optimization

author.name: Kenzhi Iskandar Wong, Lin Yang, Qian Ying Lee, Domenico Campolo

entry.title: N3P: Accelerated Automated Parking via a Learning-Based Naturalistic Three-Stage Scheme

author.name: Yifan Xue, Toktam Mohammadnejad, Faizan M Tariq, Sangjae Bae, David Isele, Yosuke Sakamoto, Nadia Figueroa, Jovin D'sa

entry.title: High Quality Embeddings for Horn Logic Reasoning

author.name: Yifan Zhang, Yasir White, Dean Clark, Joseph Sanchez, Jevon Lipsey, Ashely Hirst, Jeff Heflin

entry.summary: Introduces improved embedding methods for Horn logic reasoning using triplet loss training, with novel approaches to anchor generation, example balancing, and hard example emphasis. Results in more efficient logical reasoning searches.

entry.title: VBFDD-Agent for Electric Vehicle Battery Fault Detection and Diagnosis: Descriptive Text Modeling of Battery Digital Signals

author.name: Joey Chan, Zhen Chen, Ershun Pan

entry.summary: VBFDD-Agent proposes a descriptive text modeling approach for EV battery fault detection, converting digital signals to text representations for LLM-based diagnosis with cross-domain adaptability.

entry.title: Teaching AI Through Benchmark Construction: QuestBench as a Course-Based Practice for Accountable Knowledge Work

entry.title: You Don't Need Attention: Gated Convolutional Modeling for Watch-Based Fall Detection

author.name: Sana Alamgeer, Ronish Kumar, Awatif Yasmin, Muhammad Irshad, Anne H. H. Ngu

entry.title: FusionCell: Cross-Attentive Fusion of Layout Geometry and Netlist Topology for Standard-Cell Performance Prediction

author.name: Haoyi Zhang, Kairong Guo, Bojie Zhang, Yibo Lin, Runsheng Wang
