author.name: Xinpeng Lv, Yunxin Mao, Renzhe Xu, Chunyuan Zheng, Yikai Chen, Haoxuan Li, Yang Shi, Jinxuan Yang, Zhouchen Lin, Yuanlong Chen, Yuanxing Zhang, Shaowu Yang, Wenjing Yang, Haotian Wang

entry.summary: Introduces behaviorally realistic strategic classification where agents exhibit cognitive biases (prospect theory) rather than strict rationality. Proposes Prospect-Guided Strategic classification incorporating behavioral economics insights.

entry.title: A Methodology for Selecting and Composing Runtime Architecture Patterns for Production LLM Agents

author.name: Vasundra Srinivasan

entry.summary: Proposes a methodology for selecting and composing runtime architecture patterns for production LLM agents, introducing the 'stochastic-deterministic boundary' (SDB) as a primitive contract. Catalogs six runtime patterns across coordination, state, and control concerns.

entry.title: Riemannian Networks over Full-Rank Correlation Matrices

author.name: Ziheng Chen, Xiaojun Wu, Bernhard Sch\"olkopf, Nicu Sebe

entry.summary: Introduces Riemannian networks over correlation matrix manifolds using five recently developed geometries, extending basic neural network layers (MLR, FC, convolutional) to these spaces.

entry.title: GOAL: Graph-based Objective-Aligned Diffusion Solvers for Dynamic Multi-Objective Optimization

author.name: Xingyu Li

entry.summary: Proposes GOAL, a conditioned diffusion solver over graph representations for dynamic multi-objective optimization, using heterogeneous graph encoding for different constraint types.

entry.title: EviTrack: Selection over Sampling for Delayed Disambiguation

author.name: Omer Haq

entry.summary: Introduces EviTrack, a test-time inference framework operating over latent trajectories for sequential prediction with delayed disambiguation, using evidence-based selection to delay commitment until supported by data.

entry.title: PAVE: A Cognitive Architecture for Legitimate Violation in Generative Agent Societies

author.name: Ahmad Yehia, Abduallah Mohamed, Kun Qian, Tianyi Wang, Jiseop Byeon, Omar Hassanin, Christian Claudel

entry.summary: Proposes PAVE, a cognitive architecture for generative agents to reason about situations where rule-breaking may be legitimate (e.g., fire evacuation), with modules for perception, assessment, verdict, and emulation.

entry.title: TriForces: Augmenting Atomistic GNNs for Transferable Representations

author.name: Ali Ramlaoui, Alexandre Duval, Hannah Bull, Victor Schmidt, Hugues Talbot, Fragkiskos D. Malliaros, Joseph Musielewicz

entry.summary: Presents TriForces, a model-agnostic three-stream framework for machine learning interatomic potentials that separates composition and structure information with self-supervised learning for better transfer across chemical domains.

entry.title: Cumulative Meta-Learning from Active Learning Queries for Robustness to Spurious Correlations

author.name: Kin Whye Chew, Jingxian Wang

entry.summary: Proposes CAML, an active-learning framework that uses queried examples to meta-learn the prior/inductive bias rather than just appending them to training data, addressing spurious correlations more effectively.

entry.title: Winfree Oscillatory Neural Network

author.name: Jiawen Dai, Yue Song

entry.summary: Proposes Winfree Oscillatory Neural Network (WONN) based on generalized Winfree synchronization dynamics, evolving representations on the torus through oscillatory interactions for vision and reasoning tasks.

entry.title: Efficient Learning of Deep State Space Models via Importance Smoothing

author.name: John-Joseph Brady, Nikolas Nusken, Yunpeng Li

entry.summary: Proposes parallel variational importance smoothing for training deep state space models efficiently, bridging auto-encoding and SMC-based approaches with better hardware utilization.

entry.title: Learning First Integrals via Backward-Generated Data and Guided Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Jingfeng Zhong, Zhengxiang Liu, Zhijie Wang, Shuai Li

entry.summary: Proposes FISolver, an LLM-based solver for discovering first integrals of dynamical systems, using backward generation to create training data and guided RL for complex problems.

entry.title: IndusAgent: Reinforcing Open-Vocabulary Industrial Anomaly Detection with Agentic Tools

author.name: Rongbin Tan, Fangfang Lin, Zhenlong Yuan, Min Qiu, Kejin Cui, Mengmeng Wang, Yi Wang, Zijian Song, Zhiyuan Wang, Jiyuan Wang, Yue Wang, Shuhan Song{\S}, Huawei Cao

entry.summary: Proposes IndusAgent, a tool-augmented agentic framework for open-vocabulary industrial anomaly detection that uses structured chain-of-thought supervision and expert normalcy priors to address domain-misaligned reasoning in MLLMs.

entry.title: Resolving Long-Tail Ambiguity in Unsupervised 3D Point Cloud Segmentation with Language Priors

author.name: Siqi Wei, Hongbin Xu, Feng Xiao, Tian Lan, Chun Li, Ming Li, Qiuxia Wu

entry.summary: Proposes LangTail, a language-guided hierarchical framework for unsupervised 3D point cloud segmentation that uses language model knowledge to mitigate long-tail ambiguity where minor class features are absorbed by dominant clusters.

entry.title: AIR: Amortized Image Reconstruction Framework for Self-Supervised Feed-Forward 2D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Zhaojie Zeng, Yuesong Wang, Yawei Luo, Tao Guan

entry.summary: Presents AIR, a self-supervised feed-forward framework for 2D Gaussian splatting that amortizes iterative fitting into a single network pass using stage-wise residual architecture and Predict-Optimize-Distill training.

entry.title: VersusQ: Pairwise Margin Reasoning for Generalizable Video Quality Assessment

author.name: Shibei Meng, Binxin Yang, Yuan Liu, Jiexuan Zhang, Zhengyao Lv, Hubery Yin, Qiang Xu

entry.summary: VersusQ proposes pairwise margin reasoning for video quality assessment using Large Multimodal Models, arguing that relative comparisons alleviate absolute-scale calibration bias and improve cross-domain generalization.

entry.title: Learning Robust Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation from Joint Sensors with Proprioceptive Transformer

author.name: Senlan Yao, Chenyu Yang, Jaehoon Kim, Aristotelis Sympetheros, Robert K. Katzschmann

entry.summary: Studies how far joint sensing alone can go for dexterous in-hand manipulation, presenting a Proprioceptive Transformer that extracts environment information from joint measurements. Demonstrates competitive performance without external perception on tendon-driven hands.

entry.title: CogScale: Scalable Benchmark for Sequence Processing

author.name: Yannis Bendi-Ouis (Mnemosyne), Romain de Coudenhove (ENS-PSL), Xavier Hinaut (Mnemosyne)

entry.summary: Proposes CogScale, a benchmark of 14 scalable synthetic tasks designed to isolate cognitive and memory abilities at different parametrizable scales. Provides lightweight evaluation of sequential information processing without requiring massive datasets.

entry.title: HypergraphFormer: Learning Hypergraphs from LLMs for Editable Floor Plan Generation

author.name: Nikita Klimenko, Hesam Salehipour, Parham Eftekhar, Amir Khasahmadi, Ramon Elias Weber

entry.summary: Proposes HypergraphFormer for floor plan generation using LLM fine-tuning to generate hypergraph-based textual representations encoding spatial relationships. Outperforms existing rasterized/vectorized approaches.

entry.title: Planner-Admissible Graph-PDE Value Extensions for Sparse Goal-Conditioned Planning

author.name: Shiheng Zhang

entry.summary: Studies planner-admissible graph value extensions for sparse goal-conditioned planning, proving local action-gap certificates and showing AMLE (infinity-Laplacian) provides better guarantees than harmonic extension.

entry.title: EmbGen: Teaching with Reassembled Corpora

author.name: Arun K Lenin, Kai Rouse, Andrea Nicastro, Anna Leontjeva

entry.summary: Introduces EmbGen, a synthetic data generation pipeline that decomposes corpora into entity-description pairs, reassembles using embedding similarity, and generates QA pairs via proximity and cluster sampling.

entry.title: A Framework for Evaluating Zero-Shot Image Generation in Concept-based Explainability

author.name: Giacomo Astolfi, Matteo Bianchi, Riccardo Campi, Antonio De Santis, Marco Brambilla

entry.summary: Investigates using zero-shot text-to-image models to generate synthetic concept datasets for concept-based explainability methods, evaluating faithfulness through multiple complementary analyses.

entry.title: Modular Multimodal Classification Without Fine-Tuning: A Simple Compositional Approach

author.name: Herman Bergstr\"om, Aditya Mehrotra, Rahul G. Krishnan

entry.summary: Introduces CoMET, a simple method for multimodal classification: frozen encoders → PCA compression → concatenation → tabular foundation model. Proposes PALPooling when CLS tokens misalign with tasks.

entry.title: CIG: Exploration via Conditional Information Gain

author.name: Tim Joseph, Marcus Fechner, Philipp Stegmaier, Karam Daaboul, J. Marius Z\"ollner

entry.summary: Derives Conditional Information Gain (CIG) reward for exploration in RL that conditions on both replay buffer and rollout prefix simultaneously, using ensemble disagreement as a tractable surrogate.

entry.title: Towards Understanding Self-Pretraining for Sequence Classification

author.name: Omar Coser, Loredana Zollo, Paolo Soda, Antonio Orvieto

entry.summary: Studies why self-pretraining (masked prediction without external data) improves transformer classification, finding it helps resolve optimization bottlenecks through systematic ablation on Long-Range Arena.

entry.title: A Typed Tensor Language for Federated Learning

author.name: Theofilos Mailis, Kalliopi-Christina Despotidou, Konstantinos Filippopolitis, Yannis Foufoulas, Thanasis-Michail Karampatsis, Andreas Ktenidis, Evdokia Mailli, Theodore Papamarkou, Yannis Ioannidis

entry.summary: Introduces a typed tensor language formalizing federated learning as client-local computation with mergeable aggregation, proving shared-state factorization theorems about fixed-dimensional shared state.

entry.title: Deep Attention Reweighting: Post-Hoc Attention-Based Feature Aggregation in CNNs for Disentangling Core and Spurious Features under Spurious Correlations

author.name: Kin Whye Chew, Jingxian Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Deep Attention Reweighting (DAR) to address spurious correlations in CNNs, tracing the problem of feature entanglement to Global Average Pooling and replacing it with attention-based aggregation that can separate core from spurious features.

entry.title: SynCB: A Synergy Concept-Based Model with Dynamic Routing Between Concepts and Complementary Neural Branches

author.name: Tores Julie, Sun R\'emy, Sassatelli Lucile, Ancarani Elisa, Wu Hui-Yin, Precioso Fr\'ed\'eric

entry.summary: Introduces SynCB, a concept-based model that combines an interpretable concept branch with a complementary neural branch through dynamic routing, maintaining intervention capabilities while improving accuracy.

entry.title: optimize_anything: A Universal API for Optimizing any Text Parameter

author.name: Lakshya A Agrawal, Donghyun Lee, Shangyin Tan, Wenjie Ma, Karim Elmaaroufi, Rohit Sandadi, Sanjit A. Seshia, Koushik Sen, Dan Klein, Ion Stoica, Joseph E. Gonzalez, Omar Khattab, Alexandros G. Dimakis, Matei Zaharia

entry.summary: Continuing our coverage from yesterday, Introduces optimize_anything, a universal LLM-based optimization system that treats problems as improving text artifacts evaluated by scoring functions. Achieves remarkable results including tripling Gemini Flash's ARC-AGI accuracy, cutting cloud costs by 40%, and outperforming AlphaEvolve on circle packing.

entry.title: Position: Let's Develop Data Probes to Fundamentally Understand How Data Affects LLM Performance

author.name: Shiqiang Wang, Herbert Woisetschl\"ager, Hans Arno Jacobsen, Mingyue Ji

entry.summary: A position paper advocating for systematic 'data probes' — synthetic sequences generated from defined random processes — to understand how specific data characteristics drive LLM behavior across training, tuning, and in-context learning. The authors argue current approaches rely too heavily on expensive experimentation with large datasets without principled understanding.

entry.title: Formal Skill: Programmable Runtime Skills for Efficient and Accurate LLM Agents

author.name: Xi Zhang, Meijun Gao, Yuntian Zhao, Xinyu Tan, Yilun Yao, Feiyu Wang, Yanshu Wang, Dingsiyi, Tong Yang

entry.summary: Introduces Formal Skill, a runtime-native abstraction for LLM agents that represents reusable capabilities with JSON metadata, Python executors, hook-governed control logic, and skill-local state. Aims to bridge the gap between informal skill specifications and reliable execution.

entry.title: EMO-BOOST: Emotion-Augmented Audio-Visual Features for Improved Generalization in Deepfake Detection

author.name: Aritra Marik, Marcel Klemt, Anna Rohrbach

entry.summary: Proposes Emo-Boost, a multimodal deepfake detection framework that uses emotion as a high-level semantic cue to improve generalization to unseen manipulation types. Fuses RGB/acoustic deepfake detection with emotion-aware features.

entry.title: Improving Retrieval-Augmented Generation without Taxonomy-based Error Categorization

author.name: Gongbo Zhang, Yifan Peng, Chunhua Weng

entry.summary: Proposes RePAIR, a response-action learning paradigm for agentic RAG that improves outputs without explicit error categorization, directly mapping flawed responses to corrections. Challenges the assumption that taxonomy-based error classification is necessary.

entry.title: Symmetry in the Wild: The Role of Equivariance in Neural Fluid Surrogates

author.name: Patryk Rygiel, Julian Suk, Kak Khee Yeung, Christoph Brune, Jelmer M. Wolterink

entry.summary: Investigates when group-equivariant architectures help vs. hurt in neural fluid surrogate models, finding that equivariance can be detrimental when the problem breaks symmetry due to distributional alignment in training data.

entry.title: Lost and Found in Translation: Variational Diagnostics for Neural Codebook Channels

author.name: Yusuke Hayashi

entry.summary: Introduces a neural codebook channel diagnostic for VAEs that measures whether encoder and decoder use compatible codes, proving off-diagonal mass is bounded by an architecture-dependent quantity.

entry.title: Distributional Energy-Based Models for Uncertainty-Aware Structured LLM Reasoning

author.name: Shireen Kudukkil Manchingal, Abhey Kalia, Fernanda Gon\c{c}alves, Shebin Rawther

entry.summary: Proposes decomposed energy functions combining learned quality scorers with deterministic constraint penalties for verifying structured LLM outputs, using ensemble uncertainty to drive targeted regeneration or abstention.

entry.title: Don't Let Bandit Feedback Pull Continual LLM-Recommender Updates Off Target

author.name: Taesan Kim, Hyeongjun Yun, Jaegul Choo, Chung Park

entry.summary: Proposes ABPO framework for continual LLM recommender updates under bandit feedback, using anchored GRPO with exposure bias correction and feedback ambiguity handling for deployment-stage optimization.

entry.title: Dynamic Model Merging Made Slim

author.name: Guodong Du, Wanyu Lin

entry.summary: Proposes DiDi-Merging, a dynamic model merging framework using differentiable rank allocation to balance shared and expert parameters, with data-free refinement for rank recovery.

entry.title: Stability and Discretization Error of State Space Model Neural Operators

author.name: Abderrahim Bendahi, Adrien Fradin, Johan Peralez, Julie Digne, Madiha Nadri

entry.summary: Establishes theoretical guarantees for discretization error and stability of State Space Model (SSM) neural operators for solving PDEs, bridging the gap between continuous formulation and discrete numerical implementation.

entry.title: SynGR: Unleashing the Potential of Cross-Modal Synergy for Generative Recommendation

author.name: Wei Chen, Xingyu Guo, Shuang Li, Fuwei Zhang, Meng Yuan, Jing Fan, Zhao Zhang, Deqing Wang, Fuzhen Zhuang

entry.summary: Proposes SynGR for generative recommendation that captures synergistic cross-modal information rather than just alignment-based fusion, enabling discovery of emergent item properties not inferable from single modalities.

entry.title: CRAFT: Critic-Refined Adaptive Key-Frame Targeting for Multimodal Video Question Answering

author.name: Mahesh Bhosale, Abdul Wasi, Vishvesh Trivedi, Pengyu Yan, Akhil Gorugantu, David Doermann

entry.summary: Introduces CRAFT, a pipeline for multi-video question answering combining dynamic keyframe selection, ASR with multilingual fallback, and a hybrid critic loop for claim verification, achieving best results on MAGMaR 2026.

entry.title: Are Rationales Necessary and Sufficient? Tuning LLMs for Explainable Misinformation Detection

author.name: Bing Wang, Rui Miao, Ximing Li, Chen Shen, Shaotian Yan, Changchun Li, Kaiyuan Liu, Xiaosong Yuan, Jieping Ye

entry.summary: Proposes pipeline to fine-tune dedicated LLMs for explainable misinformation detection, investigating whether rationales are necessary and sufficient for improving detection transparency.

entry.title: Resilient Byzantine Agreement with Predictions

author.name: Julien Dallot, Darya Melnyk, Tijana Milentijevic, Stefan Schmid, Patrik Welters

entry.summary: Studies Byzantine Agreement when nodes have access to a predictor flagging potentially faulty nodes. Provides complete characterization of consistency-robustness trade-offs in both authenticated and non-authenticated settings.

entry.title: The Accessibility Capability Boundary: Operational Limits and Expansion Potential of AI-Generated Browser-Native Accessibility Systems

author.name: Rizwan Jahangir, Daisuke Ishii

entry.summary: Introduces the Accessibility Capability Boundary (ACB) framework for reasoning about operational limits of AI-generated accessibility systems. Models accessibility as a dynamic, multidimensional capability space rather than binary compliance.

entry.title: TERGAD: Structure-Aware Text-Enhanced Representations for Graph Anomaly Detection

author.name: Wen Shi, Zhe Wang, Huafei Huang, Qing Qing, Ziqi Xu, Qixin Zhang, Xikun Zhang, Renqiang Luo, Feng Xia

entry.summary: Proposes TERGAD, a framework that enriches structural semantics for graph anomaly detection using LLM reasoning capabilities, addressing the gap where existing methods neglect the structural context of nodes.

entry.title: LP-Eval: Rubric and Dataset for Measuring the Quality of Legal Proposition Generation

author.name: Shanshan Xu, Johan Lindholm, Amogh Raina, Henrik Palmer Olsen, Daniel Hershcovich

entry.summary: Introduces LP-Eval, a three-step evaluation rubric for legal proposition generation from EU court decisions. Shows LLMs can generate well-formed legal propositions while revealing quality differences based on doctrinal complexity.

entry.title: Fast and Featureless Node Representation Learning with Partial Pairwise Supervision

author.name: Sujan Chakraborty, Saptarshi Bej

entry.summary: Introduces Contrastive FUSE for scalable node representation learning in graphs with partial pairwise labels and no node features. Optimizes a spectral contrastive objective integrating community-aware signals with signed pairwise constraints.

entry.title: StruMPL: Multi-task Dense Regression under Disjoint Partial Supervision and MNAR Labels

author.name: Reza M. Asiyabi, Juan Alberto Molina-Valero, The SEOSAW Partnership, Steven Hancock, Casey M. Ryan

entry.summary: Proposes StruMPL for multi-task dense regression with disjoint partial supervision and missing-not-at-random labels, applied to forest biomass estimation from heterogeneous Earth observation data.

entry.title: GraphDiffMed: Knowledge-Constrained Differential Attention with Pharmacological Graph Priors for Medication Recommendation

author.name: Krati Saxena, Tomohiro Shibata

entry.summary: Presents GraphDiffMed, a medication recommendation framework using dual-scale Differential Attention v2 to filter noise in electronic health records while integrating pharmacological knowledge graphs for drug-drug interaction awareness.

entry.title: Graph Transductive Sharpening: Leveraging Unlabeled Predictions in Node Classification

author.name: Brown Zaz, Mar Gonz\`alez I Catal\`a, Ferran Hernandez Caralt, Moshe Eliasof, Pietro Li\`o

entry.summary: Proposes using unlabeled-node predictions during training as additional signal for semi-supervised node classification, inspired by the entropy component of cross-entropy decomposition to define prediction confidence as a natural training objective.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Safe Autonomous Driving Under Pedestrian Behavioral Uncertainty

author.name: Prakash Aryan, Kaushik Raghupathruni, Timo Kehrer, Sebastiano Panichella

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-agent RL environment for testing autonomous driving safety where pedestrians have latent personality traits governing jaywalking behavior, creating more realistic interaction scenarios than fixed pedestrian policies.

entry.title: OmniISR: A Unified Framework for Centralized and Federated Learning via Intermediate Supervision and Regularization

author.name: Wei-Bin Kou, Guangxu Zhu, Ming Tang, Chen Zhang, Lisheng Wu, Lei Zhou, Yujiu Yang

entry.summary: Proposes OmniISR, a unified framework combining centralized and federated learning with intermediate supervision and regularization, addressing the operational dichotomy between regions allowing data aggregation and those requiring data localization.

entry.title: Consistently Informative Soft-Label Temperature for Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Hoang-Chau Luong, Nghia Van Vo, Kaiqi Zhao, Lingwei Chen

entry.summary: Proposes sample-adaptive temperature scaling for knowledge distillation where teacher and student use different temperatures, ensuring consistent informativeness of soft labels across samples of varying difficulty.

entry.title: SMA-DP: Spectral Memory-Aware Differential Privacy for Deep Learning

author.name: Mohammad Partohaghighi, Roummel Marcia

entry.summary: Proposes SMA-DP-SGD, augmenting differentially private SGD with a fractional memory branch using spectral power-law exponents to adapt per-layer noise, maintaining privacy guarantees while improving utility.

entry.title: Compositional Transduction with Latent Analogies for Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Junseok Kim, Dohyeong Kim, Mineui Hong, Songhwai Oh

entry.summary: Formalizes analogy transduction for offline goal-conditioned RL, proposing a novel analogy representation that captures task-endogenous changes invariant to contextual variations for compositional generalization.

entry.title: Causal Machine Learning Is Not a Panacea: A Roadmap for Observational Causal Inference in Health

author.name: Donna Tjandra (Division of Computer Science and Engineering, University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, Michigan, United States), Trenton Chang (Division of Computer Science and Engineering, University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, Michigan, United States), Sonali Parbhoo (Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Imperial College London, London, UK), Rajesh Ranganath (Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences, New York University, New York, New York, United States, Center for Data Science, New York University, New York, New York, United States), Andre Kurepa Waschka (Department of Mathematics & Statistics, Elon University, Elon, North Carolina, United States), William Mitchell (Department of Ophthalmology, Cambridge University Hospitals, Cambridge, UK), Maggie Makar (Division of Computer Science and Engineering, University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, Michigan, United States), Shalmali Joshi (Department of Biomedical Informatics, Columbia University, New York, New York, United States), Finale Doshi-Velez (School of Engineering and Applied Science, Harvard University, Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States), Leo Anthony Celi (Laboratory for Computational Physiology, Institute for Medical Engineering and Science, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States, Department of Biostatistics, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health, Boston, Massachusetts, United States), Jenna Wiens (Division of Computer Science and Engineering, University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, Michigan, United States)

entry.summary: Provides a roadmap for applying causal ML to observational health data, emphasizing validity assumptions, responsible application, and under-appreciated limitations across disciplines.

entry.title: Finite-Time Regret Analysis of Retry-Aware Bandits

author.name: Bingkui Tong, Junpei Komiyama, Soichiro Nishimori, Paavo Parmas

entry.summary: Provides first sublinear regret bound for the ReMax bandit algorithm that maximizes expected maximum reward over multiple virtual draws, relevant to pass@k and max@k objectives.

entry.title: A Deployment Audit of Release-Side Risk in Conformal Triage under Prevalence Shift

author.name: Chengze Li, Xiao Liu, Hanrong Zhang, Haiyang Peng, Yanghao Ruan, Huanhuan Ma, Chunyu Miao, Qichao Zhou, Xiangrong Qi, Philip Yu

entry.summary: Proposes a leakage-aware deployment audit for conformal triage under prevalence shift, separating subjects into roles for calibration and release-safety evaluation to detect when event-positive patients are improperly released.

entry.title: Point Cloud Sequence Encoding for Material-conditioned Graph Network Simulators

author.name: Philipp Dahlinger, Bal\'azs Gyenes, Niklas Freymuth, Luca Geminiani, Tobias W\"urth, Johannes Mitsch, Nadja Klein, Luise K\"arger, Gerhard Neumann

entry.summary: Introduces PEACH, a framework using in-context learning on point cloud sequences to adapt learned physics simulators to unseen materials without requiring explicit material parameters.

entry.title: Efficient Banzhaf-Based Data Valuation for $k$-Nearest Neighbors Classification

author.name: Guangyi Zhang, Lutz Oettershagen, Lixu Wang, Aristides Gionis

entry.summary: Develops efficient exact algorithms for computing Banzhaf values in k-NN classifiers, proving #P-hardness but exploiting locality for practical dynamic programming solutions.

entry.title: Reviving Error Correction in Modern Deep Time-Series Forecasting

author.name: Minh Hoang Nguyen, Dai Do, Huu Hiep Nguyen, Dung Nguyen, Kien Do, Hung Le

entry.summary: Proposes a simple, architecture-agnostic error correction model for deep time-series forecasting that can be integrated with any existing forecaster without retraining, addressing error accumulation in autoregressive inference.

entry.title: FedCoE: Bridging Generalization and Personalization via Federated Coordinated Dual-level MoEs

author.name: Penglin Dai, Fulian Li, Xincao Xu, Junhua Wang, Lixin Duan, Xiao Wu

entry.summary: FedCoE proposes a dual-level mixture-of-experts framework for federated learning that balances global generalization with local personalization by maintaining multiple independent global expert models routed to heterogeneous clients.

entry.title: TimeSRL: Generalizable Time-Series Behavioral Modeling via Semantic RL-Tuned LLMs -- A Case Study in Mental Health

author.name: Yuang Fan, Lilin Xu, Millie Wu, Jingping Nie, Qingyu Chen, Yuzhe Yang, Zhuo Zhang, Xin Liu, Subigya Nepal, Xiaofan Jiang, Xuhai "Orson" Xu

entry.summary: TimeSRL uses a two-stage LLM framework with semantic bottleneck for longitudinal health prediction, first abstracting time-series into natural language then predicting outcomes. Optimized end-to-end with GRPO for cross-dataset generalization.

entry.title: Data-Efficient Neural Operator Training via Physics-Based Active Learning

author.name: Alicja Polanska, Lorenzo Zanisi, Vignesh Gopakumar, Stanislas Pamela

entry.summary: Introduces physics-based acquisition for neural operator training, using PDE residuals to guide active learning data selection. Validated on Burgers equation and compressible Navier-Stokes, matching state-of-the-art with fewer samples.

entry.title: Gaussian Sheaf Neural Networks

author.name: Andr\'e Ribeiro, Ana Luiza Ten\'orio, Tiago da Silva, Diego Mesquita

entry.summary: Gaussian Sheaf Neural Networks (GSNNs) provide principled message passing for graphs where node features are Gaussian distributions, using cellular sheaf theory to respect the geometric structure of means and covariances.

entry.title: Is Fixing Schema Graphs Necessary? Full-Resolution Graph Structure Learning for Relational Deep Learning

author.name: Yi Huang, Qingyun Sun, Jia Li, Xingcheng Fu, Jianxin Li

entry.summary: FROG proposes learnable graph structure for relational deep learning on databases, formulating structure learning as a table role modeling problem rather than relying on fixed schema-derived graphs.

entry.title: MedCRP-CL: Continual Medical Image Segmentation via Bayesian Nonparametric Semantic Modality Discovery

author.name: Ziyuan Gao

entry.summary: MedCRP-CL uses Chinese Restaurant Process for online task structure discovery in continual medical image segmentation, dynamically inferring task groupings from clinical text prompts as tasks arrive.

entry.title: SDM: A Powerful Tool for Evaluating Model Robustness

author.name: Xinlei Liu, Tao Hu, Jichao Xie, Peng Yi, Hailong Ma, Baolin Li

entry.summary: SDM proposes Sequential Difference Maximization attack that reformulates the adversarial objective as maximizing the gap between non-ground-truth probability upper bound and ground-truth probability, establishing a three-layer attack framework.

entry.title: DIVE: Embedding Compression via Self-Limiting Gradient Updates

author.name: Dongfang Zhao

entry.summary: DIVE proposes an embedding compression adapter using a self-limiting hinge-based triplet loss that produces zero gradients once margins are satisfied, preventing overfitting when labeled data is scarce for dimensionality reduction.

entry.title: GenAI-Driven Threat Detection with Microsoft Security Copilot

author.name: Scott Freitas, Amir Gharib

entry.summary: Introduces the Dynamic Threat Detection Agent (DTDA) for Microsoft Security Copilot that continuously investigates security incidents to uncover hidden threats and generate explainable detections using versioned LLM prompt contracts.

entry.title: Concentration of General Stochastic Approximation Under Heavy-Tailed Markovian Noise

author.name: Shubhada Agrawal, Siva Theja Maguluri, Martin Zubeldia

entry.summary: Establishes maximal concentration bounds for stochastic approximation iterates with Markovian noise and general step sizes, showing tail behavior ranges from sub-Gaussian to heavier depending on step size and operator properties.

entry.title: Velocityformer: Broken-Symmetry-Matched Equivariant Graph Transformers for Cosmological Velocity Reconstruction

author.name: Tilman Tr\"oster, David Mirkovic, Veronika Oehl, Arne Thomsen

entry.summary: Introduces Velocityformer, an equivariant graph transformer for reconstructing galaxy velocities from spectroscopic surveys, specifically designed to match the broken symmetry of observational data. The architecture accounts for the preferred line-of-sight direction that breaks the otherwise rotation/translation equivariant physics.

entry.title: Assessing socio-economic climate impacts from text data

author.name: Mariana Madruga de Brito, Brielen Madureira, Ta\'is Maria Nunes Carvalho, Damien Delforge, Agla\'e J\'ez\'equel, Murathan Kurfal{\i}, Ni Li, Gabriele Messori, Joakim Nivre, Barbara Pernici, Niko Speybroeck, Stefano Terzi, Wim Thiery, Bram Valkenborg, Jingxian Wang, Shorouq Zahra, Jakob Zscheischler, Jan Sodoge

entry.summary: Synthesizes practices for using NLP and LLMs to assess socio-economic impacts of climate hazards from text data, addressing methodological fragmentation in defining impacts, handling biases, and selecting modeling strategies.

entry.title: Task-Routed Mixture-of-Experts with Cognitive Appraisal for Implicit Sentiment Analysis

author.name: Yaping Chai, Haoran Xie, Joe S. Qin

entry.summary: Proposes a task-routed mixture-of-experts framework for implicit sentiment analysis incorporating cognitive appraisal theory, with auxiliary tasks for implicit sentiment detection and rationale generation to address task interference in multi-task learning.

entry.title: Single-Pass, Depth-Selective Reading for Multi-Aspect Sentiment Analysis

author.name: Yan Xia, Zhuangzhuang Pan, Amirrudin Kamsin, Chee Seng Chan

entry.summary: Proposes DABS, a single-pass inference framework for aspect-term sentiment analysis that encodes sentences once into a depth-ordered substrate, allowing each aspect to selectively query relevant tokens and abstraction levels without re-encoding.

entry.title: Reliable Automated Triage in Spanish Clinical Notes: A Hybrid Framework for Risk-Aware HIV Suspicion Identification

author.name: Rodrigo Morales-S\'anchez, Soto Montalvo, Raquel Mart\'inez

entry.summary: Proposes a risk-aware hybrid framework for HIV suspicion identification in Spanish clinical notes, combining Mondrian conformal prediction for aleatoric uncertainty with Multi-Centroid Mahalanobis Distance for epistemic uncertainty.

entry.title: Generation of Heterogeneous PET Images from Uniform Organ Activity Maps Using a Pretrained Domain-Adapted Diffusion Model

author.name: Suya Li, Kaushik Dutta, Debojyoti Pal, Jingqin Luo, Kooresh I. Shoghi

entry.summary: Develops a pretrained domain-adapted diffusion model for generating heterogeneous PET images from uniform organ activity maps, using a two-phase training strategy. Addresses the computational limitations of physics-based simulation for medical imaging training data.

entry.title: EPC-3D-Diff: Equivariant Physics Consistent Conditional 3D Latent Diffusion for CBCT to CT Synthesis

author.name: Alzahra Altalib, Chunhui Li, Haytham Al Ewaidat, Khaled Alawneh, Ahmad Qendel, Alessandro Perelli

entry.summary: Proposes EPC-3D-Diff, a conditional 3D latent diffusion framework for CBCT-to-CT synthesis that introduces a projection domain equivariance loss derived from acquisition physics, ensuring physical consistency.

entry.title: Mind Your Margin and Boundary: Are Your Distilled Datasets Truly Robust?

author.name: Muquan Li, Yingyi Ma, Yihong Huang, Hang Gou, Ke Qin, Ming Li, Yuan-Fang Li, Tao He

entry.summary: Proposes C²R for robust dataset distillation, coupling attack-aware curriculum with contrastive robustness objective to improve the accuracy-robustness trade-off by focusing on near-zero robust margins and inter-class separation.

entry.title: Let EEG Models Learn EEG

author.name: Yifan Wang, Yijia Ma, Wen Li, Chenyu You

entry.summary: JET introduces a continuous flow-based transformer for EEG generation that operates directly on the continuous evolution of neural signals, addressing spectral and temporal structure mismatches in discrete denoising approaches.

entry.title: Deformba: Vision State Space Model with Adaptive State Fusion

author.name: Hongyu Ke, Jack Morris, Yongkang Liu, Satoshi Kitai, Kentaro Oguchi, Yi Ding, Haoxin Wang

entry.summary: Deformba proposes a vision state space model with adaptive state fusion that addresses fixed scanning limitations and enables query-based interactions between information streams in SSMs.

entry.title: TempGlitch: Evaluating Vision-Language Models for Temporal Glitch Detection in Gameplay Videos

author.name: Yakun Yu, Ashley Wiens, Adri\'an Barahona-R\'ios, Benedict Wilkins, Saman Zadtootaghaj, Nabajeet Barman, Cor-Paul Bezemer

entry.summary: TempGlitch introduces a controlled benchmark for evaluating VLMs on temporal glitch detection in gameplay videos, distinguishing between spatial glitches (visible in single frames) and temporal glitches (requiring frame sequences).

entry.title: How to Build Marcus's Algebraic Mind: Algebro-Deterministic Substrate over Galois Fields

author.name: Hiroyuki Chuma, Kanji Otsuk, Yoichi Sato

entry.summary: Implements Gary Marcus's 'Algebraic Mind' concepts using hyperdimensional computing over Galois fields (GF(2)), providing operations over variables, recursive representations, and individual/kind distinctions via XOR-and-shift primitives.

entry.title: Conflict-Aware Active Perception and Control in 3D Gaussian Splatting Fields via Control Barrier Functions

author.name: Amirhossein Mollaei Khass, Athanasios Cosse, Vivek Pandey, Nader Motee

entry.summary: Develops a conflict-aware active perception framework combining 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) environment representations with Control Barrier Functions for safe navigation. Uses Average Value-at-Risk collision metrics and risk-aware Expected Information Gain for balancing exploration and safety.

entry.title: Mobile UMI: Cross-View Diffusion Policy with Decoupled Kinematics for Mobile Manipulation

author.name: Haoran Huang, Haonan Dong, Huixu Dong

entry.summary: Presents Mobile UMI, a framework for mobile manipulation imitation learning that addresses locomotion-contaminated action labels and inference latency on moving bases. Uses cross-view diffusion policy with decoupled kinematics to separate navigation from manipulation.

entry.title: Learning Structural Latent Points for Efficient Visual Representations in Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Yicheng Jiang, Jiaxu Wang, Junhao He, Zesen Gan, Junhao Li, Qiang Zhang, Jingkai Sun, Jiahang Cao, Mingyuan Sun, Xiangyu Yue, Qiming Shao

entry.summary: Proposes a pretraining framework learning hybrid 'structural latent points' that combine implicit neural features with explicit geometric structure for robotic manipulation. Uses a point-wise latent VAE within a point-cloud autoencoder to bridge implicit and explicit representations.

entry.title: Agentic Trading: When LLM Agents Meet Financial Markets

author.name: Yihan Xia, Panpan You, Taotao Wang, Fang Liu, Han Qi, Xiaoxiao Wu, Shengli Zhang

entry.summary: Surveys 77 studies on LLM-based trading agents, finding that protocol incomparability makes fair comparison nearly impossible — only 2/19 primary studies report comparable evaluation setups. Frames LLM trading agents as expert-system decision pipelines.

entry.title: Towards Multi-Model LLM Schedulers: Empirical Insights into Offloading and Preemption

author.name: Mert Yildiz, Pietro Spadaccino, Alexey Rolich, Francesca Cuomo, Andrea Baiocchi

entry.summary: Empirical study of multi-model LLM scheduling under GPU memory constraints, examining performance implications of layer offloading and preemption across different hardware platforms. Addresses challenges in serving multiple heterogeneous models on shared hardware.

entry.title: Pseudocode-Guided Structured Reasoning for Automating Reliable Inference in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Weicong Ni, Tianbao Jiang, Linlin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes PStar, a Pseudocode-guided Structured Reasoning framework for VLMs in robotic automation that adaptively selects reasoning paths to reduce hallucinations. Addresses open-ended real-world tasks requiring robust step-by-step reasoning.

entry.title: Memory-Augmented Reinforcement Learning Agent for CAD Generation

author.name: Yin Xiaolong, Liu Yu, Shen Jiahang, Lu Xingyu, Ni Jingzhe, Fan Fengxiao, Sang Fan

entry.summary: Proposes a memory-augmented reinforcement learning framework for automatic CAD model generation that addresses reasoning chain breaks and error-correction limitations in LLM-based approaches for complex models with long operation sequences.

entry.title: Streamlined Constraint Reasoning via CNN Pattern Recognition on Enumerated Solutions

author.name: Patrick Spracklen

entry.summary: Proposes using CNNs trained on enumerated solutions to discover streamliner constraints for constraint programming. Trains CNNs contrastively against perturbed non-solutions and translates learned features into constraint specifications.

entry.title: STAR: Semantic-Tuned and Tail-Adaptive Retriever for Graph-Augmented Generation

author.name: Shuai Li, Chen Huang, Duanyu Feng, Wenqiang Lei, See-Kiong Ng

entry.summary: Proposes STAR, a retriever for GraphRAG that addresses semantic shortcut bias and long-tail path bias through token-level interaction learning and path-aware adaptation. Aims to improve multi-hop question answering over knowledge graphs.

entry.title: The Insurability Frontier of AI Risk: Mapping Threats to Affirmative Coverage, Silent Exposures, and Exclusions

author.name: Alex Leung, Rex Zhang, Ervin Ling, Kentaroh Toyoda, SiewMei Loh

entry.summary: Maps the insurability frontier of AI risks by coding 55 AI threat classes against 26 insurance products, identifying four tiers from affirmatively insured to uninsurable perils. Provides a systematic framework for understanding AI risk coverage.

entry.title: RecoAtlas: From Semantic Plausibility to Set-Level Utility in LLM Recommendation Agents

author.name: Imad Aouali, Flavian Vasile, Otmane Sakhi, Alexandre Gilotte, Benjamin Heymann

entry.summary: Introduces RecoAtlas, a benchmark for evaluating LLM shopping recommendation agents with behavior-grounded metrics beyond semantic plausibility, measuring relevance, complementarity, diversity, and explanation quality.

entry.title: CounterFlow: A Two-Phase Inference-Time Sampling for Counterfactual Video Foley Generation

author.name: Gyubin Lee, Junwon Lee, Juhan Nam

entry.summary: Introduces CounterFlow for counterfactual video foley generation - producing sounds that contradict visual evidence while staying temporally synchronized. Uses a two-phase inference-time sampling scheme for flow-matching models.

entry.title: Automated Grading of Handwritten Mathematics Using Vision-Capable LLMs

author.name: Jacob Levine, Miguel Aenlle, Craig Zilles, Matthew West, Mariana Silva

entry.summary: Evaluates LLM-based automated grading of handwritten mathematics using vision-capable models with instructor-defined rubrics, testing reliability in authentic university course settings.

entry.title: Bridge: Retrieval-Augmented Spatiotemporal Modeling for Urban Delivery Demand

author.name: Yihong Tang, Tong Nie, Junlin He, Qianjun Huang, Dingyi Zhuang, Lijun Sun

entry.summary: Proposes Bridge, a retrieval-augmented spatiotemporal graph framework for urban delivery demand forecasting that handles cold-start regions by retrieving behavior patterns from similar region-time windows.

entry.title: Toward User Comprehension Supports for LLM Agent Skill Specifications

author.name: Zikai Alex Wen

entry.summary: Studies whether skill markdown specifications help users form bounded expectations about agent capabilities, finding only 2.3% of 878 cybersecurity skills exhibit cues for all four comprehension anchors.

entry.title: PromptRad: Knowledge-Enhanced Multi-Label Prompt-Tuning for Low-Resource Radiology Report Labeling

author.name: Ying-Jia Lin, Tzu-Chin Lo, Ping-Chien Li, Chi-Tung Cheng, Chien-Hung Liao, Hung-Yu Kao

entry.summary: Proposes PromptRad, a knowledge-enhanced prompt-tuning approach for radiology report labeling under low-resource settings, using UMLS synonyms in a multi-word verbalizer for masked language modeling.

entry.title: Axiomatizing Neural Networks via Pursuit of Subspaces

author.name: Mehmet Yamac, Mert Duman, Ugur Akpinar, Felix Rojas Casadiego, Serkan Kiranyaz, Marcel van Gerven, Moncef Gabbouj

entry.summary: Introduces the 'Pursuit of Subspaces' hypothesis as an axiomatic geometric framework for understanding neural network behavior. Claims to provide unified perspective on representation, computation, and generalization through geometric postulates.

entry.title: Dynamic TMoE: A Drift-Aware Dynamic Mixture of Experts Framework for Non-Stationary Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Jiawen Zhu, Shuhan Liu, Di Weng, Yingcai Wu

entry.summary: Proposes Dynamic TMoE for non-stationary time series forecasting that detects distribution shifts via MMD, dynamically instantiates/prunes heterogeneous experts, and uses temporal memory routing.

entry.title: NeighborDiv: Training-free Zero-shot Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection via Neighbor Diversity

author.name: Kaifeng Wei, Teng Liu, Liang Dong, Xiubo Liang, Yuke Li

entry.summary: Proposes NeighborDiv, a training-free graph anomaly detection framework based on neighbor diversity rather than node-to-neighbor consistency, enabling cross-domain generalization without training.

entry.title: Learning fMRI activations dictionaries across individual geometries via optimal transport

author.name: Sonia Mazelet, R\'emi Flamary, Bertrand Thirion

entry.summary: Applies optimal transport (Fused Gromov-Wasserstein distance) for dictionary learning on fMRI data, accounting for brain geometry variability across individuals without projecting onto a common template.

entry.title: Modeling Temporal scRNA-seq Data with Latent Gaussian Process and Optimal Transport

author.name: Mehmet Yigit Balik, Harri L\"ahdesm\"aki

entry.summary: Proposes a generative framework for temporal single-cell RNA sequencing that models population trends using latent heteroscedastic Gaussian processes with optimal transport alignment, capturing biological heterogeneity.

entry.title: UOTIP: Unbalanced Optimal Transport Map for Unpaired Inverse Problems

author.name: Donggyu Lee, Taekyung Lee, Jaewoong Choi

entry.summary: Proposes UOTIP, an unbalanced optimal transport map for unpaired inverse problems that relaxes marginal constraints for robustness to multi-level noise and class imbalance.

entry.title: Automatic Discovery of Disease Subgroups by Contrasting with Healthy Controls

author.name: Robin Louiset, Edouard Duchesnay, Benoit Dufumier, Antoine Grigis, Pietro Gori

entry.summary: Deep UCSL discovers disease subgroups by contrasting patients with healthy controls using deep feature extractors, identifying subgroups driven solely by pathological factors while ignoring shared variability.

entry.title: HiRes: Inspectable Precedent Memory for Reaction Condition Recommendation

author.name: Shreyas Vinaya Sathyanarayana, Raja Sekhar Pappala, Deepak Warrier

entry.summary: HiRes is a retrieval-augmented reaction condition recommendation system that provides both accurate predictions and inspectable precedent memories for chemical synthesis, achieving state-of-the-art performance on USPTO-Condition dataset.

entry.title: Adaptive Signal Resuscitation: Channel-wise Post-Pruning Repair for Sparse Vision Networks

author.name: Qishi Zhan, Ziheng Chen, Minxuan Hu

entry.summary: Adaptive Signal Resuscitation (ASR) is a training-free channel-wise repair method for post-pruning that matches repair granularity to damage granularity, addressing the failure of layer-wise methods at high sparsity levels.

entry.title: Approximation Theory for Neural Networks: Old and New

author.name: Soumendu Sundar Mukherjee, Himasish Talukdar

entry.summary: A comprehensive survey of approximation theory for neural networks, covering universal approximation theorems, quantitative bounds on approximation rates, parameter efficiency, and the roles of depth and width.

entry.title: JUDO: A Juxtaposed Domain-Oriented Multimodal Reasoner for Industrial Anomaly QA

author.name: Hyunju Kang, Woohyun Lee, Jaewon Kim, Hogun Park

entry.summary: JUDO incorporates domain knowledge into anomaly detection by juxtaposing query images with normal images for visual comparative inspection, combining visual and textual reasoning for industrial QA.

entry.title: Group-Aware Matrix Estimation and Latent Subspace Recovery

author.name: Hamza Golubovic, Matthew Shen, Genevera I. Allen, Tarek M. Zikry

entry.summary: GAME introduces a convex estimator for matrix estimation that handles overlapping subgroup-wise low-rank structure, using nuclear-norm penalties to allow related groups to share information while preserving subgroup-specific variation.

entry.title: Motion-Robust Deep Reconstruction for Free-Breathing Cardiac Cine MRI

author.name: Mahmut Yurt, Kanghyun Ryu, Zhitao Li, Xucheng Zhu, Xianglun Mao, Martin Janich, Marcus Alley, Kawin Setsompop, John Pauly, Shreyas Vasanawala, Ali Syed

entry.summary: Cine-DL proposes a framework for free-breathing cardiac MRI reconstruction combining k-space preprocessing with model-based deep learning, enabling robust cardiac imaging without breath-holds for pediatric patients.

entry.title: Stage-Audit: Auditable Source-Frontier Discovery for Cross-Wiki Tables

author.name: Chen Shen

entry.summary: Addresses the problem of LLM-curated tables appearing source-grounded while containing unsupported rows. Proposes Stage-Audit with disjoint curator-auditor roles and row-level source-citation gating, improving source-frontier precision from 0.356 to 0.505.

entry.title: Building Arabic NLP from the Ground Up: Twenty Years of Lessons, Failures, and Open Problems

author.name: Wajdi Zaghouani

entry.summary: Reflects on 20 years of building Arabic NLP infrastructure, offering three counterintuitive lessons: dataset building is social not just technical, communities matter more than shared tasks, and moving from resources to social science requires rethinking assumptions.

entry.title: ACL-Verbatim: hallucination-free question answering for research

author.name: G\'abor Recski, Szilveszter T\'oth, Nadia Verdha, Istv\'an Boros, \'Ad\'am Kov\'acs

entry.summary: Applies extractive QA system VerbatimRAG to ACL Anthology papers, mapping user queries to verbatim text spans to eliminate hallucination. Contributes a ground truth dataset for query-to-span mapping in research papers.

entry.title: Quantifying the cross-linguistic effects of syncretism on agreement attraction

author.name: Utku Turk, Eva Neu

entry.summary: Uses LLM-derived surprisal and attention entropy to investigate cross-linguistic variation in how syncretism (morphological ambiguity) affects agreement attraction errors across English, German, Turkish, and Russian.

entry.title: AI-Assisted Competency Assessment from Egocentric Video in Simulation-Based Nursing Education

author.name: Hanchen David Wang, Yilin Liu, Madison J. Lee, Surya Chand Rayala, Gautam Biswas, Daniel T. Levin, Meiyi Ma

entry.summary: Investigates using egocentric video and vision-language models for automated competency assessment in nursing simulation, extracting action timelines and relating sequence features to instructor-rated competency across 22 sessions.

entry.title: Understanding Model Behavior in Monocular Polyp Sizing

author.name: Xinqi Xiong, Andrea Dunn Beltran, Junmyeong Choi, Sarah K. McGill, Marc Niethammer, Roni Sengupta

entry.summary: Presents a diagnostic audit of binary polyp size classification in monocular colonoscopy, finding models rely on examination behavior cues rather than true metric scales, and quantifying potential improvement from perfect scale information.

entry.title: Seeing Through Fog: Towards Fog-Invariant Action Recognition

author.name: Enqi Liu, Liyuan Pan, Zhi Gao, Lingzhi Li, Qing Li

entry.summary: Presents FogAct, the first benchmark dataset for foggy action recognition with paired clean/foggy videos from a stereo camera system spanning 10 scenes and 55 action categories, plus a fog-invariant recognition method.

entry.title: Early High-Frequency Injection for Geometry-Sensitive OOD Detection

author.name: Chuanjie Cheng, Ningkang Peng, Chenxi Liu, Yifan He, Peirong Ma, Yanhui Gu

entry.summary: Proposes EIHF (Early Injection of High Frequency), an input-side intervention for OOD detection that exposes high-frequency evidence before the first convolution, motivated by band-wise analysis showing higher frequencies provide stronger ID/OOD separability.

entry.title: Diffuse to Detect: Bi-Level Sample Rebalancing with Pseudo-Label Diffusion for Point-Supervised Infrared Small-Target Detection

author.name: Zhu Liu, Yuanhang Yao, Ping Qian, Zihang Chen, Risheng Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for point-supervised infrared small target detection using physics-induced annotation (heat diffusion) to expand point labels into pseudo-masks, with bi-level optimization for sample rebalancing.

entry.title: USV: Towards Understanding the User-generated Short-form Videos

author.name: Haoyue Cheng, Su Xu, Liwei Jin, Wayne Wu, Chen Qian, Limin Wang

entry.summary: Presents USV, a 224K video dataset of user-generated short-form videos for high-level semantic understanding with tasks for topic recognition and video virality prediction.

entry.title: Map-Mono-Ego: Map-Grounded Global Human Pose Estimation from Monocular Egocentric Video

author.name: Hiroyuki Deguchi, Ryosuke Hori, Kotaro Amaya, Tsubasa Maruyama, Mitsunori Tada, Hideo Saito

entry.summary: Proposes MapMonoEgo for globally consistent human pose estimation from monocular egocentric video by leveraging pre-scanned 3D point clouds, addressing drift and scale ambiguity in long-term tracking.

entry.title: PGC: Peak-Guided Calibration for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection

author.name: Xiaoyu Zhou, Jianwei Fei, Peipeng Yu, Jingchang Xie, Chong Cheng, Zhihua Xia

entry.summary: PGC proposes a peak-guided calibration framework for detecting AI-generated images by aggregating salient features via a peak-focusing mechanism that accentuates discriminative local clues to calibrate global decisions.

entry.title: ProCrit: Self-Elicited Multi-Perspective Reasoning with Critic-Guided Revision for Multimodal Sarcasm Detection

author.name: Yingjia Xu, Jiulong Wu, Bowen Zhang, Baokui Guo, Siyuan Chai, Min Cao

entry.summary: ProCrit proposes a Proposal-Critic two-agent framework for multimodal sarcasm detection that self-elicits analytical perspectives per sample and progressively integrates them, rather than relying on fixed predefined perspectives.

entry.title: Convergence Analysis of Evolution Strategies for Mixed-Integer Optimization

author.name: Ryoki Hamano, Kento Uchida, Shinichi Shirakawa

entry.summary: Provides convergence analysis of evolution strategies for mixed-integer optimization, analyzing two variants: one with lower-bounded standard deviation and one with conditional resampling, explaining why lower bounds slow continuous variable convergence.

entry.title: VBT-MPC: Vision-Based Tactile MPC for Contour Following

author.name: Edison Velasco-Sanchez, Luis F. Recalde, Guanrui Li, Pablo Gil

entry.summary: VBT-MPC proposes a Model Predictive Control framework for robotic contour following using a vision-based tactile sensor, operating directly in contour features space without separate pose-estimation modules.

entry.title: CMC-Opt: Constraint Manifold with Corners for Inequality-Constrained Optimization

author.name: Yetong Zhang, Frank Dellaert

entry.summary: Introduces 'constraint manifolds with corners' for handling mixed equality and inequality constraints in robotics optimization, transforming constrained problems into unconstrained optimization on the constraint manifold. Demonstrates success on large-scale kinodynamic planning problems.

entry.title: STEAM: A Training-Free Congestion-Aware Enhancement Framework for Decentralized Multi-Agent Path Finding

author.name: Mingyang Feng, Mengnuo Zhang, Shaoyuan Li, Xiang Yin

entry.summary: Proposes STEAM, a training-free enhancement framework for decentralized multi-agent path finding that injects congestion-aware guidance into pretrained policies. Identifies future congestion hotspots and applies spatial/temporal mitigation without retraining or centralized planning.

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning for Risk Adaptation via Differentiable CVaR Barrier Functions

author.name: Xinyi Wang, Taekyung Kim, Bardh Hoxha, Georgios Fainekos, Dimitra Panagou

entry.summary: Proposes an end-to-end risk adaptation framework combining reinforcement learning with differentiable CVaR barrier functions for crowd navigation. Jointly learns nominal control, risk level, and safety margin while enforcing probabilistic safety constraints.

entry.title: $L^2$ over Wasserstein: Statistical Analysis for Optimal Transport

author.name: Riccardo Passeggeri, Rohan M. Shenoy, Pengcheng Ye

entry.summary: Constructs an L² over Wasserstein space framework for statistical analysis of random probability measures, lifting classical optimal transport theory to account for statistical uncertainty. Establishes distances, geodesic geometry, and random flows.

entry.title: Base Models Look Human To AI Detectors

author.name: Yixuan Even Xu, Ziqian Zhong, Aditi Raghunathan, Fei Fang, J. Zico Kolter

entry.summary: Continuing our coverage from yesterday, Discovers that text generated by base (non-instruction-tuned) language models is classified as human-written by commercial AI detectors like GPTZero, while instruction-tuned model outputs are flagged. Proposes HIP, a detector-agnostic evasion pipeline using base model paraphrasing.

entry.title: Toto 2.0: Time Series Forecasting Enters the Scaling Era

author.name: Emaad Khwaja, Chris Lettieri, Gerald Woo, Eden Belouadah, Marc Cenac, Guillaume Jarry, Enguerrand Paquin, Xunyi Zhao, Viktoriya Zhukov, Othmane Abou-Amal, Chenghao Liu, Ameet Talwalkar, David Asker

entry.summary: Continuing our coverage from yesterday, Presents Toto 2.0, a family of five open-weights time series foundation models (4M to 2.5B parameters) demonstrating that scaling laws apply to time series forecasting. Sets new SOTA on three benchmarks (BOOM, GIFT-Eval, TIME) with Apache 2.0 licensed weights.

entry.title: AgentNLQ: A General-Purpose Agent for Natural Language to SQL

author.name: Olena Bogdanov, Yeunji Jung, Chandra Dhir, Pareekshitreddy Gaddam, Saurabh Jain, Lakshmi Tumati, Vijay Parthasarathy, Anup Shirgaonkar

entry.summary: Presents a multi-agent NL2SQL method achieving 78.1% semantic accuracy on the BIRD benchmark. Uses semantically enriched schema representations and user-provided business rules to improve SQL generation accuracy.

entry.title: EngiAI: A Multi-Agent Framework and Benchmark Suite for LLM-Driven Engineering Design

author.name: Gioele Molinari, Florian Felten, Soheyl Massoudi, Mark Fuge

entry.summary: Introduces EngiAI, a multi-agent framework and benchmark suite for LLM-driven engineering design with three evaluation dimensions: workflow benchmark, RAG benchmark, and HPC benchmark for ML training orchestration.

entry.title: Using Aristotle API for AI-Assisted Theorem Proving in Lean 4: A Formalisation Case Study of the Grasshopper Problem

author.name: Gabriel Rongyang Lau

entry.summary: Reports a Lean 4 formalization case study using Aristotle API for AI-assisted theorem proving on IMO 2009 Problem 6 (Grasshopper problem). The proof attempt produces verified helper lemmas but leaves the main theorem with one unresolved sorry.

entry.title: ClusterRAG: Cluster-Based Collaborative Filtering for Personalized Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Gibson Nkhata, Uttamasha Anjally Oyshi, Quan Mai, Susan Gauch

entry.summary: Proposes ClusterRAG, which uses density-based user clustering to enhance personalized RAG by leveraging collaborative signals from similar users, performing retrieval at both cluster and document levels.

entry.title: VCR: Learning Valid Contextual Representation for Incomplete Wearable Signals

author.name: Yuxuan Weng, Wenhan Luo, Qijia Shao

entry.summary: Proposes VCR, a self-supervised framework for learning robust representations from wearable signals with modality missingness, using orthogonal tokenization to avoid hallucinating missing modality details.

entry.title: MO-CAPO: Multi-Objective Cost-Aware Prompt Optimization

author.name: Jan B\"ussing, Moritz Schlager, Timo Hei{\ss}, Tom Zehle, Matthias Feurer

entry.summary: Introduces MO-CAPO, a multi-objective prompt optimization algorithm that jointly optimizes performance and inference cost using budget allocation for cost-efficient optimization.

entry.title: KG-ASG: Collision-Knowledge-Guided Closed-Loop Adversarial Scenario Generation With Primary-Support Attribution

author.name: Cheng Wang, Chen Xiong, Ziwen Wang, Yuchen Zhou, Qiang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes KG-ASG for autonomous driving safety testing, using a collision knowledge graph to guide adversarial scenario generation with clear collision semantics and primary-support attribution for multi-vehicle interactions.

entry.title: Cross-Subject Intracranial EEG Reconstruction from Scalp Recordings Using Multi-Scale Cross-Attention Transformers

author.name: Tien-Dat Pham, Xuan-The Tran

entry.summary: Proposes CAST for cross-subject intracranial EEG reconstruction from scalp recordings, addressing the circular dependency problem where surgery is needed for training data. Uses cross-attention spatial-temporal transformers.

entry.title: SCAFDS: Edge-Feature Graph Attention for Interbank Fraud Detection with Attribution-Grounded SAR Generation

author.name: Mohammad Nasir Uddin

entry.summary: Presents SCAFDS, a seven-stage fraud detection system that models fraud propagation across interbank networks using graph attention with edge features, and generates SAR narratives with forensic traceability.

entry.title: Toward an AI-Powered Computational Testbed for Workforce Policy

author.name: Sumer S. Vaid, Ashley V. Whillans

entry.summary: Proposes using LLM-powered generative agents seeded with HR records and psychometric data to simulate employee behavioral trajectories, creating a computational testbed for workforce policy evaluation.

entry.title: Neural Operators for Design-Space Surrogate Modeling of Tendon-Actuated Continuum Robots

author.name: Branden Frieden, James M. Ferguson, Alan Kuntz, Varun Shankar

entry.summary: Formulates surrogate modeling for tendon-driven continuum robots as operator learning, enabling a single model to generalize across robot designs by mapping design parameters and actuation inputs to configurations.

entry.title: Knowing When Not to Predict: Self Supervised Learning and Abstention for Safer DR Screening

author.name: Muskaan Chopra, Lorenz Sparrenberg, Jan H. Terheyden, Rafet Sifa

entry.summary: Examines how SSL pretraining length affects calibrated confidence and confidence-based abstention for diabetic retinopathy screening, showing SSL improves selective prediction for safety-critical deployment.

entry.title: Component-Aware Structure-Preserving Style Transfer for Satellite Visual Sim2Real Data Construction

author.name: Zongwu Xie, Yonglong Zhang, Yifan Yang, Yang Liu, Baoshi Cao

entry.summary: Presents a component-aware style transfer framework for constructing realistic satellite imagery from synthetic renders, preserving structural annotations while bridging the sim-to-real appearance gap.

entry.title: Synergistic Foundation Models for Semi-Supervised Fetal Cardiac Ultrasound Analysis: SAM-Med2D Boundary Refinement and DINOv3 Semantic Enhancement

author.name: Tonghao Zhuang (Zhuhai College of Science and Technology, Zhuhai, China), Shanglong Hu (Zhuhai College of Science and Technology, Zhuhai, China), Yongsheng Luo (Zhuhai College of Science and Technology, Zhuhai, China), Zhiqi Zhang (Zhuhai College of Science and Technology, Zhuhai, China), Yu Li (Zhuhai College of Science and Technology, Zhuhai, China)

entry.summary: Presents a semi-supervised framework for fetal cardiac ultrasound analysis combining SAM-Med2D for boundary refinement and DINOv3 for pseudo-label enhancement, with view-specific masking and two-stage optimization.

entry.title: Chunking German Legal Code

author.name: Max Prior, Natalia Milanova, Andreas Schultz

entry.summary: Investigates chunking strategies for RAG on German statutory law, comparing structural, semantic, and hierarchical approaches. Finds that chunking aligned with legal structure (sections/subsections) achieves best retrieval results.

entry.title: Deep Tech to Space: Space Data Centers and AI Revolution at the Edge

author.name: Jonas Weiss, Patricia Sagmeister, Gabriel Maiolini Capez, Dinesh Verma, Roberto Garello, Alberto Perotti, Dawid Lazaj, Alicja Musial, Jakub Nalepa, Thomas Morf, Martin Schmatz, Marek Krawczyk, Mateusz Przeliorz, Kevin Roche, Sagar Tayal, Mahalakshmi Lakshminarayanan, Nicolas Long\'ep\'e, Pierre-Philippe Mathieu, Agata Wijata

entry.summary: Discusses Space Data Centers (SDCs) as AI-based service platforms for processing satellite data in orbit, addressing challenges of space-to-Earth link congestion and latency in the growing satellite constellation era.

entry.title: When Critics Disagree: Adaptive Reward Poisoning Attacks in RIS-Aided Wireless Control System

author.name: Deemah H. Tashman, Soumaya Cherkaoui

entry.summary: Proposes a disagreement-guided reward poisoning attack on Soft Actor-Critic agents in RIS-aided wireless networks, exploiting high-uncertainty states where dual critics disagree.

entry.title: Towards LLM-Assisted Architecture Recovery for Real-World ROS~2 Systems: An Agent-Based Multi-Level Approach to Hierarchical Structural Architecture Reconstruction

author.name: Dominique Briechle, Raj Chanchad, Tobias Geger, Ruidi He, Dhruv Jajadiya, Dhruv Kapadiya, Andreas Rausch, Meng Zhang

entry.summary: Extends LLM-assisted architecture recovery for ROS 2 robotic systems to multi-level hierarchical structural decomposition, going beyond node-level entity extraction.

entry.title: Instance Discrimination for Link Prediction

author.name: Valentin Cuzin-Rambaud (SyCoSMA, DM2L, LIRIS, UCBL), Mathieu Lefort (LIRIS, SyCoSMA, IRISA, MALT, UR), R\'emy Cazabet (DM2L, LIRIS, UCBL, IXXI)

entry.summary: Adapts instance discrimination methods from self-supervised learning to link prediction on graphs, proposing a new structural augmentation based on community structure that improves performance.

entry.title: FusionCell: Cross-Attentive Fusion of Layout Geometry and Netlist Topology for Standard-Cell Performance Prediction

author.name: Haoyi Zhang, Kairong Guo, Bojie Zhang, Yibo Lin, Runsheng Wang

entry.summary: Introduces FusionCell, a dual-modality predictor for standard-cell circuit performance that fuses routed layout geometry (via DeiT encoder) with netlist topology (via graph transformer) using cross-attention.

entry.title: AirfoilGen: A valid-by-construction and performance-aware latent diffusion model for airfoil generation

author.name: Zhijie Yang, Min Tang, Qiang Zou

entry.summary: Proposes AirfoilGen, a latent diffusion model for airfoil design that guarantees geometric validity through a novel circle sweeping representation and conditions on aerodynamic performance.

entry.title: Nonlocal operator learning for fMRI encoding and decoding tasks

author.name: Andreas Kramer, Saugat Acharya, Alice Giola, Emanuele Zappala

entry.summary: Investigates neural integral-operator-based models for fMRI encoding and decoding, emphasizing the role of nonlocal spatiotemporal context in capturing brain activity patterns.

entry.title: Can Conversational XAI Improve User Performance? An Experimental Study

author.name: Sven Kruschel, Julian Rosenberger, Lasse Bohlen, Mathias Kraus, Patrick Zschech

entry.summary: Proposes an experimental design for evaluating conversational XAI assistants on objective performance measures, creating conditions where users can outperform models by identifying systematic errors.

entry.title: SURF: Steering the Scalarization Weight to Uniformly Traverse the Pareto Front

author.name: Liuyuan Jiang, Chentong Huang, Lisha Chen

entry.summary: Proposes SURF for uniformly traversing the Pareto front in multi-objective optimization by inverting the arc-length CDF of the scalarization path to select weights that produce uniform coverage.

entry.title: The General Theory of Localization Methods

author.name: Congwei Song

entry.summary: Proposes a general 'localization method' framework built on localization kernels and local means, connecting self-attention, kernel methods, lazy learning, MeanShift, Hopfield networks, and other ML methods.

entry.title: ShapeBench: A Scalable Benchmark and Diagnostic Suite for Standardized Evaluation in Aerodynamic Shape Optimization

author.name: Shaghayegh Fazliani, Krissh Chawla, Jack Guo, Yiren Shen, Matthias Ihme, Madeleine Udell

entry.summary: Introduces ShapeBench, an open-source aerodynamic shape optimization benchmark with 103 tasks, unified API, validated surrogates, and CFD verification pipelines across eight shape categories.

entry.title: Sutra: Tensor-Op RNNs as a Compilation Target for Vector Symbolic Architectures

author.name: Emma Leonhart

entry.summary: Introduces Sutra, a typed functional programming language that compiles to PyTorch neural networks, with vector symbolic architecture operations lowered to tensor operations over frozen embeddings.

entry.title: Choose Wisely and Privately: Proactive Client Selection for Fair and Efficient Federated Learning

author.name: Adda Akram Bendoukha, Heber Hwang Arcolezi, Nesrine Kaaniche, Aymen Boudguiga

entry.summary: Proposes proactive client selection for federated learning that finds optimal federations matching utility distributions before training, rather than reactively filtering gradient updates.

entry.title: Divide et Calibra: Multiclass Local Calibration via Vector Quantization

author.name: Cesare Barbera, Lorenzo Perini, Giovanni De Toni, Andrea Passerini, Andrea Pugnana

entry.summary: Proposes vector quantization-based multiclass calibration that constructs region-specific calibration maps from shared codeword-dependent Dirichlet concentration factors, balancing local and global calibration.

entry.title: A Unified Framework for Uncertainty-Aware Explainable Artificial Intelligence: A Case Study in Power Quality Disturbance Classification

author.name: Yinsong Chen, Samson S. Yu, Zhong Li, Chee Peng Lim

entry.summary: Formalizes the explanation distribution as push-forward of BNN posterior through attribution operators and proposes uncertainty-aware relevance attribution operators (UA-RAO) with theoretical Monte Carlo accessibility guarantees.

entry.title: Divide and Contrast: Learning Robust Temporal Features without Augmentation

author.name: Abdul-Kazeem Shamba, Kerstin Bach, Gavin Taylor

entry.summary: Di-COT is an unsupervised self-supervised learning framework for time-series that avoids data augmentation by contrasting informative substructures within windows, using stochastic partitioning into overlapping sub-blocks to enable efficient contrast.

entry.title: Optimized Federated Knowledge Distillation with Distributed Neural Architecture Search

author.name: Chaimaa Medjadji, Sylvain Kubler, Yves Le Traon, Guilain Leduc, Sadi Alawadi, Feras M. Awaysheh

entry.summary: FedKDNAS combines federated knowledge distillation with distributed neural architecture search, allowing heterogeneous client architectures to be adapted to varying data complexity and hardware constraints.

entry.title: Efficient Table QA via TableGrid Navigation and Progressive Inference Prompting

author.name: Amritansh Maurya, Navjot Singh, Mohammed Javed, Omar Moured

entry.summary: Proposes TableGrid Navigation and Progressive Inference Prompting for training-free Table QA that iteratively navigates rows/columns to locate evidence and enforces structured reasoning steps.

entry.title: WildRoadBench: A Wild Aerial Road-Damage Grounding Benchmark for Vision-Language Models and Autonomous Agents

author.name: Bingnan Liu, Chenhang Cui, Rui Huang, Jiani Luo, Zhirong Shen, Tinghao Wang, Xiande Huang, Lingbei Meng, Fei Shen, An Zhang

entry.summary: WildRoadBench introduces a wild aerial road-damage grounding benchmark evaluating both VLMs for direct localization and LLM-driven agents for autonomous research-and-engineering on UAV imagery.

entry.title: Corrected Integrated Laplace Approximation for Bayesian Inference in Latent Gaussian Models

author.name: Jinlin Lai, Charles C. Margossian, Daniel R. Sheldon

entry.summary: Proposes corrected Integrated Laplace Approximation using importance sampling to fix errors introduced by ILA in latent Gaussian models, improving posterior accuracy for Bayesian hierarchical models.

entry.title: Mahjax: A GPU-Accelerated Mahjong Simulator for Reinforcement Learning in JAX

author.name: Soichiro Nishimori, Shinri Okano, Keigo Habara, Sotetsu Koyamada, Eason Yu, Masashi Sugiyama

entry.summary: Mahjax introduces a fully vectorized Riichi Mahjong environment in JAX for GPU-accelerated reinforcement learning, enabling large-scale parallel rollouts for tabula rasa learning in this complex imperfect-information game.

entry.title: Scale-Calibrated Median-of-Means for Robust Distributed Principal Component Analysis

author.name: Kisung You

entry.summary: Proposes a scale-calibrated median-of-means estimator for distributed PCA that properly handles the different scales of mean estimation and subspace estimation on the product geometry of Euclidean and Grassmann manifolds.

entry.title: AiraXiv: An AI-Driven Open-Access Platform for Human and AI Scientists

author.name: Junshu Pan, Panzhong Lu, Yixuan Weng, Qiyao Sun, Fang Guo, Zijie Yang, Qiji Zhou, Yue Zhang

entry.summary: AiraXiv proposes an AI-driven open-access publishing platform where both human and AI scientists participate as authors/readers, with AI-augmented analysis, review, and continuous feedback-driven iteration.

entry.title: When Irregularity Helps: A Subclass Analysis of Inductive Bias in Neural Morphology

author.name: Wen Zhang

entry.summary: Shows that a tiny structurally-specific irregular verb subtype (<1% of data) in Japanese accounts for disproportionate model errors in morphological generation. Removing this subtype yields larger improvements than removing all irregular verbs.

entry.title: Divide-Prompt-Refine: a Training-Free, Structure-Aware Framework for Biomedical Abstract Generation

author.name: Sylvey Lin, Joe Menke, Shufan Ming, Dongin Nam, Neil Smalheiser, Halil Kilicoglu

entry.summary: Proposes DPR-BAG, a training-free framework for generating biomedical abstracts for articles that lack them, decomposing full texts into rhetorical facets and performing parallel LLM-based summarization with iterative refinement.

entry.title: Text Analytics Evaluation Framework: A Case Study on LLMs and Social Media

author.name: Yuefeng Shi, Nedjma Ousidhoum, Jose Camacho-Collados

entry.summary: Introduces an evaluation framework for LLMs processing long sequences of social media posts, with 470 manually curated questions testing semantic understanding and reasoning over aggregated text data across various NLP tasks.

entry.title: Hiding in Plain Sight: Finding MAHA on Reddit

author.name: Sabit Ahmed, Subigya Nepal, Henry Kautz

entry.summary: Introduces a Reddit dataset spanning 6 years (2020-2025) with 19.4M posts from 4M users for studying the Make America Healthy Again movement, using LLM-assisted classification across health-related themes.

entry.title: HAPS: Rethinking Image Similarity for Virtual Staining

author.name: Fedor Gubanov, Svetlana Illarionova, Vlad Kozlovskiy, Mikhail Romanov, Yersultan Akhmetov, Aida Akaeva, Vyacheslav Grinevich, Rifat Hamoudi, Maxim Sharaev

entry.summary: Proposes HAPS, a domain-specific image similarity metric for virtual staining in histopathology that addresses the misalignment between generic metrics (SSIM, PSNR, LPIPS) and histological evaluation needs including tissue morphology and biomarker patterns.

entry.title: Findings of the Counter Turing Test: AI-Generated Image Detection

author.name: Rajarshi Roy, Nasrin Imanpour, Ashhar Aziz, Shashwat Bajpai, Gurpreet Singh, Shwetangshu Biswas, Kapil Wanaskar, Parth Patwa, Subhankar Ghosh, Shreyas Dixit, Nilesh Ranjan Pal, Vipula Rawte, Ritvik Garimella, Amitava Das, Amit Sheth, Vasu Sharma, Aishwarya Naresh Reganti, Vinija Jain, Aman Chadha

entry.summary: Presents findings from the Counter Turing Test competition for AI-generated image detection, covering binary classification and model attribution tasks with analysis of winning approaches across multiple generative models.

entry.title: Decomposing Subject-Driven Image Generation via Intermediate Structural Prediction

author.name: Hanzhong Guo, Yizhou Yu

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage framework for subject-driven image generation that decouples structure from appearance by first predicting Canny maps then rendering conditioned on both, with a 100k-pair text-aware dataset for text handling.

entry.title: OSGNet with MLLM Reranking @ Ego4D Episodic Memory Challenge 2026

author.name: Yisen Feng, Leigang Qu, Haoyu Zhang, Qiaohui Chu, Meng Liu, Xuemeng Song, Weili Guan, Liqiang Nie

entry.summary: Champion solution for Ego4D Episodic Memory Challenge at CVPR 2026 using MLLM reranking of OSGNet candidates for temporal segment localization in egocentric video.

entry.title: LiteViLNet: Lightweight Vision-LiDAR Fusion Network for Efficient Road Segmentation

author.name: Daojie Peng, Bingtao Wang, Fulong Ma, Liang Zhang, Jun Ma

entry.summary: LiteViLNet proposes a lightweight multi-modal network fusing RGB and LiDAR for road segmentation, designed for deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. Uses dual-stream lightweight encoder with depth-wise separable convolutions.

entry.title: STiTch: Semantic Transition and Transportation in Collaboration for Training-Free Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval

author.name: Miaoge Li, Dongsheng Wang, Zening Sun, Jinsen Zhang, Wenhan Luo, Jingcai Guo

entry.summary: STiTch addresses training-free zero-shot composed image retrieval by handling semantic gaps between reference images and text modifications through semantic transition and transportation mechanisms.

entry.title: RoadTones: Tone Controllable Text Generation from Road Event Videos

author.name: Chirag Parikh, Siddhi Pravin Lipare, Ravi Kiran Sarvadevabhatla

entry.summary: RoadTones introduces tone-controllable video captioning for road events, with a dataset (RoadTones-51K) and model that generates captions with controlled urgency, style, and tone using chain-of-thought reasoning.

entry.title: E-ReCON: An Energy- and Resource-Efficient Precision-Configurable Sparse nvCIM Macro for Conventional and Spiking Neural Edge Inference

author.name: Ankit Kumar Tenwar, Mukul Lokhande, Santosh Kumar Vishvakarma

entry.summary: E-ReCON presents a 16Kb energy-efficient digital compute-in-memory macro based on 3T1R ReRAM bitcell achieving up to 419 TOPS/W efficiency for both CNN and SNN workloads on edge devices.

entry.title: Anomaly-Informed Confidence Calibration for Vision-Based Safety Prediction

author.name: Zhenjiang Mao, Jiawen Wu, Gabriel Wagner, Zhongzheng Zhang, Ivan Ruchkin

entry.summary: Proposes anomaly-informed online calibration for vision-based safety prediction in autonomous racing that fuses perceptual and dynamics anomaly signals from a world model. Identifies a 'perception-dynamics gap' where visual anomaly detection misses dynamics failures.

entry.title: Safety-Critical Control for Smoothed Implicit Contact Dynamics

author.name: Haegu Lee, Yitaek Kim, Christoffer Sloth

entry.summary: Provides formal methods for safety-critical control with smoothed implicit contact dynamics, bounding actual contact forces despite relaxed complementarity constraints. Shows that constraint violations can be non-monotonic in the smoothing parameter.

entry.title: If AI is normal technology, history is not reassuring.

author.name: Davidmanheim

entry.summary: Argues that major technological revolutions (agriculture, industrial revolution) historically harmed the majority of people during the transition period, even if long-term outcomes were positive. Applies this lens to AI development to challenge the assumption that AI progress will be smoothly beneficial.

entry.title: KAN-MLP-Mixer: A comprehensive investigation of the usage of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) for improving IMU-based Human Activity Recognition
